### [1] [Action Jets: Learning the Local Shape of the Action-conditioned Data Manifold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19007)
*Anton Arapin,Chahyon Ku,Bernadette Bucher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Action Jet，通过在局部用三阶 Taylor 多项式近似动作条件世界模型的低维流形，使规划器只需对每个状态推理一次即可评估大量候选动作，速度提升 300 倍以上且更准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型维度高、计算昂贵，限制了规划器可评估的候选动作数量，而短时域规划实际上只需当前状态附近的局部信息。

Method: 观察到固定状态下变化低维动作（相机移动或末端执行器命令）所达帧位于低维流形上；用网络估计图像各区域沿每个动作轴的单位位移，校正头用轨迹数据拟合该流形的三阶 Taylor 多项式（Action Jet），并闭式计算其有效半径；遍历该局部近似，每状态只推理一次。

Result: 单次提取评估 16 个候选比源生成器快 300 倍以上，且随候选数增加差距扩大；在 BridgeData V2（对比 IRASim、WorldGym）和 DL3DV（FrameCrafter 对比 DepthSplat、LagerNVS）；短时域下预测留出帧比提供切向量的 IRASim 更准确，计算量低 100 倍以上。

Conclusion: 通过仅从生成器获取切向、其余项来自数据，Action Jet 在短时域规划中以极低计算成本实现更快、更准确的动作评估。

Abstract: World models are a powerful means of reasoning and planning, but many of these action-conditioned predictive models are high dimensional and computationally expensive. These challenges limit the number of action candidates that can be evaluated by a planner. We show that this cost is avoidable for planners over short horizons, which only require local information with respect to the current state. For a fixed state, the frames reachable by varying a low-dimensional action (a camera movement or an end-effector command) lie on a low-dimensional manifold. We estimate the local shape of that manifold directly via a network trained to estimate how each image region moves per unit of each action axis supervised by data collected from samples by the generator. A correction head fit to trajectory data estimates the shape of this manifold region up to a third-order Taylor polynomial. We call this network estimating the Taylor polynomial describing the manifold shape an Action Jet and compute its radius of validity in closed form. By traversing this approximation of the local manifold shape, we only have to perform inference once per state for any number of candidate actions. Scoring sixteen candidates from a single extraction is over 300x faster than with either source generator, and this gap widens with the number of candidates a planner evaluates. We measure against state-of-the-art action-conditioned generators, IRASim and WorldGym on BridgeData V2, a real 7-DoF manipulation benchmark, and FrameCrafter on DL3DV scenes, where we chart from the novel-view generators DepthSplat and LagerNVS. Because only the tangent comes from the generator and every other term from the data, the Action Jet also predicts held-out frames more accurately than IRASim, the generator that supplied its tangent, at short horizons and at over 100x less compute.

</details>


### [2] [How Far Can Coding Agents Go in Visual Generation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19025)
*Hengguang Zhou,Yuanhao Ban,Jiaqi Feng,Xiaohuan Pei,Justin Cui,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究通用编码智能体通过可执行程序构建图像，发现其在结构与约束任务上表现优异，并探索了代码作为外部视觉思维语言及内部共享表征的假说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代图像生成依赖专用模型，将图像构建过程隐式封装于学习参数中；作者想探索用通用编码智能体通过可执行程序显式构建图像的替代方案。

Method: 在200提示的AgentDrawBench上做零样本绘图研究；将代码作为可构造、可检查的外部视觉思维语言，在VQA任务中测试重构视觉代码；通过跨工具绘图与独立单像素查询组装图像，检验共享内部视觉思维语言假说。

Result: 智能体擅长保持结构和满足精确视觉约束，在构图准确性比写实更重要的领域有竞争力，但感知丰富度有限；表现随绘图接口变化；重构视觉代码保留大量问答信息，某些领域准确率高于原图；跨工具绘图与单像素查询展现出相关布局和色调；移除可见绘图后智能体仍能跨视角保持自生成的房间布局。

Conclusion: 编码智能体在绘图工具介入前、生成开始前，就已在其"想象"中维持一个一致连贯的世界，支持内部视觉思维语言的假设。

Abstract: Modern image generation largely relies on specialized generative models that leave the process of image construction implicit in learned parameters. We explore an alternative: general-purpose coding agents that construct images through executable programs. Our study of zero-shot drawing on AgentDrawBench, a 200-prompt benchmark, reveals a distinctive capability profile. Agents excel at preserving structure and satisfying precise visual constraints, achieving competitive results in domains where compositional accuracy matters more than photorealistic appearance, while remaining limited in perceptual richness. Their visual expressiveness varies with the drawing interface, and a qualitative study on reconstruction shows how procedural skills extracted from human demonstrations support different artistic media. We then examine code as an external visual language of thought: a structured, executable representation that agents can construct and inspect. We test it in visual question answering task and find reconstructed visual code retains substantial information for question answering and, in some domains, supports higher accuracy than the original image. These abilities raise a further question: do agents draw on a shared internal representation of scene content beyond a particular drawing program? We explore an internal visual language-of-thought hypothesis, in which a shared, compositionally structured representation supports visual operations across drawing languages. Cross-harness drawings and images assembled from independent single-pixel queries exhibit related layouts and tones. Agents also maintain self-generated room arrangements across viewpoints after visible drawings are removed. These results demonstrate that the coding agent would maintain a consistent and coherent world inside its imagine even before the harness gets involved and the generation starts.

</details>


### [3] [Why Do VLMs Fail at Remote Physiological Measurement? Rethinking with Physiological Grounding and Numerical Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19052)
*Xiao Yang,Zekun Zhang,Yuxuan Fan,Duoxun Tang,Ziyang Liu,Dengbo He,Kaishun Wu,Jiyao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VITAL框架，通过视觉-生理Token对齐，让VLM同时具备远程生理测量与通用视觉理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RPM方法依赖任务专用模型，无法与VLM的多模态理解与交互能力融合；且存在两大瓶颈：通用视觉语义表示丢失细粒度生理线索，自回归生成的离散token预测与连续数值测量本质不匹配。

Method: VITAL保留原视觉通路用于语义理解，引入独立的生理通路联合建模语义与生理信息；并提出结构化数值对齐方法，增强数值关系建模以提升生成式心率估计的可靠性。

Result: 在多个rPPG数据集上提升跨域估计性能，同时保持VLM的通用视觉理解能力，验证其作为统一视觉-生理模型的有效性。

Conclusion: VITAL为RPM与VLM融合提供了可行方案，兼顾生理测量精度与通用视觉能力；代码将开源。

Abstract: Video-based remote physiological measurement (RPM) has broad applications, while Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide a promising opportunity to enable end-to-end physiological monitoring for future human-aware intelligent systems. However, existing RPM methods rely on task-specific models and cannot be seamlessly integrated with the multimodal understanding and interaction capabilities of VLMs. We revisit RPM with VLMs and provide empirical evidence for two major bottlenecks: generic visual semantic representations fail to preserve fine-grained physiological cues; while discrete token prediction in autoregressive generation is inherently misaligned with continuous numerical measurement. To address these challenges, we propose VITAL (Visual-physiological Token Alignment for Language Models), a visual-physiological token alignment framework for RPM and preserving general vision tasks. VITAL retains the original visual pathway for semantic understanding and introduces an independent physiological pathway to jointly model semantic and physiological information. Moreover, we propose a structured numerical alignment approach to improve the reliability of generative heart rate estimation by enhancing numerical relationship modeling. Extensive experiments show that VITAL improves cross-domain estimation performance on multiple rPPG datasets while preserving the general visual understanding capability of VLMs, demonstrating its effectiveness as a unified visual-physiological model. Code will be released.

</details>


### [4] [WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19063)
*Nan Zhou,Jianxiong Gao,Qiuyu Wang,Wen Wang,Jiahao Wang,Yufeng Yuan,Shuaiting Li,Hao Ouyang,Yujun Shen,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldMemBench，一个系统评估视频世界模型"世界记忆"能力的基准，包含260个测试用例，涵盖静态与动态记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着视频模型支持更长、更真实的交互体验，维持与历史一致的世界变得越来越重要，需要同时保留已观察内容并保证世界随时间连贯演进。世界记忆是应与视觉保真度和视频时长一起评估的关键能力，但目前缺乏系统评估手段。

Method: 构建 WorldMemBench，含260个测试用例：通过人类身份与外貌保持、物体外观与几何、环境内容与几何评估静态记忆；通过事件推进与状态持久评估动态记忆。采用受控相机离开和多重重访轨迹，静态内容对照固定初始参考，动态事件对照预期状态转移，结合外观与几何指标及事件特定评估，并将视频质量和相机跟随精度作为辅助诊断。

Result: 对九个代表性模型的评估显示：强静态保持并不意味着可靠的动态状态演进；多重重访揭示首次返回后记忆退化。人类研究支持自动评估与人类判断的一致性。

Conclusion: WorldMemBench 为诊断记忆失效、指导持久且时间连贯的视频世界模型发展提供了系统测试平台。

Abstract: As video models enable longer and more realistic interactive experiences, maintaining a world consistent with its history becomes essential. This requires both preserving previously observed content and ensuring coherent world evolution over time. World memory is a critical capability to evaluate alongside visual fidelity and video duration. We introduce WorldMemBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating world memory in video world models. Across 260 test cases, it assesses static memory through the retention of human identity and appearance, object appearance and geometry, and environmental content and geometry, and dynamic memory through event progression and state persistence. Using controlled camera departures and multi-revisit trajectories, the benchmark evaluates static content against fixed initial references and dynamic events against expected state transitions. It combines appearance and geometry metrics with event-specific assessments, and reports video quality and camera-following accuracy as complementary diagnostics. Evaluation of nine representative models shows that strong static retention does not imply reliable dynamic state evolution, while repeated revisits reveal memory degradation beyond the first return. Human studies support the alignment between our automatic evaluations and human judgments. WorldMemBench provides a systematic testbed for diagnosing memory failures and guiding the development of persistent, temporally coherent video worlds.

</details>


### [5] [MonoMIP: Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping for Monocular 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19071)
*Emir Ulurak,Furkan Kıraç*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MonoMIP：双解码器单目3D检测，用多高度逆透视映射构建BEV特征补充几何推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目3D检测依赖深度引导Transformer，但仅在透视图像平面上操作，空间关系受透视收缩扭曲。

Method: 在K个高度平面做IPM，生成有序的高度条件度量BEV特征堆叠；BEV解码器用多尺度可变形注意力按查询聚合多高度证据，深度引导3D解码器提供透视空间预测。

Result: KITTI val Car达25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40，官方测试集21.66%，在KITTI和Waymo基准上超越近期单目方法，且无需额外训练数据。

Conclusion: 引入BEV几何推理可有效弥补透视平面的表示缺陷，提升单目3D检测性能。

Abstract: Monocular 3D object detection methods increasingly rely on depth-guided transformers, but they operate entirely in the perspective image plane where spatial relationships are distorted by foreshortening. We propose MonoMIP, a dual-decoder framework that adds complementary 3D geometric reasoning through Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features constructed via Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping. We perform IPM at K elevation planes spanning ground to rooftop, producing an ordered stack of height-conditioned metric BEV features that reduces above-ground misprojection and exposes depth-dependent appearance variation across planes. A BEV decoder with multi-scale deformable attention aggregates this multi-height evidence per query, while a depth-guided 3D decoder provides complementary perspective-space predictions. Without extra training data, MonoMIP attains 25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40 on KITTI val and 21.66% on the official test set for Car, outperforming recent published monocular methods on both the KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.

</details>


### [6] [The Gap Is in the Geometry: A Convergent Meta-Analysis of Multi-Facet Aerial and Remote Sensing Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19102)
*Georgios Angelidis,Aggelos Psiris,Maria Vakalopoulou,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos,Giorgos Sfikas,Iraklis Varlamis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过四层证据的元分析论证：当前航空/遥感视频多选题评测衡量的是错误的能力维度，并提出五条可证伪原则和AVU-Card报告规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空与遥感视频正被按网页视频的方式评测（对采样帧做多选题、报告MLLM准确率），作者认为这一范式衡量了错误的能力侧面，需要系统证据来纠正。

Method: 对大量已发表结果做收敛性元分析，按四层证据组织；当证据一致时把主张上升为"立场"，并据此推导五条可证伪原则，同时提出AVU-Card报告卡。

Result: 参数规模每扩大十倍中位仅提升+3.4分，远低于人类至少19分的差距；采集条件主导感知——19组同文对比中318次评测有315次在高度、视角、目标尺寸或时间跨度变难时掉分；语料中无任何航空基准同时具备视频输入与逐任务人类/随机基线；从"回答"到闭环导航"行动"时能力崩塌；同一批MLLM在航空基准上高于地面空间任务，却在跨视角几何研究中更低。

Conclusion: 现有多选题评测无法反映航空视频真实能力，应以采集条件、闭环行动与跨视角几何等维度重构评测，并用AVU-Card规范报告，使主张可被证伪检验。

Abstract: Aerial and remote sensing video is increasingly evaluated like web video, by posing multiple-choice questions to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) over sampled frames and reporting accuracy. This paper argues that this recipe measures the wrong aspect, and supports the claim with a convergent meta-analysis of a broad set of published results, organized in four evidence tiers, in which a claim becomes a position only when collected evidence agrees. Parameter scale exhibits a median of +3.4 accuracy points per tenfold increase on aerial benchmarks, far below a human gap of at least 19 points, whereas acquisition conditions control perception, as 315 of 318 evaluations in 19 within-paper contrasts lose accuracy when conditions such as altitude, view, object size or time horizon become harder. No aerial benchmark in the corpus combines video input with per-task human and random baselines, competence collapses from answering to acting in closed-loop navigation, and the same MLLMs score higher on the aerial benchmark than on ground spatial ones, but lower on studies that test cross-view geometry. From these findings the current study derives five falsifiable principles and proposes the AVU-Card, a reporting card for aerial video benchmarks

</details>


### [7] [Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19108)
*Mahdieh Mallahnezhad,Masoud Jafaripour,Mohamadali Tofigh,Sheila Schoepp,Osmar R. Zaiane*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了面向多模态大模型（MLLMs）空间推理能力微调的方法与数据集，涵盖从监督到强化学习的训练范式，并按数据集设计、构建与评估三大主题分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs 在具身智能与机器人视觉任务中广泛应用，但在空间推理与感知上存在明显不足；后训练技术虽有改善潜力，但缺乏面向数据驱动的系统综述。

Method: 综述预训练 MLLMs 空间推理微调方法，重点关注数据集；围绕数据集构建、数据模态与标注、模型评估等主题，将研究归为数据集设计、数据集构建与评估三类；并归纳固定空间标注的四种构建方法：规则模板、LLM 提示、程序化生成与人在回路。

Result: 梳理出四类固定空间标注构建方法；发现评估方法差异显著，包括不同打分方式、容差指标与基准类型；指出未来方向：统一动态标注、高效空间推理、评估标准化、扩展空间范围与以人为中心的空间交互。

Conclusion: 空间推理微调的数据与评估仍缺乏统一标准，亟需在标注动态化、评估规范化及人本交互等方向推进研究。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.

</details>


### [8] [Agronomic Characterization and Time-Series UAV Phenotyping to Support Field Pea Breeding in Iowa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19154)
*Yanben Shen,Joscif Raigne,Asheesh Singh,Arti Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 评估17份PI种质与7个加拿大品种在美国爱荷华州的田间表现，利用UAV时间序列冠层性状筛选高产品种，发现冠层面积是最具产量相关性且选择可靠性高的性状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野豌豆（field pea）在美国中西部逐渐受到关注，有望改善爱荷华州种植制度，但缺乏本地适应的优质育种材料与高效表型鉴定手段。

Method: 在六个站点-年份下评价17份PI种质和7个加拿大品种的农艺与产量表现；提取UAV时间序列冠层性状，分析其与多种农艺性状及产量的相关性。

Result: PI种质在物候与冠层性状上具有遗传多样性，成熟期为75–95 DAP；加拿大大田优良品种平均产量1961 kg/ha；UAV时间序列冠层面积与产量相关性最高（r=0.63），且选择可靠性优于产量本身（H2=0.87，CV=13.46%）。

Conclusion: UAV衍生的冠层面积性状适用于表型选择，可加速中西部野豌豆育种；整合多样种质、优良商用品种与UAV时间序列表型鉴定，有助于培育本地适应的高产野豌豆品种。

Abstract: Field pea has gained interest in the Midwest U.S. and has the potential to benefit Iowa cropping systems. This study evaluated 17 accessions and 7 Canadian varieties for agronomic and seed yield performance. This study found that PI accession trials exhibit genetic diversity in phenology and canopy traits, whereas the Canadian elite varieties demonstrated great yield potential under Iowa conditions. The accession genotypes matured between 75 DAP (late June) and 95 DAP (late July) across six site-years. The top-yielding Canadian varieties averaged 1961 kg/ha across two site-years. To comprehensively assess field pea performance, this study extracted time-series Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV)-derived traits, assessed UAV-derived traits, and evaluated their correlations with multiple agronomic traits and yield. The results found that UAV-derived time-series canopy area was the most yield-relevant trait (r = 0.63) among all UAV-derived canopy features, vegetation indices, and manually collected measurements. Compared with yield, UAV-derived canopy area showed higher selection reliability (H2 = 0.87, CV = 13.46%), making it suitable for phenotypic selection and accelerating Midwest field pea breeding programs. This study identifies useful UAV-derived features for pea breeding and demonstrates the value of integrating diverse germplasm, elite commercial varieties, and time-series UAV phenotyping. Combining genetic variation from the accession trial with the yield potential of high-performing commercial varieties provides valuable breeding materials and phenotyping strategies for developing locally adapted, high-yielding field pea varieties for future production in the Midwest.

</details>


### [9] [Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19201)
*Henry Che,Xuanchi Ren,Sanja Fidler,Shenlong Wang,Laura Leal-Taixé,Shengyu Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LidarVerse是一个实时统一的LiDAR世界模型，将重建式与生成式范式整合进单一条件生成框架，实现跨任务、跨传感器的传感器仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR仿真器分两类：重建式保真几何但需逐场景长时优化，生成式可跨数据学习但缺乏长时滚动一致性，二者互补但割裂，难以用于闭环传感器仿真。

Method: 采用通用tokenizer将LiDAR距离序列映射到共享隐空间，双向teacher学习统一条件接口（LiDAR前缀、HD地图、持久空间缓存、可选文本）。将teacher蒸馏为四步自回归因果学生模型，并维护滚动时序K/V缓存与世界对齐空间缓存。

Result: 在三种评测协议多数指标上达SOTA；单张H100上11 FPS实时推理，支持长时滚动；tokenizer支持32/64/128线LiDAR并泛化到未见扫描模式。

Conclusion: 生成式与重建基础的LiDAR仿真可在单一模型内统一实现，为未来闭环传感器仿真提供核心能力。

Abstract: We present LidarVerse, a real-time unified LiDAR world model for sensor simulation across tasks and sensors. Existing LiDAR simulators largely follow one of two complementary paradigms: reconstruction-based methods preserve the geometry of a captured scene but require lengthy per-scene optimization, whereas generative methods amortize learning across data but lack the consistency needed for long-horizon rollouts. LidarVerse brings both paradigms into a single, unified conditional generative framework. A universal tokenizer maps LiDAR range sequences into a shared latent space, where a bidirectional teacher learns a common interface for conditioning on a LiDAR prefix, an HD-Map, a persistent spatial cache, and optionally, text. Varying the available scene evidence turns the same model into a generator of new worlds, a point-cloud forecaster, or a generalizable resimulator of observed scenes without per-scene optimization. We distill the teacher into a four-step autoregressive causal student and maintain both a rolling temporal K/V cache and a world-aligned spatial cache, enabling persistent long-horizon rollouts with real-time inference at 11 FPS on a single H100 GPU. *Anton Arapin,Aditya Singh,Yixin Wang,Jun Gao,Bernadette Bucher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出D3WM，通过联合预测确定性下一状态与空间异方差不确定性图，用不确定性图门控条件扩散，分离确定性漂移与随机扩散，提升视觉世界模型预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉世界模型需同时处理确定性变化（如平台受控运动）和随机性变化（如物体渲染、新暴露区域），而现有方法未显式利用随机变化的空间位置信息。

Result: 在机器人桌面操作与相机运动两类动作空间上，均优于竞争基线。

Conclusion: 通过学习空间不确定性图并门控扩散过程，可有效解耦确定性与随机性预测，为视觉世界模型提供更优的场景演化预测框架。

Abstract: World models of visual information predict future image frames conditioned on given action sequences. This predicted scene evolution is driven by deterministic changes such as controlled motion on a robot platform, as well as stochastic changes such as rendering of manipulated objects or previously occluded regions. Our key insight is that the spatial location of these stochastic changes is itself learnable. We leverage this insight by jointly regressing both the deterministic next-state prediction and the spatial uncertainty map, then using the uncertainty map to guide a conditional diffusion process. We propose Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model (D3WM), which uses a transformer trained with a Gaussian negative-log-likelihood objective to produce both the deterministic next-state prediction and a spatial map of heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty. The learned uncertainty map then provides a structured spatial gate for a conditional diffusion model: deterministic regions are anchored to the predicted state, while uncertain regions, such as disocclusions or dynamic textures, are sampled by the diffusion process. We frame this decomposition under a variance-gated stochastic differential equation that separates deterministic drift from stochastic diffusion. D3WM shows improved results over competitive baselines in two distinct types of action spaces: robotic tabletop manipulation and camera motion.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近视因球面离焦像差导致精细空间细节感知受损。本文旨在通过计算方式设计变换图像，使固定距离的近视者在无需矫正设备的情况下获得更清晰的场景感知。

Method: 用二阶Zernike多项式Z_2^0建模离焦像差，训练神经网络进行反补偿。采用U-Net架构，损失函数结合重建误差最小化与空间差异结构保持（ℓ1正则化）。仅在KITTI数据集训练，在DIV2K和ImageNet上测试以验证泛化性。

Abstract: Myopic vision degrades the quality of human vision due to spherical eye defocus aberrations that impair the perception of fine spatial details. ### [12] [Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19257)
*Eren Cetin,Julius Erbach,Vukasin Bozic,Hyojun Go,Zixiang Zhao,Nikolai Kalischek,Federico Tombari,Konrad Schindler,Dominik Narnhofer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SMART 提出用区域 token 寻址的槽记忆，实现常量存储下的空间寻址式长时程视频生成记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程视频生成需同时满足存储有界与远距离空间回忆两个冲突要求：重建式记忆依赖显式几何且缓存增长，循环式记忆容量恒定但记忆随时间衰减。

Method: 采用常量大小的槽循环记忆，写入由观察相机寻址、读取由渲染相机查询，无需显式 3D 表征或增长缓存；每次读取附带置信度估计，用于条件化 chunk-causal 扩散 Transformer，使其选择性信任检索内容。

Result: 在 Memory Maze 和 Minecraft 的长轨迹上，SMART 在远超训练时程的情况下保持高保真回忆，且内存与单步成本恒定。

Conclusion: 以视图几何而非时间近因驱动回忆，可在有界存储下实现可扩展的长时程空间记忆。

Abstract: Memory for long-horizon video generation must satisfy two competing requirements: it must remain bounded so generation can continue indefinitely, while still recovering what was observed at a place when the camera returns, regardless of how long ago it was seen. Reconstruction-based memories provide spatial recall by caching and reprojecting explicit geometry, but require growing storage and depend on estimated 3D structure. Recurrent memories keep a constant-size state, but retention is governed by temporal recurrence, causing old observations to fade with time. We introduce SMART, a slot memory addressed by region tokens, which combines bounded storage with spatially addressed recall. SMART stores content in a constant-size slot recurrence whose writes are addressed by the observing camera and whose reads are queried by the rendering camera, without constructing an explicit 3D representation or maintaining a growing cache. Consequently, recall is conditioned on inter-view geometry rather than on recency. Each read additionally provides a confidence estimate that conditions a chunk-causal diffusion transformer, allowing it to selectively trust retrieved content while relying on its generative prior elsewhere. </details>

*Yanqiao Wang,Jin Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光照估计方法主要恢复用于渲染的光照分布，但未显式给出特定场景位置上各个物理光源的贡献，缺乏局部光照与物理光源之间的关联。

Method: LAMP构建活跃光源共享清单，为每个查询点对贡献光源排序并预测3D查询点到光源方向。利用程序化控制的室内场景监督，复用独立渲染的光源响应推导不同光照配置下的贡献目标，并从光源与查询点位置获得精确方向。

Conclusion: LAMP借助VLM场景理解能力，将局部光照与物理光源相连，在保持渲染质量的同时实现了光源的3D定位与显式归因。

Abstract: Existing illumination estimation methods primarily recover lighting distributions for rendering, but typically leave the contributions of individual physical light sources at specific scene locations implicit. We address this gap by leveraging the scene understanding capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to connect local illumination with its physical sources. We introduce LAMP, a framework for point-conditioned, source-aware illumination reasoning from a single RGB image with marked query points. LAMP constructs a shared inventory of active light sources, ranks contributing sources for each query, and predicts their 3D query-to-source directions. We supervise these relationships using procedurally controlled indoor scenes, reusing independently rendered source responses to derive contribution targets across lighting configurations and obtaining exact directions from source and query positions. On the Infinigen test set, fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B increases dominant-source 3D PCK@0.5m from 0% to 70.6%, with 94.5% of directions within 12.5 degrees of ground truth among correctly localized sources. Combined with a lightweight network predicting dense RGB irradiance, LAMP achieves probe-rendering quality comparable to prior lighting-estimation methods while additionally localizing individual physical sources in 3D and explicitly attributing local illumination to them.

</details>

*Nikolay Semenov,Artem Riabinin,Sergey Bassenko,Anna Averchenkova,Julia Agafonova,Anastasia Aliaskina,Kirill Kozlov,Lev Novitskiy,Nikita Samsonov,Nikolai Gerasimenko,Denis Dimitrov*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现可控的语音驱动人物动画，生成唇动、表情、姿态和手势与语音同步的长视频，并推动该领域开源研究与部署。

Abstract: We present Kandinsky S2V 1.0, an open family of speech-to-video models for controllable audio-driven human animation, comprising Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite (2B parameters) and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro (21B parameters). From a single reference image, a speech waveform, and a text prompt, the models generate long-form 25 FPS video in which lip motion, expression, pose, and gesture follow the speech. The architecture draws text and audio conditioning from one Qwen2.5-Omni model and adds a reference-aware three-scale visual memory. Training starts from the Kandinsky 5.0 Video foundation models [1] and combines mixed reference-memory layouts with an area-adaptive face loss. The training corpus contains 1.17M single-speaker clips selected by active-speaker detection, with captions generated directly in English and Russian. A side-by-side human evaluation against the strongest open-source baseline and two proprietary commercial models shows that Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro performs comparably to or better than these models on average and is also preferred for lip synchronization. On common speech to video benchmarks, Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro rank among the top performing models according to mean rank over five reported metrics. Beyond the base models, we provide π-Flow distilled variants of both Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro. The distilled Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro model generates video in 16 sampling steps without classifier-free guidance, achieving a 5.4 times end-to-end speedup over the base model, while matching or exceeding it on nearly all reported benchmark metrics. To accelerate open research and deployment in speech-to-video generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

</details>


### [15] [Data-free Multistep Diffusion Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19305)
*Ngoc Duy Tran,Kien Do,Duc Thanh Nguyen,Truyen Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PMDD，一种渐进式多步无数据蒸馏方法，为每个学生分布分配专属适配网络，避免同时训练带来的偏差与不稳定，实现单一模型支持多推理预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步扩散蒸馏在小数据集上表现好，但在高分辨率或复杂文生图场景不足；扩展到多步蒸馏时依赖训练数据、存在早期步退化、跨采样预算输出不一致及高计算成本等问题。

Method: 识别问题根源为"同时训练"——单一适配网络需同时逼近多个学生分布的不同分数函数，导致分布匹配偏差与优化不稳定。提出PMDD，为每个学生分布分配专属适配网络，同时通过设计避免维护多个适配网络的内存开销，结合分阶段unforget损失保留早期步生成。

Result: PMDD在每个多步预算下匹配或超越无数据少步基线；ImageNet 64x64两步达到FID 1.99（优于512-NFE教师2.32）；零样本COCO 512x512达FID 7.76；支持三种推理预算，训练计算量比无数据DMDv2少4-5倍。

Conclusion: PMDD降低了学生的优化偏差，收敛更快，提供支持多推理预算的单一统一模型，在多步无数据蒸馏上取得领先效果。

Abstract: One-step diffusion distillation achieves strong performance on small datasets but remains insufficient for high-resolution or complex text-to-image settings. Extending to multistep distillation often requires training data, suffers from early-step degradation, inconsistent outputs across sampling budgets, and incurs high computational cost. We identify that these limitations stem from simultaneous training, where a single adapted network approximates multiple score functions of different student distributions at once, causing biased distribution matching and unstable optimization. Therefore, we propose Progressive Multistep Data-free Distillation (PMDD), which assigns a dedicated adapted network per student distribution while avoiding the memory overhead of maintaining multiple adapted networks. Combined with a stage-wise unforget loss to preserve earlier-step generations, PMDD reduces optimization bias in the student, provides faster convergence, and a single unified model that supports multiple inference budgets. Extensive experiments show that PMDD matches or outperforms data-free few-step baselines at every multistep budget, reaches FID 1.99 on ImageNet 64x64 in two steps, below its 512-NFE teacher (2.32), and achieves FID 7.76 on zero-shot COCO 512x512, while requiring 4-5x less training compute than data-free DMDv2 to support three inference budgets.

</details>


### [16] [SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19327)
*Zefan Yang,Zheyuan Zhang,Boris Maihe,Yikang Liu,Hang Yu,Ankush Mukherjee,Xiao Chen,Pingkun Yan,Terrence Chen,Shanhui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SonoWorld：首个主要从自由手临床视频学习、因果且位姿可控的超声世界模型，用于机器人超声数据采集与策略评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人超声可标准化采集并降低操作者负担，但策略学习缺乏真实可控的仿真环境。超声世界建模困难：每帧仅为未观测三维解剖的截面，探头微小运动即导致大幅外观变化；现有方法依赖机器人位姿跟踪和潜空间预测，不能直接生成交互控制所需的观测。

Method: 三阶段训练：(1) 在约690万帧无标注多器官超声上预训练潜动作条件视频扩散模型；(2) 用少量EM跟踪的甲状腺数据将视频动力学对齐到度量探头位姿；(3) 用分布匹配蒸馏实现因果、长时程自回归生成，并在推理时选择性缓存驱逐token。

Result: 在留存的跟踪扫描上以位姿跟随保真度、往返一致性、合成动作下的轴向控制评估可控性，并进行用户研究。基于模型的动作判别中，SonoWorld在高达74.8%的试验中正确将目标导向探头运动排序于等幅反向运动之上。

Conclusion: SonoWorld是首个主要从自由手临床视频学习的因果、位姿可控超声世界模型，为机器人超声数据采集与策略评估提供数据驱动的交互环境。

Abstract: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.

</details>


### [17] [NavAble: A Large-Scale Dataset and Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Blind Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19330)
*Hochul Hwang,Jahir Sadik Monon,Soowan Yang,Shiven Umeshbhai Patel,Anh Nhat Hong Nguyen,Kien Nguyen,Keshav Garg,Dylan Gage,Duretti Hordofaa,Anshu Anjna,Eshed Ohn-Bar,Donghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NavAble：面向盲人及低视力导航的11类无障碍关键物大规�模数据集，结合41K开源+8K真实+452K合成图像，分割>80% mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 盲人与低视力（BLV）辅助导航需要可靠识别无障碍关键物体（如提示音、开门按钮、扶手），但现有大规模视觉数据集对这些类别覆盖不足，存在类别少、标注不一致、多样性差的问题。

Method: 构建NavAble数据集，涵盖11类无障碍物体，融合41K开源图像与8K新采集密集标注真实图像；开发合成数据生成流程，通过自动网页爬取、VLM过滤、SAM 3D资产生成和便捷相机轨迹配置，在37个环境中渲染565个3D资产，产出452K帧。

Result: 微调现有分割模型可达>80% mIoU（留存测试集）；合成数据增强比仅真实数据微调提升最多+3.5 mIoU；在两个移动辅助机器人上验证了真实导航场景感知可靠性提升。

Conclusion: NavAble为BLV导航感知提供可扩展基础，缓解数据稀缺与具身差距，数据集与流程已公开。

Abstract: Reliable recognition of accessibility-critical objects (e.g., audible pedestrian signals, door-activation buttons, and handrails) is essential for assistive navigation technologies that support safe, independent mobility for blind and low-vision (BLV) users. Yet these categories are underrepresented in existing large-scale vision datasets, and the few datasets that include them suffer from limited class coverage, inconsistent annotations, and poor diversity. We introduce NavAble, a large-scale dataset spanning 11 accessibility-critical object classes, combining 41K curated open-source images with 8K newly collected, densely annotated real-world images. To extend scale and diversity, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that renders high-fidelity 3D assets across 37 environments under diverse styles and viewpoints, yielding 452K frames with rich ground-truth annotations from 565 assets. The pipeline minimizes manual effort by combining automated web image crawling, VLM-based filtering, SAM 3D-based asset generation, and convenient camera trajectory configuration, enabling large-scale data generation at a diversity unattainable through manual collection. Experiments show that fine-tuning existing segmentation models on the NavAble Dataset achieves reliable accessibility-object segmentation (>80% mIoU on our held-out test set). We also demonstrate the effectiveness of synthetic data augmentation, which yields up to +3.5 mIoU over real-world-only fine-tuning. Beyond benchmark evaluation, validation on egocentric data from two mobility-assistive robots demonstrates improved perception reliability in real-world navigation scenarios. Together, NavAble establishes a scalable foundation for BLV navigation perception, directly addressing the data scarcity and embodiment gaps. The dataset and pipeline are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/NavAble/NeurIPS_2026_BLV.

</details>


### [18] [MMKG-R1: Constructing Multimodal Knowledge Graphs via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19341)
*Zongyu Wu,Yilong Wang,Xiaochen Wang,Minhua Lin,Yuan Zhong,Fenglong Ma,Xiang Zhang,Suhang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MMKG-R1 提出一种面向多模态知识图谱质量的强化学习框架，训练 MLLM 作为多模态知识构建器，通过质量感知奖励提升 MMKG 质量和下游问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MMKG 构建方法缺乏明确的图质量指导，而基于 RL 的方法仅依赖最终答案正确性，只能间接反馈 MMKG 质量。

Method: MMKG-R1 引入多种质量感知奖励，直接评估从单个知识源提取的信息质量以及组装后 MMKG 的质量，并用这些奖励引导 MLLM 的 RL 训练。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，MMKG-R1 构建的 MMKG 提升了下游问答准确率。

Abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) organize information across different modalities to support multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which aims to improve the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The effectiveness of these multimodal Graph RAG methods largely depends on the quality of the constructed MMKGs. However, most existing methods construct MMKGs without explicit guidance on graph quality, while reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods that rely on final-answer correctness may provide only indirect feedback on MMKG quality. To address these limitations, we propose MMKG-R1, a novel MMKG-quality-driven RL framework for training an MLLM as a multimodal knowledge constructor. To be specific, MMKG-R1 introduces multiple quality-aware rewards to directly evaluate both the quality of information extracted from individual knowledge sources and the quality of the assembled MMKG. These rewards are then used to guide the RL training. Experiments across multiple datasets show that MMKG-R1 constructs MMKGs that improve downstream question-answering accuracy.

*Kyusong Lee,Heting Ying,Tiancheng Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 \method{}，一种视觉-语言航点策略，通过分阶段多模态学习提升干扰环境下的具身视觉跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在干扰者存在时，跟踪目标人物极具挑战，现有方法从单目标到干扰跟踪成功率大幅下降，因此需要关注共享空间中人物跟随机器人。

Method: 构建视觉-语言航点策略：结合冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文、Transformer主干和轻量航点头。训练分三阶段：视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理中期训练、基于19,532条oracle轨迹的跟踪专业化；并探索用过滤oracle标签进行策略内(on-policy)微调。

Conclusion: 分阶段多模态学习是干扰跟踪的有效方向，策略内微调对共享空间人物跟随有进一步研究价值。

Abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.

</details>

*Pedro Manoel Herminio Alves,Dalton Cézane Gomes Valadares,Cláudio de Souza Baptista*

TL;DR: 本文对比YOLO11、RT-DETR、YOLO26检测器与ByteTrack、BoT-SORT跟踪器在多行人跟踪基准上的表现，分析检测器架构、模型规模、场景密度和推理方式对跟踪的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拥挤场景中的遮挡和快速运动使多行人视频跟踪更具挑战，需要明确检测器架构、模型规模、场景密度与推理方式如何影响跟踪性能，为实际应用中的检测器与跟踪器选择提供依据。

Method: 在MOT17、MOT20、SOMPT22序列上，比较YOLO11、RT-DETR、YOLO26检测器家族与ByteTrack、BoT-SORT跟踪器的组合；对YOLO26额外比较基于NMS的传统重叠过滤与端到端推理。

Abstract: Pedestrian tracking in video is important for applications such as surveillance and scene analysis, but it becomes more challenging in crowded scenarios with frequent occlusions and rapid motion. This paper analyzes how detector architecture, model scale, scene density, and inference regime affect the tracking of multiple pedestrians. We compare the YOLO11, RT-DETR, and YOLO26 detector families with the ByteTrack and BoT-SORT trackers on sequences from the MOT17, MOT20, and SOMPT22 benchmarks. For YOLO26, we also compare traditional overlap filtering via Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) with end-to-end inference. The RT-DETR family achieved the highest mean scores on the HOTA tracking quality metric across all three benchmarks with both trackers, with a more pronounced advantage on MOT20, albeit at a higher computational cost. On MOT17 and SOMPT22, YOLO26 variants, especially YOLO26-L with NMS, offered favorable combinations of quality and speed compared with RT-DETR. In the YOLO26 inference comparison, the end-to-end mode did not yield consistent tracking gains over the NMS-based regime. Taken together, these results provide a practical guide for selecting detectors and trackers for this task based on application priorities.

</details>


### [21] [WinARDet: Compressed Window Auto-Regression for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19419)
*Chenxu Wang,Hangyi Kuang,Bo-Wen Yin,Yuxuan Li,Quan-Sheng Zeng,Yang Zhang,Xu Guo,Xiang Li,Qibin Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对MLLM检测器在密集场景中的框重复循环问题，提出压缩窗口自回归（WinAR）机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM检测器将视觉-语言定位建模为自回归坐标生成，但在密集场景中常陷入框重复循环，不断输出相同框直到解码预算耗尽。作者将其归因于"历史答案注意力接管"：全历史自回归下，答案历史中重复的坐标token吸引过多注意力，挤占了感知新视觉证据所需的注意力汇。

Method: 提出Compressed Window Auto-Regression (WinAR)：将长答案序列划分为连续生成窗口，仅对当前窗口进行完整token级自回归，同时把每个先前窗口压缩为一组固定数量的潜在token来条件化后续解码。该设计减少对原始历史坐标的重复暴露，同时保留跨窗口依赖。

Result: 在RSDense（每图200-2000个对象）上，WinARDet将RexOmni的F1（IoU=0.5）从32.16提升至39.36，冗余率从35.48%降至13.00%。模型还泛化到多种解码策略与输出格式（并行框解码、多边形生成）。

Conclusion: WinAR为跨场景密度的长时程视觉-语言定位提供了实用范式。

Abstract: MLLM-based detectors formulate vision-language grounding as autoregressive coordinate generation, yet in dense scenes, they often collapse into a box repetition loop, repeatedly emitting identical boxes until the decoding budget is exhausted. We trace this failure to historical-answer attention takeover: Under full-history autoregression, repeated coordinate tokens in the growing answer history attract disproportionate attention, crowding out the attention sinks needed to attend to new visual evidence. % To break this loop, in this paper, we propose \textbf{Compressed Window Auto-Regression} (WinAR). This new mechanism partitions a long answer sequence into consecutive generation windows and restricts full token-level autoregression to the current window only while compressing each previous window into a fixed set of latent tokens that condition subsequent decoding. This design reduces the repeated exposure to raw historical coordinates that triggers the attention takeover, yet preserves cross-window dependencies essential for coherent multi-object generation. On RSDense, which contains 200-2,000 objects per image, our model WinARDet improves RexOmni F1-score (IoU=0.5) from 32.16 to 39.36 over the baseline, while reducing the redundancy rate from 35.48% to 13.00%. WinARDet also generalizes across decoding strategies and output formats, including parallel box decoding and polygon generation, providing a practical paradigm for long-horizon vision-language grounding across scene densities.

</details>


### [22] [VideoHarness-SRSI: Structured Recursive Self-Improvement for Video Understanding Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19424)
*Zihao Lin,Haoyu Dong,Haobo Xu,Chi-Chih Chang,Xuying Ning,Yinglong Xia,Shuang Yang,Zhuokai Zhao,Xinying Song,Dongfang Liu,Lifu Huang,Yang Song,Qifan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究递归式harness进化能否在有限、噪声且反复使用的反馈下稳定发现可泛化系统。提出VideoHarness-BRSI并发现三种失效模式，进而提出证据治理框架VideoHarness-SRSI，在四个视频理解基准上显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM系统能力不仅依赖模型参数，还依赖组织信息获取、工具使用、推理与记忆的可执行harness。递归式harness进化可自动化设计，但在有限、噪声、反复重用的反馈下，如何可靠地发现可泛化系统仍不清晰，论文以agentic视频理解为场景研究该问题。

Method: 先提出VideoHarness-BRSI递归自我改进框架，在冻结的视觉语言模型上进化视频harness。分析4000多个候选后发现验证过拟合、搜索预算稀释和早期经验陷阱三种失效模式，其共同根源是同一不完美验证证据同时驱动harness修订与proposer搜索策略。据此提出VideoHarness-SRSI证据治理框架：限制proposer使用无内容反馈、用仪器化预热实验引导探索、在隔离的probe-race分支中开发机制后再做因子组合与联合精炼。

Result: VideoHarness-BRSI与手工设计系统相当。VideoHarness-SRSI在四个视频理解基准上，等权平均留出分数相对BRSI提升6.2%，平均验证-测试差距缩小37.9%。

Conclusion: 可靠的harness进化取决于搜索如何被组织和提供信息，而不仅取决于其优化验证性能的好坏。

Abstract: LLM system capabilities depend not only on model parameters but also on the executable harnesses that organize information acquisition, tool use, reasoning, and memory. Recursive harness evolution can automate their design, but how it can reliably discover generalizable systems from limited, noisy, and repeatedly reused feedback remains unclear. We study this question in agentic video understanding, where rich multimodal evidence and coupled mechanisms make harness optimization challenging. We first introduce VideoHarness-BRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework that evolves video harnesses around a frozen vision-language model. Analyzing over 4,000 evolved candidates, we find it competitive with hand-engineered systems but identify three interconnected failure modes: validation overfitting, search-budget dilution, and the early-experience trap. We trace all three to a common root: the same imperfect validation evidence drives both harness revisions and the proposer's search strategy. We therefore propose VideoHarness-SRSI, an evidence-governed framework in which every search decision rests on evidence that is transferable, sufficient, and gathered before the search commits. It restricts the proposer to content-free feedback, informs exploration with instrumented warm-up experiments, and develops mechanisms in isolated probe-race branches before factorial composition and joint refinement. Across four video understanding benchmarks, VideoHarness-SRSI improves the equally weighted mean held-out score by 6.2% relative to VideoHarness-BRSI and reduces the mean validation-test gap by 37.9%. Reliable harness evolution thus depends on how search is organized and informed, not only on how well it optimizes validation performance.

</details>


### [23] [Learning to Select Features with Manifold Deep Unfolding PCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19436)
*Jingjing Liu,Pei Tai,Xianchao Xiu,Wanquan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MDUFS-Net，将ℓ2,0范数融入PCA，用ADMM展开为端到端可训练网络，并给出ℓ0范数增强版MDUFS-Net+，在无监督特征选择中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督特征选择的基于模型方法依赖人工调参，而深度学习方法需要大量训练数据。

Method: 在经典PCA框架中引入ℓ2,0范数，将基于ADMM的迭代算法展开为端到端可训练网络以实现自动参数学习；发展流形优化策略提升数值鲁棒性；并扩展出引入ℓ0范数的增强版MDUFS-Net+。

Result: 大量实验表明，MDUFS-Net与MDUFS-Net+在无监督特征选择任务上优于现有最先进方法，并在聚类中表现良好。

Conclusion: MDUFS-Net通过深度展开结合流形优化，有效解决了超参数与数据依赖问题，ℓ0范数增强版进一步提升特征判别性。

Abstract: Unsupervised feature selection (UFS) is of great significance in image processing and pattern recognition. Nevertheless, existing model-based methods often rely on manually tuned hyperparameters, while deep learning-based methods generally require massive training data. To address these issues, this paper proposes an efficient manifold deep unfolding feature selection network (MDUFS-Net). Technically, we first incorporate the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm into the classic principal component analysis (PCA) framework, then unfold the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based iterative algorithm into an end-to-end trainable network, thereby enabling automatic parameter learning. Moreover, a manifold optimization strategy is developed to improve the numerical robustness. On this basis, we further extend MDUFS-Net into an enhanced variant called MDUFS-Net+ by introducing the $\ell_{0}$-norm for more discriminative feature representations. Extensive experiments validate that our proposed MDUFS-Net and MDUFS-Net+ outperform state-of-the-art methods in the UFS task, with promising performance in clustering. Our code is available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/MDUFS.

</details>


### [24] [DeBoneDiT: Depth-Driven Conditional Bridge Diffusion Transformers for Bone Suppression in Chest X-Ray Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19466)
*Yifei Sun,Fenglei Fan,Junhao Jia,Wenming Deng,Hongxia Xu,Changmiao Wang,Ruiquan Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeBoneDiT，一种基于深度驱动条件桥扩散Transformer的高效高分辨率骨抑制方法，并发布最大配对数据集SZCH-X-Rays。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸部X线是肺部疾病诊断的主要手段，但骨骼结构重叠会遮挡关键影像特征。双能减影（DES）虽为临床金标准，却受限于专用硬件和高辐射剂量；现有扩散生成模型又面临潜在压缩偏差、先验导致的域间隙及高质量配对数据稀缺等问题。

Method: 1) 提出深度自编码器（DAE），一种结构感知视觉tokenizer，引入来自预训练Depth Anything V2编码器的多级深度特征损失，兼顾视觉保真与结构一致性；2) 将骨抑制建模为源条件布朗桥扩散过程，以CXR同时作为扩散先验和结构引导，缩小源-目标域间隙并保持解剖合理性；3) 构建并发布SZCH-X-Rays数据集。

Result: 构建并公开SZCH-X-Rays数据集，包含741对CXR与DES软组织图像，为目前最大的公开高质量骨抑制配对数据集。大量实验及下游评估表明，DeBoneDiT在更低的计算开销下取得更优的骨抑制性能。

Conclusion: DeBoneDiT通过深度引导的条件桥扩散Transformer架构，有效解决了骨抑制中的结构一致性、域间隙和数据稀缺问题，实现了高效高分辨率骨抑制，并提供了大规模公开数据集以推动该领域研究。

Abstract: Chest X-Ray (CXR) is a primary modality for diagnosing pulmonary diseases, yet the overlap of bony structures often obscures critical radiographic findings, increasing the risk of diagnostic uncertainty. While Dual-Energy Subtraction (DES) is the clinical benchmark for bone suppression, its widespread adoption is primarily hindered by specialized hardware requirements and increased radiation exposure. Recently, diffusion-based generative models have shown promise for this task, yet they are still constrained by reconstruction-biased latent compression, prior-induced domain gap, and a scarcity of high-quality paired datasets. To address these challenges, we propose DeBoneDiT, a depth-driven conditional bridge diffusion Transformer architecture for efficient high-resolution bone suppression. We first introduce Depth Auto-Encoder (DAE), a structure-aware vision tokenizer for latent compression. By incorporating a multi-level depth feature loss derived from the pretrained Depth Anything V2 encoder, DAE preserves both visual fidelity and structural consistency. Second, we formulate bone suppression as a source-conditioned Brownian bridge diffusion process, leveraging CXRs as both the diffusion prior and structural guidance to narrow the source-to-target domain gap and maintain anatomical plausibility. Furthermore, we have constructed and released SZCH-X-Rays, the largest publicly available high-quality paired dataset for bone suppression to date, comprising 741 pairs of CXR and DES soft tissue images. Extensive experiments and downstream evaluation demonstrate that DeBoneDiT achieves superior bone suppression performance with reduced computational overhead.

</details>


### [25] [ActICL: Post-Training for Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19475)
*Yanshu Li,Ruixiang Tang,Junyi Jessy Li,Elias Stengel-Eskin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ActICL 训练一个多模态大模型智能体，通过工具增强推理自主获取并利用 ICL 上下文，实现自适应、按需的示范检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态 ICL 示范检索多采用固定打分一次性检索，易引入冗余与噪声；上下文感知方法虽支持增量检索，但无法让 MLLM 自主学习判断需要何种新示范并自主进行渐进检索。

Method: 提出 ActICL：训练 MLLM 智能体通过工具增强推理获取 ICL 上下文。智能体在迭代推理与工具调用中分析自身信息缺口，据此定向检索初始候选集，再利用已有上下文过滤、精炼候选或迭代新检索；当判断上下文充分或达资源上限且满足用户请求时，将上下文交给答案模型（自身或另一 MLLM）。采用两阶段后训练联合优化"获取"与"回答"。

Result: 在 7 个基准、3 个 MLLM 上，ActICL 以自适应示范数量较标准相似度检索平均提升 11.6 个百分点，较最强基线提升 4.4 个百分点；其获取的上下文可被前沿模型有效使用，GPT-5.6-Sol 做 4-shot ICL 时在三基准上平均较标准检索提升 3.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: 让 MLLM 智能体自主学习并执行渐进式示范检索，可显著优于固定与上下文感知检索策略，且所得上下文具有良好可迁移性。

Abstract: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. It can then use the existing context to further filter the candidates and refine the context, or it can iteratively perform a new retrieval. When the agent judges that the context is sufficient for the task, or when the resource limit is reached with the user request met, it sends the acquired context to an answering model, either the agent itself or another MLLM. We use a two-stage post-training procedure that jointly optimizes the agent's acquisition and answering. With an adaptive number of demonstrations, ActICL improves average performance by 11.6 percentage points over standard similarity-based retrieval across seven benchmarks and three MLLMs, and by 4.4 points compared to the strongest prior baseline. The contexts acquired by ActICL agents can also be used effectively by frontier models. When GPT-5.6-Sol performs 4-shot ICL, ActICL's contexts improve its performance by 3.5 points over standard retrieval, averaged over three benchmarks.

</details>

*Liang Yu,Tao Zhu,Xiangqing Lu,Wenjian Luo,Liming Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究利用简单足底压力和加速度传感器，通过部件解耦时序融合框架，弥补单目人体姿态估计在遮挡和视觉丢失时的不足。

Result: 实验表明，引入简单足部传感器在姿态精度、运动平滑度和步态相关指标上一致优于纯视觉基线，在遮挡和短时视觉丢失下提升最显著。

Conclusion: 无感足部传感在相机观测暂时不可用时提供了重要且互补的物理可观测性。

Abstract: Real-time monocular human pose estimation is an important sensing component for human-centered intelligent systems. While recent camera-based methods have achieved impressive accuracy, fundamental challenges persist, particularly when visual observations are incomplete, such as during lower-body occlusion or short out-of-frame intervals. In these challenging but common scenarios, vision-only systems often struggle to reconstruct physically plausible lower-limb motion and reliable foot-ground contact. Due to the highly unobtrusive and wearable nature of smart insoles, this paper investigates whether simple plantar pressure and acceleration sensors can effectively resolve these visually induced limitations. To systematically investigate this, we first collect a synchronized multimodal dataset and then propose a part-decoupled temporal fusion framework. The proposed model fuses foot-sensing features into the lower-body branch to compensate for incomplete visual evidence, while a lightweight coordinator exchanges information between the upper- and lower-body temporal representations to maintain whole-body consistency. The framework is evaluated with three representative real-time visual backbones based on 2D keypoints, 3D landmarks, and SMPL-based human mesh recovery. We evaluate our framework on three representative real-time visual backbones. Quantitative experiments demonstrate that incorporating simple foot sensors consistently improves pose accuracy, motion smoothness, and gait-related measurements over vision-only baselines, with the most significant gains observed under occlusion and short visual-dropout conditions. Ultimately, our results demonstrate that unobtrusive foot sensing provides vital and complementary physical observability when camera observations are temporarily unavailable.

</details>


### [27] [Holi-Spatial 360: Generative Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramas for Spatial Rendering and Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19502)
*Yuanyuan Gao,Zhirui Liu,Yuning Gong,Yifei Liu,Yifan Zhan,Kuixuan Jiao,Xiaolong Zhou,Yifan Yang,Hongjie Zhang,Xue Yang,Dan Xu,Zhihang Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Holi-Spatial 360 将房地产全景图转化为带标注的多房间3D环境，构建了Holi360数据集和基准，显著提升VLM的空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室内3D数据集多为房间尺度且依赖昂贵LiDAR采集。在线房产平台有大量多房间全景图，但视角稀疏、纹理贫乏，重建约束不足。

Method: 提出生成式重建与数据整理框架：对应引导的几何优化将前馈重建先验转为跨视角约束，构建3D高斯泼溅表示作为空间记忆；再用单图/视频先验恢复外观与轨迹，支持RGB-D渲染，并通过3D grounding与VLM验证自动标注。

Result: Holi360含1K+多房间3DGS场景、10万+实例标注、200万空间问答对；实验显示稀疏全景输入下重建和整理质量优越，微调VLM后空间推理显著提升。

Conclusion: 该框架有效利用稀疏全景图构建高质量多房间3D环境，并提供大规模数据集与基准，推动VLM空间智能发展。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires scalable 3D environments that are both photorealistic and semantically grounded, yet existing indoor datasets are dominated by room-scale captures and costly LiDAR acquisition. Online real-estate platforms offer abundant panoramas of diverse multi-room homes, but sparse viewpoints and texture-poor regions make reconstruction severely under-constrained. We introduce Holi-Spatial 360, a generative reconstruction and data curation framework for converting these panoramas into annotated multi-room 3D environments. Because reconstruction quality bounds subsequent generation, our Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization converts feed-forward reconstruction priors into reliable cross-view constraints and builds a coherent 3D Gaussian Splatting representation as 3D spatial memory. Adapted single-image and video priors then restore appearance and complete continuous trajectories while preserving observed content. The reconstructed scenes support arbitrary RGB-D rendering and an automated curation pipeline that combines end-to-end 3D grounding with VLM-based verification. Holi360 contains over 1K multi-room 3DGS scenes, more than 100K instance annotations, and 2M spatial question-answer pairs. We also introduce the Holi360 benchmark to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in real-world, multi-room indoor environments. Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and curation quality under sparse panoramic inputs, while fine-tuning VLMs on Holi360 substantially improves spatial reasoning capabilities.

</details>


### [28] [Spectral World Renderer: Unified 3D Hyperspectral Unmixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19520)
*Chia-Ming Lee,Yu-Jou Hsiao,Ming-Ching Chang,Xin Li,Yu-Lun Liu,Chih-Chung Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SWR，将3D世界生成与高光谱解混统一：用编码智能体构建带精确标签的可执行3D世界（SWR-Bench，8个室内外场景），并将解混嵌入渲染过程——每个高斯在合成前解码为材质丰度，一次渲染即得光谱与材质图，且支持按材质名/像素/参考光谱查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有相机及基础模型只能识别场景"有什么"，无法判断"由什么材质构成"，同色表面可能是不同材质。3D高光谱解混要么在视图合成后对渲染图像处理，要么依赖缓慢的隐式场，且缺乏已知成分的多视图数据来验证结果。

Method: SWR方法分两部分：(1) 用编码智能体生成可执行3D世界并用实测光谱渲染，使每张高光谱图自带精确标签与亚像素比例，构建含8个室内外世界的SWR-Bench；(2) 在渲染内部解混，将紧凑3D表示（高斯）在合成前解码为材质丰度，从而一次渲染同时产出色谱与材质图，并支持按材质名、点击像素或参考光谱查询任意表面。

Result: 无材质标签时，SWR在全部8个世界中材质识别最优；在真实拍摄数据上取得最佳平均PSNR；训练速度比解混基线快3.7–12.9倍；渲染速度达34.9标注视图/秒；能区分同色不同材质的表面。

Conclusion: SWR将世界生成与高光谱解混统一，在渲染管线内部完成解混，兼顾精确监督、快速训练与渲染，并能区分同色异材质表面，为可验证的3D材质理解提供了基准与方案。

Abstract: Cameras and the foundation models built on them recognize what a 3D scene contains, but not what it is made of: surfaces of the same colour can be different materials. Hyperspectral unmixing explains each spectrum as a mixture of material signatures, yet in 3D it is applied to rendered images after the views are composited, or tied to slow implicit fields, and no multi-view data with known composition exist to check the result. We present the Spectral World Renderer (SWR), which unifies world generation and unmixing. A coding agent builds executable 3D worlds that are rendered with measured spectra, so every hyperspectral image comes with exact labels and sub-pixel proportions; the resulting SWR-Bench provides eight indoor and outdoor worlds in which decompositions can be verified. SWR then unmixes inside rendering: each Gaussian of a compact 3D representation is decoded into material abundances before compositing, so one render yields spectra and material maps, and any surface can be queried by material name, a clicked pixel or a reference spectrum. Without material labels, SWR identifies materials best in all eight worlds, has the best mean PSNR on real captures, trains 3.7-12.9x faster than unmixing baselines, renders 34.9 labelled views/s and separates same-coloured materials.

</details>


### [29] [HyrCap: Hybrid Rank-Calibration of Action Proposals for Temporal Event Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19526)
*Rui Chen,Xingyu Chen,Pengxin Xu,Kai Chen,Junzhi Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HyrCap，一种以提案为中心的查询式时序动作检测框架，通过混合特征与排序校准提升定位与语义理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长未裁剪视频中的时序动作检测存在定位不准、提案质量低的问题，尤其在稀疏标注和边界模糊时。传统TAD管线缺乏对提案定位质量的显式建模、跨表示支持及提案间关系建模，难以支撑开放式视频理解与LLM驱动的事件分析。

Method: HyrCap将密集查询预测视为过完备的时序事件假设空间，包含三个核心组件：跨表示共识校准、定位质量估计、提案冗余抑制。其中"Hybrid"融合具有不同定位线索的互补视频特征，"Rank-Calibration"调整提案排序置信度以反映定位可靠性。并引入面向语义动作理解的HyrCap，将校准后提案用于标准TAD及LLM语义理解输入。定义了分阶段评估协议。

Result: 在公开基准上，HyrCap在多项指标上达到SOTA性能，并为基于查询的事件分割与标注提供了更细粒度的范式与评估协议。

Conclusion: HyrCap通过混合特征与排序校准显著提升提案可靠性与定位质量，并为时序事件理解及LLM集成提供了分阶段评估框架。

Abstract: Temporal action detection in long untrimmed videos suffers from inaccurate localization and low-quality proposals, especially with sparse annotations and ambiguous boundaries. For open-ended video understanding and LLM-driven event analysis, reliable proposals connect temporal localization, event annotation, and semantic understanding. However, conventional temporal action detection (TAD) pipelines lack explicit modeling of proposal localization quality, cross-representation support, and inter-proposal relations. We propose Hybrid Rank-Calibration of Action Proposals (HyrCap), a proposal-centric query-based TAD framework for temporal event understanding. Hybrid combines complementary video features with different localization cues, while Rank-Calibration adjusts proposal ranking confidence to reflect localization reliability and candidate competition. HyrCap treats dense query-based predictions as an over-complete temporal event hypothesis space. Cross-Representation Consensus Calibration, Localization Quality Estimation, and Proposal Redundancy Suppression improve proposal ranking reliability, localization quality, and candidate discrimination. Inspired by LLMs' capabilities in fine-grained semantic recognition, event description, and reasoning, we introduce HyrCap for Semantic Action Understanding, using calibrated proposals for standard TAD and as inputs to LLM-based semantic understanding. We define a staged evaluation protocol to separately measure event localization, segment-level semantic understanding, and combined event understanding performance. Experiments on public benchmarks show that HyrCap achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics and provides a finer-grained paradigm and evaluation protocol for query-based event segmentation and annotation.

</details>


### [30] [Reducing the Gap Between Spatial and Space-Filling Curve Neighbors in 3D Point Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19530)
*Konan Sasaki,Junya Komori,Kazuhiro Hotta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种损失函数，缓解空间填充曲线(SFC)邻近关系与欧氏空间不一致的间隙，用于3D点云分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于空间填充曲线的3D点云最近邻搜索轻量且准确，但SFC上的邻近关系与原欧氏空间存在间隙，影响特征学习。

Method: 计算SFC上相邻点之间的距离，训练模型优化在原3D空间中相距较远的点对之间的特征相似度，并将该方法嵌入高性能3D点云分割模型。

Result: 在三个数据集上评估，室内与室外点云数据集上均优于传统方法。

Conclusion: 所提损失函数有效缩小SFC间隙带来的影响，提升3D点云分割性能。

Abstract: As a lightweight and highly accurate method for nearest-neighbor search in 3D point clouds, approaches based on space-filling curves (SFC) have been proposed. However, due to the inherent properties of SFC, a gap arises between proximity relationships along the SFC and those in the original Euclidean space. In this study, we propose a loss function that reduces the influence of this gap. Specifically, we compute the distances between adjacent points along the SFC and train the model to optimize feature similarity between pairs of points that are distant from each other in the original 3D space. We incorporate the proposed method into a high-performing 3D point cloud segmentation model and evaluate its effectiveness on three datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional methods on both indoor and outdoor point cloud datasets.

</details>


### [31] [RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19538)
*Huiping Ren,Shuai Wan,Luqian Bai,Zhang Chen,Fuzheng Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RDCompGS通过将可微编码码率估计纳入率失真优化，实现3DGS的整体率失真优化，在HEVC和JPEG XL上分别降低BD-Rate 37.84%和49.31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽能实现高质量实时新视角合成，但存储与传输开销大。将高斯属性映射到2D可用图像编解码器压缩，然而现有方法对渲染质量相近的高斯表征在优化时同等对待，忽略其编码码率差异，导致压缩后率失真性能受限。

Method: 提出RDCompGS：1）将编码码率的可微估计引入率失真优化，与渲染失真联合优化；2）引入码率约束调整模型，调节不同压缩条件下的率失真权衡。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，使用H.265/HEVC和JPEG XL分别实现平均BD-Rate降低37.84%和49.31%；估计码率与不同压缩条件下的实际比特率高度相关。

Conclusion: 整体率失真优化可显著提升3DGS压缩效率，验证了码率估计与真实比特率的相关性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bjøntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.

</details>


### [32] [Cross-Scenario Industrial Defect Detection via Domain-Robust Training and Metric-Aligned Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19540)
*Dikai Li,Weijia Wang,Yuan-Gen Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨场景缺陷检测方法，应对IDA 2026 Track 1挑战，含四个互补模块，测试集Track 1得分0.564。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业板缺陷检测需在光照、表面污染物、产线条件变化下保持高可靠，是领域泛化问题，需在未见场景中检测、定位、分类缺陷并减少误报。

Method: 四个模块：跨场景鲁棒训练（鲁棒归一化、DSU统计扰动、渐进随机卷积）、小缺陷感知学习（NWD、无参空间注意力、VFL目标）、分数校准与推理阈值选择、指标对齐的checkpoint选择（自定义SWAD变体）。

Result: 单张RTX 4090 GPU上，测试集Track 1得分0.564，screening得分0.696。

Conclusion: 所提方法在跨场景工业板缺陷检测中取得有效性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Automated defect detection of industrial boards must remain highly reliable under cross-scenario variations in lighting, surface contaminants, and production line conditions. This makes cross-scenario defect detection a domain generalization problem, wherein models are required to detect, localize, and classify defects across unseen scenarios while minimizing false alarms on clean boards. For the IDA 2026 Track 1 challenge, we propose a cross-scenario defect detection method that includes four complementary modules: cross-scenario robust training, small-defect-aware learning, score calibration and inference threshold selection, and metric-aligned checkpoint selection. These four modules respectively introduce cross-scenario robust normalization and DSU-style statistic perturbation with progressive random convolution, NWD and parameter-free spatial attention, the VFL learning objective, and a custom SWAD variant driven by the Track 1-oriented proxy. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves a Track 1 score of 0.564 with a screening score of 0.696 on the test dataset on a single RTX 4090 GPU. The code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/Dikai.

</details>


### [33] [TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19551)
*Yiyang Chen,Guo-Hua Wang,Yaoli Liu,Qing-Guo Chen,Zhao Xu,Weihua Luo,Xiujun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出目标条件下的文本渲染验证器 TEXTVERIFIER，用 IDS 序列替代单字符符号，检测生成中文图像的局部字符渲染缺陷，并构建基准 TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生图模型生成的汉字常出现多笔画、少笔画或部件畸形等局部缺陷，而 OCR 与通用 VLM 面向识别训练，对这类结构性偏差不敏感，导致错误难以被发现。

Method: 将文本渲染验证形式化为目标条件问题：给定目标字符与图像裁剪，判断是否正确渲染。TEXTVERIFIER 向文本塔输入汉字的表意描述序列（IDS）而非单字符符号，并在 1270 万裁剪-IDS 对及从文本区域修复模型训练轨迹采样的“同字符、不同质量”无标签困难对上训练。

Result: 在自建的 TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH（首个逐字符生成中文文本基准，标注 7358 个字符的位置、身份与正确性）上，TEXTVERIFIER 达 F1=0.844，显著优于 OCR 置信度（0.526）、通用 VLM（0.329）和 TextPecker（0.590）。

Conclusion: TEXTVERIFIER 作为 Flow-GRPO 后训练的逐字符奖励可进一步降低渲染错误，表明其评分既能检测也能纠正渲染缺陷。

Abstract: Text-to-image models increasingly generate readable Chinese text that still contains local rendering defects, such as a character with an extra or missing stroke or a malformed component. Such errors are invisible to OCR and vision-language models, which are trained for recognition and are therefore invariant to the very structural deviations that define a rendering error. We formalize text rendering verification as a target-conditioned problem: given a target character and an image crop, decide whether the crop is a correct rendering of that character. Our verifier TEXTVERIFIER feeds the text tower a character's Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) rather than a single-character symbol, and is trained on 12.7M crop-IDS pairs plus label-free "same-character, different-quality" hard pairs sampled from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. To evaluate this ability we build TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH, the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text, annotating position, identity, and correctness for 7,358 characters. TEXTVERIFIER reaches an F1 of 0.844, far above OCR confidence (0.526), a general VLM (0.329), and TextPecker (0.590). Used as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO post-training, it further reduces rendering errors, showing that its score can both detect and correct errors.

</details>


### [34] [Learning Visual Speech Representations via Cross-Modal Distillation and Joint Face-Lip Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19559)
*Jing-Xuan Zhang,Genshun Wan,Jianqing Gao,Jia Pan,Yumei Zhang,Lichen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FLARE：通过跨模态蒸馏与联合面部-唇部建模，学习鲁棒的视觉语音表征，在LRS2/LRS3/WildVSR上取得强唇读性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 唇读因视觉语音线索的固有歧义性以及对头部姿态和视频分辨率的敏感性而具挑战性。

Method: 以Whisper作为声学教师信号，经随机投影量化器转为离散蒸馏目标，用掩码预测预训练；采用双流架构联合处理唇部ROI与全脸输入；预训练时引入辅助音频进行跨模态对齐，并用模态dropout鼓励纯视觉表征；下游用轻量Transformer或LLM解码器作视觉编码器。

Result: 在LRS2、LRS3和域外WildVSR上词错误率分别为11.7%、13.2%和34.3%；消融研究验证各组件贡献。

Conclusion: 联合面部-唇部建模提升了对低分辨率和大幅头部姿态变化的鲁棒性，并产生更具音素区分性的视觉表征。

Abstract: Lipreading remains challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of visual speech cues and their sensitivity to head pose and video resolution. In this work, we propose FLARE, a framework for robust visual speech representation learning via cross-modal distillation and joint face-lip modeling. FLARE leverages semantically rich Whisper representations as the acoustic teacher signal, converting them into discrete distillation targets through a random-projection quantizer and pretraining the model with a masked prediction objective. To capture complementary visual information, FLARE employs a dual-stream architecture that jointly processes lip region-of-interest (ROI) and full-face inputs, where the lip stream captures finegrained articulatory motion and the face stream encodes broader facial dynamics. During pretraining, auxiliary audio input is incorporated to facilitate cross-modal alignment, and modality dropout is applied to encourage robust visual-only representations. For downstream lipreading, FLARE serves as a visual encoder coupled with either a lightweight Transformer decoder or an LLM-based decoder. Evaluated on LRS2, LRS3, and the out-of-domain WildVSR benchmark, FLARE achieves strong lipreading performance, with word error rates of 11.7%, 13.2%, and 34.3%, respectively. A progressive design study confirms the contribution of each major component. Further analyses demonstrate that joint face-lip modeling improves robustness under degraded video resolution and large head pose variation, while yielding more phoneme-discriminative visual representations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/jxzhanggg/FLARE.

</details>


### [35] [SaTPO: Text-to-Image Safety Alignment via Transition Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19563)
*Ziyi Fang,Jingzhi Li,Xiaojun Jia,Xingxing Wei,Wenqi Ren,Haijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SaTPO方法，在去噪过程中逐步对齐文本到图像扩散模型的安全性，实现安全与质量更好的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于完整图像的偏好信号将多维生成因素压缩为粗糙信号，可能导致超出安全需求的行为偏移，损害生成能力。

Method: SaTPO利用不安全提示与其安全重写在共享父状态和噪声实现下形成紧密偏好对，将优化锚定于相同父状态以消除轨迹分歧，结合多尺度漂移约束和良性重放，并构建视觉验证数据集CoProPV。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.5和SDXL上，相比AlignGuard，PerspectiveVision不安全检测率从12.70%降至6.00%、15.04%降至9.30%，FID从32.28改善至25.95、36.50改善至27.51。

Conclusion: SaTPO通过逐步去噪对齐有效提升安全性并保持生成质量，实现更优的安全-质量权衡。

Abstract: Safety alignment of text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress harmful content without compromising useful generation capabilities. However, preferences over completed images compress multidimensional generation factors into a coarse signal, potentially driving changes beyond those required for safety. To address this, we propose Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO), which enforces step-wise alignment during denoising. SaTPO leverages the insight that an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite naturally form a tightly coupled preference pair when conditioned on a shared parent state and noise realization. By anchoring optimization on identical parent states, SaTPO eliminates historical trajectory divergence, confining safety adaptation to an incremental alignment while preserving task-relevant semantics. Multi-scale drift constraints and benign replay further limit behavioral deviation and preserve ordinary generation. Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection (AD) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of anomalous samples, making high-fidelity anomaly synthesis crucial for improving downstream performance. Abstract: Single-image 3D reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet standalone garments remain challenging due to thin-shell geometry, open boundaries, and layered structures. </details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直觉认为flow matching等迭代采样器适合视觉推理（每步采样类似一步推理），但作者想从复杂性理论角度检验这一直觉是否正确。

Abstract: Recent work has explored visual reasoning through image generation, where models solve visual-reasoning problems by directly generating solution images. Intuitively, iterative samplers such as flow matching are well suited to this task, since each sampling step may resemble one reasoning step. However, in this work, from a circuit complexity perspective, we show that this intuition is misleading. We prove that as long as the model outputs satisfy certain mild regularity conditions, the trajectory of the vanilla flow-matching sampler can be simulated by a constant number of sequential rounds of parallel model evaluations. Consequently, additional sampling steps cannot increase the expressive power of a constant-depth backbone model under the standard complexity-theoretic model of transformers. We then reveal that self-conditioning, which conditions the model on the previous step's estimate of the final image, plays a previously unrecognized role in removing this bottleneck. Controlled experiments on diverse visual-reasoning tasks show that flow matching with self-conditioning achieves higher accuracy and greater reasoning depth than vanilla flow matching, and its performance improves with more sampling steps. Theoretically, we prove that with self-conditioning, a constant-depth backbone can achieve expressive power equivalent to that of space-bounded Turing machines. Our study suggests a design principle for future visual reasoning research: carry more information between sampling steps, so that additional steps translate into deeper reasoning.

</details>

Abstract: Accurately delineating Arctic coastal polynyas from sea ice concentration data remains challenging because of complex coastal geometry and spatially heterogeneous ice conditions. We develop a daily sea ice concentration (SIC) mapping framework based on hierarchical partitioning, connected-component analysis, and differentiated region growing for polynya and open-water regions. Applied to September-May ice seasons from 2002/03 to 2024/25, the framework achieves a mean overall accuracy of 96.74% and a mean kappa coefficient of 0.93 in the 63-scene visual assessment. Sensitivity experiments reveal a consistent pattern: the absolute magnitude of SIC-defined polynya extent is strongly configuration-dependent, whereas major temporal features are comparatively more stable. Relative to a 75% upper SIC threshold, seasonal extent integrals differ by 13.48%, 32.47%, and 65.04% at thresholds of 80%, 85%, and 90%, respectively, while the broad interannual structure remains recognizable. The response is also strongly regional and seasonal, with the largest threshold sensitivity in the Central Arctic Ocean, very weak sensitivity in the Gulf of St. Lawrence, and greater pan-Arctic curve separation from January onward. At an 80% threshold, product-comparison MAPE is 68.19% between the 6.25 and 25 km products and 11.47% between the 12.5 and 25 km products under their respective comparison periods and reference definitions. Regional product disagreement is likewise heterogeneous. Together, these results show that reproducible long-term polynya monitoring requires a fixed and explicitly documented combination of SIC product, threshold, and spatial classification rules, while broad temporal patterns can remain informative even when absolute extent differs substantially.

</details>

Abstract: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MicroSDF，基于微表面理论统一建模反射与非反射表面，实现高保真3D重建。

  <summary>Details</summary>
