Abstract: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: (i) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; (ii) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and (iii) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.

</details>


### [47] [SceneAE: Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Queryable 3D-Anchored Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19708)
*Shuofeng Sun,Wenzhao Zheng,Yunpeng Zhang,Yi Wu,Linqing Zhao,Haibin Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SceneAE，将场景表示为紧凑且非结构化的 3D 锚定隐空间（每个隐点结合显式 3D 位置与隐式内容特征），可直接用于重建与生成，在生成质量、计算成本与相机可控性上取得更优表现。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an
  explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a
  sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our
  representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For
  reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory.
  For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and
  then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera
  controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.

</details>


### [48] [No Way To Steal My Face: Proactive Defense Against Identity-Preserving Personalized Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19717)
*Lizhi Xiong,Jun Li,Ziqiang Li,Weiwei Jiang,Zhangjie Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IDGuardian提出首个可泛化、模型无关的身份保护框架，通过对抗扰动同时破坏身份提取与注入两个阶段，防御基于训练和免训练两类个性化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型实现高保真身份保持生成，但依赖敏感人脸参考图引发隐私担忧。现有防御主要针对基于训练的个性化，难以泛化到免训练方法，因两者身份整合范式根本不同。

Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-fidelity, identity-preserving image generation for personalized applications such as digital avatars and virtual try-on systems. However, their reliance on sensitive facial reference images raises growing privacy concerns. Existing defense mechanisms are primarily designed for training-based personalization and struggle to generalize to emerging training-free approaches, due to fundamental differences in their identity integration paradigms. To bridge this gap, we propose IDGuardian-the first generalizable and model-agnostic identity protection framework capable of defending against both training-based and training-free personalization methods. IDGuardian abstracts the personalization process into two critical stages: identity extraction and identity injection. It then introduces crafted adversarial perturbations to simultaneously disrupt both stages. Specifically, it degrades the identity features extracted by external encoders and establishes an adversarial conceptual bridge that misdirects the generative trajectory away from the target identity. Extensive experiments show that IDGuardian effectively protects identity across various personalization pipelines and model architectures, while remaining robust to post-processing, adaptive attacks, and cross-dataset generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian.git.

</details>


### [49] [Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19726)
*XGEN Team,Guohao Cai,Haoxuan Che,Frank Fan,Chenran Huang,Junjia Huang,Jiayi Jiang,Yanheng Li,Leon Liu,Shaoteng Liu,Xi Liu,Feng Nie,Zhefan Rao,An Wang,Hanwen Wang,Pengxiang Yan,Jieming Yu,Qian Zha,Wentao Zheng*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We present a Generative World Simulation framework that couples persistent shared world state with continuous first-person audiovisual generation. The framework integrates DAO, a computable world engine, and JING, an Egocentric Interactive Experience Model, to support sustained interaction for humans and agents. DAO maintains the states of characters, objects, and spaces and their relationships, advancing the world according to interaction rules and world time while preserving the consequences of past actions. From this evolving state, DAO derives observer-specific conditions for JING, which combines these conditions with character, object, and scene references, observation history, and current actions to generate each observer's audiovisual experience. Users can explore environments, manipulate objects, and communicate with characters through viewpoint control and text instructions, with their actions shaping both the shared state and subsequent experiences. By connecting world-state evolution with experience generation in a continuous interaction loop, the framework offers an approach to building interactive worlds that retain their history, evolve through action, and persist beyond any individual observer.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ARP-CD，一种免训练框架，通过在表征空间构建对比负样本，利用注意力引导的扰动降低视觉依赖，从而缓解视频大语言模型的幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频大语言模型常生成缺乏视频依据的回答，现有对比解码方法依赖预定义扰动或基于问题重构的掩码，对模型视觉依赖的控制有限。

Conclusion: 注意力引导的表征扰动可生成有效负样本，为纠正原始预测提供对比参考，证明该方法在缓解视频幻觉方面的有效性。

Abstract: Video large language models (Video LLMs) often generate responses unsupported by the input video. Contrastive decoding (CD) can mitigate these hallucinations, but its effectiveness depends on how the negative branch weakens visual evidence. Existing methods rely on predefined perturbations or masking guided by question reconstruction, offering limited control over the model's visual reliance during answer generation. We introduce Attention-guided Representation Perturbation for Contrastive Decoding (ARP-CD), a training-free framework for constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space. ARP-CD uses the attention mass assigned to visual tokens at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates of the language model's input visual hidden states. These updates reduce visual attention and produce a negative input, whose predictions are contrasted with those of the original branch throughout generation. </details>


### [51] [A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19729)
*Hao-Jen Chien,Wei-Lun Chao,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文揭示单目世界空间人体恢复在快速相机运动下产生漂移的根本原因，并提出免训练闭式校正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目世界空间人体恢复方法在常规基准上表现优异，但基准缺乏快速相机运动。在广播舞蹈视频（快速大幅相机运动+多人密集编舞）中，方法虽能生成合理的逐帧网格，但世界空间轨迹漂移严重，偏离表演者真实舞台位置。

Method: 提出K-Pop压力测试数据集。系统诊断发现相机与人体估计各自自洽，但组合时存在尺度不匹配：两者各自在自身尺度下恢复，导致相机运动被错误转化为随相机位移增长的人体漂移。据此推导闭式校正，估计该尺度失配并对所有表演者施加统一尺度，同时保持其共享世界坐标系中的相对位置。方法无需重训练，可与现有后端兼容，并结合物理约束。

Result: 校正消除了漂移，在保留表演者相对位置的同时实现稳定的世界空间重建，支持编舞建模、场景编辑、数据生成与虚拟重拍等应用。

Conclusion: 相机与人体尺度失配是世界空间漂移的关键原因，闭式尺度校正可无需训练地解决该问题，为快速相机运动下的多人世界空间重建提供实用方案。

Abstract: Monocular world-space human recovery methods excel on current benchmarks, but these rarely include fast camera motion. We introduce the K-Pop stress test, broadcast dance videos that combine fast, large camera motion with dense multi-person choreography. Leading methods produce plausible per-frame meshes on these videos, yet their world-space trajectories drift far from the performers' stage positions. Through a systematic diagnosis, we show that the camera and human estimates each remain self-consistent, and that the drift appears when they are combined at mismatched scales. Each is recovered at its own scale, so a mismatch between the two can turn camera motion into human drift that grows with camera displacement and becomes severe in broadcast dance videos. We derive a closed-form correction that estimates this mismatch and applies one scale to all performers, removing the drift while keeping their relative positions in one shared world frame. It requires no retraining and works with existing backends. Combined with physical constraints, the correction yields stable world-space reconstruction for choreography modeling, scene editing, data generation, and virtual reshooting.

</details>


### [52] [Object Pose from 2-D to 3-D Point and Line Correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19734)
*Thai Quynh Phong,Radu Horaud,Adnan Yassine,Pham Dinh Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用对偶四元数表示旋转与平移，将相机与3D物体间位姿估计的误差函数化为二次形式，并用信赖域方法最小化，实验验证其鲁棒性优于Newton法、Faugeras-Toscani线性法和Levenberg-Marquardt法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从点/线对应关系估计相机与3D物体之间的旋转和平移是位姿估计的核心问题。已有方法（如Newton法）求解困难，急需一种更优的误差建模与优化方式。

Method: 用对偶四元数（dual number quaternion）表示旋转与平移，构造误差函数，使该函数具有二次性质；随后采用信赖域（trust-region）优化方法进行最小化，并详细讨论其计算细节。

Result: 与Newton法、Faugeras-Toscani相机标定线性法、Levenberg-Marquardt非线性优化法相比，所提方法表现更优；实验表明其对图像噪声和匹配误差具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 基于对偶四元数的二次误差函数配合信赖域优化，为点/线对应的位姿估计提供了一个鲁棒且优于现有主流方法的解决方案。

Abstract: In this paper we present a method for optimally estimating the rotation and translation between a camera and a 3-D object from point and/or line correspondences. First we devise an error function and second we show how to minimize this error function. The quadratic nature of this function is made possible by representing rotation and translation with a dual number quaternion. We provide a detailed account of the computational aspects of a trust-region optimization method. This method compares favourably with Newton's method which has extensively been used to solve the problem at hand, with Faugeras-Toscani linear method [6] for calibrating a camera, and with the Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear optimization method. Finally we present some experimental results which demonstrate the robustness of our method with respect to image noise and matching errors.

</details>


### [53] [HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19742)
*Annie Bhalla,Dennis Rotondi,Riccardo Giubilato,Kai O. Arras,Wolfgang Stuerzl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperLoop，首个将高光谱成像(HSI)集成到 3DGS-SLAM 回环检测的框架，引入 BoSW 与 PCAK-VLAD 两种光谱描述子。但在月球-火星模拟场地实测中，红-近红外(600-860nm)对岩石地形区分力有限，最佳融合仅达 5.04cm ATE RMSE，与单用 SIFT-VLAD(4.95cm)差距 1.8%，表明 HSI 融合贡献甚微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行星漫游车自主导航面临视觉重复、无特征地形的挑战。基于 3DGS 的 SLAM 虽能稠密建图，但依赖 RGB 外观描述子，在感知混淆(perceptual aliasing)下退化严重——这是外星环境中物理不同但视觉相同位置的常见失败模式，故需引入材质级光谱信息增强回环检测鲁棒性。

Method: 将高光谱成像集成进 3DGS-SLAM 的回环模块，提出两类 HSI 描述子：BoSW(经 TF-IDF 加权的光谱材质分布直方图)与 PCAK-VLAD(PCA 压缩光谱特征的一阶残差统计)；与 SIFT-VLAD、NetVLAD 两种 RGB 描述子在 Strict-AND 和 Weighted 融合策略下对比；数据集为 DLR 月球-火星户外测试场(MMOTS)采集的同步 RGB-D 与高光谱序列，含四条行星类比路线(共 65.5m)。

Result: 传感器 600-860nm 红-近红外范围对岩石地形区分力有限：最佳 HSI 融合(SIFT-VLAD+BoSW, Strict-AND) ATE RMSE 为 5.04cm，与单用 SIFT-VLAD(4.95cm)仅差 1.8%；相较 NetVLAD(8.81cm)的提升主要来自 SIFT-VLAD 本身，而非 HSI 融合。

Conclusion: 当前红-近红外 HSI 对行星类比岩石地形的回环贡献有限，建议未来行星 SLAM 任务采用可捕获诊断性矿物吸收特征的短波红外(SWIR)传感器。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation of planetary rovers is challenged by visually repetitive, featureless terrain. SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offer dense mapping but rely on RGB appearance descriptors that degrade under perceptual aliasing - a common failure mode in extraterrestrial environments where physically distinct locations appear visually identical. This paper presents HyperLoop, the first framework integrating hyperspectral imaging (HSI) into the loop closure module of a 3DGS-based SLAM system. Hyperspectral descriptors encode material-level spectral signatures complementing RGB features, providing robustness to illumination changes and visual repetitiveness. Two HSI descriptor families are introduced: Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW), encoding spectral material distributions via TF-IDF weighted histograms, and PCA-K VLAD (PCAK-VLAD), capturing first-order residual statistics of PCA-compressed spectral signatures. Both are evaluated with SIFT-VLAD and NetVLAD RGB descriptors under Strict-AND and Weighted fusion strategies on a custom dataset from the Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site (MMOTS) at DLR, comprising synchronized RGB-D and hyperspectral sequences across four planetary analog traverses (65.5 m total). A key finding is that the sensor's Red-NIR range (600-860 nm) provides limited discriminability for rock terrain: the best HSI fusion (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) achieves 5.04 cm ATE RMSE, within 1.8% of SIFT-VLAD alone (4.95 cm). The gain over NetVLAD (8.81 cm) is attributable to SIFT-VLAD, not HSI fusion. This motivates future adoption of SWIR sensors capturing diagnostic mineral absorption features absent from the 600-860 nm range for planetary SLAM missions.

</details>


### [54] [Discriminative Score Function: Turning Pretrained Models into Functional Generative Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19743)
*Junhoo Lee,Hyeonjin Kim,Sangbum Han,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出判别式得分函数（DSF），从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间的生成场，无需重训练即可实现无条件/条件生成与零样本量化校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判别模型虽以分类、检测或表示学习等任务目标训练，但其实际效用依赖对同域未见样本的泛化，暗示模型可能隐含保留了数据流形的痕迹。作者追问：这种痕迹能否在无任务特定指导下被显式揭示为生成信号。

Method: 提出 DSF，从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间生成场，提供免训练的更新规则，将图像移向模型一致的视觉区域，无需重训练或任务特定目标。可应用于 ResNet 分类器、DETR 检测器、DINOv2 ViT 编码器。

Result: DSF 能从噪声生成无条件图像，并支持条件引导、编辑、修复与解释；其生成样本在无真实图像或标签时可有效用于零样本量化校准，比无数据校准基线更好地保持特征几何。

Conclusion: 结果表明判别式训练留下了可用于合成与校准的生成功能信号。

Abstract: Discriminative models are trained with task-specific objectives such as classification, detection, or representation learning, yet their practical utility depends on generalizing beyond the training task to unseen samples from the same domain. This suggests that a discriminative model may retain an implicit trace of the data manifold beyond its task labels. We ask whether this trace can be exposed as a generative signal without task-specific guidance. We introduce the Discriminative Score Function (DSF), which extracts an image-space generative field from the loss-gradient geometry of a pretrained discriminative model. DSF provides a training-free update rule that moves images toward model-consistent visual regions without retraining or task-specific targets. We apply DSF to diverse pretrained discriminative models, including ResNet classifiers, DETR detectors, and DINOv2 ViT encoders. DSF generates unconditional images from noise and supports conditional guidance, editing, inpainting, and explanation through the same field. DSF-generated samples also provide effective zero-shot quantization calibration when real images or labels are unavailable, preserving feature geometry better than data-free calibration baselines. These results show that discriminative training leaves a generative functional signal for synthesis and calibration. Project page: https://junhoo.me/dsf.

</details>


### [55] [Physics-Shaped, Not Physical: Auditing Physics-Guided Underwater Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19763)
*Mochamad Rizal Fauzan,Irgi Surya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 审计PhysGuide-Net发现：物理模块在全量数据下无零样本增益却增3.4倍FLOPs；仅在少样本时有效，但收益源于"物理形状的归纳偏置"而非真实物理机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理引导的水下图像复原网络声称预测透射率与后向散射并反演成像模型，但很少检验这些物理成分是否真正起作用。作者旨在系统审计一个代表性设计，检验物理约束的实际贡献。

Method: 对PhysGuide-Net进行四组受控实验：(1) UIEB上五种子消融，并在完整LSUI(4279对)和AUIED3K(3000对)上零样本评估；(2) 数据效率研究，配以去除成像模型的容量匹配对照；(3) 在Sea-thru上用实测距离验证预测map；(4) 分析退化严重度影响及单次消融的可复现性。

Result: 全量800图时物理模块无零样本增益(PSNR差≤0.16dB，95%区间含零)，FLOPs增3.4倍。80图时增益较大(UIEB +0.65dB，AUIED3K +1.48dB)，但校正后不显著，对照无法复现。预测透射率与距离的相关性不强于其他图像的range map(合并差+0.02)，Beer-Lambert拟合仅解释0.4%方差。模块效应随数据集退化程度改变符号。

Conclusion: 物理模块的收益来自物理形状的归纳偏置而非物理本身。单次运行消融可能符号反转，且存在使损失消融失效的实现缺陷，呼吁对物理引导方法进行更严格验证。

Abstract: Physics-guided networks for underwater image restoration predict transmission and backscatter and invert the image-formation model, yet rarely test whether this physics does any work. We audit one representative design, PhysGuide-Net, with four controlled experiments: five-seed ablations on UIEB with zero-shot evaluation on the complete LSUI (4279 pairs) and AUIED3K (3000 pairs) sets; a data-efficiency study with a capacity-matched control that removes the formation model; and a validation of the predicted maps against measured range on Sea-thru. With all 800 training images the physics module gives no zero-shot gain (mean PSNR differences of at most 0.16 dB; all 95% intervals include zero) at 3.4x the FLOPs. With 80 images it helps more (+0.65 dB on UIEB, +1.48 dB on AUIED3K; seed-to-seed s.d. on AUIED3K from 1.3 to 0.5 dB), although not individually significant after correction, and the control does not reproduce this (0.8-1.0 dB lower). Yet the predicted transmission does not behave like a physical quantity: its correlation with range is no stronger than for the range map of a different image (pooled difference +0.02, versus -0.06 for the dark-channel prior), and a Beer-Lambert fit explains 0.4% of its variance. The effect of the module also changes sign with degradation severity between datasets. The benefit thus comes from a physics-shaped inductive bias, not from physics. We further show that single-run ablations can reverse sign and document implementation defects that invalidate loss ablations.

</details>


### [56] [Q-MAGIC: Quad-only Mesh Autoregressive Generation via Singularity-Aware Circular Relative Offset Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19777)
*Yuming Zhao,Zezeng Li,Weimin Wang,Xiang Wu,Na Lei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Q-MAGIC自回归模型生成纯四边形网格，通过奇异点感知序列化和环形相对偏移token化，实现更紧凑序列并提升几何保真度与网格质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四边形网格相比三角形有更严格的拓扑约束，自回归方法将网格生成转为下一面预测时，四边形的序列化和反序列化连通重建更具挑战性。

Method: 设计面向四边形网格的序列化方案，要求下一面至少含两个新顶点；提出奇异点感知序列化，从奇异点优先布线以获得更连贯遍历；提出环形相对偏移token化编码几何；基于该表示用自回归Transformer进行下一token预测。

Result: 大量实验表明Q-MAGIC生成的序列更紧凑，在几何保真度和网格质量上持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: Q-MAGIC有效解决了四边形网格自回归生成中的序列化与连通重建难题，实现了高质量纯四边形网格生成。

Abstract: Autoregressive models have proven effective for triangular mesh generation by transforming it into predicting the next face, converting the non-differentiable connectivity prediction into a sequence of token predictions. However, generating quad-only meshes remains challenging because quad faces impose stricter topological constraints than triangles. The model must not only serialize quad faces into a valid token sequence, but also support unambiguous connectivity reconstruction during de-serialization. To address this, we propose Q-MAGIC, a novel autoregressive model for quad mesh generation. We first introduce a tailored serialization scheme for quad meshes, which requires at least two new vertices for the next face and is less flexible than triangles due to strict wiring constraints. To meet these requirements and reduce serialization length, we propose a singularity-aware serialization that prioritizes wiring from singular points, leading to more coherent traversals. Additionally, we propose a circular relative offset tokenization that encodes geometry mainly via local relative offsets. Built upon this representation, an autoregressive Transformer learns the underlying distribution of quad meshes via next-token prediction, enabling effective quad mesh generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-MAGIC produces more compact sequences while consistently improving geometric fidelity and mesh quality compared to state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [57] [FPV-CRASH: A Dataset for Offline Crash Moment Localization in Drone First-Person-View Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19785)
*Jifan Zhang,Tingyu Wang,Qian Liu,Zhedong Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出FPV-CRASH数据集与固定协议评估，用于无人机FPV视频中离线"坠机瞬间定位"任务，并提供基于热力图的参考模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有坠机视频数据集多针对监控或行车记录仪，其标注方案与任务形式不适合无人机FPV视频中主要物理冲击的时间定位，存在数据集缺口。

Method: 构建FPV-CRASH数据集：1,052个无人机FPV片段（526 Crash/526 Normal），Crash片段带单帧坠机时刻标注，每片段配四条自动生成的英文描述；Normal片段无时间目标，仅作训练期背景监督。描述支持辅助的文本到视频检索任务，定位推理仅用视频。另提出基于热力图的参考模型，从稀疏采样帧估计连续坠机时刻。

Result: 在固定、非源不相交的片段级协议下，参考模型将MAE从最强固定时间先验基线的1.12s降至0.56s（相对降低50%），MedAE为0.33s；0.5s内定位比例从37.14%升至65.71%。

Conclusion: 发布内容含标注、可用源视频标识与URL、裁剪元数据、固定划分列表及预处理代码，可在不重新分发源素材的前提下重建可报告部分；提交时所有源汇编URL仍可访问。

Abstract: Crash Moment Localization aims to localize the major physical impact that interrupts controlled flight in an onboard first-person-view (FPV) video recorded by a drone, thereby providing a temporal reference for retrospective crash analysis in aerial robotics. However, existing crash-video datasets predominantly target surveillance or dash-camera footage, and their annotation schemes and task formulations are not designed for temporal localization of the major physical impact in UAV onboard FPV videos. To address this gap, we present FPV-CRASH, a dataset and fixed-protocol reference evaluation for offline Crash Moment Localization in drone FPV videos. FPV-CRASH contains 1,052 drone FPV clips (526 Crash and 526 Normal); each Crash clip has a single-frame reference annotation for the Crash Moment, and every clip is paired with four English captions automatically generated from sampled frames and the known Crash/Normal label. Normal clips carry no timestamp target and provide training-time background supervision. The captions support an auxiliary Text-to-Video Retrieval task, whereas localization inference remains video-only. We further provide a heatmap-based reference model that estimates a continuous Crash Moment timestamp from sparsely sampled frames. Under the fixed, non-source-disjoint clip-level protocol, the reference model reduces MAE from 1.12 s for the strongest fixed timing-prior baseline to 0.56 s (a 50% relative reduction) and achieves a median absolute error (MedAE) of 0.33 s; the fraction of clips localized within 0.5 s rises from 37.14% to 65.71%. The release includes annotations, available source video identifiers and URLs, clipping metadata, fixed split lists, and preprocessing code so that the reportable portion can be reconstructed without redistributing source footage. At submission time, all source-compilation URLs remained accessible.

</details>


### [58] [LiFi: LiDAR Generation from Multi-View Images via Geometric and Semantic Collaborative Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19786)
*Sizhuo Zhou,Xiaosong Jia,Fanrui Zhang,Qifeng Li,Junjie Li,Zirui Wang,Yukang Feng,Yu Hong,Shaofeng Zhang,Wenlong Liao,Tao He,Juyong Zhang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiFi：从多视角相机图像生成视觉与几何对齐的LiDAR场景的专用扩散框架，含几何与语义双分支及双分支平衡CFG策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法非专为此任务设计，生成LiDAR质量有限；多仅关注图像语义线索或仅从单目图像生成。

Method: 以潜在扩散为核心，通过几何分支（反向采样算法+不确定性感知几何编码器+DepthAnything3）与语义分支（跨视角交互模块）双分支引导；提出双分支平衡无分类器引导（CFG）策略。

Result: 大量实验表明LiFi在高保真LiDAR场景生成上优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: LiFi为多视角图像到LiDAR场景生成提供专用框架，兼顾视觉与几何对齐，代码将公开。

Abstract: Generating LiDAR point clouds from multi-view camera images is a valuable task with applications in controllable data synthesis, cross-modal simulation and various perception tasks. However, most existing methods are not specifically designed for this task, and the quality of their generated LiDAR remains limited. Moreover, these methods typically focus only on semantic cues in images or generate LiDAR from a monocular camera image. In this work, we introduce LiFi (LiDAR From images), a dedicated framework for generating visually and geometrically aligned LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process through two complementary branches: geometry and semantics. The geometry branch constructs scene features from images through a reverse sampling algorithm and an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder combined with DepthAnything3, whereas the semantic branch provides high-level semantic representations via a cross-view interaction module. We further introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy, which enhances the model's conditional generation capability while preserving the independent learning and collaborative controllability of the two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiFi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi.

</details>


### [59] [StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19795)
*Lorenzo Venturoli,Nedko Savov,Xi Wang,Marc Pollefeys,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StateCraft，将可更新抽象状态与视觉状态解耦，用语言模型+视频扩散模型演化视频世界模型，在长轨迹一致性与可控性上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型需在长交互中保持一致性，但只能生成部分观测，仅记忆过去观测不足，因为世界在动作序列后已改变，需要跟踪实体变化。

Method: 将持久可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦：抽象状态跟踪实体随世界演化，并用以条件化当前视图的视觉状态。StateCraft架构结合语言模型与视频扩散模型。构建了大规模密集标注轨迹的数据采集流程，及衡量生成质量、记忆和可控性的基准。

Result: 在基准上超越SOTA基线，长轨迹下保持高自一致性与生成质量；抽象状态可显式编辑且生成能跟随未观测状态编辑；3D概念验证显示动作改变未观测房间光照时范式可迁移。

Conclusion: 解耦抽象状态与视觉状态的范式能有效提升视频世界模型的长期一致性、记忆与可控性，并可扩展到空间环境。

Abstract: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/.

</details>


### [60] [Improving Category-Aware Active Domain Adaptation via Uncertainty-Guided Region Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19803)
*My Tra Nguyen Huynh,Viet Cuong Ta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对主动域适应中逐点选择策略的敏感性和冗余问题，提出基于区域的选择方法，结合不确定性分数提升域适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动域适应旨在降低源域和目标域标注成本并提升无监督域适应性能，但基于平均准确率优化的适应模型会导致某些困难类别性能下降。逐点选择策略虽可改善性能，却存在敏感和冗余问题，易导致采集函数过拟合。

Method: 提出基于区域的选择方法，通过最大化正流形覆盖确保适应模型改进；在选择机制中引入不确定性分数以学习更好的目标域决策边界。

Result: 在多个域适应基准上，该方法超越了首个类别感知主动域适应基线及现有主动域适应方法。

Conclusion: 区域化选择加不确定性分数能有效解决逐点选择的敏感与冗余问题，提升主动域适应性能。

Abstract: Active domain adaptation researches focus on alleviating the annotation cost, which comprises source data and target data labelling, as well as enhancing the performance of unsupervised domain adaptation. However, optimizing the adaptation model based on the average accuracy can lead to the drop in performance of some difficult categories. To overcome this issue, a point-wise selection strategy built upon the influence function can be used to improve domain adaptation performance. In our work, we first address the sensitive and redundant aspects of point-wise selection, which can lead to overfitting of the acquisition function. We thus introduce a region-based approach that ensures the improvement of the adaptation model by maximizing a positive manifold coverage. An uncertainty score is further introduced to the selection mechanism to learn a better decision boundary for the target domain. In comprehensive experiments, our proposed method surpasses the first category-aware active domain adaptation baseline as well as existing active domain adaptation methods across multiple domain adaptation benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://github.com/nhtm2702/WHO IS NEXT.

</details>


### [61] [PhyMetric: Diagnosing Physical Plausibility in Text-to-Video Generation via Scene-Level QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19823)
*Siwei Meng,Xuerou Cai,Rui Hu,Ping Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PhyMetric，一个将物理合理性评估转化为场景级、可验证问答的诊断基准，覆盖50个物理类别、1115个场景与8920个平衡二元问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V生成模型的物理合理性评测多依赖整体性打分或宽泛质量维度，无法明确测试了哪种物理行为、为何模型失败，缺乏可解释性。

Method: 构建场景级基准：1115个场景、50个物理类别、6个领域，配8920个答案平衡的二元问题、12个评估维度；每场景含8个针对性 yes/no 问题及结构化物理先验（支配定律、预期时序、可观察特征、常见失败模式）；由VLM评判员基于问题感知采样帧与先验作答，结果按场景、维度、物理类别、模型层级聚合。

Result: 在4个开源T2V模型和3个VLM评判员上实验：用单一通用合理性提问替换针对性二元问答时，评判准确率降至随机水平；结构化物理先验提供互补信号，提升分数与人类对齐程度，效果随VLM评判员能力不同而异。

Conclusion: PhyMetric 将物理合理性评估从不可解释的整体打分转变为可解释的场景级检查，场景特定二元问答是协议的关键组成部分。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce visually realistic videos that nevertheless violate the physical consequences implied by the prompt and scene. Existing benchmarks largely rely on holistic plausibility scores or broad quality dimensions, leaving it unclear which physical behavior is being tested and why a model fails. We introduce PhyMetric, a scene-level diagnostic benchmark that recasts physical plausibility evaluation as verifiable, scene-grounded question answering. PhyMetric contains 1{,}115 scenes spanning 50 physical categories across six domains, paired with 8{,}920 answer-balanced binary questions over 12 evaluation dimensions. Each scene is associated with eight targeted yes/no questions and a structured physical prior specifying the governing law, expected temporal sequence, observable signatures, and common failure modes. At evaluation time, a vision-language model (VLM) judge answers each question from question-aware sampled frames conditioned on the prior, and correctness is hierarchically aggregated into scene, dimension, physical category, and model scores. Experiments on four open-source T2V models and three VLM judges show that scene-specific binary QA is a critical component of the protocol: when each targeted question is replaced by a single generic plausibility query, evaluator accuracy drops to the chance level. Structured physical priors offer a complementary signal that improves human alignment of the resulting scores, with effects that vary across VLM judges of different capacity. These findings establish PhyMetric as a benchmark that turns physical plausibility evaluation from opaque holistic scoring into interpretable, scene-level inspection. Our project page is available at: https://mengsiwei.github.io/PhyMetric/.

</details>


### [62] [VisibilitySplat: Ray-Traced Occlusion for Relighting with 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19847)
*Sven Kluge,Oliver Staadt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出在3DGS逆渲染中显式建模可见性，通过稀疏点基光线追踪实现遮挡估计，提升重光照与材质-光照解耦效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在逆渲染中缺乏显式可见性建模，导致重光照和材质-光照分解效果受限。

Method: 在标准光栅化3DGS管线中引入稀疏可见性预言机，用BVH加速的点基光线追踪估计透射率加权遮挡，稀疏查询于逆渲染目标；着色采用PBR微表面BRDF与低分辨率HDR环境图。

Result: 在TensoIR合成数据集上，相比基于NeRF、张量表示和3DGS的基线，本方法在新视图合成、反照率重建和重光照上表现有竞争力并优于部分早期基线。消融表明显式可见性建模对重光照和材质-光照解耦贡献显著。

Conclusion: 稀疏点基可见性查询能有效补充光栅化泼溅用于逆渲染，同时保留3DGS生态的实用优势。

Abstract: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.

</details>


### [63] [DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19849)
*Boyuan Sun,Deshui Miao,Wenzhao Gao,Shaoyong Jia,Shaohui Jiao,Chi Liu,Yan Shu,Derek Li,Bryan Dai,Shengsheng Qian,Qibin Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeltaStreamer：面向流式视频理解的智能体框架，通过变化感知记忆与查询驱动规划、目标回放证据收集，提升理解性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解需在未知未来查询前保留证据，但现有方法压缩视频历史时模糊了事件转换、遗漏细节，且无法恢复缺失的视觉证据。

Method: 结合变化感知记忆、查询驱动规划与目标证据收集及回放：查询前持续观测并以结构化记忆记录视觉变化；查询到来时规划器确定所需证据，引导记忆检索与针对性回放，重新访问历史帧恢复细节。

Result: 在 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上优于代表性流式视频理解方法，总体得分分别为 66.07% 和 59.53%。

Conclusion: 将连续观测与针对每个问题的主动调查相结合，有效缓解现有方法在证据保留与恢复上的不足。

Abstract: We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. Existing approaches often obscure event transitions and omit relevant details when compressing video history, and cannot recover missing visual evidence. DeltaStreamer addresses these limitations by combining change-aware memory with query-driven planning and targeted evidence gathering with replay. Before a query arrives, it continuously observes the stream and explicitly records visual changes in structured memory, preserving how events unfold rather than only what is present. When a query arrives, a query-driven planner identifies the required evidence and guides memory retrieval and targeted replay. By revisiting historical frames, the agent can recover visual details omitted during observation and ground its answer in evidence beyond the retained descriptions. This connects continuous observation with active investigation tailored to each question. Experiments on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench demonstrate improvements over representative streaming video understanding methods, with overall scores of 66.07% and 59.53%, respectively.
  Project page: https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/

</details>


### [64] [OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19857)
*Minghao Liu,Tutian Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniPoser 是一个通用框架，可从异构稀疏可穿戴传感器（3D关键点、稀疏IMU旋转、头部6-DoF位姿或其任意子集）在单一模型内恢复全身SMPL运动，支持灵活传感器配置并实现700+ FPS实时推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏可穿戴传感器恢复3D人体运动面临真实跟踪信号的噪声、遮挡和不稳定性挑战；现有方法受限于固定传感器配置，且基于扩散模型的方法计算开销大，难以实时部署。

Method: 提出跨模态掩码机制配合 Masked Conditioning Encoder，使单一架构通过掩码设计兼容多种传感器配置；采用解耦双流生成骨干，基于 Conditional Flow Matching 生成完整运动，推理时仅需单步ODE积分。

Result: 在三种设置和七个基准（包括野外 Nymeria 与 Ego-Exo4D 数据集）上，性能与最先进方法相当，同时运行速度超过 700 FPS。

Conclusion: OmniPoser 以统一模型实现异构稀疏传感器输入的通用运动恢复，兼顾精度与实时性，适用于多样化实际部署场景。

Abstract: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.

</details>


### [65] [CoDy: Codec Dynamics as Complementary Priors for Unsupervised Temporal Action Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19880)
*Tianyu Yan,Qingyi Yang,Qin Yang,Xufei Guo,Yuan Tang,Rui Wang,Yixue Hao,Long Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoDy框架，利用视频编解码器量化、运动矢量和残差信号作为无监督时序动作定位的补充监督，实现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督时序动作定位方法仅依赖RGB和光流，导致类别分配噪声大、时序边界不准确。

Method: 利用视频编解码器特性：GOP量化模式保留类别判别动态，运动矢量和残差在动作转换处响应显著。CoDy将编解码增强视图与RGB、光流通过置信感知共识聚类融合生成软伪标签，并将编解码动态转化为类别无关的边界先验，监督视觉边界学习并指导候选初始化与迭代优化。编解码分支仅用于训练，推理无额外开销。

Result: 在THUMOS14和ActivityNet v1.3上，CoDy一致优于现有UTAL方法，达到SOTA定位性能。

Conclusion: 编解码信号可作为有效的无标注先验，用于联合推断动作类别与发生时间。

Abstract: Unsupervised temporal action localization (UTAL) aims to identify action categories and localize their temporal boundaries without annotation supervision. Existing methods typically derive supervision for both tasks solely from RGB and optical-flow representations, often resulting in noisy category assignments and inaccurate temporal boundaries. In this work, we reveal an overlooked property of video codecs: group-of-pictures quantization patterns preserve category-discriminative dynamics, while motion-vector and residual variations exhibit pronounced responses around action transitions. Based on this insight, we propose CoDy, a codec dynamics-guided framework that exploits the codec as complementary information to the visual view for UTAL. CoDy integrates a codec-enhanced view with RGB and flow through confidence-aware consensus clustering, producing reliable soft pseudo-labels. It further converts codec dynamics into a class-agnostic boundary prior, which supervises visual boundary learning and guides proposal initialization and iterative refinement. The codec branches are only used during the training stage and introduce no extra codec-side computation at inference. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.3 demonstrate that CoDy consistently outperforms existing UTAL methods and achieves state-of-the-art localization performance. These results establish codec signals as effective annotation-free priors for jointly inferring which actions occur and when they occur.

</details>


### [66] [BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19882)
*Shanyan Guan,Shiyu Li,Xin Li,Zhizhou Chen,Yunzhe Xu,Yuehao Liu,Ruixue Shen,Shiju Zhang,Min Jin,Qiang Liu,Junbo Liu,Penggang Shi,Sheng Sun,Xiao Wang,Yong Zhang,Zhongang Qi,Wei Li,Chao Ma,Ying Tai,Yanhao Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BluePixel系统，将原生4K编辑模型与智能体框架结合，公开完整训练配方，可在单张XPU上8.7秒完成4K编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令驱动的图像编辑已达原生4K，但训练方法未公开，从头预训练超出多数团队能力；单一端到端模型难以做精确参数调整、匹配专家或理解模糊指令。作者认为4K编辑是系统问题而非单模型问题。

Method: 模型侧：通过渐进式VAE适配把1K预训练编辑器转为原生4K（训练成本与1K相当），用持续学习吸收长尾垂直编辑技能，用强化学习优化美学-保真度权衡，并用源锚定目标投影(SATP)蒸馏把50步去噪压缩到4步。框架侧：BluePixel Agent将指令分解为专家/通用操作，用训练时的同一奖励模型验证结果并在限定次数内重试。

Result: 单张Kunlunxin P800 XPU上8.7秒完成4K编辑，保持任务成功率与背景一致性；在VINS-4KEval++（3,305个原生4K案例）上七个模型中排名第二，非编辑区域一致性仅次于GPT Image 2。

Conclusion: 4K编辑应作为系统问题求解，模型+框架耦合的方案配合公开训练配方，实现了高效、可控的原生4K编辑，性能达到领先水平。

Abstract: Instruction-driven image editing has reached native 4K, yet how such editors are trained remains undisclosed, and pretraining one from scratch is beyond most teams. The task itself compounds the difficulty: a single end-to-end editor cannot make precise parametric adjustments, match specialized experts, or interpret the vague instructions users actually write. We argue that 4K editing is a system problem rather than a single-model problem, and present BluePixel, which couples a native-4K editing model with an agent harness; the complete training recipe is disclosed in this paper. The model makes 4K training practical: it turns a 1K-pretrained editor into a native-4K one through progressive VAE adaptation that keeps 4K training as affordable as 1K, absorbs a long tail of vertical editing skills through continual learning, and refines the aesthetic-fidelity trade-off with reinforcement learning. Distillation via source-anchored target projection (SATP) then compresses 50 denoising steps to 4, completing a 4K edit in 8.7 s on a single Kunlunxin P800 XPU while preserving task success rate and background consistency. The harness, BluePixel Agent, makes editing controllable: it decomposes user instructions into specialist and general operations, verifies every result with the same reward model that guided training, and retries within bounded attempts. On VINS-4KEval++ (3,305 native-4K cases), BluePixel ranks second among seven models, behind only GPT Image 2 in non-edited-region consistency.

</details>


### [67] [Multimodal Medical Image Parsing with Task-Specific Low-Rank Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19901)
*Taha Sabir,Alberto Montero Molina,Thinh Quang Ly,Veronika Dmitrenko,Mohammad Yaqub,Tausifa Jan Saleem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于Qwen3.5-9B的任务特定适配方法，用于FLARE 2026 Task 3医学图像解析，覆盖6类任务与7种影像模态，采用冻结4-bit骨干+LoRA适配器方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一视觉语言模型适配医学图像解析时，需要针对不同任务特点选择相应的训练策略，以应对多任务、多模态的差异性需求。

Method: 共享冻结4-bit骨干网络，根据输入问题选择LoRA适配器；定制适配器秩与提示词，重新平衡稀有分类目标，并用皮肤科分类样本补充回归训练。

Result: 内部留出集：分类平衡准确率0.7791、多标签micro-F1 0.6286、计数MAE 11.73、检测F1 0.8914、回归MAE 9.78、报告生成CRIMSON 0.8204。隐藏验证集（1703例）：分类平衡准确率0.8496、多标签F1 0.5338、回归MAE 14.5950。容器30.1GB，每例平均3.1秒，重复验证结果一致。

Conclusion: 任务特定适配器配置与图像预算在共享医学视觉语言模型中有效，但收益因任务而异。

Abstract: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. On the organizer's 1,703-example hidden-validation set, the submitted system achieves 0.8496 classification balanced accuracy, 0.5338 sample-averaged multi-label F1, and 14.5950 regression MAE. The final 30.1 GB container averages 3.1 seconds per case, including model loading, and produces identical outputs across repeated verification runs. The benefits vary across tasks, supporting the use of task-specific adapter configurations and image budgets within a shared medical vision-language model. Code is available at https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus.

</details>


### [68] [Quantifying Annotation Agreement in Object Detection with Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19912)
*Kirill Prokhorov,Alexandr A. Kalinin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出用最优传输(OT)度量目标检测标注之间的一致性，避免对框重叠进行二值化，能捕捉渐变式一致性变化并区分阈值型指标得分相同的标注对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型验证依赖被视为真值的标注测试集，但标注可能含噪或存歧义。目标检测中，不同来源会在物体是否存在、框位置或类别标签上产生分歧，而标准一致性指标通常先二值化框重叠再汇总，掩盖了标注集之间分歧的程度与结构。

Method: 研究基于最优传输(OT)的度量来衡量目标检测标注间一致性。该指标不对边界框重叠做二值化，而是为匹配和未匹配的标注框分配分级代价。通过理论分析与在真实及人工扰动标注上的实验进行验证。

Result: OT能捕捉一致性的渐变变化，并能区分那些被阈值化指标评为相同的标注对。

Conclusion: OT为目标检测中标注一致性提供了更丰富的度量，尤其适用于含大量小目标或模糊目标的领域；此类一致性估计可在标签含噪或冲突时支持更可靠的验证。

Abstract: Reliable validation of machine learning models is a crucial step in designing robust and trustworthy systems. Yet validation relies on annotated test sets treated as ground truth, even though annotations can be noisy or ambiguous. In object detection, sources may disagree on object presence, box location, or class label. Standard agreement metrics usually binarize box overlap before computing a summary score, obscuring the degree and structure of disagreement between annotation sets. Here, we study an Optimal Transport (OT)-based metric for measuring agreement between object detection annotations. Instead of binarizing bounding box overlap, this metric assigns graded costs to matched and unmatched labeled boxes. Through theoretical analysis and experiments on real and synthetically perturbed annotations, we show that OT captures graded changes in agreement and distinguishes annotation pairs that thresholded metrics score identically. Our results suggest that OT provides a richer measure of annotation agreement in object detection, especially for domains with many small or ambiguous objects. Such agreement estimates can support more reliable validation when labels are noisy or conflicting.

</details>


### [69] [SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19931)
*Tomáš Čížek,Matej Straka,Illia Volkov,Matěj Kripner,Ervin Macić,Jiri Matas,Klara Janouskova,Martin Schmid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAM3RL 用强化学习训练轻量记忆控制器，决定哪些帧进入记忆库，在多数跟踪与视频分割基准上超越手工规则且无运行时开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 3 的跟踪器继承 SAM 2 的 FIFO 记忆库机制，现有改良方法多依赖针对特定失败模式（如干扰物、遮挡、运动）的手工记忆更新规则，其收益难以迁移到更强的 SAM 3 骨干上。因此需要一种更通用、数据驱动的记忆控制方案。

Method: 将记忆控制建模为序列决策任务，在 SAM 3 跟踪器上加入轻量级记忆控制器，用强化学习训练其决定哪些帧进入记忆库，以最大化跟踪性能；同样方法应用于 SAM 2 得到 SAM2RL。

Result: SAM3RL 在 12 个跟踪与视频目标分割基准中的 10 个上达到新 SOTA，优于所有手工规则且无运行时开销；SAM2RL 在 12 个基准中的 9 个上超越手工规则。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的记忆控制方式比手工规则更通用有效，且可跨模型代际（SAM 2 与 SAM 3）迁移，验证了方法的普适性。

Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.

</details>


### [70] [Instruction Mining From Images: Constructing a Synthetic Dataset for Multimodal Learning ILSP DCVLR Competition Submission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19932)
*Eleni E. Kasoura,Dimitrios Damianos,Georgios Paraskevopoulos,Vassilios Katsouros*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个紧凑、可复现的流水线，用于为 DCVLR 合成并筛选基于图像的指令-回复对，最终得到覆盖数学、空间与社会推理的多样化数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为 DCVLR 构建高质量的图像指令数据需求高，但缺乏可复现且高效的合成与筛选流程，本文旨在提供这样的方案。

Method: 从 Cauldron 集合取材，采用 Magpie 风格，用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct 在系统提示控制下合成简洁的图像条件指令；随后进行净化、打标签，并用 DeBERTa-v3 奖励模型打分筛选，保留正分样本。

Result: 奖励分数中位数约 1.53、均值约 1.75，表明多数生成指令质量较好；最终数据集涵盖数学、空间和社会推理等多样指令。

Conclusion: 该流水线可复现地生成了高质量、多样化的图像指令数据，适合用于 DCVLR 相关训练。

Abstract: This work presents a compact and reproducible pipeline for synthesizing and curating image-based instruction-response pairs for DCVLR. We draw from the Cauldron collection and use Magpie-style instruction and response synthesis with Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct to create concise, image-conditioned instruction pairs. The pipeline consists of instruction synthesis, conditioned on input images and controlled via a system prompt, sanitization, tagging, and filtering of the instructions based on the score obtained by a reward model (DeBERTa-v3). We retain samples with positive scores to maximize the quality of the generated instructions. We observe that score distributions have a median and mean reward score of ~ 1.53 and ~ 1.75 respectively, indicating that most generated instructions are of good quality. The resulting dataset contains diverse instructions in the math, spatial, and social reasoning domains.

</details>


### [71] [Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19993)
*Ana-Ştefania Kogălniceanu,Klára Orbán,Ashwin Nedungadi,Stefan Lüdtke,Kuderna-Iulian Benţa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文测试了四种3D重建方法在冰下AUV视频上的表现，全部失败，并将其归因于相机基线-场景深度比过小的采集条件，进而提出快速检测此类失败的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冰下AUV视频的3D重建精度很低，但尚不清楚这是方法本身的缺陷还是采集系统的固有限制，本文旨在厘清原因。

Abstract: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.

</details>


### [72] [GeoCloak: An Agentic Framework for Semantics-Preserving Geolocation Privacy via Peripheral Clue Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20055)
*Yixin Wu,Mingjie Li,Yun Shen,Michael Backes,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoCloak利用视觉-地理定位不对称性，通过代理框架结合语义编辑与对抗扰动，保护图像地理隐私且保留语义效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型可从单张无元数据图像高精度推断地理位置，威胁隐私。现有防御几乎仅依赖对抗扰动，导致可见伪影与效用下降。作者发现地理定位决定性线索（如路牌）常处于视觉边缘，却主导位置推断这一不对称性。

Method: 提出GeoCloak代理框架，作为线索感知规划器：分析图像识别地理相关线索，定向语义编辑抑制边缘线索，并自动配置对抗扰动抑制残余地理特征，整个过程由迭代的效用感知反馈引导。

Result: 在覆盖108国576城的四个数据集上，对五种LVLM与三种推断方法评估。城市级准确率从41.2%降至9.9%，约为最佳基线的一半，同时定性与定量效用保持显著更优。

Conclusion: GeoCloak朝向实用、语义保持的地理隐私保护迈出有意义一步，让用户更好控制分享图像中无意嵌入的位置信息。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large vision language models (LVLMs) has made geolocation inference from images highly accurate and accessible. This poses serious privacy risks: a passive adversary with black-box LVLM access can infer a user's location from a single photo with no metadata. Existing protection methods rely almost exclusively on adversarial perturbation, which introduces perceptible visual artifacts and utility degradation. We identify the visual-geolocation asymmetry: geolocation-decisive clues, such as street signs, tend to be visually peripheral but dominate location inference. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose GeoCloak, an agentic framework for semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection. It acts as a clue-aware planner that analyzes each image to identify geolocation-relevant clues, dispatches targeted semantic edits to directly suppress peripheral clues, and autonomously configures adversarial perturbation to further suppress residual geolocation features, all under iterative utility-aware feedback. We evaluate GeoCloak on four diverse datasets spanning 108 countries and 576 cities against five LVLMs and three inference methods. GeoCloak reduces overall city-level accuracy from 41.2% to 9.9%, approximately half of the best-performing baseline, while achieving substantially superior utility preservation both qualitatively and quantitatively. We hope this work takes a meaningful step toward practical, semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection, giving users greater control over the location information inadvertently embedded in their shared images.

</details>


### [73] [GDBA-Net: A Gated Dual-Branch Adaptation of SAM2 for Robust Cross-Domain Nuclei Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20073)
*Biplab Poudel,Betserai Albert Magarire,Anish Kumar Shah,Jiacheng Xie,Dong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GDBA-Net是一个参数高效（仅4.3M可训练参数）的细胞核分割框架，通过门控双分支适配器（GDBA）适配冻结的SAM2编码器，融合语义先验与频率结构先验，在六个基准上实现域内SOTA与更优的跨域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞核分割受形态多变、边界弱、核拥挤及染色/制备/采集差异导致的域偏移影响；深度学习与基础模型仅在训练分布匹配时表现好，跨异构病理域泛化仍有限。

Method: 提出GDBA-Net，核心为Gated Dual-Branch Adapter（GDBA）：适配冻结的SAM2编码器，将预训练语义表征与显式频率导出的结构先验结合；两类表征分别经Grid MLP分支变换，再通过样本自适应通道门控动态融合，选择性突出与核轮廓相关的结构线索。

Result: 仅4.3M可训练参数，在六个多样细胞核分割基准上达到域内SOTA，并在全监督、跨数据集、五样本（five-shot）适应协议下持续获得更优跨域泛化，超过CNN、Transformer及基础模型方法；消融验证增益来自语义-频率互补与自适应门控的协同设计而非模型容量。

Conclusion: 通过结合可迁移语义表征与显式结构先验，GDBA-Net为细胞核分割中的域变异性提供了鲁棒且标注高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate nuclei segmentation underpins quantitative computational pathology, yet remains challenging due to morphological variability, weak boundaries, nuclear crowding, and pronounced domain shifts arising from differences in tissue preparation, staining, and acquisition. While deep learning and recent foundation models have improved segmentation performance under matched distributions with the original training data, their generalization across heterogeneous histopathology domains remains limited. We introduce GDBA-Net, a parameter-efficient nuclei segmentation framework built around the proposed Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA). GDBA-Net adapts a frozen SAM2 encoder by integrating pretrained semantic representations with explicit frequency-derived structural priors. The complementary representations are independently transformed through Grid MLP branches and dynamically integrated using sample-adaptive channel-wise gating, selectively emphasizing structural cues relevant to nuclear delineation. Despite using only 4.3 million trainable parameters, GDBA-Net achieves state-of-the-art in-dataset performance and consistently superior cross-dataset generalization across six diverse nuclei segmentation benchmarks under fully supervised, cross-dataset, and five-shot adaptation protocols, outperforming competing CNN-, transformer-, and foundation model based methods. Comprehensive ablations confirm that these gains arise from the coordinated design of semantic-frequency complementarity and adaptive gating rather than increased model capacity. By uniting transferable semantic representations with explicit structural priors, GDBA-Net provides a robust, annotation-efficient solution to domain variability in nuclei segmentation. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net

</details>


### [74] [Feasibility of a Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20074)
*Kritsanavis Chongsrid,Vich Yindeedej,Supaporn Konmun,Xulei Yang,Si Yong Yeo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个从术前CT重建颅骨、头皮、耳及脑室的数字孪生，能在Keen's点周围自动搜索满足安全约束、脑室内长度最长的垂直穿刺轨迹，并给出以耳为基准的两条标尺测量和两个深度的个体化置管方案。11例成人徒手执行（IDEAL Stage 2a）中10例达到Hayhurst 1级置管，显著优于历史对照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 导管梗阻是分流失败最常见的原因，而Keen's点徒手置管仅约十分之一的病例导管尖端能游离于脑脊液中，说明传统固定入路与深度缺乏个体化优化。

Method: 用确定性几何方法从术前CT重建颅骨、头皮、耳和脑室的数字孪生，在Keen's点周围所有入点中搜索在安全约束下脑室内长度最长的垂直轨迹，并将方案输出为从耳起的两条标尺测量值和两个深度值；随后在11例连续成人中徒手执行（IDEAL Stage 2a）。

Result: 10/11例达到Hayhurst 1级置管，历史对照为22/213（p=9×10^-9）；入点与角度偏差中位数分别为2.5 mm和5.9度；脑室内导管长度比Keen's点增加1.4 cm；无术中并发症。

Conclusion: 技术本身未改变，收益来自按患者个体选择入点与深度；该方案能否降低翻修率是下一阶段需要验证的假设。

Abstract: Catheter obstruction is the commonest cause of shunt failure; freehand insertion at Keen's point leaves the tip free in cerebrospinal fluid in only one case in ten. We built a digital twin that reconstructs skull, scalp, ear and ventricles from preoperative CT by deterministic geometry, searches every entry around Keen's point for the perpendicular trajectory with the longest intraventricular length under safety constraints, and returns the plan as two ruler measurements from the ear and two depths. Executed freehand in 11 consecutive adults (IDEAL Stage 2a), it achieved Hayhurst Grade 1 placement in 10 of 11 against 22 of 213 historically (p = 9 x 10^-9), median entry and angular deviations 2.5 mm and 5.9 degrees, 1.4 cm more intraventricular catheter than Keen's point, and no intraoperative complication. The technique was unchanged; the gain came from choosing entry and depth per patient. Whether it lowers revision is the next stage's hypothesis.

</details>


### [75] [VisualWorldBench: A Fine-Grained Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Visual World Knowledge in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20083)
*Chen Chen,Zheming Liang,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VisualWorldBench：基于21,291个叶节点类别层级分类的多任务基准（32,541实例、覆盖15,479类），含四项任务，揭示MLLM细粒度视觉世界知识不足，并构建VisualWorldBench-50K训练资源实现显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM视觉世界知识基准有两缺陷：类别覆盖狭窄（仅少量类别/领域，远不及真实世界开放规模）；任务构建不严谨（模型靠粗粒度线索、模糊联想或排除法即可答对，无法真正评估细粒度实体知识）。

Method: 构建基于8个视觉领域、21,291个叶节点类别层级分类的基准VisualWorldBench，含32,541个评测实例，真值覆盖15,479类；设计四项互补任务（闭集识别、对比选择、精确定位、开放世界命名），覆盖不同知识检索方向与答案开放度。多数问题由分类学邻近类别构建，强制细粒度区分。另构建50K+类别的训练资源VisualWorldBench-50K。

Result: 最强闭源模型平均准确率仅80.4%，暴露传统基准掩盖的能力差距；在VisualWorldBench-50K上微调在VisualWorldBench提升超21个百分点，并一致迁移到公开细粒度识别与视觉知识基准。

Conclusion: VisualWorldBench以大规模分类学层级和多任务设计更严格地评估MLLM视觉世界知识，揭示现有模型细粒度知识短板；配套训练资源可有效提升性能且具泛化性。

Abstract: Visual world knowledge is a core capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), underpinning knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in two key respects. First, their category coverage is narrow: most benchmarks span only a small number of categories across a few domains, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities. Second, their task construction is often insufficiently rigorous: models can answer correctly using coarse-grained cues, vague associations, or elimination strategies without truly mastering precise concepts, making it difficult to accurately assess their knowledge of fine-grained entities. We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark built on a hierarchical taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, with 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across four complementary tasks: closed-set recognition, contrastive selection, precise localization, and open-world naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness to comprehensively evaluate visual world knowledge. Most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, forcing precise discrimination among fine-grained entities. Experiments reveal that the strongest closed-source model achieves only 80.4% average accuracy, exposing capability gaps hidden under conventional benchmarks. We further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories. Fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields over 21 percentage points improvement on VisualWorldBench, with consistent transfer to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks.

</details>


### [76] [When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20089)
*Xinrui Lin,Fan Li,Shumin Wang,Dehong Kong,Yanyong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk（RAPW），一种图感知的优势聚合方法，用于视频生成模型的强化学习中，通过利用循环偏好图中的可靠关系证据来改进基于胜率的优势估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对偏好在视频生成RL中比标量评分更可靠，但审计6,976个on-policy比较图发现循环偏好普遍存在且贯穿训练。朴素的基于平均胜率的奖励聚合忽略了比较结构，独立处理每个rollout，导致部分rollout的优势估计不可靠，影响RL优化。

Method: 为每个GRPO组在成对评估器下定义偏好图，节点为采样的rollout，边编码成对偏好。提出 RAPW：一种图感知的优势聚合方法，通过可靠性引导的偏好游走，用循环偏好图中的可靠关系证据增强来自胜率的全局偏好信号。无需在组内已观察比较之外额外查询评估器。

Result: 在匹配评估器、比较协议、组大小、提示调度和查询预算下，RAPW 在受控比较、迁移设置和盲测人类评估中均优于 Pairwise-GRPO。

Conclusion: 利用偏好图的循环结构进行可靠性锚定的优势聚合，可显著提升视频生成RL中的成对偏好优化效果。

Abstract: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.

</details>


### [77] [RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20091)
*Jaeyeon Heo,Geuntaek Lim,Yukyung Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出RTAformer，一个单阶段框架，解决视频场景图生成中的"关系语义惯性"问题，通过分别建模实体持续性与关系变化，在Action Genome上提升了召回率和平均召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频场景图生成方法通过跨帧聚合信息利用时序上下文，但过度强调一致性会掩盖关系的突变，导致模型在关系已改变后仍保留旧预测，作者将此失效模式称为"关系语义惯性"。

Method: 提出Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer)，单阶段框架，分别建模实体持续性与关系变化：注入相邻帧关系查询之间的校准差异来引导谓词更新，并在训练时进行跨帧实例对齐以减少跨帧表示漂移。

Result: 在Action Genome数据集上，召回率和平均召回率相比现有方法均有提升；消融实验验证了各组件贡献；与匹配骨干网络的比较显示，在关系转换帧上的增益大于非转换帧。

Conclusion: RTAformer通过显式区分实体持续性与关系变化，有效缓解关系语义惯性，尤其改善关系转换帧上的预测表现。

Abstract: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.

</details>


### [78] [RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20111)
*Siming Fu,Zheming Fu,Lianrui Mu,Haoyang Huang,Chaojie Gu,Ruizhe He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Representation Forcing，用表示空间监督替代中间教师轨迹回归来实现少步因果初始化，在四步采样下优于 causal ODE 初始化，并在 VBench 与 VisionReward 上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将预训练视频扩散模型蒸馏为少步自回归生成器通常结合学生初始化与 DMD。中间 AR 教师可提供因果兼容目标用于 ODE 初始化，但仅靠因果兼容目标无法保证短采样日程下的高质量生成。作者发现 causal ODE 初始化虽缓解模糊，但细节仍不清晰。

Method: 提出 Representation Forcing：通过表示空间监督学习少步因果初始化，而非回归中间教师轨迹。学生以 teacher forcing 方式训练，用冻结视频扩散 transformer 的归一化特征比较干净预测与训练目标。该阶段复用双向模型生成的合成视频用于 AR 教师训练，替代教师训练与 causal ODE 蒸馏，无需额外生成 causal ODE 轨迹；后续非对称 DMD 流程保持不变。

Result: 四步采样下，RepForcing 在 DMD 前比基于中间教师的初始化更好地保持生成质量。经 DMD 后，四步 chunk-wise 模型将 VBench Total 从 84.04 提升至 84.66（+0.62），VisionReward 从 6.326 提升至 10.074（+59.25%），优于所报告的 causal-ODE 基线。

Conclusion: 表示空间监督的因果初始化可有效替代因果 ODE 蒸馏，提升少步自回归视频生成质量。

Abstract: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.

</details>


### [79] [DreamHMR: From Video Generation to Human Motion Modeling via Structural Focusing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20124)
*Zhengjie Xu,Ruihao Gong,Xianglong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DreamHMR，利用视频生成先验进行完整的身体与手部网格重建，采用全局到局部策略，在多个数据集和遮挡场景下取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视频中准确重建人体运动与精细手部关节仍具挑战，尤其在遮挡和部分可见的真实场景中。视频生成预训练虽提供丰富的时空先验，但其侧重视觉合成，与显式人体几何之间存在差距。

Method: DreamHMR遵循全局到局部策略：先用Global Body Representation Transfer训练视频骨干预测完整人体渲染，将其原生预测任务转化为学习表面对应与姿态几何的手段；再用Local Joint Feature Enhancement结合上下文估计与可靠的局部证据，恢复精细身体和手部细节，同时抑制遮挡物和背景干扰。

Result: 在5个数据集、4种视频骨干上验证。统一评测下，最佳模型在3DPW、EMDB-1、RICH所有指标上超越现有方法，身体MPJPE分别降低4.2%、4.7%、6.1%；在更具挑战的遮挡场景（BEDLAM和EgoBody）中，整体身体与手部MPJPE分别降低7.0%和10.0%。

Conclusion: DreamHMR有效弥合了视频生成先验与人体几何之间的差距，实现鲁棒的身体与手部网格重建，跨骨干家族表现优异。代码将公开。

Abstract: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [80] [StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20137)
*Zhuobai Dong,Xiaobing Tu,Xiantao Zhang,Jinkui Ren,Yinggui Wang,Yue Ma,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamErase 通过将双向基础模型的擦除能力蒸馏为单向流式擦除器，实现单 GPU 上亚秒级延迟、最高 26 FPS 的实时长视频物体擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频物体擦除方法延迟极高（每视频需数分钟）且采用非因果处理，无法实时交互。作者希望实现亚秒级延迟、可无限延长的流式擦除。

Method: 先用掩码增强文本到视频模型生成高质量擦除视频（非实时）；再渐进式将擦除能力从双向基础模型迁移到高效单向流式擦除器；设计滑动窗口因果注意力与注意力汇（attention sinks），结合自 rollout 与 KV 缓存滚动训练，用固定上下文窗口模拟推理外推，实现恒速生成任意长视频；并建立 LongErase 基准。

Result: 单 GPU 上亚秒级延迟、最高 26 FPS 流式生成；在 LongErase 基准上优于现有视频物体擦除模型，泛化到真实场景，独有地支持无限长流式擦除。

Conclusion: StreamErase 实现了实时交互式长视频物体擦除，用户输入掩码即可实时看到擦除结果展开，带来真正交互体验。

Abstract: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.

</details>


### [81] [Attention-Based Spatio-Temporal Approach for Fire and Smoke Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20141)
*Alireza Mirrashid,Mohammad Khoshbin,Ali Atghaei,Hassan Shahbazi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种结合空间与时间特征的视觉方法，利用Transformer模块检测烟雾和火灾，三阶段递进降低误差，性能良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外热感和烟雾传感器无法用于户外场景，因此需要基于视觉的烟雾与火灾检测方法；该问题本质是时空问题，需要时空解决方案。

Method: 方法融合空间特征和时间特征进行检测，包含三个主要部分，各部分逐步修正前一部分的误差以提升整体鲁棒性；并引入Transformer模块提高模型精度。

Result: 模型结果显示了所提方法在烟雾和火灾检测问题上的良好表现。

Conclusion: 该方法可用于提升工作场所安全性。

Abstract: In various industries, smoke and fire are two of the most important threats in the workplace. One of the common methods for detecting smoke and fire is the use of infrared thermal and smoke sensors, which cannot be used in outdoor applications. Therefore, the use of vision-based methods seems necessary. The problem of smoke and fire detection is spatiotemporal and requires spatiotemporal solutions. This paper presents a method that uses spatial features along with temporal-based features to detect smoke and fire in the scene. It consists of three main parts; the task of each part is to reduce the error of the previous part so that the final model has a robust performance. This method also uses transformer modules to increase the accuracy of the model. The results of our model show the proper performance of the proposed approach in solving the problem of smoke and fire detection and can be used to increase workplace safety.

</details>


### [82] [Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20158)
*Konstantinos Almpanakis,Anna Kreshuk*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"批次外正则化"(out-of-batch regularization)，在CPU内存中维护数据集级状态构建全局实例目标，使正则化梯度估计更准确，在小批量下显著提升对比与非对比自监督学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督联合嵌入学习通过正则化表示分布防止坍塌，但现有方法将正则化计算限制在当前mini-batch内，导致在batch size较小时对全数据集正则化梯度的估计不准确。

Method: 提出批次外正则化方法：在CPU内存中维护数据集级状态（anchors），使用全局构建的逐实例目标进行mini-batch训练，从而近似完整数据集的正则化梯度；可应用于对比方法SimCLR和非对比方法SIGReg。

Result: 在自然图像和生物医学数据集上，anchors比传统mini-batch估计更忠实地近似全数据集正则化梯度；在图像分类、受控不平衡下的少数类性能、实例检索和持续自监督预训练任务上均优于对应的批内目标，且batch size越小增益越大。

Conclusion: 数据集级正则化可以与mini-batch优化解耦，使batch size成为纯粹的优化选择，而不影响正则器的几何结构。

Abstract: Self-supervised joint embedding learning aligns representations of augmented views while regularizing their distribution to prevent collapse. Regularization aims to shape the overall representation distribution, but most joint embedding methods restrict its computation to the active minibatch. We propose out-of-batch regularization, which maintains a dataset-level state in CPU memory and uses globally constructed per-instance targets during minibatch training. Evaluated on natural images and biomedical datasets, these anchors approximate the full-dataset regularization gradient more faithfully than conventional minibatch estimation at small batch sizes. Applications to contrastive (SimCLR) and non-contrastive (SIGReg) approaches show consistent improvement over the corresponding in-batch objectives for image classification, minority-class performance under controlled imbalance, instance retrieval, and continued self-supervised pretraining, with the largest gains at small batch sizes. These results suggest that dataset-level regularization can be decoupled from minibatch optimization, making batch size an optimization choice that does not affect the geometry of the regularizer.

</details>


### [83] [OneLA: Learning Many Worlds from Latent Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20160)
*Ziyu Zhu,Zhaoxu Sun,Fan Jiang,Chiyu Wang,Junfeng Ni,Mu Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OneLA提出用共享正交字典和统一预测目标学习连续潜在动作，无需任务特定设计或跨域对齐损失，为世界模型提供通用控制接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同域的动作接口各异且动作标注稀缺，直接学跨域共享潜在动作面临外观、形态、动力学差异导致的域特异视觉线索与可迁移过渡结构纠缠问题。

Method: 通过共享正交字典与共同预测目标学连续潜在动作，无需跨域对齐损失；用轻量适配器将原生控制命令映射到同一空间，结合当前视觉状态预测上下文相关过渡实现可控rollout。

Result: 跨域动作读出提升，动作循环迁移旋转误差比最强基线降24.8%；联合训练下真实场景生成HPSv3提升20.5%。

Conclusion: 该结果指向一种从多样视频学习、经潜在动作空间灵活控制的通用世界模型路径。

Abstract: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.

</details>
