### [84] [Continual pretraining Prostate MRI ViT Encoder for task alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20217)
*Bilal A. Sidiqi,Yipei Wang,Shaheer U. Saeed,Shiqi Huang,Daniel C. Alexander,Yipeng Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 探索通过持续预训练(LoRA微调)提升ViT编码器在MRI任务中的预训练-下游对齐，并用CKA分析表征变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MRI基础模型研究多关注预训练策略与下游性能，忽视预训练与下游目标任务的对齐问题。与语言模型不同，视觉任务中两阶段对齐不明显，故需探索提升对齐的方法。

Method: 在前列腺分割任务上使用LoRA对预训练ViT编码器进行持续预训练，以增强任务对齐；并用中心核对齐(CKA)进行逐层表征分析，评估表征偏移及其与任务结果的相关性。

Result: 在6个下游任务中，3个性能提升，其余相当。特征分析显示，对分割任务而言，持续预训练编码器特征与微调编码器特征更相似，且与性能提升相关。

Conclusion: 持续预训练可改善预训练-下游任务对齐并提升部分任务性能；CKA分析揭示了表征相似性与性能增益之间的关联。

Abstract: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shifts and their correlation with task outcomes. Our experiments show improved performance in 3 of 6 downstream tasks and comparable results in the others. Our Feature analysis reveals that, for segmentation tasks, continually pretrained encoder features exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned encoder than the original pretrained encoder, correlating with observed performance gains.

</details>


### [85] [Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20220)
*Zhuobai Dong,Junchao Yi,Hu Jian Guo,Linjie Li,Rui Zhao,Alex Jinpeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Glance Forcing，用单条 PF-ODE 轨迹蒸馏因果视频扩散模型，将轨迹收集成本从数千 GPU 小时降至约 1 A100 小时，同时超越 SOTA 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将双向扩散模型蒸馏为因果少步学生模型的方法需离线 PF-ODE 轨迹，成本极高（数万 GPU 小时、TB 级存储）；而将监督压缩到单样本时出现严重质量崩溃，源于教师轨迹高噪声（语义布局与运动）与低噪声（细节纹理）区间曲率与优化行为不同，单一学生模型难以兼顾。

Method: Glance Forcing：轻量蒸馏框架，将去噪轨迹解耦为慢、快两个互补专家，各配以阶段特定目标，同时冻结预训练教师模型。用单条 PF-ODE 轨迹监督，避免表示干扰。

Result: 仅用一条 PF-ODE 轨迹即超越全面训练的 SOTA 基线：VBench 总分从 84.04 提至 84.22；成本从数千 GPU 小时降至约 1 A100 小时；在动态度、VisionReward、指令遵循上增益更显著；人类评估偏好一致。

Conclusion: 轨迹解耦揭示少步蒸馏通用机制：PF-ODE 蒸馏主要拉直少步轨迹几何，后续分布匹配阶段独立决定分布质量。Glance Forcing 大幅提升蒸馏效率与质量。

Abstract: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.

</details>


### [86] [PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20240)
*Siqi Yang,Yimu Wang,Ziqi Cai,Chengxuan Zhu,Shuchen Weng,Erwin Wu,Zhaofei Yu,Kaipeng Zhang,Boxin Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAWA：一个面向动作条件全景多人世界建模的数据集与框架，同步采集POV与全景视频及动作，并提出双塔模型预测POV与全景视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人世界模型需预测多个玩家独立动作如何改变共享环境，包括视野外变化。POV视频只在变化进入视野后记录，全景视频可作中间表示，但Minecraft领域缺乏同步的POV、全景视频与动作数据集。

Method: 构建PAWA数据集，配对每个玩家的POV视频、世界稳定的全景视频与对齐动作；分布式管线解耦CPU采集与GPU渲染，支持超64名玩家，并可在新观测配置下重渲染。提出双塔模型联合预测POV与全景视频，通过跨注意力对齐共享世界坐标系中同方向token；引入二次相位玩家编码以在相同嵌入维度下提供更多玩家编码。

Result: PAWA在POV预测质量上优于现有最先进多人世界模型，同时能生成高保真全景预测。

Conclusion: 数据集与采集管线已开源，支持多人世界模型进一步研究。

Abstract: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.

</details>


### [87] [Contrastive uncertainty learning for robust multi-structure segmentation in lower-pelvic MR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20251)
*Bilal Sidiqi,Yipei Wang,Wen Yan,Shaheer U. Saeed,Daniel C. Alexander,Yipeng Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出对比不确定性学习(CUL)框架，用预测不确定性直接指导表示学习，在保持Dice相当的情况下显著改善前列腺MRI分割的表面距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺MRI中解剖结构边界存在区域模糊性，依赖全局重叠损失函数的自动分割方法对表面偏差不敏感，易在模糊区域产生重大误差；现有不确定性方法多仅将不确定性作为事后质量指标或预测过滤器，未用于指导表示学习。

Method: CUL为监督框架，通过Monte Carlo Dropout计算体素级不确定性并按此组织嵌入几何：低不确定性且正确预测的特征形成稳定的体素簇，高不确定性或误分类特征被主动排斥，防止困难边界处特征塌陷。在589例3D前列腺MRI多结构分割任务（8个解剖结构）上采用ViT+UperNet解码器架构评估。

Result: 平均Dice为83.38%，与基线83.35%相当；但在8个解剖结构中的6个上表面距离显著下降(p<0.001)。困难案例分析显示改善与退化案例存在22倍不对称(18.8% vs 0.9%)。消融表明：移除不确定性引导样本选择会使过渡区改善消失；将对比目标替换为边界损失还会使膀胱改善消失，说明两者均为增益所必需。

Conclusion: 所提出的不确定性引导表示学习是降低安全关键医学分割中极端误差风险的有效机制。

Abstract: Boundary delineation of anatomical structures in prostate MRI is often compromised by regional ambiguity. Automated segmentation methods relying on global overlap loss functions tend to be insensitive to surface deviations, leading to significant errors in ambiguous regions. Most existing uncertainty-aware methods treat uncertainty as a post-hoc quality indicator or prediction filter. We propose Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses predictive uncertainty to directly guide representation learning. Using Monte Carlo Dropout, CUL identifies voxel-wise uncertainty and structures the embedding geometry accordingly: low-uncertainty, correctly predicted features form stable voxels while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are actively repelled, preventing feature collapse at difficult boundaries. We evaluate CUL on a 589-scan 3D prostate MRI multi-structure segmentation task (8 anatomical structures) using a ViT with UperNet decoder architecture. Average Dice ($83.38\%$) remains comparable to the baseline ($83.35\%$), while surface distance decreases significantly ($p<0.001$) across 6 of 8 anatomical structures. A hard-case analysis reveals a $22{\times}$ asymmetry between significantly improved and degraded cases ($18.8\%$ vs $0.9\%$). Ablation studies show that removing uncertainty-guided sample selection eliminates improvements for the transition zone, while replacing the contrastive objective with a boundary loss additionally removes bladder improvements, demonstrating that both uncertainty-guided sampling and the contrastive objective are essential for the observed gains. These findings demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided representation learning is a useful mechanism for reducing the risk of extreme errors in safety-critical medical segmentation

</details>


### [88] [GLoD-LVSM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Continuous-LoD Scene Representations for Large View Synthesis Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20254)
*Weikai Lin,Nicholas Milef,Carl S Marshall,Grant Kaijuin Yang,Todd Keeler,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GLoD-LVSM 提出一种紧凑、几何感知的连续细节层次场景表示，通过连续场初始化锚点与几何引导注意力压缩场景 token，在保持渲染质量的同时大幅减少 token 数量并加速渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视角合成模型（LVSMs）虽能快速从稀疏视角重建并渲染新视角，但存在 token 冗余，导致不必要的存储与渲染开销，需要在质量与效率间取得更好平衡。

Method: 提出 GLoD-LVSM：1) 学习连续场来初始化可变数量的场景锚点以匹配预算，并用 condenser 聚合场景信息，端到端训练；2) condenser 推断参考 token 与锚点几何，通过几何引导注意力指导压缩，提升渲染质量并支持解码时的视锥剔除。

Result: 相比现有压缩基线取得最佳质量-token 权衡；相比未压缩基模型，token 减少 33.4%、渲染加速 1.23×且无质量损失；放宽质量预算时 token 减少达 85.5%、加速 3.00×。分析显示监督带来涌现深度与自适应锚点，并支持场景语义理解。

Conclusion: GLoD-LVSM 提供高效紧凑的场景表示，兼顾渲染质量与效率，并展现对下游语义任务的潜力。

Abstract: Large view synthesis models (LVSMs) reconstruct scenes from sparse views and render novel views quickly, but they incur unnecessary storage and rendering costs due to token redundancy. We present GLoD-LVSM, a compact, geometry-grounded scene representation for LVSMs with continuous levels of detail. First, instead of learning a fixed set of scene anchor initializations, GLoD-LVSM learns a continuous field that initializes a flexible number of anchors to match the desired budget. A condenser then aggregates scene information into these anchors, with both the field and condenser trained end-to-end. Second, the condenser infers reference-token and anchor geometry to guide compression through geometry-grounded attention, improving rendering quality and enabling frustum culling during decoding. Compared with existing LVSM scene-compression baselines, GLoD-LVSM achieves the best trade-off between rendering quality and scene token count. Compared with the uncompressed base model, GLoD-LVSM reduces the scene-token count by 33.4% and accelerates rendering by $1.23\times$ with no quality loss. Under a relaxed quality-loss budget, the reduction increases to 85.5%, with $3.00\times$ rendering speedup. Further analysis reveals that view-synthesis supervision yields emergent scene depth and self-organized anchors that align with surfaces and adapt their density to local texture complexity. Beyond rendering, we further show that our scene representation also supports scene-semantic understanding, highlighting its potential for broader downstream tasks.

</details>


### [89] [A Valid Watermark Is Not a Valid Identity: Spatial-Spectral Adversarial Face Evasion with Watermark Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20278)
*Jefferson David Rodriguez Chivata,Davide Ghiani,Simone Maurizio La Cava,Marco Micheletto,Giulia Orrù,Gian Luca Marcialis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种黑盒水印保持型人脸逃逸攻击PGD-L2，在保持水印可恢复和视觉质量的同时降低人脸识别相似度，逃逸率超92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于水印的人脸溯源/篡改检测无法保证生物身份可靠性，存在"水印有效但生物识别失效"的结构性缺口，且攻击者无法访问水印组件（黑盒设定）。

Method: 提出PGD-L2攻击，在对抗扰动优化中加入空间与频域保持项，抑制像素级失真及可能干扰隐藏水印线索的高频变化，从而在不访问水印模块的情况下实现逃逸。

Result: 在2种水印方案、2种人脸识别模型、2个数据集上评估：操作阈值下逃逸率>92%；水印恢复率StegaFormer>93%、FaceSigns>99.7%；ε2=2.0时PSNR>47dB。

Conclusion: 结果揭示基于水印的人脸认证存在结构性漏洞：人脸图像可同时保持水印有效、视觉保真，却在生物识别上不可靠。

Abstract: Facial image watermarking can support traceability and certification in biometric pipelines, but provenance or manipulation detection alone does not guarantee reliable biometric identity. We introduce a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that targets this gap under a black-box watermarking setting, without access to the watermarking components. The proposed PGD-L_2 attack guides adversarial perturbations with spatial and spectral preservation terms to reduce face-recognition similarity while limiting pixel-level distortion and high-frequency changes that may interfere with hidden watermark cues. Evaluated on controlled facial images with two watermarking schemes, two face-recognition models, and two datasets, the attack achieves evasion rates above 92% at operational thresholds while preserving watermark recovery above 93% for StegaFormer and above 99.7% for FaceSigns, with visual quality above 47dB PSNR at epsilon_2=2.0. These results expose a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification: a face image can remain watermark-valid and visually faithful while becoming biometrically unreliable.

</details>


### [90] [Event Cameras versus Frame Cameras for Synthetic-Aperture Imaging: A Simulation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20309)
*Jakob Hinterholzer,Mohamed Youssef,Oliver Bimber*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过仿真比较了事件相机与帧相机在合成孔径成像(SAI)去除遮挡物任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAI目前主要使用帧相机，作者想探究事件相机是否具有优势，尤其在高动态、高速场景中。

Method: 用Blender渲染序列，分别用EMVA 1288噪声模型生成帧图像、用v2e模拟器(类Sony IMX636)生成事件流；帧用现有渲染器积分，事件则提出新方法将每个事件按其插值位姿投影到焦平面，无需分箱成帧。

Result: 25 m/s亮场景下帧相机仅3帧无法去遮挡，事件相机可重建目标（即使事件率控制器丢弃大部分事件）；5 lux下高速时两者均失败；5 lux、5 m/s时两者质量相近；高速度下事件流数据量与3帧相当；1 m/s匹配数据预算下事件相机无优势。

Conclusion: 事件相机在高速亮场景SAI中优于帧相机，但其数据率依赖场景，恰在最需要的高速亮场景中最高。

Abstract: Synthetic-aperture imaging (SAI) removes occluders such as foliage by integrating many views of a scene along a camera path. It has so far been used mainly with frame cameras. We ask whether an event camera has advantages for SAI, and answer the question in simulation, where both sensors see exactly the same scene and the same camera movement. A densely rendered Blender sequence is turned into frames with an EMVA~1288 noise model of an industrial global-shutter camera, and into an event stream with the v2e simulator parameterized like a Sony IMX636. The frames are integrated with the existing airborne optical sectioning renderer. For the events we add a new integration path that projects every single event onto the focal plane at its own interpolated pose, so no events have to be binned into frames. We compare the two sensors in three main runs and an additional dark high-speed test. In a bright scene at 25,m/s the frame camera records only three images on the path and cannot remove the occluder, while the event camera reconstructs the target, even after an event-rate controller drops most of its events to fit the camera link. At the same speed in a 5,lux scene the event camera no longer resolves the target either. In a 5,lux scene at 5,m/s both sensors reconstruct the target at similar quality. We also compare the data one traversal of the aperture costs. At high speed the capped event stream still shows the target at the same data volume as the three frames. At 1,m/s we compare both cameras at two matched data budgets, and there the event camera has no advantage over the frame camera in reconstruction quality. The data rate of the event camera depends on the scene and is highest exactly in the fast bright scenes where it is needed most.

</details>


### [91] [Beyond Static Cues: Unified Dynamic Detection of MLLM Backdoors via Dual-Flow Trajectory Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20319)
*Yinzhen Huang,Jiahe Xie,Yitong Sun,Ruochen Zhang,Xingxing Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EVO-Detect，将多模态大模型后门检测从静态观测转向动态输出演化，通过监测早期解码步中注意力流与logits流的演化实现统一检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有防御依赖静态快照和攻击特定启发式，难以应对文本注入、亚感知噪声、跨模态协同等多样未知后门触发器。

Method: 监测早期解码步的内部信号动态演化，包含两个分支：注意力流衡量图文注意力分配演化；logits流量化输出分布对模态扰动的敏感性（介入式消融）。将轨迹转为样本级指标并针对负对照签名归一化。

Result: 在多种攻击族上显著优于BYE、TCAP等最新基线。

Conclusion: 动态输出演化为后门检测提供了统一且有效的范式，能更好应对未知攻击类型。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.

</details>


### [92] [Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20335)
*Yuheng Chen,Yufan Chen,Zhuojun Cai,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Jiale Wei,Di Wen,Weijia Fan,Kunyu Peng,Jiaming Zhang,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出统一文档解析数据集 Read-Parse-Describe（RPD），要求模型对页面图像输出含边框、语义标签、阅读顺序、文本内容及视觉元素替代文本的有序解析结果，并提出即插即用的空间感知增强器，实验表明现有系统难以联合恢复阅读顺序与视觉语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档理解系统通常将版面分析、光学文本识别、阅读顺序预测和图像描述作为独立模块评估，导致科学图表、标题和视觉语义之间的关联薄弱，且无法衡量模型能否产生结构忠实且语义可访问的页面级统一解析。

Method: 构建统一数据集 RPD，包含 2,402 篇文档、18,163 连续页、125,218 个版面元素和 11,338 个视觉实例，任务要求输出有序版面元素列表（含边界框、语义标签、阅读顺序索引、识别文本及视觉元素替代文本）；并提出即插即用的空间感知增强器，复用多层视觉特征并向视觉-语言 token 注入网格感知空间引导以实现版面感知生成。

Result: 在端到端 VLM 与流水线解析器上的实验显示，现有系统仍难以联合恢复阅读顺序和视觉语义，而所提增强模型取得了较强的联合性能。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明需要超越孤立的文档解析模块，转向能够联合阅读、解析和描述复杂文档的统一模型。数据集与代码将在 https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD 公开。

Abstract: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD

</details>


### [93] [InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20341)
*Yongzhen Hu,Hao Yu,Jiawei Wang,Xianming Zeng,Jianyun Xu,Xingliang Liu,Ruizhen Hu,Xiaowei Zhou,Hujun Bao,Sida Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfiniSplat v2通过架构与训练改进，提升前馈高斯重建在大视角变化下的渲染质量，在六个数据集上取得SOTA的LPIPS与DISTS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈高斯重建虽能直接从输入图像构建3D场景，但在大视角变化下，从预测几何学习高斯属性以实现高质量渲染仍具挑战性。作者分析了高斯属性学习中的局限性。

Method: 采用冻结几何分支将几何与属性预测解耦；训练时用真值相机位姿对齐预测高斯；采用大角度目标视角监督。

Result: 在六个数据集上，单一训练模型的前馈输出在姿态条件与无姿态设定下均取得评估方法中最佳的均值LPIPS与DISTS。姿态条件下，LPIPS与DISTS分别较最强基线下降25.8%和32.9%。

Conclusion: 架构与训练改动有效提升渲染质量；仅用图像重建监督学习的不透明度会抑制几何不一致的点。

Abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

</details>


### [94] [ReferFlow: Beyond Final-Target Localization for Complex Referring Expressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20352)
*Tianyi Gao,Han Fang,Xin Wei,Yaoyao Zhong,Zhaoyan Pan,Weijie Zhu,Hongbo Sun,Zhiyu Lin,Kaicheng Yang,Jinglin Xu,Ye Yuan,Hao Li,Hao Sun,Jingmin Xin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹级REC任务与ReferFlow-Bench基准，并设计ReferFlow模型，通过状态化区域潜在推理、轨迹感知并行解码和Grounding-Aware GRPO实现一致的多步定位，在通用REC和ReferFlow-Bench上均取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有REC基准多聚焦最终目标定位，复杂查询中的中间视觉参考及其对先前定位的不同依赖未被评估，最终-only评价掩盖了多步定位过程的问题。

Method: 形式化轨迹级REC，构建含Refinement、Shift、Reset、Mixture四类轨迹的ReferFlow-Bench；提出ReferFlow，将交错的文本-潜在轨迹生成与坐标解码解耦，使用Stateful Region Latent Reasoning以对象索引状态表示区域并施加视觉与空间监督，采用Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding并行恢复坐标块，并应用Grounding-Aware GRPO促进跨步一致定位与自适应轨迹生成。

Result: 当前模型在连续步骤中难以稳定定位中间视觉参考；ReferFlow在通用REC基准和ReferFlow-Bench上均取得领先性能。

Conclusion: 轨迹级REC能揭示最终-only评估忽视的多步定位能力，ReferFlow通过状态化潜在推理、并行解码与轨迹感知强化学习，有效提升复杂REC查询下的一致定位表现。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models have made significant progress in referring expression comprehension (REC), yet most REC benchmarks still focus on final-target localization. Complex queries often involve intermediate visual references with different dependencies on prior grounding, but final-only evaluation leaves this process unexamined. To address this gap, we formulate trajectory-level REC, in which models receive an ordered sequence of grounding steps constructed from a single complex query and localize the target regions associated with each step. We instantiate this setting in ReferFlow-Bench, which characterizes structured region transitions through four trajectory types, namely Refinement, Shift, Reset, and Mixture. Experiments show that current models struggle to consistently ground intermediate visual references across successive steps. We further propose ReferFlow, which decouples interleaved text-latent trajectory generation from coordinate decoding. Specifically, Stateful Region Latent Reasoning represents each target region as an object-indexed state composed of continuous latents, with explicit visual and spatial supervision to preserve region information for subsequent grounding. Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding then recovers all coordinate blocks in parallel through four geometry-constrained refinement rounds, with each block conditioned on its corresponding trajectory prefix, thereby reducing within-box sequential dependencies and eliminating cross-box autoregression. We further apply Grounding-Aware GRPO to promote consistent grounding across steps and learn adaptive trajectory generation from complex REC queries. ReferFlow achieves leading performance on general REC benchmarks and ReferFlow-Bench.

</details>


### [95] [Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20384)
*Xu Zhang,Jun Wan,Lefei Zhang,Liangpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PreActIR，一种在执行工具前预测其后果的智能体图像修复框架，通过工具条件世界模型预测退化、质量、保真度变化及风险与不确定性，减少无效调用并提升修复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合退化图像修复智能体只有在运行工具后才知道其效果，失败调用浪费算力，有害输出也不能及时察觉。

Method: 为每个候选工具构建工具条件世界模型，预测残差退化、图像质量、保真度变化以及有害风险和预测不确定性；智能体执行排序最靠前的候选，独立验证器在重规划前决定提交或回滚输出；同时审计性能受选择器还是候选空间限制，并研究通过定向工具适配扩展候选空间。

Result: 在固定候选池、验证器和预算并使用参考标注退化状态的受控评估中，相比反应式"先执行再评估"试错，PreActIR 减少 42.5% 真实工具调用和 63.4% 被拒调用，Y-PSNR 提升 0.92 dB。

Conclusion: 在执行前预测工具后果可有效提升混合退化图像修复智能体的效率与效果，并帮助诊断性能瓶颈来源。

Abstract: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

</details>


### [96] [STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20390)
*Shuo Wang,Sifan Zhou,Xiaobo Wang,Tianyu Fu,Chenxu Zhao,Anyang Su,Hanning Wang,Ping Jiang,Minghui Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STP-GUI，一种面向GUI智能体的查询引导空间感知token剪枝框架，在激进降token下保持局部视觉结构完整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM驱动的Web-GUI智能体因高分辨率截图和多轮历史带来过多视觉token，推理开销大；现有面向自然图像的剪枝方法独立按重要性选token，会破坏识别小GUI元素（按钮、图标、超链接）所需的局部视觉结构。

Method: STP-GUI结合查询引导的细粒度指令条件token打分与空间连贯的窗口级选择；通过策略学习优化一个轻量选择器，VLM主干保持冻结。

Result: 在Online-Mind2Web上，21% token保留率下保持77.7%的全token性能，推理延迟降低31%，FLOPs降低57%；在Android in the Wild上显示可迁移到移动GUI环境。

Conclusion: STP-GUI在低token预算下实现良好的效率-性能权衡，并具备跨Web与移动GUI的泛化能力。

Abstract: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.

</details>


### [97] [Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20397)
*Bowen Xiang,Dingjie Su,Jon S. Heiselman,Michael I. Miga*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可复用的标签感知高斯分配前端，将CT、标签与传递函数映射到2mm密度并精确选取B个高斯位置，无需逐患者优化。神经先验与七参数VACF在20例测试集上将血管PSNR较均匀分配提升4.5-7.1dB，接近逐患者优化水平，并可加速位置优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅在CT电影渲染中靠解剖标签保护血管，但表示需逐患者优化场景，稠密化决定高斯位置而实时显示限制其数量。本文聚焦其中一环：在固定预算B下决定高斯应放在哪里。

Method: 提出可复用、标签感知的分配前端，将患者CT、标签和传递函数映射为2mm体素上的密度，并精确采样B个位置，无需逐患者优化（其余高斯属性仍逐患者拟合）。前端从逐患者优化场景中一次性学习，实现为群体训练的神经先验和可解释的七参数可见性感知闭式解（VACF）。

Result: 在20例留出患者、10K-100K高斯、相同属性拟合下，两者将血管掩膜PSNR较均匀分配提升4.5-7.1dB，较剪枝的稠密体素对齐模型提升1.6-3.3dB。神经先验在各预算下与逐患者优化分配无显著差异，VACF血管上相差0.6dB内；19例外部患者上神经先验同样匹配，VACF在0.7dB内。作为位置优化初始化，VACF在10K时血管指标优于逐患者稠密化，25K时118s优化后PSNR高于稠密化248s。渲染预设变化下VACF可迁移到新颜色与光照但不适用于无标签传递函数，神经先验则相反。

Conclusion: 标签感知的高斯分配前端可在无逐患者优化下接近优化分配质量，并可作为有效初始化加速优化；神经先验与VACF在泛化性上各有优劣。

Abstract: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.

</details>


### [98] [Hybrid supervised instance segmentation by learning label noise suppression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20412)
*Linwei Chen,Ying Fu,Shaodi You,Hongzhe Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合监督实例分割流程，结合廉价的边界框标签与精确的像素级标签，在降低标注成本的同时保持较高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全监督实例分割依赖大规模像素级标注，成本高且耗时；弱/半监督方法虽节省成本但性能牺牲大，因此需要在节省标注成本和不显著损失性能之间取得平衡。

Method: 设计两个辅助模型：一个抑制前景与背景间的错误标注，另一个抑制实例间误标噪声，从边界框标签获取精确伪像素级标签；并利用类别感知空间注意力模块、类别约束模块、实例约束模块及自学习训练策略提升伪标签精度。

Result: 在 PASCAL VOC 2012 和 Cityscapes 数据集上，该方法以更少标注成本达到有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 混合使用边界框标签与像素级标签的流水线能有效降低标注成本并保持实例分割性能。

Abstract: To reach top accuracy, current fully supervised instance segmentation methods severely rely on large-scale pixel-wise labeled datasets. They are usually expensive and time-consuming to obtain. Though weakly or semi-supervised methods utilize cheap bounding box labeled, image-level labeled or unlabeled samples to save the labeling cost, their performance is largely sacrificed. To save labeling cost without losing much performance, in this paper, we present a pipeline that can utilize economical bounding box labels and accurate pixel-wise labels in a hybrid way. Specifically, we design two ancillary models to learn label noise suppression and obtain accurate pseudo pixel-wise labels from bounding box labels for training. One is designed to suppress mislabeling between foreground and background, and the other is designed to suppress noise from mislabeling of instances. Moreover, we exploit category-aware spatial attention module, category constraint module, instance constraint module, and self-learning training approach to improve the accuracy of pseudo labels. Experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and the Cityscapes datasets show that our method can achieve competitive performance with much less labeling cost.

</details>


### [99] [Infant Fingerprints: Quality Assessment & Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20432)
*João L. H. Dall Agnol,Dalcimar Casanova,Rodrigo Minetto,Luiz F. P. Southier,Marcelo Teixeira,Marcelo Filipak,Anil K. Jain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文评估十种指纹质量评估方法在婴幼儿纵向数据集（新生儿至三个月，六个年龄组）上的表现，并提出参数调优流程以适配婴幼儿生理与采集特点，从而提升婴儿指纹识别可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴儿指纹识别受限于生理特点（脊线宽度与间距小）和采集挑战（非自主运动、皮肤残留、指压不均），导致面向成人设计的指纹质量标准失效，因其特征分布假设不适用于婴儿。

Method: 在覆盖六个年龄组的纵向数据集上评估十种指纹质量评估方法，并提出参数调优流程，基于年龄特异性指纹特征对含领域依赖假设的方法进行重校准；通过识别实验比较默认与调优配置对质量引导的图库选择效果，并进一步考察模板融合策略与潜伏指纹识别技术。

Result: 调优参数集在多数方法和年龄组上优于默认配置，表明对现有框架的针对性重校准可提升图库效用；同时通过模板融合与潜伏指纹识别技术确认了最佳方法可达的最高匹配率。

Conclusion: 针对婴幼儿特点对现有指纹质量评估框架进行重校准，能有效改善图库效用，推动更可靠的婴儿指纹识别。

Abstract: Infant fingerprint recognition is hindered by a combination of physiological characteristics, such as small ridge width and spacing, and acquisition challenges that include involuntary motion, skin residue, and uneven fingertip pressure. These factors undermine fingerprint quality standards originally designed for adults, which assume feature distributions that do not hold for infants. To address this gap, this paper evaluates ten fingerprint quality assessment methods on a longitudinal dataset that spans six age groups from newborns to three months, alongside a parameter tuning routine that uncovers age-specific fingerprint characteristics to recalibrate methods with domain-dependent assumptions. Both default and tuned configurations are compared through recognition experiments assessing the effectiveness of quality-guided gallery selection. Template-fusion strategies and latent fingerprint recognition technologies are further examined to identify the best possible matching rates achievable by the top-performing method. Results show that tuned parameter sets outperform default configurations for the majority of methods and age groups, indicating that targeted recalibration of existing frameworks improves gallery utility and contributes to more reliable infant fingerprint recognition.

</details>


### [100] [Quantifying privacy risks in foundation model representations of brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20494)
*Imen Bajar,Héber Hwang Arcolezi,Antoine Boutet,Carole Frindel,Mohamed Maouche*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究冻结的脑MRI预训练编码器释放的嵌入表示保留了患者特异性信息的程度，发现即使没有身份识别训练目标，患者链接和敏感属性推断风险仍很高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练表示被广泛用于共享医学图像信息而不暴露原始扫描，但这些表示保留多少患者特异性信息尚不清楚，这对隐私保护至关重要。

Method: 在OASIS-2和MIRIAD两个纵向T1加权数据集上，评估5个冻结的预训练编码器（涵盖不同架构、预训练目标和训练领域）。采用攻击者模型，假设其可访问释放的嵌入、对应公开编码器及辅助MRI扫描，评估患者链接和敏感属性推断。

Result: 最高风险表示的rank-1患者链接在MIRIAD上达99%，在OASIS-2上超过90%；记录的性别预测在OASIS-2上平衡准确率达90.9%，在MIRIAD上达95.5%。

Conclusion: 用学习嵌入替代原始脑MRI本身并不能消除患者链接或属性推断风险，仅靠嵌入不足以保证匿名性。

Abstract: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. We investigate this question for brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by evaluating five frozen pretrained encoders spanning different architectures, pretraining objectives, and training domains on two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. Across the evaluated representations, we observe substantial subject-specific information: rank-1 patient linkage reaches up to 99\% on MIRIAD and exceeds 90\% on OASIS-2 for the highest-risk representation, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We further show that the released embeddings retain information about a demographic attribute, with recorded-sex prediction reaching balanced accuracy of 90.9\% on OASIS-2 and 95.5\% on MIRIAD. Overall, our results demonstrate that replacing raw brain MRI with learned embeddings does not, by itself, eliminate patient-linkage or attribute-inference risk, and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.

</details>


### [101] [OLiVES: An Outdoor Low-Light Video Benchmark for Enhancement and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20501)
*Yini Li,Joanne Lin,David Blackham,David Bull,Nantheera Anantrasirichai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OLiVES，一个面向户外动态场景的低光照视频基准数据集，同时支持低光视频增强(LLVE)和视频目标分割(VOS)，包含超25,000对齐帧对和46,000+ VOS标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光视频处理因高质量真值数据稀缺而研究不足。现有数据集存在运动多样性受限、场景覆盖有限、退化弱、依赖事件等辅助模态、低光输入与真值不对齐等问题，且通常只关注增强或场景理解之一，而二者应联合考虑。

Method: 构建OLiVES数据集：采用专业电影级相机采集户外低光动态视频，涵盖多种自然纹理、动物、遮挡、动态活动和特写场景，并提供对齐的正常光/低光帧对及VOS标注。

Result: OLiVES包含超25,000对对齐的正常光与低光帧，以及超46,000条VOS标注。在此数据集上对当前最先进LLVE和VOS方法进行基准测试，证明在其上训练可提升两个任务的性能。

Conclusion: OLiVES是首个使用专业电影级相机采集的户外低光视频数据集，弥补了内容空白，并为低光增强与视频目标分割的联合研究提供基准支持。

Abstract: Low-light video processing remains an underexplored problem in computer vision, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality ground-truth data. Existing public datasets exhibit several limitations, including restricted motion diversity, limited scene coverage, weak degradations, reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data, and misalignment between low-light inputs and ground truth. Furthermore, current datasets typically address either low-light enhancement or scene understanding, whereas these tasks should be considered jointly. We introduce \textbf{OLiVES}, a benchmark dataset for outdoor low-light videos with dynamic scenes, designed to support both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). The dataset addresses key content gaps by incorporating a diverse range of natural textures, animals, occlusions, dynamic activities, and close-up scenes. To the best of our knowledge, OLiVES is the first outdoor low-light video dataset captured using professional cinema-grade cameras. It provides over 25,000 aligned normal- and low-light frame pairs, along with over 46,000 VOS annotations. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLVE and VOS methods on OLiVES and show that training on it improves performance on both tasks. The OLiVES project page is available at: https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/.

</details>


### [102] [VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20509)
*Hairong Ni,Jiahe Huang,Minghao Guo,Wojciech Matusik,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VascuSR是一种解剖感知的迭代扩散超分框架，通过显式3D血管引导提升CT图像血管结构重建的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式超分在CT重建中可能产生解剖学上不支持的血管细节（缺失、伪影或错误连接），因为高频信息无法由低分辨率输入唯一确定。

Method: 采用显式3D血管表示捕捉跨切片结构信息；用轻量级3D生成精炼器优化血管结构；通过轻量解剖控制器将精炼结构注入扩散解码器，并借助迭代反馈从每个新SR体积更新引导。

Result: 在重新标注的MSD Task08和HVM数据集上，分割精度（Dice、clDice）和3D血管结构（连通性、平均中心线距离）均优于插值和基于学习的基线，图像质量与SR骨干相当；连接组件计数降低超20%，MSD上平均中心线距离降低超10%。

Conclusion: 显式3D血管引导能有效缓解生成式CT超分中的解剖学不合理问题，在保持图像质量的同时显著提升血管结构与分割精度。

Abstract: Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller injects the refined structure into the diffusion decoder, while iterative feedback updates this guidance from each new SR volume. On re-annotated MSD Task08 and HVM datasets, VascuSR outperforms interpolation and learning-based SR baselines in segmentation accuracy (Dice and clDice) and 3D vascular structure (connectivity and mean centerline distance), while maintaining image quality comparable to its SR backbone. Compared with learning-based baselines, VascuSR reduces class-averaged connected-component counts by over 20% on both datasets and mean centerline distance by over 10% on MSD.

</details>


### [103] [Reliability-Aware Multimodal Sentiment Prediction Under Local Modality Missingness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20543)
*Minghao Kong,Deng Yao,Xi Zhang,Ying Gao,Jiurun Chen,Zirong Liu,Rongjie Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RM-Net用学习token表示缺失位置、按观测质量门控各模态强度，结合LoRA-BERT文本专家融合，在CMU-MOSEI上处理局部缺失：干净宏F1 0.655，40%混合缺失0.634，并给出可解释性与对齐流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态情感模型通常在完整话语上评测，但真实流常丢失连续的文本、音频或视频片段。论文研究对齐后CMU-MOSEI特征上的局部缺失问题。

Method: 提出可靠性感知网络RM-Net：保留原始时间位置，用学习token表示未观测位置，输出受观测质量门控的有界模态强度贡献，并用连续段双视图掩码训练。将五个RM-Net种子与LoRA适配的BERT文本专家融合，融合权重仅依赖可见内容token比例。

Result: 留出集上，融合模型干净输入宏F1为0.655，40%混合缺失下为0.634；双视图平均比辅助头基线高0.024（95%视频簇bootstrap区间[0.003,0.045]）。但该集在开发中被查看，非盲测。Shapley归因与位置遮挡显示最高排名位置比随机位置更快降低预测类概率（验证集AUC差0.113）。

Conclusion: RM-Net在局部缺失下具备较好鲁棒性并提供一定可解释性，但结果非盲测需谨慎解读；另描述了用于原始片段的可审计词级对齐流程，其输出不进入预测模型。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.

</details>


### [104] [Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20556)
*Yubo Huang,Yuxuan Zhang,Jiaming Liu,Sirui Zhao,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Speculative Sampling 策略，用大双向窗口建模+噪声填充与缓存复用，兼顾视频质量与低延迟交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频生成通常用小双向块降低延迟，但初步实验发现更大块能提升视频质量并更好利用 GPU 并行，采样时间增加有限。

Method: Speculative Sampling：通过附加噪声 latent 作为 padding 扩大建模窗口，并缓存预测结果在条件不变时复用；预测增量交付，未提交的未来可替换。

Result: 延迟分析表明该方法消除了块边界带来的等待时间下界，将优化重点从减小块大小转向加速单块采样。

Conclusion: 双向窗口大小成为联合优化视觉质量与采样时间的决策变量，而非低延迟约束；无需复杂流式后训练即可在交互式流系统中服务大双向模型。

Abstract: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.

</details>


### [105] [A$^3$PreCore: Robust Rigid Registration for Native FLAIR-Space Brain-Mask Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20561)
*Elmira Mirzabeigi,Zahra Khalilzad,Taylor Snowden-Richardson,Jesus Eduardo Lugo Arce,Jodie R. Gawryluk,Brian R. Christie,Jocelyn Faubert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出A³PreCore刚性配准策略与E-QC质控框架，将T1脑掩膜可靠迁移到原生FLAIR空间，显著降低配准失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当T1到FLAIR的刚性配准不稳定时，脑掩膜向原生FLAIR空间的可靠迁移会失败，需更稳健的策略与质控方法。

Method: A³PreCore为六自由度刚性配准策略：用归一化互信息将全脑偏置校正T1对齐到原生FLAIR，同时保留既有T1空间解剖掩膜；并引入E-QC，从掩膜范围、视野相对位置、FLAIR强度支持、边界支持、下部形态及成对几何不一致性刻画质量。

Result: 78名被试中，fsl_anat严重刚性错配21/78(26.9%)，A³PreCore为0/78(McNemar p=9.54×10⁻⁷)。无严重错配的57人中，A³PreCore与fsl_anat高度一致(中位Dice=0.993；ΔNMI中位=-0.00007，p=0.429)，与BET亦一致(中位Dice=0.955)且下部和颅外延伸更少。盲法神经科学家在35/40(87.5%)中被试中将A³PreCore排第一。E-QC还揭示全局指标或质心位移无法发现的严重方向性不一致。

Conclusion: A³PreCore是稳健的原生FLAIR脑掩膜迁移策略，E-QC是互补的多维掩膜表征与被试特异性质控框架。

Abstract: Reliable brain-mask transfer into native fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) space can fail when T1-to-FLAIR rigid registration is unstable. We developed A$^3$PreCore, a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-registration strategy that aligns the full bias-corrected T1-weighted image to native FLAIR using normalized mutual information while preserving the established T1-space anatomical mask. We also introduced extended quantitative quality control (E-QC), which characterizes mask extent, field-of-view-relative position, FLAIR intensity support, boundary support, inferior morphology, and pairwise geometric disagreement. In 78 participants with paired T1-weighted and FLAIR imaging, A$^3$PreCore was compared with fsl_anat and the Brain Extraction Tool (BET). Gross rigid-body misregistration occurred in 21/78 fsl_anat outputs (26.9%) and 0/78 A$^3$PreCore outputs (exact two-sided McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7). Among 57 participants without gross fsl_anat misregistration, A$^3$PreCore preserved close agreement (median Dice=0.993; median paired Delta NMI=-0.00007, p=0.429). A$^3$PreCore remained broadly concordant with BET (median Dice=0.955), with less inferior and extracranial extension in representative comparisons. Method-blinded neuroscientists ranked A$^3$PreCore first in 35/40 participants (87.5%). E-QC additionally exposed severe orientation-related disagreement not evident from global descriptors or centroid displacement alone. These findings support A$^3$PreCore as a robust native-FLAIR brain-mask transfer strategy and E-QC as a complementary framework for multidimensional mask characterization and participant-specific geometric quality control.

</details>


### [106] [Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20571)
*Weijie Wang,Haomin Zhang,Ye Li,Akide Liu,Zeyu Zhang,Haoyu Zhao,Yefei He,Donny Y. Chen,Feng Chen,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ATAS框架，将剧本编译为带有位置、相机和事件时间引用的镜头请求，并借助场景记忆与事件记忆实现长视频生成中的跨镜头空间与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长篇幅智能体视频生成需要把剧本转化为镜头，并在非连续请求间保持空间和时间一致性；仅传递提示或最近帧无法提供共享空间参照或按时间索引的事件记录。

Method: ATAS将剧本编译为带显式location、camera、event-time引用的镜头请求；生成前从静态几何场景记忆和按scene/event/time索引的动态事件记忆中检索证据；生成后重建并注册片段，仅在review和state检查通过时更新记忆，且影片交付独立于记忆准入。

Result: 在四种视频生成器上，ATAS提升所有跨镜头一致性指标并取得每个backbone最高综合基准分；在目标图像空间重访上优于对比智能体与3D引导方法，在事件重捕获上领先三项标准，并在全部六项人类评分标准上获最高分。

Conclusion: ATAS通过显式引用和双记忆检索/注册机制有效提升长视频跨镜头一致性与事件重访能力，代码与视频已公开。

Abstract: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.

</details>


### [107] [Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20584)
*Mingyu Ouyang,Yiran Wang,Siyuan Hu,Xingyilang Yin,Huiqiang Sun,Guangzhi Wang,Junfu Pu,Cheng Cheng,Honghao Chen,Ying Shan,Mike Zheng Shou,Hwee Tou Ng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Player-1后训练框架，通过合成经验学习游戏控制，超越演示学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏视觉丰富、机制多样，是通用数字控制的挑战性下一步。现有游戏智能体依赖大规模演示，对动态状态覆盖有限，且可扩展的交互训练环境难以获得。

Method: 扩展动作空间（相对指针运动、持续输入、复合动作）；用6,044条精选游戏轨迹微调做监督初始化；构建Player-1-Gym（16个2D/3D合成环境），用程序化可验证奖励和随机化观测/控制动态做多环境PPO强化学习。

Result: Player-1-9B和35B-A3B在MineDojo-300上比SFT分别提升27.8和17.7个百分点；9B达38.33%成功率，最强基线仅12.63%；在ViZDoom-10和GameWorld上也优于SFT。

Conclusion: 合成经验学习显著提升游戏控制，泛化超出RL训练环境；更广的合成环境覆盖改善迁移，复合动作使用在RL中增加。

Abstract: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.

</details>


### [108] [Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20590)
*Seungmi Choi,Ji-Hyoun Choi,Suhyun Jo,Tae-Gwon Park,Hui Yong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MFGS 提出端到端前馈多视角特征编码框架，直接压缩多视角特征而非显式3DGS表示，实现跨属性冗余利用和重要性引导的高斯选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3DGS场景编码采用"先生成后压缩"流程，分别编码几何与外观属性，含不可微操作，设计复杂且限制率失真性能。

Method: MFGS提取输入图像的多视角特征并编码为紧凑比特流；通过端到端率失真训练学习联合表示几何与外观的紧凑特征；引入重要性引导的高斯选择以适应不同渲染预算。

Result: 在RE10K、ACID、DL3DV上，BD-rate显示相比"生成后压缩"流程节省99.76-99.86%比特率，GMACs减少52-55%，端到端加速约12倍。

Conclusion: MFGS通过直接编码多视角特征，避免复杂属性专用编解码器，显著提升率失真性能与计算效率，并支持灵活渲染预算。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.

</details>


### [109] [GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20592)
*Haoyuan Li,Qihang Cao,Huanyuan Zhou,Xin Hu,Sijia Chen,Zihan Guo,Kun Xiang,Yunshuang Nie,Tao Tang,Xinlong Zheng,Jia-Wang Bian,Xianming Liu,Xiaodan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoThinker-F 通过将 MLLM 隐状态转化为预测性潜在世界表示，使模型无需外部 3D 编码器即可具备时空感知，实现最高 3.6 倍推理加速并保持强空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何感知 MLLM 依赖外部 3D 编码器提供结构先验，但推理时执行额外编码器路径会带来显著的延迟与计算开销。

Method: 提出 GeoThinker-F 框架，核心思想是中间语义表示足以预测当前几何与未来语义的有用表示，无需精确复现 3D 编码器特征。采用解耦两阶段训练：第一阶段冻结 MLLM 主干，用轻量 Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) 头从离线 3D 几何专家和下一帧语义目标中学习；第二阶段移除外部专家，联合优化模型，通过 Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion 模块生成并选择性整合自预测先验。

Result: 在多个空间智能基准上保持有竞争力性能，消除对运行时外部 3D 几何编码器的依赖，实现最高 3.6 倍推理加速，延迟从 1.45 秒降至 0.40 秒。

Conclusion: GeoThinker-F 证明可将时空感知内化到 MLLM 中，在显著提升推理效率的同时保留强空间推理能力。

Abstract: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.

</details>


### [110] [DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20598)
*Qihang Cao,Haoyuan Li,Zihan Guo,Sensen Gao,Zihui Gao,Huixin Zhang,Fan He,Jianhua Han,Hang Xu,Xiaodan Liang,Jia-Wang Bian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DynThinker统一框架，通过D-EMA和SDF缓解静态3D与动态4D空间推理之间的干扰，在9个基准的10个指标上取得开源模型最优平均分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用空间智能需统一理解静态3D与动态4D，但现有模型难以兼顾：3D后训练会削弱动态理解，4D专用模型缺乏静态3D推理能力。作者发现这种空间-动态干扰在参数组间高度不均匀，静态与动态能力的平衡对后层MLP变化尤为敏感。

Method: 提出DynThinker统一框架，包含两个组件：Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) 对干扰敏感的可配置参数组施加分组平均以约束预训练参数漂移，同时保留能力增强的灵活性；Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) 在语义引导下，选择性地将动态几何编码器的空间与时间先验融入VLM中间层表示。

Result: 在涵盖9个静态3D和动态4D基准的10个指标上，DynThinker取得所有评估模型中最高的平均分。ReVSI达56.0，DSR-Bench达67.2，DSI-Bench在sample-wise和group-wise协议下分别为51.2和40.1，在单一统一模型中于四项评测均刷新对比开源模型的最优结果。

Conclusion: 通过针对性地缓解参数组层面的空间-动态干扰，DynThinker在统一模型内同时强化了静态3D与动态4D空间推理，验证了该干扰分析与干预策略的有效性。

Abstract: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.

</details>


### [111] [CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20603)
*Xiaoli Xu,Zhengtao Wu,Zhengze Xu,Tao Liu,Yongchao Du,Zuan Gao,Xingjian Wang,Hao Yan,Mengting Chen,Wei Li,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CommerceGen-Studio是一个端到端电商SKU商业级主图生成框架，包含信息抽取、语义改写和多条件生成三阶段流水线，已实现每天数百万张的规模化生产，并发布了CommerceGen-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商主图需同时满足主体保真、商标完整、字符级文字准确和可发布性，而通用生成模型难以稳定达到商业级要求，且缺乏针对真实流量难例的评测基准。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) PERL-Agent通过VLM与LLM迭代闭环，用无参考评分标准将异构SKU元数据蒸馏为卖点文本；(2) LTO通过交替的领域特定策略优化使改写器对齐标题与渲染图像质量；(3) SKU-DiT在RDR渐进训练下，联合以白底产品图、商标裁剪图和结构化布局为条件进行生成。

Result: 生产环境每天生成数百万张主图，单图延迟数秒；在CommerceGen-Bench（跨品类真实流量难例）上，编辑两个赛道（含/不含提示增强）总体得分均为开源基线最高，并可与更大规模闭源模型匹敌，在Instruction Following和Product Integration上超过若干闭源模型。

Conclusion: 该框架是首批在商业规模运行的电商主图生成系统之一，验证了多条件生成在保真与文字准确性上的可行性，并提供了可复现的难例评测基准。

Abstract: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.

</details>


### [112] [VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20604)
*Ao Liang,Youquan Liu,Mingxiao Li,Wei Chow,Lingdong Kong,Yue Liao,Dongyue Lu,Yu Yang,Wei Yin,Runnan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VITAL提出用视觉运动作为主要动作预测目标的动作tokenizer，结合flow matching与残差表示，在NAVSIM上取得高效高分的驾驶决策效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有world-action模型的动作专家基于与视觉动态无关的轨迹表示训练，无法充分利用视觉运动信息，因此需要直接从视觉运动中推导动作目标。

Method: 先分析从未来图像重建轨迹的简单设定，发现重建能捕捉主要机动但存在厘米级误差；据此设计VITAL动作tokenizer，将视觉导出的运动骨架与紧凑残差（编码骨架遗留误差）耦合，用flow matching让动作专家从当前图像、自车状态和导航指令联合预测两部分，推理时无需生成未来图像；同一残差坐标还支持有界强化学习后训练。

Result: 单步去噪在NAVSIM v1 navtest达90.8 PDMS，与十步得分仅差0.13分，端到端推理加速3.29倍；无需重训在NAVSIM v2 navtest达91.1 EPDMS、navhard达38.6。

Conclusion: 以视觉运动为主预测目标、残差分离归一化学习尺度的表示方式，可实现高效且高精度的驾驶动作预测，并支持无需重训的强化学习后训练迁移。

Abstract: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital

</details>


### [113] [Representation Conditioning for Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20608)
*Saeed Razavi,Xingjian Leng,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出表示条件化方法RECON，通过向扩散Transformer的后层注入预训练视觉编码器语义，加速训练收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: REPA等方法虽在早期层引入视觉编码器语义，但后层仅受速度预测损失监督，无法保证很好地获取这些语义。

Method: 训练时将预训练视觉编码器token喂入后层；推理时因无干净图像，复用MLP头作为编码器代理，将其输出token投影到后层。不增加任何参数。

Result: 收敛显著加快，比SiT快63倍，比REPA快25倍。

Conclusion: RECON简单有效地改善扩散Transformer后层语义，实现更快收敛且零额外参数。

Abstract: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers, supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is $63\times$ faster than SiT and $25\times$ faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON

</details>


### [114] [Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20610)
*Jahyeok Koo,Hyeonseo Yu,Seungho Jang,Jaewoo Jung,Jiwon Kang,Seokju Cho,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Ask4NV，利用3D语言理解作为新视角生成的互补监督，基于Mixture-of-Transformers统一多模态模型，在图像质量、几何一致性和3D语言理解上均表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从有限观测生成新视角需保持外观与空间结构。现有方法虽利用细粒度几何线索，但未显式建模高层语义与空间属性（物体身份、属性、物体间关系）。作者探究3D语言理解能否为新视角生成提供互补监督。

Method: 基于预训练统一多模态模型，采用Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构。将相机几何注入VAE与ViT表示；通过联合自注意力及模态感知注意力掩码策略，在生成过程中利用理解特征。

Result: 新视角生成具有较强图像质量与几何一致性，同时具备有竞争力的3D语言理解能力。分析表明联合训练改善了VAE表示的跨视角对应性与3D感知特征空间中的相似性。

Conclusion: 3D语言理解可为新视角生成提供有效的互补监督，联合建模理解与生成能同时提升生成质量与跨视角语义/几何一致性。

Abstract: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [115] [Following the Flow the Law Requires: Training Voice Agents to Transfer to Unseen Regulated Procedures in Debt Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18881)
*Petmongkon Pornpichitsuwan,Krittin Pachtrachai,Touchapon Kraisingkorn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FlowSpec机器可读规范，让小型自托管语音代理通过一次微调即可遵循从未见过的受监管对话流程；在泰国催收外呼场景中，文档化流程检查从67-71%提升至93-100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM语音代理已用于客户通话，但受监管场景（如债务催收）要求代理严格遵循法律规定的对话流程（先确认债务人身份、自报身份与债权人、说明金额、避免违禁措辞）。每家债权人的流程不同且经常修改，需要一种能一次训练、泛化到未见流程的小型自托管策略。

Method: 用FlowSpec（每个部署一份机器可读规范）生成策略指令、门控工具、提供监督并定义测试；代理只使用经批准的目录句子。基于297个随机化流程的2,506段对话，微调90亿参数模型，在四个未见部署流程（三个催收、一个非债务，其中一个来自完全未知谱系）上评估泰语外呼代理。

Result: 由流程固定的文档化检查从67-71%提升到93-100%；由对话固定的接地检查在训练前已达97-100%；场景通过率从15/43提升到40/43。对共享规范的审计发现11个缺陷，其中3个其自身指标未能暴露。

Conclusion: 小型自托管模型经一次微调即可跨未见的受监管流程泛化，FlowSpec在指令生成、工具门控、监督与测试上提供统一支持；但规范本身仍需人工审计以发现指标未覆盖的缺陷。

Abstract: Voice agents built on large language models (LLMs) now handle customer calls, but in regulated applications completing the task is not enough: the agent must follow a conversational flow set by law. In debt collection, it must confirm it is speaking to the debtor before mentioning the debt, identify itself and the creditor, state the amount, and avoid prohibited language. Every creditor turns these rules into its own procedure and revises it. We ask whether a small, self-hosted policy can be trained once and then follow regulated procedures it has never seen. One machine-readable specification per deployment, FlowSpec, generates the policy instruction, gates the tools, supplies the supervision and defines the tests; the agent speaks only approved catalogue sentences. We fine-tune a 9-billion-parameter model on 2,506 conversations from 297 randomized procedures and evaluate a Thai outbound-call agent on four unseen deployment procedures (three debt collection, one non-debt), one from a wholly withheld lineage. Documented checks, fixed by the procedure, rise from 67--71 percents to 93--100 percents, while grounded checks, fixed by the conversation, already pass at 97--100 percents before training; scenario pass rate rises from 15/43 to 40/43. An audit of the shared specification finds 11 defects, 3 of which its own metric did not expose.

</details>


### [116] [Evaluating Large Language Models for Multilingual Abstractive Summarization: A Comprehensive Study of English and Bengali](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19003)
*Khan Mahi Al Atahar,Nazifa Tasneem,Ajwad Abrar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个标准化零样本基准，用8个LLM在规模匹配的英语和孟加拉语XL-Sum测试集上评估多语言摘要，结合词汇/语义指标、无参考事实性验证和LLM-as-a-Judge多维评估，发现模型表现存在显著跨语言差异，且单一指标会导致不同排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抽象式摘要在不同语言中仍具挑战性，语言质量与事实一致性可能不一致，低资源场景尤甚；现有评估多依赖单一指标，难以全面反映多语言摘要的表面质量与事实可靠性。

Method: 在规模匹配的英语和孟加拉语XL-Sum测试集上，对8个闭源与开放权重LLM进行标准化零样本评估；融合词汇与语义指标、无参考事实性验证，以及多维LLM-as-a-Judge评估。

Result: 存在显著跨语言差异：GPT-5.6 Luna在多项英语词汇指标领先，但在孟加拉语中不具备同样优势；LLaMA 3.3 70B在孟加拉语取得最高ROUGE和BLEU；Gemini 2.5 Flash获得最高孟加拉语事实性得分；不同评估方法给出不同模型排名。

Conclusion: 强英语摘要性能不必然迁移到孟加拉语；多语言摘要评估不应依赖单一指标，需要面向低资源语言的综合评估框架。

Abstract: Abstractive summarization remains challenging across languages, where linguistic quality and factual consistency may diverge, particularly in low-resource settings. We present a standardized zero-shot benchmark of eight closed-source and open-weight LLMs on size-matched English and Bengali XL-Sum test sets. Our evaluation combines lexical and semantic metrics with reference-free factuality verification and multidimensional LLM-as-a-Judge assessment, providing a comprehensive analysis of both surface-level quality and factual reliability in multilingual summarization. Results reveal substantial cross-lingual variation: GPT-5.6 Luna leads several English lexical metrics but does not maintain the same advantage in Bengali, where LLaMA 3.3 70B achieves the highest ROUGE and BLEU scores. Gemini 2.5 Flash obtains the highest observed Bengali factuality score. Furthermore, evaluation methods produce different model rankings, highlighting the limitations of relying on a single metric for multilingual summarization assessment. These findings demonstrate that strong English summarization performance does not necessarily transfer to Bengali and emphasize the need for comprehensive evaluation frameworks for low-resource languages.

</details>


### [117] [Can LLMs Access their World Knowledge for Event Prediction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19021)
*Zijun Wu,Zhitian Zhang,Hossein Hajimirsadeghi,Nikita Dvornik,Alexander Pashevich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨LLM是否真无法用于时间事件预测，认为问题在于接口设计而非知识缺失，提出基于自然语言描述与符号标签的方法，并发布DescribeEvent基准（~150K事件、7数据集、6领域）验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究质疑LLM在时间事件预测上常不如简单专用模型，作者提出关键问题：LLM的世界知识是否真的无法获取，还是现有方法未能以LLM可用的形式呈现事件预测任务。

Method: 提出两项接口设计：1）用自然语言描述将每个事件具体化；2）将事件语义与预测空间分离，避免标签关联带来的语义偏差。据此构建DescribeEvent基准，覆盖约15万事件、7个数据集、6个领域，并提供事件级描述。

Result: 能力较强的LLM在加入描述和符号标签后有显著提升，优于无描述变体及非LLM基线；较弱模型获益有限。

Conclusion: LLM用于事件预测的关键是接口问题；事件描述是激发LLM已有世界知识的实用方式，使LLM能成为有效的事件预测器。

Abstract: Recent work has questioned whether large language models (LLMs) can be useful for temporal event prediction. Despite vast pretrained world knowledge, LLMs often underperform simpler specialized models. We ask whether this knowledge is truly inaccessible, or whether current methods fail to present event prediction in a form LLMs can use. We argue for the latter and show that LLMs become effective event forecasters when the interface is designed around two choices. The first grounds each event in a natural-language description, and the second separates event semantics from the prediction space to prevent semantic bias from label associations. To test this, we introduce DescribeEvent, a benchmark of ~150K events across seven datasets and six domains with event-level descriptions. We find that capable LLMs substantially benefit from descriptions and symbolic labels, outperforming description-free variants and non-LLM baselines, while weaker models gain little. These results suggest that accessing LLM world knowledge for event prediction is an interface problem, and that event descriptions offer a practical way to elicit the knowledge LLMs already encode.

</details>


### [118] [Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19026)
*Jiwon Song,Yoongon Kim,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: JSSA 提出联合子空间稀疏注意力，兼顾 token 级选择质量与执行效率，在长上下文 LLM 解码中显著提升吞吐并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏注意力可减少长上下文解码中占主导的 KV-cache 流量，但现有方法多为粗粒度。Token 级选择更精细，却面临两个挑战：低维打分可能丢失 query-key 结构导致排序不准；分散选取 token 的收集开销会抵消延迟收益。

Method: JSSA 通过学习共享低维 query-key 子空间（最小化 token 分数保持误差）提升选择质量；对非凸目标上界化，得到可解的边际目标并给出闭式谱解。同时提出无 gather 的 token 级索引注意力 kernel，在标准 GQA KV-cache 布局下支持每个 KV 头独立选择。

Result: 在 GQA、混合滑窗/全局注意力和 MLA 模型上，JSSA 接近全 KV 精度，避免生成长度膨胀和架构相关失败。B200 GPU 上 128K 上下文解码吞吐最高达全 KV 的 6.43 倍；无需训练即达到模型原生 DSA 的推理精度，700B 规模下吞吐达其 96–99%。

Conclusion: JSSA 通过子空间打分和免 gather 的 token 级 kernel，有效解决了稀疏注意力的选择质量与执行效率问题，在多种架构和大规模模型上实现高吞吐与高精度。

Abstract: Sparse attention reduces the KV-cache traffic that dominates long-context LLM decoding, but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. Token-level selection offers finer control, yet presents two challenges: low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking, while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. We introduce Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA) to address both challenges. For selection quality, JSSA learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. We upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution; direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. For execution efficiency, we develop a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel that supports distinct per-KV-head selections under the standard grouped-query attention (GQA) KV-cache layout. Across standard GQA, hybrid sliding-window/global attention, and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) models, JSSA consistently remains close to full-KV accuracy while avoiding the substantial generation-length inflation and architecture-dependent failures observed with competing methods. On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, JSSA achieves up to $6.43\times$ the decoding throughput of full-KV attention at 128K context. JSSA achieves reasoning accuracy comparable to model-native DSA without model training and reaches 96--99\% of its decoding throughput even at 700B scale large models.

</details>


### [119] [Crossing the Gender Binary: Modelling Gendered Reference in Science Fiction and General Fiction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19028)
*Yuxuan Liu,Haim Dubossarsky,Ruth Ahnert*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过遮蔽科幻小说与一般小说语料中的性别词（man/woman/person），用RoBERTa预测替代词并按性别分类，检验科幻小说在语言层面是否更具性别流动性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科幻小说常被认为挑战性别规范，但这一说法在语言层面（性别指称是否更易被中性或其他社会类别替代）是否成立、且是否区别于一般小说，尚缺乏证据。

Method: 在同一时期的科幻与一般小说语料中遮蔽 man/men、woman/women、person/people，取RoBERTa最可能的五个替代词并按性别分类；用置换检验在五轮重采样中考察保留与置换情况，并细读原句。

Result: 两个语料均双向跨越性别二元，但不对称：遮蔽woman时模型预测阳性词约为遮蔽man时预测阴性词的两倍；科幻小说性别渗透性更强，man更多出现在阴性语境，去性别化倾向也更强；遮蔽woman比遮蔽man更常引出只指社会类别而无性别的替代词。

Conclusion: 研究为科幻研究的主题论断提供了语言学证据，并为计算文学研究提供了可推广到种族、阶级等其他类别词汇的分析流程。

Abstract: Science fiction is widely credited with unsettling gender. This article asks whether that holds at the linguistic level, in how readily gendered reference gives way to its counterpart, a neutral term, or other social category, and whether it separates the genre from general fiction. It does so by masking man/men, woman/women, and person/people across same-period science fiction and general fiction corpora and classifying RoBERTa's five likeliest substitutes by gender.
