Such verifiers usually pick one, often tacitly, and benchmarks score their verdicts against expert labels without recording the expert's interpretation or the verifier's in a comparable form. This leads to disagreements with expert labels that cannot be traced to the evidence or the interpretation, and to compute spent on unchecked interpretations. We introduce Claim Cards to make such interpretations explicit in the reasoning itself. A Claim Card records a verifier's interpretation as nine fields before evidence gathering, each marked stated, inferred, or default. To test whether an agent's interpretation can change its verdict, we ran a GPT-5.4 agent five times on each of 60 expert-labeled materials-science and biomedical claims with a card, without one, and with one card frozen across runs (900 runs). Over 40% of card fields were not marked stated, and a card added about a tenth to a run's GPT-5.4 tokens and time without measurably changing agreement with expert labels. The agent's own interpretations varied between runs, although within a claim this variation did not measurably track the verdict. A deliberate change to one field of the frozen card, however, making the quantifier universal or the threshold for support stricter, changed the verdict on about a third of the claims, against about one in seven expected by chance (p < 0.001 for each edit). On 24 materials-science claims run with computational tools, the stricter threshold also changed what the agent asked those tools to compute. We therefore argue that verdicts should be reported with their interpretations and that benchmarks could publish the interpretation behind each label.

</details>


### [236] [MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20459)
*Jiatong Li,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出MolLean，一种过程可验证的语言，通过显式分子状态约束化学推理，解决思维链中的幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学思维链可能包含虚构的结构和性质断言，需要将化学推理建立在可验证的显式分子状态上。

Method: 设计基于Lean的分层内核，检验分子读数的状态转移与断言；采用类型化见证协议区分原生结构检查与外部测量；并提出MolLean-MCP有状态工具接口，在生成过程中暴露转移、检查和读数，模型根据反馈决定下一步，被拒动作不改变状态。支持一次性追踪执行、整体追踪细化和交互式推理三种模式，在12个任务、8800个匹配样本上评估。

Result: 使用Qwen3.6-27B，整体追踪细化在所有12个任务上优于直接思维链；MolLean-MCP结合逐步验证反馈，在反应任务上表现更好。

Conclusion: 该工作为化学推理提供了可执行基础，显式化学承诺可被检查与修正，而非仅停留在自由形式解释中。

Abstract: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, editing, optimization, and reactions. With Qwen3.6-27B, whole-trace refinement outperforms direct chain-of-thought on all 12 tasks. MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks. Together, these results highlight an executable foundation for chemical reasoning, in which explicit chemical commitments can be checked and revised rather than remaining solely in free-form explanations.

</details>


### [237] [Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20461)
*Nguyen Nguyen,Yongyi Zang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 semCER 指标：在保持 CER 对齐与分母的基础上，用 LLM 判官为每个字形编辑赋严重度分数，可分解为具名编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 CER 将拼写错误与关键错误（如人名写错）等同计分，无法反映编辑的实际严重程度。

Method: 保留 CER 的对齐方式与分母，不做分词；对每个字形编辑由 LLM 判官给出严重度权重，归一化后得到整体分数并可拆解为具名编辑。

Result: 归一化 CER 整体分数与读者评分相当或更好；semCER 能逐编辑追踪读者评分（英、越、中）；在 CER 与 semCER 分歧样本上读者更倾向 semCER（英中）或持平（越）；16 种语言中严重度差异显著（如西班牙语变音符几乎不计，泰卢固语接近错字母）；VLMs 错字母得分远高于随机，传统流水线接近随机。

Conclusion: semCER 提供更贴近人类感知的可分解 OCR/VLM 评测指标，并公开 6100 万条判官编辑、读者评分及蒸馏评分器。

Abstract: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.

</details>


### [238] [ChronoCulture: Evaluating Cultural Awareness Across Time in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20472)
*Rusali Saha,Nitya Khurana,Ruihong Huang,Kuan-Hao Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ChronoCulture基准，用72国纵向调查数据构建10,360个时间对比样本，发现LLM能预测某时点的文化态度，却难以捕捉其随时间的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM文化基准多将文化视为国家或地区的静态属性，忽略文化态度与社会规范随时间演变的事实，缺乏对时间维度的评估。

Method: 基于72个国家的纵向调查数据，构建10,360个时间对（同一国家同一问题的较早与较晚年份问卷），以完整人口回答分布为真实标签；在六种LLM上进行测试，并对比提示中指定年份的效果。

Result: 模型常能预测某一时点的国家态度，但无法可靠捕捉态度变化；其不同年份的预测趋于接近，低估实际变化幅度；提示中指定年份对整体对齐几乎无改善。

Conclusion: LLM往往呈现静态的文化态度图景，需在时间维度上评估模型的文化认知能力。

Abstract: Cultural attitudes and social norms evolve over time, yet most cultural benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) treat culture as a static attribute of a country or region. We introduce ChronoCulture, a benchmark of 10,360 temporal pairs built from longitudinal survey data across 72 countries. Each pair contains the same survey question asked in the same country in an older and a newer year, with full population response distributions as ground truth. Across six LLMs, we find that models can often predict a country's attitudes at one point in time but do not reliably capture how those attitudes change. Their predictions for different years tend to stay close together, failing to capture much of the observed change. Specifying the intended year in the prompt also offers little overall improvement in alignment with survey responses. These findings suggest that models often present a largely static picture of cultural attitudes, highlighting the need to evaluate cultural awareness across time.

</details>


### [239] [AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20474)
*Peidong Wang,Ying Chang,Zhiming Ma,Xiaocui Yang,Shi Feng,Daqi Liu,Yuzhe Yang,Xu Cao,Chuang Wang,Jian Su,Daling Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AdaRSI，一个按需递归自我改进框架，判断具身智能体何时应改变执行器权重，在 RoboCasa365 上将未见复合任务成功率从 4.6% 提升到 13.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练 VLA 在未见长程任务中常中途失败。现有具身 RSI 方法要么只改进固定执行器外围框架而无法补充缺失动作，要么在持续失败上训练执行器而不区分失败源于调用方式还是能力不足。

Method: AdaRSI 让编码智能体先改进自身技能与框架，再通过从保存状态重试失败子步骤来归因持续失败，仅对仍不可靠的子步骤进行微调，使用自行采集的演示和跨任务经验。

Result: 在 RoboCasa365 全部 50 个目标任务上，以 GR00T N1.5 为执行器、无人工演示，三个套件均提升，未见复合任务成功率从 4.6% 升至 13.8%；相比微调每个子步骤，成功率略高而 GPU 时间仅 28%、自采集演示仅 22%；无框架微调则训练更多但收益更少。

Conclusion: 按需决定是否更新执行器权重比全量微调更高效有效，框架改进与选择性微调结合是关键。

Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.

</details>


### [240] [Lost in Translation: Why Lower Bias Scores Don't Mean Fairer Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20479)
*Harsh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 多语言语言模型的偏见审计通常比较英语与其他语言的平均刻板印象得分，并将差异解读为公平性差异。本文质疑这一差异中有多少是噪声。作者审计8种语言中的10个开放模型，测量英语测试项仅改写时得分的波动，逐项检验每种语言转变，并验证测试能否捕获故意注入的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨语言偏见审计直接把平均刻板印象得分的语言间差异等同于公平性差异，但这一假设未经验证。作者想探究其中有多少是测试噪声，从而判断平均分比较是否可靠。

Method: 审计10个开放模型、8种语言：测量英语测试项仅改写时的得分波动；逐项检验语言转换；验证测试能否捕获有意注入的转变；判断每个翻译质量；比较英语得分对翻译得分与改写得分的预测力；检验得分离中性程度、模型间一致性及翻译与改写相关性。

Result: 全部70个模型-语言对中刻板印象得分均低于英语水平；印地语、韩语和斯瓦希里语的下降明显超过英语改写带来的波动，主要来自StereoSet项目。不完美翻译下降更多，但忠实翻译也几乎同样下降。英语得分对翻译得分的预测力远弱于改写得分（相关0.23、忠实翻译0.27，对比0.48）；得分仍远离中性，模型在翻译项上一致，印地语/西班牙语内翻译项与自身改写相关达0.84和0.82。

Conclusion: 较低的平均分并不表明模型更公平，平均值无法区分更低的偏见与不同的逐项得分模式。作者还记录了三种会静默抹除偏见信号的常见流程错误，并公开代码。

Abstract: Bias audits of multilingual language models usually compare a model's average stereotype score in English with its average in another language and read the difference as a difference in fairness. We ask how much of that difference is noise. Auditing ten open models in eight languages, we measure how far scores move when English test items are merely reworded, test every language shift item by item, and check that the test catches shifts we inject on purpose. In all 70 model-language pairs the stereotype score falls below its English level, and for Hindi, Korean and Swahili the drop clearly exceeds what rewording English produces; most of it comes from StereoSet items. Judging every translation, we find that imperfect ones drop more, but faithful translations alone drop nearly as much. Still, a lower average does not show that a model is fairer. An item's English score predicts its translated score far less well than its reworded score (correlation 0.23, 0.27 on faithful translations, vs. 0.48), while scores stay as far from neutral, models agree on translated items, and within Hindi or Spanish a translated item's score correlates with its own rewording at 0.84 and 0.82. The average cannot distinguish lower bias from a different pattern of item-level scores. We also document three common pipeline errors that silently erase bias signal, and release our code.

</details>


### [241] [ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20503)
*Bohan Sun,Zunhai Su,Xialie Zhuang,Jianjin Li,Ngai Wong,Chuan-Wei Kuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReaDy是首个利用混合线性注意力(HLA)的循环状态进行位置特定上下文检索的推测解码方法，在7个基准上平均实现3.16倍加速，超越DSpark。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于特征的草稿器依赖目标隐藏特征，但其上下文侧重可能与后续草稿位置的需求不一致；而HLA模型的紧凑循环状态累积历史关联，可为草稿提供互补上下文。

Method: 为每个草稿位置配备可学习查询，从目标的已提交循环状态中检索补充上下文；轻量级状态读取器通过残差更新整合上下文；采用低秩状态读取与融合算子降低计算/IO开销；基于DSpark的并行骨干与顺序预测头，采用两阶段适配策略，并通过消融考察读取器容量、状态来源与残差位置。

Result: 在数学、代码生成、对话等7个基准上，Qwen3.8-27B在单张NVIDIA B200上平均达3.16倍解码加速；各项基准均优于DSpark，吞吐平均提升7.97%，接受长度提升8.50%。

Conclusion: ReaDy验证了利用HLA循环状态进行位置特定检索可有效提升推测解码效率与质量。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

</details>


### [242] [VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20516)
*Fei Wu,Zhenrong Zhang,Jianshu Zhang,Jun Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VASPO将特权自蒸馏信号整合进PPO框架，用critic提供token级优势、自教师调节正优势，六个数学推理基准上平均准确率优于PPO和GRPO类方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏只反映局部token偏好而非无引导续写的期望回报；GRPO+自教师的方法仅用GRPO定方向、教师做缩放，整合方式次优。

Method: 发现在PPO中互补的位置动态：特权信息在中后段提升critic价值预测精度，自教师指导前期强、中期弱、末期回升。据此提出VASPO，自教师与critic在student前缀上评估同一特权信息，critic从预测续写回报计算token级PPO优势，自教师通过有界概率比调节选定的正优势。

Result: 六个数学推理基准上，VASPO较PPO平均准确率在Qwen3-4B提升2.59个百分点、OLMo3-7B提升1.81个百分点；在Knights and Knaves上取得最优平均准确率。

Conclusion: 在PPO内部整合特权自蒸馏比GRPO缩放更有效，验证了位置互补动态的实用价值。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher. However, this supervision reflects local token preferences rather than the expected return of an unguided student continuation. Recent methods combine this signal with GRPO. They use GRPO for update directions and the teacher for signal scaling. However, we demonstrate a more effective integration within PPO. Specifically, we identify complementary positional dynamics: privileged information enhances a critic's value-prediction accuracy toward the response's end, whereas self-teacher guidance is strong initially, drops mid-generation, and rebounds finally. These insights motivate Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO), wherein a self-teacher and critic evaluate identical privileged information at student-generated prefixes. The critic computes token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns, while the self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages via bounded probability ratios. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 and 1.81 percentage points on Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B variants, respectively, and achieves the highest mean accuracy among evaluated methods on Knights and Knaves. Our code is available at https://github.com/cii030/VASPO.

</details>


### [243] [PerSo: Investigating Facets of LLMs' Social Intelligence in Real-World Persuasion Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20548)
*Ali Zamani,Soroush Esfahanian,Erfan Shahabi,Mohammad Taher Pilehvar,Azadeh Shakery,Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PerSo基准，用真实Reddit说服对话同时评估LLM的认知与行为社交智能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交智能对人机交互和多智能体场景日益重要，但现有基准多用合成场景且将认知与行为两方面分开评估。

Method: 基于Reddit ChangeMyView社区的真实说服对话，采用LLM-in-the-loop流水线构建评估任务，并通过人工标注验证。

Result: 模型表现总体随规模提升但各维度差异明显；最强LLM在行为任务上略超最佳人类表现，而最佳人类在认知任务上仍领先。

Conclusion: PerSo为同时评估LLM社交智能两方面提供了真实场景基准，揭示认知与行为能力的差异化表现。

Abstract: Understanding the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important for applications involving human-AI interaction and multi-agent environments. Social intelligence comprises two aspects: cognitive intelligence, the ability to infer others' mental states, and behavioral intelligence, the ability to select appropriate social actions based on these inferences to achieve social goals. Persuasion provides a natural testbed in which both aspects are simultaneously at play, yet prior benchmarks typically evaluate them in isolation using synthetic scenarios. We introduce PerSo, a benchmark that evaluates both aspects on real-world persuasion dialogues from Reddit's ChangeMyView community, using an LLM-in-the-loop pipeline to construct the evaluation tasks, validated through human annotation. Our evaluation of diverse LLMs shows that performance generally scales with model size but varies across dimensions. The strongest LLM slightly surpasses the best observed human performance on the behavioral task, while the best human participant remains ahead on the cognitive task.

</details>


### [244] [Manacá-1B-Instruct-2: Reproducible Safety Alignment for a Native Brazilian-Portuguese LLM. Negative DPO Results, a Controlled Composition Scan, and a Silent Failure Mode of the LLM Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20570)
*Bruno Leonardo Santos Menezes,Carlos Leonardo Souza Cardoso,Fabio André Machado Porto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍 Manacá-1B-Instruct-2，一个面向巴西葡萄牙语的 1.72B 参数模型第二代对齐工作，重点记录失败的 DPO 尝试、有效的 safety-SFT 方案及统计显著性对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语开源模型稀缺，且已有安全对齐模型很少记录失败经验或做统计显著性验证。

Method: 使用 291,223 条 SFT 语料；记录三次均失败的 DPO 尝试；采用 LLM-jp AnswerCarefully 风格的安全 SFT，迭代三次；扫描通用数据占比 10%–60%；用 Wilson 置信区间与配对 McNemar 检验（Holm-Bonferroni 校正）对比四个外部 PT-BR 模型；辅以 n-gram 去污染和 Chinchilla 计算预算表。

Result: DPO 训练奖励边际达 1.0 但自由生成无变化；安全 SFT 收敛至安全-有用性前沿；过拒曲线非单调，拐点在 40%–50%；最终模型安全区间下界 94.1% 高于四个基线上界；发现 MT-Bench-PT 六项安全题中两项评委拒评，静默缩小有效 N。

Conclusion: 安全能力主要来自专用 safety-SFT 而非 DPO；通用能力差距归因于预训练规模而非对齐方法；全部代码、数据、日志与脚本公开。

Abstract: Brazilian Portuguese remains underserved by open-source language models, and the few that are safety-aligned rarely document what did not work or validate comparisons with statistical significance. We present Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, the second-generation post-training alignment of Manacá-1B (1.72B parameters, trained from scratch for PT-BR), with an SFT corpus of 291,223 examples. We document three DPO attempts, all negative, including a case where the training reward margin reaches 1.0 while free generation does not change at all, and show that safety came from a dedicated safety-SFT (LLM-jp AnswerCarefully style), refined over three iterations until closing the safety-helpfulness frontier. A controlled scan of the fraction of general data in the safety-SFT mix (10% to 60%) reveals a non-monotonic over-refusal curve with a knee point at 40-50%. The final model is compared against four external PT-BR models on the same items, with Wilson confidence intervals and paired McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction: the lower bound of its safety interval (94.1%) lies above the upper bound of all four baselines. We also report a methodological finding for LLM-judge evaluation: on two of six safety items in MT-Bench-PT, the judge categorically refuses to assign a score regardless of the evaluated response, silently reducing the effective N of that category in every prior report of the project. We complement this with an n-gram decontamination check and a Chinchilla-anchored compute-budget table that attributes the gap in general capability to pre-training scale rather than alignment methodology. All code, raw data, logs, and scripts that produce every reported number are publicly released.

</details>


### [245] [Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20582)
*Yingfa Chen,Xingyu Shen,Chaojun Xiao,Xu Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Latent Compaction，通过测试时训练学习文档专属的紧凑 KV 缓存，在 32× 压缩下 RULER 准确率达 96.7%（基线 40.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文使 KV 缓存膨胀，增加显存占用与注意力开销；压缩缓存时必须为未见问题保留信息，这是一大挑战。

Method: 冻结模型权重，用重建重要性、教师注意力、键空间多样性初始化缓存条目；第一阶段固定重建选出的条目，拟合全缓存的注意力输出与 log-normalizer；第二阶段通过全缓存模型的端到端蒸馏联合优化整个缓存。训练仅用文档相关的通用提示，不接触下游问答。

Result: 在 RULER、LongBench、Phonebook Lookup 上大幅超越同预算压缩基线；RULER 32× 压缩达 96.7% vs KVZip+ 40.0%；可跨模型规模与家族迁移，在 Qwen3 与 MiniCPM5 上均有检索增益。

Conclusion: 将 KV 缓存视为神经网络并用测试时训练优化，可在激进压缩下保持检索精度。

Abstract: Long contexts enlarge key--value (KV) caches, increasing memory use and attention costs during generation. Compressing these caches must preserve information for unseen questions. We introduce **Latent Compaction**, which learns a compact document-specific cache through test-time training. We initialize cache entries using reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity. Training first fits attention outputs and log-normalizers to those of the full cache, with reconstruction-selected entries held fixed. It then jointly optimizes the entire cache through end-to-end distillation from the full-cache model. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and training uses only generic prompts about the document, without access to downstream questions or answers. Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate substantial gains over budget-matched compression baselines. On a RULER, for example, our method achieves 96.7% accuracy at 32$\times$ compression, compared with 40.0% for KVZip+. The method also transfers across model scales and families, with retrieval gains on both Qwen3 and MiniCPM5. These results show that treating the KV cache as a neural network and optimizing it with test-time training can preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression. The code is released at https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [246] [Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19065)
*Renbo Tu,Yang Liu,Shuying Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 生成式检索(GR)并非在电商候选生成中普遍优于稠密检索(DR)：GR的价值优势主要来自流行度，加入静态物品价值后DR可反超且保持更高召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GR被视为序列推荐的有力候选生成器，但作者想探究它在在线零售候选生成中是否真的全面优于DR，以及两者差异的真正来源。

Method: 在两个Amazon Toys数据集上按多种指标对比GR与DR；做深度归因分析；在DR的重排序步骤中加入相同的静态物品价值进行实验；并在工业级内部电商数据集上用LLM判定相关性，对比14B SID-LLM与体量小47倍的稠密编码器。

Result: GR仅在双方共同覆盖用户的"最佳相关物品价值"上领先，DR在精确目标召回与整列表相关价值上领先；流行度是GR价值领先的最大贡献者。加入静态物品价值后DR反超GR并保持更高召回。工业数据上14B SID-LLM仍不如小47倍的稠密编码器。

Conclusion: GR并非对DR的一致更强替代，其表面优势多可归因于流行度；简单重排序即可让DR反超，且SID-LLM相比小型稠密编码器并无实际优势。

Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. However, GR is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval (DR) in online retail candidate generation. We examine their differences on two Amazon Toys datasets under different metrics. GR leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover, while DR leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. With deep analysis, we find that popularity contributes the most to GR's measured value lead. Adding the same static item value to DR in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above GR. Finally, on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with LLM-judged relevance, we show that a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a $47\times$ smaller dense encoder.

</details>


### [247] [RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19398)
*Linyao Zheng,Xuhang Shi,Zhifang Mao,Xiuquan Hou,Sai Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RCER，一种迭代RAG方法，通过重构跨证据关系来提升多跳问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迭代RAG难以在新信息出现时重构实体对应关系与推理依赖。

Method: 包含轮间关系证据获取、推理上下文重构、跨证据组合推理三部分。

Result: 在三个多跳QA基准上平均超最优基线2.83 EM和3.06 F1，叙事与隐式推理任务表现优异。

Conclusion: 直接从累积源段落重构跨证据关系可有效提升迭代RAG的复杂问答能力。

Abstract: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. Cross-evidence compositional reasoning leverages these inferences to establish entity correspondences and compose relations across selected passages for answer derivation. Experiments show that RCER outperforms the best baselines by 2.83 EM and 3.06 F1 points on average across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and achieves superior performance on narrative and implicit reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [248] [Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19578)
*Yuanfeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 DualGCN 双分支图知识蒸馏框架，解决严格冷启动下图协同过滤的表征坍塌问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图协同过滤在严格冷启动场景中，因未观测物品的拓扑孤立而遭遇表征坍塌。引入多模态语义特征虽有潜力，但将孤立语义属性直接映射到全局拓扑驱动的协同空间会引发表征退化和优化冲突。

Method: 采用解耦的两阶段训练范式：1) 构建稳健的协同教师网络，物品表征由拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定，重塑潜在流形；2) 语义学生分支使用残差映射机制和幅度无关的余弦蒸馏目标，实现高保真跨模态对齐而不破坏既有协同信号；3) 引入动态范数重建机制，在全局检索时校准新物品与热物品的物理尺度。

Result: 在三个真实基准数据集上，DualGCN 在严格冷启动场景中显著优于现有最优基线，同时全面保持高热物品的推荐准确率。

Conclusion: DualGCN 通过双分支图知识蒸馏有效弥合拓扑与语义的结构性鸿沟，兼顾冷启动性能与热物品推荐精度。

Abstract: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.

</details>


### [249] [Twenty Days Later: A Pre-Registered Test of History-Based Forecasts of Brand Mentions in Gemini Answers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19608)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 预注册复制实验检验LLM品牌提及率的持久性：用gemini-3.1-pro-preview对162个请求进行多波次（8小时3波+20.3天后1波）测试，发现品牌提及率预测具有持久性，但仅覆盖单一模型、单一区间和12个已知品牌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM提及哪些品牌的计数只有在足够持久、可供行动时才有用。因此需要检验品牌提及率在时间上是否稳定、可预测。

Method: 预注册复制：相同162个请求（54个问题，英语/爱沙尼亚语/芬兰语，3个软件类别，每题12个候选品牌中的4个，3次重复），在2026年9月22-23日约10小时内分3波发送给gemini-3.1-pro-preview，并在10月13日（第三波后20.3天）再次发送。计划与决策规则在首次调用前冻结、哈希并注册于OSF。结果为每个回答与品牌的词汇提及标签，每波648个。另有96个标签的盲人人工核验。

Result: 主要预测（基于前9个回答的每品牌-问题单元提及率）Brier 0.0281、log loss 0.126，优于8小时波次6回答预测的Brier 0.0259（对照天花板0.0559？），并在两个指标和全部9个问题族上胜过品牌历史（0.104）、总体率（0.234）和常数0.5（0.250），精确符号翻转p=0.0039。仅用第一波冻结的预测在1.5小时、9.6小时、20.7天时分别为0.0599、0.0587、0.0604。8小时波次中202个一致单元里，194个在D1未变，无一反转。最新波次几乎与汇总历史一样准确（Brier 0.0292；汇总在9族中5族更优，p=0.28）。所有回答均报告了请求的模型版本，且尽管启用了搜索，无一发出搜索查询。人工核验96个标签中94个与规则一致，2个分歧经裁定为评分者遗漏，故裁定后规则与96/96一致。

Conclusion: 在注册规则下，品牌提及率的持久性成立。但该测试仅覆盖一个模型、一个时间区间和12个已知品牌，且未估计衰减率。

Abstract: Counts of which brands a large language model names are useful only if they hold long enough to act on. We test this with a pre-registered replication. The same 162 requests (54 questions in English, Estonian and Finnish about three software categories, four of twelve candidate brands per question, three repeats) were sent to gemini-3.1-pro-preview in three waves within about ten hours on 22 and 23 September 2026, and again on 13 October 2026, 20.3 days after the third wave, with identical request bodies. The plan and its decision rule were frozen, hashed and registered on OSF before the first call. The outcome is a lexical mention label per answer and brand, 648 per wave. The primary forecast, each brand-and-question cell's mention rate over the nine earlier answers, scored Brier 0.0281 and log loss 0.126, against Brier 0.0259 for the six-answer forecast of the 8-hour wave and a registered ceiling of 0.0559. It beat brand history (0.104), the overall rate (0.234) and a constant 0.5 (0.250) on both scores and in all nine question families (exact sign-flip p = 0.0039), so durability holds under the registered rule. A forecast frozen from the first wave alone scored 0.0599, 0.0587 and 0.0604 at horizons of 1.5 hours, 9.6 hours and 20.7 days. Of the 202 cells unanimous in the 8-hour wave, 194 were unchanged at D1 and none reversed. The latest wave alone was nearly as accurate as the pooled history (Brier 0.0292; pooled lower in 5 of 9 families, p = 0.28). Every answer reported the requested model version, and none issued a search query although search was enabled. A blind human check of 96 labels agreed with the rule on 94; both disagreements were adjudicated as rater omissions, so after adjudication the rule matched on 96 of 96. The test covers one model, one interval and twelve known brands, and estimates no decay rate.

</details>


### [250] [Reading the Neighborhood: Text-Attentive Graph Reranking for Automated Subject Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20048)
*Lakshmi Rajendram Bashyam,Ralf Krestel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TAGHN：基于主题词表异构图重排序的主题标引方法，在STW数据集上宏F1达0.380，优于交叉编码器与XMLC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主题标引任务标签数庞大、正例稀少、长尾严重，现有极端多标签分类器将词表视为扁平列表，忽略了主题词表编码的语义关系。

Method: TAGHN是一个在检索候选的逐文档子图上进行的异构图重排序器，子图用主题词表邻域增强；候选描述符的相关性由文档相似度与主题词表邻域匹配度联合估计，分解式打分头融合可解释图特征与检索信号。

Result: 在6,198个描述符的经济主题词表STW上，宏F1达0.380（微调交叉编码器0.346，固定词表XMLC 0.278）；微F1超过重排序模型并与最佳XMLC差距仅-3.0；定性分析显示图能纠正逐标签打分的错误，如选择更窄的黄金描述符而非常用父类。

Conclusion: 引入主题词表语义关系可有效提升主题标引性能，尤其在宏F1和细粒度描述符选择上表现突出。

Abstract: Subject indexing assigns descriptors from a controlled vocabulary to bibliographic records, a task characterized by thousands of labels, few positive examples per label, and a long tail of rarely used descriptors. Existing extreme multi-label classifiers treat the vocabulary as a flat list, ignoring the semantic relations that thesauri encode. We present TAGHN, a heterogeneous graph reranker over a per-document subgraph of retrieved candidates augmented with the thesaurus neighborhood. The relevance of a candidate descriptor is estimated jointly from its similarity with the document and also the degree to which the candidate's thesaurus neighborhood matches the document content. A decomposed scoring head combines interpretable graph-derived features with retrieval signals. On STW, an economic thesaurus of 6,198 descriptors, TAGHN reaches 0.380 macro F1 against 0.346 for a fine-tuned cross-encoder and 0.278 for a fixed-vocabulary XMLC classifier. In terms of micro F1, it outperforms reranking models and stays competitive (-3.0) with the best fixed-vocabulary XMLC model. Qualitative analysis shows the graph resolving errors that per-label scoring cannot, selecting a narrower gold descriptor where an unstructured reranker settles for its broader parent.

</details>


### [251] [XViewRank: Overlap-Conditioned Score Fusion for LLM-Augmented Sparse Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20122)
*Xinxuan Lv,Minghan Li,Guodong Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 XViewRank，一个轻量级检索端方法，基于查询级重叠度条件式融合原查询、假设视图与退步视图的 BM25 结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成查询的替代视图可缓解稀疏检索的词汇不匹配，但各视图独立检索后其排名列表可能互补、冗余或受查询漂移影响，固定融合策略（如 RRF）因此次优。

Method: 对每个候选文档保留三个归一化 BM25 分数及三个视图检索结果集之间的查询级重叠度；用小型非线性打分器以重叠度作为上下文来调节各视图分数的解读，且不联合编码查询与段落文本。

Result: 在匹配输入协议下，XViewRank 在 TREC DL 2019 和 2020 上 nDCG@10 与 MAP 均数值上优于 RRF，DL19 的 MAP 提升具统计显著性；视图排名一致性低时收益最明显，DL20 证据较弱。

Conclusion: 重叠度条件式分数融合可作为固定融合的紧凑检索端替代方案，但论文也界定了其优势的实证边界。

Abstract: Large language models can reduce vocabulary mismatch in sparse retrieval by generating alternative views of a query. Once these views are searched independently, however, their ranked lists may be complementary, redundant, or affected by query drift, making fixed fusion suboptimal. We present XViewRank, a lightweight retrieval-side method for conditionally fusing BM25 results from an original query, a hypothesis view, and a step-back view. For each pooled candidate, XViewRank retains three normalized BM25 scores and three query-level overlaps between the retrieved result sets. A small nonlinear scorer uses the overlaps as context that changes how the view-specific scores are interpreted, without jointly encoding query and passage text. Under a matched-input protocol, XViewRank improves nDCG@10 and MAP numerically over reciprocal rank fusion on both TREC DL 2019 and 2020, with a statistically significant MAP gain on DL19. Additional analyses show that the clearest benefit occurs when the view rankings have low agreement, while the evidence on DL20 is weaker. The results support overlap-conditioned score fusion as a compact retrieval-side alternative to fixed fusion, while also delimiting where its advantage is empirically established.

</details>


### [252] [Creating SquashFS Images to Support HPC and AI Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20578)
*Julie Mullen,Albert Reuther,LaToya Anderson,Michael Jones,William Arcand,William Bergeron,David Bestor,Alex Bonn,Daniel Burrill,Chansup Byun,Vijay Gadepally,Michael Houle,Matthew Hubbell,Hayden Jananthan,Piotr Luszczek,Peter Michaleas,Guillermo Morales,Andrew Prout,Antonio Rosa,Chuck Yee,Jeremy Kepner*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对11种在HPC系统上创建SquashFS数据集镜像的工作流进行基准测试，比较不同数据格式、存储位置和压缩线程数下的效率，并为用户提供最佳实践建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC用户在处理由数十万甚至更多小文件组成的数据集时，并行访问会给中央并行文件系统的元数据服务器带来巨大负担。将只读数据集压缩为SquashFS镜像是一种有效解决方案，但不同创建工作流的效率存在差异，用户缺乏有效指导。

Method: 基准测试了11种不同工作流来创建包含数千到数百万极小文件的SquashFS数据集镜像，考察因素包括：数据以tar.gz、zip还是文件与目录形式下载、镜像创建位于中央文件系统还是本地计算节点存储、以及SquashFS文件压缩线程数。

Result: 不同工作流在创建SquashFS镜像时的效率存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 论文分享了基准测试结果，并为HPC系统用户推荐创建SquashFS镜像的最佳工作流。

Abstract: HPC users often download datasets on HPC systems for analysis and processing. When these datasets are comprised of hundreds of thousands (or more) of small files, accessing them in parallel can put a tremendous burden on the metadata servers of central parallel file systems. If the dataset is read-only, an effective solution is to compress the dataset into a SquashFS image. There are, however, a number of workflows that can be used to create such a dataset image, and we observed that some were more efficient than others. To provide more effective guidance for our userbase, we benchmarked eleven different workflows for creating SquashFS dataset image files of datasets with thousands to millions of very small files. We took into account whether the data arrived as tar.gz, zip, or files-and-directories downloads, whether the image creation was on the central file system or local compute node storage, and the number of SquashFS file compression threads used. This paper shares the results of these benchmarks and provides recommendations to HPC system users toward the best workflows to use for SquashFS image creation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [253] [Why Static Skill Inconsistencies Do Not Equate to Runtime Risks: A Behavioral Analysis of LLM Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18927)
*Fengrui Fan,Huahao Wang,Jingyi Fang,Yutao Hu,Yueming Wu,Deqing Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文对LLM agent技能包中的跨制品不一致进行大规模审计与运行时实证研究，发现并验证1182个契约不一致，并通过49个可执行任务和441条轨迹量化其对实际性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent框架依赖外部技能资产，多组件技能包常存在文档、脚本与配置间的行为约束冲突。静态审计虽能发现契约不一致，但其缺陷数量无法可靠反映真实agent性能退化，导致实践者缺乏评估有缺陷技能实际风险的严谨证据。

Method: 开展系统性实证研究：对575个社区与基准技能进行大规模审计，人工验证出1182个契约不一致；构建受控评估流水线，包含49个可执行agent任务和3个代表性LLM，设置NoSkill、OriginalSkill、FixedSkill三种实验条件；对441条配对执行轨迹进行细粒度行为分析。

Result: 审计获得1182个经人工验证的契约不一致；通过441条配对执行轨迹分析，量化了被修复缺陷对agent实际性能的影响。

Conclusion: 技能包中的跨制品不一致会带来真实运行时性能影响，仅靠静态缺陷数量不足以评估风险；需要通过受控执行实验来衡量技能缺陷的实际危害。

Abstract: LLM agent frameworks heavily rely on external skill assets to standardize tool usage, encode operational workflows, and supply executable runtime resources. Despite their widespread adoption, multi-component skill packages frequently suffer from cross-artifact inconsistencies, where documentation, scripts, and configuration files specify conflicting behavioral constraints. Although static auditing techniques can uncover such contractual discrepancies, static defect volume cannot reliably reflect real-world agent performance degradation. This gap leaves practitioners without rigorous evidence to assess the practical risk of flawed agent skills.
  This paper presents a systematic empirical study to demystify the runtime implications of skill inconsistencies. We conduct large-scale auditing over 575 community and benchmark skills, yielding 1,182 manually validated contract inconsistencies. We further build a controlled evaluation pipeline with 49 executable agent tasks and three representative LLMs across NoSkill, OriginalSkill, and FixedSkill experimental settings. Through fine-grained behavioral analysis of 441 paired execution trajectories, we quantify the actual performance impacts of resolved defects.

</details>


### [254] [The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18933)
*Robert Tjarko Lange,Luca Grillotti,Yutaro Yamada,Rujikorn Charakorn,David Ha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"The Agentic Scientist"，一个端到端分布式流水线，让人类研究者与编码智能体协同开展计算研究，通过元控制器管理并行研究智能体并在各阶段强制 rubric 验证，支持从"协科学家"到全自主科研的多种自治谱，已成功投稿并被 ALIFE 2026 接收。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代编码智能体能写代码、跑实验、分析结果并在越来越长的时间尺度上自主运行，但完全自主的研究智能体受限于"构思半径"（ideation radius）小，且搜索动力学是短视的爬山式，难以胜任真正的科研发现。因此需要弥合人类研究者与编码智能体之间的鸿沟。

Method: 构建分布式端到端流水线，将研究分解为任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙盒实验、结果聚合、基线与消融构建、事后分析和报告撰写；每步由新一代编码智能体驱动并进行 agentic self-verification；由元控制器管理并行研究智能体，并在每个阶段强制执行 rubric 验证；同一编排层可跨异构领域（不同执行环境、编码框架、评价指标）复用。

Result: 在"协科学家"设定下，用开发版系统撰写的单篇研究论文被 ALIFE 2026 接收；并全自主地应用于机器学习开放问题求解任务，展示了跨不同计算研究领域的科学发现能力。消融实验表明，可靠的科学自治不仅依赖基础模型能力，也依赖跨智能体编排层。

Conclusion: 该系统支持从人类主导到全自主的科研谱系，说明编排层（cross-agent orchestration）对实现可靠科学自治至关重要，可与基础模型能力形成互补。

Abstract: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.

</details>


### [255] [Beyond Equation Search: Conjecture-Guided Discovery with SCOPE and ClosureBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18938)
*Yuxiao Hu,Qian Li,Ding Wang,Siheng Chen,Linfeng Zhang,Jinyue Yan,Yuntian Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将符号回归从"优化单个方程"转向"发展并检验科学猜想"，并构建ClosureBench基准来评估发现过程（证据忠实性、机制洞察、实验有效性）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号回归方法只优化候选方程的拟合度，但拟合好并不意味着其背后的科学猜想应当被保留、修正或舍弃。同一猜想可能有多种数学实现，准确度相近的方程也可能蕴含不同解释。因此需要从精修单个表达式转向发展和检验指导表达式的猜想。

Method: SCOPE框架维护多条由猜想驱动的研究轨迹：多个"科学家智能体"独立通过方程建模、问题提出和主动实验推进各自猜想，再交换证据以修正猜想与研究方向，最终将发现汇总为科学报告，把模型、结论与证据关联起来。同时构建ClosureBench交互式基准，含五个科学领域60个闭环发现任务，每项任务在已知PDE系统中嵌入未知代数关系，智能体在OpenFOAM中控制实验条件获取新数据用于方程发现，并提出三项新指标。

Result: 与多种基线相比，SCOPE在ClosureBench及一个真实科学发现案例上均取得更高的方程准确率，同时产生更准确、可靠且有效的科学发现。

Conclusion: 该工作强调符号回归应从优化表达式转向猜想驱动的探索，并提供了评估发现过程而非仅评估恢复表达式的基准与新指标，推动方程发现具备明确的科学目的。

Abstract: Most symbolic regression methods optimize candidate equations, but improving an equation's fit does not establish whether its underlying scientific conjecture should be retained, revised, or rejected. A conjecture may admit multiple mathematical realizations, and similarly accurate equations may imply different explanations. This motivates a shift from refining individual expressions to developing and testing the conjectures that guide them. We introduce SCOPE, a framework that sustains multiple conjecture-driven research trajectories. Multiple scientist agents independently pursue conjectures through equation modeling, question formulation, and active experimentation, then exchange evidence to revise their conjectures and research directions. Their findings are consolidated into a scientific report linking models, conclusions, and evidence. Existing equation-discovery benchmarks primarily assess recovered expressions, leaving the evidence and scientific conclusions established through the investigation underexamined. We therefore introduce ClosureBench, an interactive benchmark of 60 closure-discovery tasks across five scientific domains. ClosureBench focuses on closure-discovery tasks to give equation discovery a concrete scientific purpose. Each task embeds an unknown algebraic relation in a known PDE system, where agents control experimental conditions in OpenFOAM to acquire new data for equation discovery. Beyond equation accuracy, ClosureBench proposes three metrics to evaluate the discovery process: evidence faithfulness, mechanism insight, and experimental effectiveness. Compared with diverse baselines, SCOPE achieves higher equation accuracy on both ClosureBench and a real-world scientific discovery case, while producing more accurate, reliable, and effective scientific discoveries.

</details>


### [256] [Discovering Undisclosed Concepts in LoRA Adapters for Diffusion-Based AIGC Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18990)
*Yupeng Qiu,Han Fang,Dhananjai Sharma,Ee-Chien Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段框架，通过子空间引导的进化搜索与配对视觉识别，高效发现LoRA适配器中隐藏的目标概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA使扩散模型个性化变得廉价且易分享，但也带来审核风险：有害内容可能未被如实披露。因此需要一个机制，给定LoRA适配器，找出它被训练生成的概念，以支持下游调查。

Method: 将概念发现问题形式化为搜索一个条件输入，使其同时最大化输出连贯性、LoRA诱导的区分度以及子空间对齐度。观察到输入无需渲染即可通过子空间对齐进行筛选，故提出两阶段框架：SGES用免渲染的子空间对齐探索候选提示并保留精简候选列表；PVI仅渲染这些候选，比较LoRA与基座模型输出以识别连贯且独特的行为。

Result: 该设计实现了对LoRA适配器中未知名概念的高效可靠发现（摘要未给出具体量化结果）。

Conclusion: 通过先以轻量子空间对齐定位有潜力的候选，再以视觉验证确认，能够在开放输入空间中低成本、可靠地发现LoRA所编码的概念。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. Even with a clear objective, however, optimizing it over an open-ended input space is prohibitively expensive, since reliable evaluation of coherence and distinctiveness requires repeated diffusion rendering. Crucially, we observe that an input need not be rendered to determine whether it is promising. Its alignment with the learned LoRA subspace provides a lightweight signal for localizing promising candidates before visual verification. Based on this insight, we develop a two-stage framework for text-to-image LoRAs. Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) uses render-free subspace alignment to explore candidate prompts and retain a compact shortlist, while Paired Visual Identification (PVI) renders only these candidates and compares the LoRA and base-model outputs to identify those exhibiting coherent and distinctive generation behavior. This design enables efficient and reliable discovery of previously unknown concepts encoded in LoRA adapters.

</details>


### [257] [Smart Alone, Blind Together: Why Accuracy Fails to CertifyTheory of Mind in Multi-Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19051)
*Will Beaumaster,Paul Schrater*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文论证"准确性"是错误的认证标准，提出应认证部署而非模块，并给出Blind-Spot Gate方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协调模块通常以对队友推断的准确性来认证，但准确性忽视两点：正确行动所需准确度取决于错误代价（属部署而非模块）；模块误差常非独立且具方向性，正相关在损害重叠时有利、在损害叠加时有害，因此准确性阈值会朝可预测方向失效，一旦错误信念交互并可能有害，就没有任何基于准确性的规则对每个模块都适用。

Method: 在任务分配、Level-Based Foraging和Hanabi中测试，注入错误，使用训练与贝叶斯模块及五个语言模型，并结合人类判断。提出认证部署的Blind-Spot Gate，纳入错误代价、成对交互与实测依赖，且无需部署模块。

Result: 准确性双向失效：在错误共享叠加的Hanabi中批准有害的语言模型部署，在代价高错误罕见的任务分配中拒绝有益部署。冗余低于独立假设：GPT-5.4-mini到Claude Opus 5.5对已有证据队友的错误从32%降至11%，但三名观察者同时误读的概率仅从16%降至9%（独立预期3.4%至0.15%）。Blind-Spot Gate在开发数据20次划分中无显著错误批准（准确性为每划分3.2次）；在预注册的新模块测试中，挽回准确性拒绝者（七个分类器regret 0.004对0.479）并抓住准确性批准者（贝叶斯模块：准确性20次中17次显著错误批准，门控仅1次）。

Conclusion: 认证应针对部署而非模块准确性；Blind-Spot Gate通过定价错误代价、成对交互与实测依赖，能更可靠地区分有害与有益部署。

Abstract: Coordinators that act on what they infer about teammates are usually certified by the accuracy of those inferences. We argue that accuracy is the wrong certificate, for two reasons. First, the accuracy needed to act depends on what a wrong action costs, so the bar belongs to the deployment, not the module. Second, a module's errors are rarely independent, and dependence has a sign: positively associated errors help where their damage overlaps and hurt where it compounds, so an accuracy threshold fails in a predictable direction, and once wrong beliefs interact and can do harm, no rule based on accuracy is right for every module. We test these predictions in task assignment, Level-Based Foraging and Hanabi, with injected errors, trained and Bayesian modules and five language models, and in human judgments. Accuracy fails in both directions, approving harmful language-model deployments in Hanabi, where shared errors compound, and rejecting beneficial ones in task assignment, where costly errors are rare. In our tasks it also buys far less redundancy than independence predicts: from GPT-5.4-mini to Claude Opus 5.5, error on teammates the models have evidence about falls from 32% to 11%, but the chance that all three observers misread one falls only from 16% to 9% (independence: 3.4% to 0.15%). We propose certifying the deployment, with a Blind-Spot Gate that prices error costs, pairwise interactions and measured dependence without deploying the module. On held-out data from the cells it was developed on, it makes no significant false approval in 20 splits (accuracy: 3.2 per split), and in preregistered tests on modules it was not developed on, it recovers what accuracy rejects (seven classifiers: regret 0.004 against 0.479) and catches what accuracy approves (a Bayesian module: significant false approvals in 17 of 20 splits for accuracy, 1 for the gate).

</details>


### [258] [RLPE: Teaching LLMs to Prompt with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19062)
*Rahul Singhal,Karime Maamari,Pradyumna Tambwekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RLPE：训练模型基于任务模型的行为轨迹分析失败模式并写提示词，仅需查询访问，提示一次生成可复用，9B模型在2/3基准上超越前沿模型与提示优化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有让LLM写提示词的方法要么不观察任务模型行为（看不到需解决的失败模式），要么在推理时需与任务LLM并行运行，增加每次查询开销；两者都不符合真实的提示工程实践。

Method: 使用强化学习训练一个模型分析独立任务模型的轨迹，针对观察到的失败写出提示词；奖励仅依据提示词在任务上的表现，提示词生成一次后可跨任务复用，推理时无需该训练模型，且只需查询访问故兼容闭源模型。

Result: 在Enigmata、BIG-Bench Extra Hard、PlanBench上，9B模型在2/3基准写出的提示词优于gpt-5.6-sol、claude-opus-5及GEPA、TextGrad；未经显式迭代训练却涌现出可与前沿模型媲美或更强的迭代能力；可提升6倍大的任务模型（含不同模型家族），并在留出基准上匹配claude-opus-5。

Conclusion: RLPE以真实提示工程范式训练提示词生成，兼顾低成本推理与闭源兼容性，学习到的提示能力可泛化到更大及异构模型。

Abstract: Prompting is a widely used method for adapting general-purpose LLMs to domain-specific tasks. Effective prompts can be tedious to create manually, so prompt writing is increasingly handed to LLMs, with recent work training LLMs to write prompts for other models. These techniques either write prompts without observing how the task model behaves, blind to the failure modes the prompt should address, or must run alongside the task LLM at inference time, adding overhead to every query. Neither reflects how prompt engineering is often practiced. To close this gap, we introduce Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering (RLPE), which trains a model to analyze traces of a separate task model and write a prompt targeting the failures it observes. RLPE rewards the trained model strictly on prompt performance, so it learns the prompting strategies that improve the task model. The prompt is generated once and reused across the task, so inference does not require the trained model. Since RLPE needs only query access to the model it prompts, it is also compatible with closed-source models. We apply RLPE to Enigmata, BIG-Bench Extra Hard, and PlanBench. We train a 9B-parameter model that writes better prompts than state-of-the-art frontier models (gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5) and prompt optimizers (GEPA and TextGrad) on 2/3 benchmarks. Although the model is never explicitly trained to iterate on prompts, this capability emerges at a level that matches or beats frontier models. The learned prompting capability also generalizes, with the trained model improving task models 6x larger than the one it trained with, including ones from entirely different model families, and matching claude-opus-5 on a fourth benchmark held out from training.

</details>


### [259] [Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19068)
*Mingfei Zhang,Amit Surana,Ziauddin Majid,Chenxi Wang,Michael Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对比工具增强LLM智能体的两种API检索范式：先检索后规划（RtP）与先规划后检索（PtR），发现两者在单工具与多工具查询上存在复杂度相关的交叉效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体需从大型API注册表中检索相关工具，但上下文窗口有限，无法注入全部工具定义。主流RtP方法在复杂多工具查询上可能失效，作者探索PtR替代范式及其适用边界。

Method: 提出PtR：LLM首先生成"抽象工具存根"（假设的函数签名描述所需能力），再以此作为检索查询。在ToolBench（46,984个API）上，分单工具（G1）、同类别多工具（G2）、跨类别多工具（G3）子集评估，并与RtP对比。

Result: 发现明确的复杂度相关交叉：RtP在单工具查询上更优，PtR在多工具查询上更优；该交叉在k=1至20各检索预算、1k至47k注册表规模及Gemini 2.5 Flash与gpt-oss-120b上均成立。PtR存在"存根幻觉"失败模式，双刃剑效应。

Conclusion: PtR的额外发现调用约使推理成本翻倍，在多工具查询上值得、单工具上不利，因此提出复杂度自适应路由，可由RtP的top-1检索分数这一零成本信号驱动。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. Evaluating on ToolBench (46,984 unique API endpoints, 50 categories) across single-tool (G1), intra-category multi-tool (G2), and cross-category multi-tool (G3) query subsets, we find a clear complexity-dependent crossover: RtP outperforms PtR on single-tool queries while PtR outperforms RtP on multi-tool queries. This crossover holds at every retrieval budget (k=1 to 20), is robust across registry sizes from 1k to 47k APIs, and is consistent across model families (Gemini 2.5 Flash and gpt-oss-120b). We characterize a stub-hallucination failure mode (the LLM invents plausible but non-existent API names) that acts as a double-edged sword: on simple queries PtR's stubs abstract away proper-noun signals that RtP matches directly, yet on complex queries the same mechanism decomposes multi-faceted intent into functional sub-needs. We further analyze token overhead and show that PtR's extra discovery call roughly doubles inference cost, which pays off on multi-tool queries but hurts on single-tool ones, motivating complexity-adaptive routing as a practical direction, one that can be driven by a zero-cost signal already present in the pipeline (RtP's top-1 retrieval score).

</details>


### [260] [GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19100)
*Qingsong Xie,Jiahao Tian,Jiacheng Tang,Zhifeng Li,Madalina Ciobanu,Navan Preet Singh,Qingqing Mao,Ritankar Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ScreenRef数据集与D2RL训练方法，训练出GroundGUI-8B模型，在多个GUI grounding基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建鲁棒的GUI智能体依赖于多模态视觉定位能力，但面向多样环境的高质量资源十分稀缺，现有基准难以满足需求。

Method: 提出ScreenRef数据集（58.6万截图、63.3万指代表达实例，覆盖桌面/网页/移动端及多类任务）；并提出Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL)方法，解决SFT泛化不足与RL奖励稀疏问题，基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct经SFT+D2RL顺序训练得到GroundGUI-8B。

Result: GroundGUI-8B在ScreenSpot-V2达95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro达63.9%、OSWorld-G达65.4%、MMBench-GUI L2达86.8%、UI-Vision达38.3%；在8B规模模型中显著优于开源数据训练模型，性能可比甚至超越闭源数据训练模型。

Conclusion: ScreenRef与D2RL有效提升GUI grounding性能，为多环境GUI智能体提供高质量资源与训练范式，代码模型数据集已开源。

Abstract: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.

</details>


### [261] [AdCoEvo: A Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Advertising Delivery System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19454)
*Tianzhu Hu,Hang Yu,Zeyuan Zhao,Zeyu Pan,Huan Luo,Chun Gan,Mingzhe Cao,Liubin Wang,Mingming Li,Jiao Dai,Jizhong Han,Songlin Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AdCoEvo——协同进化的多智能体广告投放系统，实现全流程自动化并提升动态市场适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅在竞价、预算分配等单任务实现部分自动化，整体协调仍依赖人工，难以规模化、难以达到最优，且个体经验难沉淀为可复用能力；市场变化还需策略及时更新。

Method: 通过角色专业化连接不同时间尺度与运营粒度的投放决策；诊断结果指导下一周期的账户规划与策略调整；多智能体基于实际投放结果更新模型参数，通过规划、调整、诊断间相互反馈持续改进策略，实现协同进化。

Result: 相比规则基线(Rule)，广告主价值提升14.02%，单次转化成本降低7.07%；相比参数固定的多智能体系统，价值提升3.96%，成本降低1.24%。

Conclusion: 协同进化能带来更高的投放回报，验证了全流程自动化多智能体广告投放系统的有效性。

Abstract: Digital advertising is an important means for platforms to reach potential users and drive business growth. Advertising delivery is the core link between marketing objectives and actual returns. Existing methods have achieved partial automation in individual tasks such as bidding and budget allocation, but they still rely on human operators for overall coordination, making it difficult to support large-scale operations. They also often fail to achieve optimal performance, and individual experience remains difficult to turn into reusable operational capabilities. In addition, as advertising markets change, advertising delivery systems need timely strategy updates to remain effective in dynamic markets. To automate the entire advertising operations process and improve adaptability to market changes, we propose AdCoEvo, a co-evolving multi-agent advertising delivery system. Specifically, the system connects delivery decisions across different timescales and operational granularities through role specialization. Diagnostic results guide account planning and strategy adjustment in the next period. The multi-agent system updates its model parameters based on actual delivery outcomes and continually improves delivery strategies through mutual feedback among planning, adjustment, and diagnosis, thereby achieving co-evolution. Experiments show that, relative to the rule-based operational baseline (Rule), AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 14.02% while reducing cost per acquisition by 7.07%. Compared with a multi-agent system with fixed parameters, AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 3.96% and reduces cost per acquisition by 1.24%, indicating that co-evolution can yield greater delivery returns.

</details>


### [262] [Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19131)
*Akash Raj*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Plant Memory 将技术语言处理应用于 SAP PM 工单导出，构建 ISO 14224 对齐的维护本体，所有事实带置信度、证据与验证状态，并通过 MCP 同时服务人类与 AI 智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工单是工业设备故障的最大书面记录，但因文本缩写错拼、资产身份混在自由文本中、工单类型标签矛盾、症状/根因/措施等关键字段常为空，导致难以分析，诊断知识随资深技师流失。

Method: 规则优先抽取，可选 LLM 作为第二读者，分歧提高复核优先级而非覆盖；构建 ISO 14224 对齐本体，每个事实被实体化为带置信度、证据来源和验证状态的记录；技师通过复核队列验证事实、回答知识缺口问题、审批本体漂移提案；图通过 Web 应用和 MCP 服务器提供服务，引用底层工单。

Result: 在蒸谷米厂 400 个工单的合成 12 个月数据上，规则抽取达到 96.2% 组件准确率、88.9% 故障模式准确率、100% 根因精确率（62% 覆盖率）；28 个诊断问题中，本体排序根因 top-1 正确率 82.1%，而原始 SAP 根因列为 53.6%。

Conclusion: 通过规则+可选 LLM 的验证式抽取与本体化，Plant Memory 将不可用工单转为可引用的可信诊断知识，显著优于原始 SAP 字段，同时保留人工验证与知识传承。

Abstract: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. Extraction is rule-first, with an optional large language model (LLM) acting as a second reader whose disagreements raise a fact's review priority rather than overwrite it. Technicians verify facts through a review queue, answer targeted knowledge-gap questions where failures repeat without a recorded cause, and approve or reject ontology drift proposals when new terms appear. The resulting graph is served to people through a web application and to AI agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so both query the same verified knowledge and every answer cites the work orders behind it. On a synthetic 12-month export of 400 work orders from a parboiled-rice plant, rule-based extraction reaches 96.2% component accuracy, 88.9% failure-mode accuracy and 100% root-cause precision at 62% coverage; on 28 diagnostic questions, ranked root causes from the ontology are correct at top-1 in 82.1% of cases against 53.6% for the raw SAP root-cause column.

</details>


### [263] [Graph-Based Orchestration of Heterogeneous AI Models: A Control Node Approach to Composite Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19136)
*G. Michael Youngblood,Filip Dvořák,Slavo Švancár,Tomáš Balyo,Michal Ficek,Martin Dousek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于图的Composite AI框架，用专用控制节点编排规划、机器学习、约束编程和LLM等多种AI技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一模型方法存在局限，需整合多种AI技术处理复杂问题，但缺乏统一的操作模式来管理模型关系与执行顺序。

Method: 采用有向无环图和行为树管理模型关系与执行序列；架构包含数据连接器、计算服务和容器化部署框架，支持层次化、顺序和并发的模型组合模式。

Result: 通过案例研究验证该架构能构建Composite AI系统，在统一操作模式下融合多种AI技术优势。

Conclusion: 该图框架可克服单一模型方法的局限，实现多技术协同的Composite AI系统。

Abstract: We present a graph-based framework for Composite AI systems that integrate multiple AI techniques to address complex problems. We describe an architecture using specialized control nodes to orchestrate diverse models including planning, machine learning, constraint programming, and large language models. The system employs directed acyclic graphs and behavior trees to manage model relationships and execution sequencing. Our methodology encompasses data connectors, computational services, and a containerized deployment framework supporting hierarchical, sequential, and concurrent model composition patterns. Through case studies, we demonstrate how this architecture enables the creation of composite systems that leverage the strengths of multiple AI techniques within a unified operational schema, overcoming the limitations of single-model approaches.

</details>


### [264] [HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20191)
*Min Xiao,Jin Li,Shoujin Wang,Yeguang Zhen,Yishuo Li,Wenpeng Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HEM-Med，一种用于多中心药物推荐的分层智能体记忆框架，通过解耦跨医院经验与医院特异模式，并引入多标签安全约束，实验证明其在准确性与安全性上优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物推荐方法多针对单中心场景，而多中心（不同规模医院）需求日益增长，大型中心数据可帮助低资源医院。已有初步尝试存在两大缺口：1）未能分离可迁移的跨医院临床经验与医院特有的处方模式，影响临床可行性与医生接受度；2）忽视了多标签安全约束（如药物相互作用风险和本地处方集可行性），这对安全部署至关重要。

Method: 提出HEM-Med分层智能体记忆框架。针对缺口1，设计解耦分层记忆模块，构建患者级药物上下文归因记录，并将其解耦为跨医院经验记忆与医院特异性残余记忆。针对缺口2，引入安全感知药物集合生成模块，集成双层经验检索与安全感知集合解码，生成临床相关、更安全且本地自适应的推荐。

Result: 在真实世界多中心eICU数据集上的实验表明，HEM-Med在推荐准确性和安全性两方面均优于具有代表性的迁移学习、基于LLM及药物推荐基线方法。

Conclusion: HEM-Med通过解耦跨医院经验与安全感知生成，有效应对多中心药物推荐中的可迁移性与安全性挑战，提升了多中心场景下的推荐性能与临床可行性。

Abstract: Medication recommendation (MR) is critical for clinical decision support. While existing MR methods are mostly designed for single-center learning, where only one independent hospital is involved, multi-center MR with hospitals of different scales has become increasingly demanding in practice. In multi center settings, abundant data from large medical centers can improve recommendation performance for low-resource centers. Despite a few preliminary attempts on this task, two critical gaps remain. Gap 1: Existing multi-center methods fail to disentangle transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, limiting clinical feasibility and physician acceptance. Gap 2: They commonly overlook multi label safety constraints of MR, including drug-drug interaction risks and local formulary feasibility, which are essential for safe real-world deployment. To address these gaps, we propose HEM-Med, a novel hierarchical agentic memory framework for multi-center MR. To address Gap 1, we design a disentangled hierarchical memory module that builds patient-level medication context attribution records and disentangles them into cross hospital experience memory and hospital-specific residual memory. To address Gap 2, we introduce a safety-aware medication set generation module, which integrates dual-level experience retrieval with safety-aware set decoding to produce clinically relevant, safer, and locally adaptive medication recommendations. Experiments on a real-world multi-center eICU dataset show that HEM-Med outperforms representative transfer learning, LLM-based, and MR baselines in terms of both recommendation accuracy and safety.

</details>


### [265] [Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19148)
*Vishvesh Bhat,Asad Aali,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PLVR通过挖掘教师模型推理轨迹自动构建显式程序，在不改动小模型权重的情况下显著提升程序性工具使用任务表现，并缩小基座模型间差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在程序性工具使用任务中，基座模型间的性能差距有多少源自"程序/流程"而非"能力"本身。

Method: 用教师模型(Kimi-K3)的推理轨迹聚类定位反复出现的操作，由前沿模型为每个操作编写类型化原语，每个原语由冻结的小模型执行，并在挖掘的规则库上以A*搜索、按参考动作目标组装成程序。推理时程序有两种形式：故障排查与工具搜索中生成学生本应自生的思维链；多轮工具匹配中学生提议动作、程序检查修复或重试。

Result: 在tau2-Bench Retail/Telecom及LiveMCPBench上，程序因领域而异。Telecom上Granite-4.2-8B从43.0%升至91.2%，各Nemotron学生达93.3-94.4%，远超微调、提示优化及两个token匹配基线(≤58.2%)。Granite-4.2-8B在Telecom/Retail上距Nemotron学生仅2-3分，LiveMCPBench上低3-13分。Retail与LiveMCPBench上程序与最佳基线相当，基座模型间差距从约7分降至约2分。

Conclusion: 在程序性领域，8B学生已足够；在工具搜索上学生模型仍重要。显式程序能在不改动权重的前提下大幅弥合基座模型差距。

Abstract: In procedural tool-use domains, how much of the gap between base models is procedure rather than capability? We build an explicit program from a teacher's traces and run it in front of unchanged small models, including an 8B model. The construction, PLVR , takes the reasoning traces of a teacher, Kimi-K3, clusters their segments to locate recurring operations, has a frontier model author one typed primitive per operation, each run by a small frozen model and assembles the program by A* search over a mined rule library, under a reference-action objective. At inference the program takes one of two forms: for troubleshooting and tool search it produces the chain of thought the student would otherwise generate for itself, and the student acts on it; for multi-turn tool matching the student proposes each action and the program checks, repairs, or retries it before it goes out. On the official tau2-Bench Retail and Telecom test sets and on LiveMCPBench, with three Nemotron base models and the same program for each, the answer depends on the domain. On Telecom, Granite-4.2-8B as the student goes from 43.0% to 91.2% under the program, and every Nemotron student reaches 93.3-94.4%, against at most 58.2% for fine-tuning on the same traces, prompt optimisation of the student, or two token-matched baselines. With Granite-4.2-8B as the student, the program is within 2 to 3 points of the Nemotron students on Telecom and within 3 on Retail, and 3 to 13 points below them on LiveMCPBench: where the domain is procedural an 8B student is enough, and on tool search the student still matters. On Retail and LiveMCPBench the program is competitive with the best baseline. The spread between base models shrinks from about 7 points to about 2, averaged over the suites, with no weights changed.

</details>


### [266] [CASI: Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20293)
*Xinyi Cheng,Tianfu Zhang,Jiwen Li,Xuesen Zhang,Shihao Yu,Pengfei Zhu,Renhuan,Heda Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CASI：用快照式集合干预构造反事实，将集合级奖励通过Shapley聚合拆分为集合内信用，进而训练多检索动作的LLM代理；在赞助搜索实验中优于Singleton/Broadcast，并在生产A/B测试中带来3.51%的主指标提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已能联合生成多个检索动作，但下游只给整个动作集合一个奖励。将该奖励广播虽对集合级目标有效，却无法给出依赖动作组合（coalition）的集合内信用分配。

Method: CASI通过快照锚定的集合干预构造反事实：一次生成与检索后，固定可重放的快照组件，在相同条件下评估替代子集；用Shapley聚合把这些边际贡献转为集合内信用，并通过有界零和优势塑形融入策略优化。理论上：m>=4时单点、留一、全集端点一般不决定Shapley分配；加成集合价值下额外组合评估冗余。

Result: 五动作赞助搜索、1200请求的穷举拍卖回放显示显著组合依赖；训练评估器下CASI对回放定义的Shapley参考中位余弦相似度最高（但敏感后端下不优于Singleton）；五次独立训练中CASI策略的留出回放集合价值高于Singleton/Broadcast；10%流量、七天随机生产A/B测试中主广告主价值指标观测提升3.51%。

Conclusion: 集合级奖励训练需要显式的集合内信用分配；CASI通过快照干预+Shapley聚合提供了可行方案，并在离线与在线实验中获得一致增益。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate multiple retrieval actions jointly, while downstream systems often provide only one reward for the resulting set. Broadcasting this reward provides a valid score-function gradient estimator for the expected set-level objective, but does not determine a coalition-dependent within-set attribution. We introduce CASI (Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval), which constructs the missing counterfactual information through snapshot-grounded set intervention: generate and retrieve once, hold replayable snapshot components fixed, and evaluate alternative subsets under common conditions. Shapley aggregation converts these marginals into within-set credit, which bounded zero-sum advantage shaping incorporates into policy optimization. For m >= 4, singleton, leave-one-out, and full-set endpoints do not generally determine the Shapley allocation; under additive set values, extra coalition evaluations are redundant. In a five-action sponsored-search setting, exhaustive auction replay over 1,200 requests reveals substantial coalition dependence. Under the training-time evaluator, CASI achieves the highest median cosine similarity to a replay-defined Shapley reference among evaluated credit rules; under a sensitivity backend, CASI does not outperform Singleton. Across five independent training runs, CASI-trained policies achieve higher held-out auction-replay set value than Singleton- or Broadcast-trained policies. In a randomized seven-day production A/B test on 10% of traffic, the CASI-trained policy yields an observed 3.51% lift in the primary advertiser-value metric over production control.

</details>


### [267] [AgentCIScope: Grounded Contextual Integrity Evaluation for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19158)
*Chengquan Guo,Zhaorun Chen,Zinan Lin,Xiaodong Liu,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentCIScope，一个评估 LLM 智能体情境完整性（CI）的统一平台与基准，通过可执行多步任务揭示智能体在真实应用环境中的数据泄露问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在邮件、文档等应用中读写敏感数据，其产生的信息流是否符合情境特定的披露约束（情境完整性）尚不明确。已有工作要么关注模型级隐私泄露，要么仅在有限环境、手工构造的约束下评估，缺乏统一、真实的评估基准。

Method: AgentCIScope 将公开与合成的隐私案例转化为可执行的智能体任务，披露约束基于三项标准：治理性隐私政策、基于角色的协议、预定义的敏感属性分类法。基于该平台评估了 12 个智能体、936 个任务。

Result: 强任务完成能力并不能保证情境完整性：单次运行泄露率 32.5%–94.4%，重复五次后泄露率再增 4–19 个百分点。泄露率因属性而异（个人偏好 84.7%、预订详情 76.5%，信用卡 17.1%、SSN 29.4%）；日历作为信息源泄露最高，WhatsApp 作为信息目的地最高；治理性隐私政策亦有影响。

Conclusion: AgentCIScope 深入揭示了智能体隐私泄露规律，为开发隐私保护型智能体提供了统一测试平台。

Abstract: LLM agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling daily workspace tasks by interacting with application environments through tool calls. However, as agents read and write sensitive user data across email, documents, and other applications, a central privacy question is whether they preserve contextual integrity (CI), that is, whether the information flows they produce comply with context-specific disclosure constraints. Existing work either focuses on model-level privacy leakage or evaluates agents in limited application environments with manually constructed disclosure constraints. In this work, we introduce AgentCIScope, a unified platform and benchmark for evaluating agent-level contextual integrity through executable, multi-step tasks across diverse, realistic application environments. AgentCIScope transforms public and synthetic privacy cases into executable agent tasks, with disclosure constraints grounded in three criteria: governing privacy policies, persona-based agreement, and a predefined sensitive-attribute taxonomy. Based on AgentCIScope, we evaluate 12 agents on 936 tasks and find that strong task-completion capability does not guarantee contextual-integrity preservation: single-run leakage rates range from 32.5% to 94.4%, while repeating each task five times further increases leakage by 4-19 percentage points. Leakage varies substantially across attributes: personal preferences and booking details have average leakage rates of 84.7% and 76.5%, compared with 17.1% for credit-card information and 29.4% for SSNs; environments: calendar has the highest average leakage rate as an information source, while WhatsApp ranks highest as an information destination; and governing privacy policies. AgentCIScope provides deep insights into agent privacy leakage and serves as a unified testbed for developing privacy-preserving agents.

</details>


### [268] [SafeAdapt-Poker: Counterfactual Risk Calibration for Budgeted Adaptation under Opponent Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20473)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Rui Chen,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SafeAdapt-Poker 将对手行为突变下的预算化适应建模为双反事实序列控制问题，仅用决策前可用信息，通过策略风险模型与预算状态续期模型平衡即时适应价值与未来适应价值损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对手历史在行为突变后会误导决策，需要在有限偏离预算下安全地适应对手变化，同时控制相对冻结锚策略的偏离程度。

Method: 在每个决策点提出两个反事实问题：偏离锚策略的局部下行风险，以及消耗剩余偏离预算导致的未来适应价值损失。前者用单调策略风险模型刻画偏离强度，后者用成对预算状态续期模型对预算消耗定价。通过支持保持的候选偏离在即时价值与二者间权衡，采用路径累积KL账本约束总偏离，并在完整配对校准会话上筛选一组冻结控制器；另给出有限候选扰动界。

Result: 在精确 Leduc 上，完整控制器达到 +0.0718 的弱池匹配收益，最差对手 delta 为 -0.0126；将延迟机会捕获率从短视分配的 0.6318 提升至 0.7841；在 abstract-HUNL 交叉对战达到 +42.7 mbb/hand；公共历史筛选实现 0.5820 动作准确率和 0.9277 log loss，优于公共先验的 0.5039 和 0.9778。

Conclusion: 该方法在预算约束下实现了安全且有效的对手适应，兼顾即时收益与长期适应价值，并在多种评估中表现优于基线。

Abstract: Opponent histories can mislead after behavioral shifts. SafeAdapt-Poker formulates budgeted adaptation under opponent shift as a dual-counterfactual sequential-control problem using only information available before each decision. At each decision the controller asks two distinct questions: what local downside a deviation from the frozen anchor would induce under matched legal continuations, and what future adaptation value would be lost by consuming part of the remaining deviation budget now. The first question is answered by a monotone strategic-risk model over deviation intensity; the second by a paired budget-state continuation model that prices current budget consumption. The controller selects among support-preserving candidate deviations by trading immediate adaptation value against these two quantities, a pathwise cumulative-KL ledger bounds total anchor-relative deviation, and a finite family of frozen controllers is screened on complete paired calibration sessions before held-out interaction. A finite-candidate perturbation bound shows that the allocation objective degrades continuously with continuation-value estimation error. Evaluation covers exact-game exploitation and safety, four opponent shifts, local-risk calibration, delayed-opportunity allocation, direct opportunity-value estimation, value-error robustness, factorial mechanism attribution, budget sensitivity, abstract-HUNL cross-play, and player/time-held-out public-history behavior. On exact Leduc the full controller attains a matched weak-pool gain of +0.0718 with a worst-opponent delta of -0.0126, raises delayed-opportunity capture from 0.6318 under myopic allocation to 0.7841 under the same session budget, and reaches +42.7 mbb/hand in abstract-HUNL cross-play; the retained public-history screen reports 0.5820 action accuracy and 0.9277 log loss versus 0.5039 and 0.9778 for a public prior.

</details>


### [269] [Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19159)
*Seungone Kim,Jiayi Geng,Young-Jun Lee,Bo Liu,Juyoung Suk,Nicholas Lubbers,Mitchell Wood,Marcus Noack,Yong-Xin Yao,Yuan Shi,Roxana Bujack,Cristina Garcia Cardona,Austin Rodriguez,Ilon Joseph,Woojin Cho,Zora Zhiruo Wang,Chuanyang Jin,Ian Wu,Apurva Gandhi,Tianjian Li,Weiwei Sun,Carolin Lawrence,Kiril Gashteovski,Dongyeop Kang,Jay Shin,Akari Asai,Graham Neubig,Sean Welleck*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"Into the Unknown"基准，测试AI智能体能否针对开放科学问题撰写后续研究论文。9个前沿智能体在5个领域共提交135篇，无一满足领域科学家的所有条件，114篇未通过诚信检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索AI智能体能否对开放科学问题开展研究，并评估其生成后续论文的真实质量。

Method: 与美国DOE国家实验室科学家合作，各提供未发表的后续研究方向及提交必须满足的条件；用这些条件构建评分标准。9个前沿智能体各撰写15篇后续论文。

Result: 覆盖量子计算、等离子体物理、计算化学、材料科学、科学机器学习5个领域，共135篇论文。无一满足全部条件，114篇未过诚信检查，主因是声称未做的工作或报告与记录证据矛盾的数值。

Conclusion: 智能体能轻易产出看似后续研究的论文，但无一达到领域科学家标准，仍存在巨大提升空间。代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.

</details>


### [270] [ListQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating List-Formatted Factual Knowledge Retrieval in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19165)
*Mayank Kulkarni,Rakesh Vaideeswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ListQA是一个包含9,045个人工校验问题的基准，要求LLM回忆多个事实并组织成3-10元素的结构化列表，用于评估多事实列表式知识检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
