CR training also shifts the compute--accuracy frontier across inference budgets from 512 to 4,096 tokens, outperforming matched non-CR training throughout and reaching 48.1\% recovery at the largest budget. The same pattern is supported across multiple data sources, remains visible under on-policy distillation, and extends to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct when CR sets are reconstructed separately for that model. Better test-time compute utilization can therefore be learned through post-training, with recoverable responses to additional reasoning providing a particularly informative signal for selecting training examples.

</details>


### [342] [Designing Textual Interfaces To Enhance Llm Reasoning On Audio-Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20085)
*Yi Wang,Tianzi Wang,Tong Lei,Dahan Wang,Peter Bell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究文本接口设计如何影响音视频多模态推理中的自动提示优化，比较三种系统架构在APO下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: APO对文本LLM有效，但应用于音视频多模态系统需要合适的文本接口来暴露多模态推理过程。

Method: 在音视频问答任务上比较三种接口设计：单一全能LLM直接推理、captioner-reasoner系统、以及主agent编排子OmniLLM的智能体架构；使用Qwen3-Omni和Gemini进行实验。

Result: 直接提示优化带来依赖模型的增益；captioner-reasoner和智能体系统提供更可解释的优化接口但更难优化，并对优化影响案例进行了误差分析。

Conclusion: 文本接口设计是使提示优化在全模态推理系统中有效的重要因素。

Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.

</details>


### [343] [EvalBuilder: Can LLMs Build Efficient Benchmarks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20099)
*Huaisheng Zhu,Hangfan Zhang,Teng Xiao,Siyuan Xu,Shijie Zhou,Zhimeng Guo,Zhengyu Chen,Jingang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EvalBuilder 框架，将自动基准构建形式化为元评估问题，评估 LLM 智能体能否在低成本下构建保留参考评估结论的代理基准，并从保真度、效率和鲁棒性三个维度进行衡量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多用于长周期研究与工程任务，但评估这些能力成本高昂、耗时且高度依赖人类专家。因此作者提出：LLM 智能体自身能否构建高效基准，同时保留昂贵参考评估的结论？

Method: 将自动基准开发建模为元评估问题：给定任务和昂贵参考基准，要求智能体构建低成本代理基准，以忠实区分候选模型和方案。提出 EvalBuilder 框架，从保真度、效率和鲁棒性三个维度评估基准生成能力，并提供一个迭代环境，让智能体在固定时间预算下优化基准。

Result: 框架评估生成的基准是否保留模型排序、能否泛化到留出模型和新收集的响应，以及是否在显著降低评估成本的同时提供良好校准且有区分度的分数。

Conclusion: 该框架为理解当前 LLM 智能体何时能开发有用评估器、以及基准构建如何逐步自动化提供了系统性测试平台和基准。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for long-horizon research and engineering, yet evaluating these capabilities remains expensive, time-consuming, and heavily dependent on human expertise. This motivates a natural question: can LLM agents themselves construct efficient benchmarks that preserve the conclusions of costly reference evaluations? We study this capability by formulating automatic benchmark development as a meta-evaluation problem, where an agent is given a task and an expensive reference benchmark and requested to construct a lower-cost proxy benchmark that faithfully distinguishes among candidate models and solutions. Based on this formulation, we introduce EvalBuilder, a framework for evaluating such benchmark-generation capabilities along three key dimensions: fidelity, efficiency, and robustness. Specifically, we assess whether generated benchmarks preserve model rankings, generalize to held-out models and freshly collected responses, and provide well-calibrated and discriminative scores while substantially reducing evaluation cost. We further provide an iterative environment in which agents can refine their benchmarks under a fixed time budget. Our framework provides a systematic testbed and benchmark for understanding when current LLM agents can develop useful evaluators and how benchmark construction itself can be increasingly automated.

</details>


### [344] [Maximising Transparency in Context Compaction Improves Retention of Facts and Commitments for Lightweight Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20116)
*Felix Woolford*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 transparent-compact：一种面向轻量级模型的确定性上下文压缩方法，保留用户/助手原文并显式标注被删信息，在承诺与事实召回任务上优于模型摘要与 pi-vcc。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长会话超出上下文窗口，主流做法是模型写摘要压缩，但摘要会选择性改写且丢失信息不可见；现有研究较少关注轻量级/本地部署模型上的压缩效果。

Method: 为开源 Pi coding agent 设计的简单确定性压缩法：保证上下文中用户与助手的散文内容不被模型或算法改写，并显式标记压缩剔除的信息位置；与 Pi 默认的模型摘要压缩及 pi-vcc 对比。

Result: 在四个不同性能模型（重点 Qwen3.8-27B）上测试承诺（仅存在于对话中的用户规则）与事实召回：transparent-compact 匹配或超越两种基线，尤其在避免"自信犯错"（把错误信息当事实断言而非承认未回忆）上占优；在前沿模型上优势存在但更小。

Conclusion: 让轻量模型无需自行推理/搜索来弥补压缩丢失的信息，即可提升召回与应用效果，且无需针对任务或上下文做特定结构化设计。

Abstract: Long coding agent sessions outgrow the model's context window, so agents compact: older history is replaced by something shorter, usually a model-written summary. A summary selects and rewords, and the agent cannot see what was lost. Existing work has explored a range of compaction techniques, but comparatively little attention has been paid to their effectiveness with lightweight models, including those deployed locally or used for high-volume workloads. Here, we present transparent-compact, a simple deterministic method for the open-source Pi coding agent, designed specifically for use with such models and with the purpose of maximising the transparency of the agent's view of its own compacted context. It guarantees that user and assistant prose in its context is unchanged by a model or algorithm, and explicitly flags where compaction has stripped information. We compare it with Pi's default model-written summary compaction and with pi-vcc, a popular deterministic method with similar methods but without verbatim retention of prose. Our benchmarks run on four models of varying performance levels, with emphasis on Qwen3.8-27B: a lightweight model at the top end of what consumer hardware can serve locally. On sets probing commitments (rules the user set which exist only in the conversation) and recall of facts, transparent-compact matched or outperformed both alternatives. In particular, it showed an advantage in avoiding confident blunders, i.e. assertion of false information as opposed to recognizing that something was not recalled. Even with a frontier model, its advantage was present but smaller. We argue that transparent-compact spares lightweight models from reasoning or searching their way around what compaction lost, and results in improved recall and application of information as a result, without the need for task or context-specific structuring of the session history.

</details>


### [345] [LLM-Based Policy Compliance Verification of Loan Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20155)
*Florentina Voboril*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于LLM的原型系统，自动将内部贷款政策转化为机器可读规则，并据此核查贷款申请的合规性，能检出手工审核易忽略的政策违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银行依赖大量内部政策框架确保公司贷款决策合规，但人工依据政策审核贷款申请既繁琐又依赖专业知识，容易漏掉政策违规或例外情况，因此需要自动化核查工具。

Method: 采用两步架构：第一步从政策文档中自动提取合规相关规则，转换为结构化、机器可读的表示；第二步将贷款申请与提取出的规则逐一比对，识别政策例外、不合规问题、缺失信息以及需人工复核的情形。

Result: 规则提取过程在多次运行中高度稳定，且能一致捕捉领域专家认为关键的规则；在11份含已知政策例外的真实贷款申请上，系统成功检出多数已知例外，并额外发现人工审核中此前被忽略的合规问题；但系统也会产生假阳性。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的政策合规核查虽不能完全替代人工判断，但能通过提示潜在合规风险，为贷款申请审核流程提供有价值的辅助支持。

Abstract: Banks rely on extensive internal policy frameworks to ensure that corporate lending decisions comply with regulatory requirements and internal risk standards. Reviewing loan applications against these policies is a largely manual and knowledge-intensive process, which can lead to overlooked policy violations or exceptions. This report presents a prototype of an LLM-based policy checker that automatically verifies loan applications against internal lending policies.
  The proposed approach follows a two-step architecture. First, compliance-relevant rules are automatically extracted from policy documents and converted into structured, machine-readable representations. Second, loan applications are evaluated against the extracted rules to identify policy exceptions, non-compliant findings, missing information, and cases requiring manual review.
  Evaluation results demonstrate that the rule extraction process is highly stable across multiple runs and consistently captures rules identified as critical by a domain expert. When evaluated on 11 real loan applications with known policy exceptions, the system successfully detected the majority of these exceptions and identified additional compliance issues that had previously been overlooked during manual reviews. While the approach produces false positives and cannot fully replace human judgement, the results indicate that LLM-based policy compliance verification can provide valuable support in the loan application verification process by highlighting potential compliance risks.

</details>


### [346] [Value-Guided Repulsion for Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20190)
*Yixue Hao,Jiahao Zhang,Jiesong Lian,Xufei Guo,Xumeng Guo,Wenhui Zhang,Long Hu,Rui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VRQL，将动作价值估计融入漂移模型的粒子交互场，用价值引导的排斥实现离线RL策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准漂移策略仅依据生成动作间的几何关系决定排斥，无法按期望价值区分动作，导致行为正则化与策略改进脱节。

Method: VRQL在每个状态下将几何核距离与归一化Q值缩放相结合，对低价值粒子赋予更强排斥，同时保留对行为动作的吸引，无需额外行为模型阶段即可对齐行为正则化与策略改进。

Result: 在50个OGBench任务配置和6个D4RL AntMaze配置上，VRQL相较主流基线表现出强竞争力。

Conclusion: 价值引导的粒子交互是离线强化学习中一种有效方法。

Abstract: Drifting models have emerged as a highly efficient and stable paradigm for policy design in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, standard drift policies determine repulsion solely from geometric relationships among generated actions and therefore cannot distinguish them by expected value. To address this limitation, we introduce Value-Guided Repulsion Q-Learning (VRQL) to integrate action value estimates into the particle interaction field. For each state, VRQL combines geometric kernel distance with a normalized Q value scaling. This mechanism assigns greater repulsive influence to particles with lower values while strictly retaining attraction toward behavior action. Consequently, this value-guided interaction field aligns behavior regularization with policy improvement without adding an auxiliary behavior model stage. On 50 OGBench task configurations and 6 D4RL AntMaze configurations, VRQL demonstrates highly competitive performance against established baselines, suggesting that value-guided particle interaction is an effective method for offline RL.

</details>


### [347] [Drivers of LLM Consensus Formation Under Competing Incentives: A Simulation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20200)
*Isabel Jones,Matthew Edwards,Janina A. Hoffmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于“网络共识博弈”的评测框架，研究具有竞争激励的LLM智能体如何达成共识，发现开源模型共识率低于人类且需全局通信，而ChatGPT 5.6-sol能在受限甚至无通信下达成共识，行为差异源于模型特质与网络结构共同作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被部署于会产生一致意见的多智能体环境，既包括需要协调的预期互动，也包括意外涌现的互动。理解具有竞争激励的LLM如何达成共识，对于解释和设计LLM群体至关重要。

Method: 作者引入基于网络共识博弈（Network Consensus game）的评测：智能体网络需在两种颜色中选择一种以获取收益，但不同智能体对同一颜色获得的收益不同。通过变化通信权限与网络结构等组件，评测六个开源模型和一个闭源模型（ChatGPT 5.6-sol）。

Result: 开源LLM在可比实验中达成共识的频率低于人类，且只有在消息能跨全局网络传播时才能达成共识。ChatGPT 5.6-sol则能在通信仅限于邻居、甚至完全无通信能力的情况下达成共识。这得益于其更低的固执性和更高的从众倾向，以及在消息中提供更多关于邻居状态的信息。然而，将智能体置于高度聚集的图中会降低共识，与这些特质无关。

Conclusion: 集体结果由系统设计（如网络结构、通信方式）和个体模型特质共同驱动。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent environments that produce unanimous agreement, both in intended interactions that need coordination and in unintended emergent interactions. Consequently, understanding how LLMs with competing incentives reach consensus is crucial to better interpret and design LLM collectives. We introduce an evaluation, based on the Network Consensus game, to assess the mechanisms driving this process. Here, a network of agents must agree on one of two colours to receive a payoff, but agents are offered different payoffs for the agreed colour. We vary components such as communication access and network structure and assess six open-source models and one closed model (ChatGPT 5.6-sol).
  We find that open-source LLMs reach consensus less often than humans in comparable experiments and only if messages are communicated across the global network. ChatGPT 5.6-sol, however, is able to reach consensus with communication limited to its neighbours and with no communication ability. This is achieved through lower stubbornness and higher majority-following tendencies, and by providing more information about its neighbours' states in messages. However, situating agents in a highly clustered graph reduces consensus, regardless of these traits, demonstrating that both system design and individual model traits drive collective outcomes.

</details>


### [348] [Robust Counterfactuals for Markov Decision Processes under Statistical and Causal Uncertainties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20210)
*Jessica Lally,Milad Kazemi,Nicola Paoletti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个在MDP中进行部分反事实推理的框架，同时应对统计不确定性与因果模型不确定性，给出闭式解析边界并通过对反事实IMDP的悲观值迭代计算最小鲁棒干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实推理可用于识别失败原因、解释序列决策中AI的行为。但在MDP中存在两类不确定性：由轨迹数据估计转移时的统计不确定性，以及多个SCM与同一MDP兼容导致的因果模型不确定性。已有工作只单独处理其中之一。

Method: 将MDP建模为区间MDP（IMDP），提出对因果关系中统计与因果不确定性同时鲁棒的部分反事实推理框架：1）给出对所有由该IMDP蕴含的SCM均成立的反事实概率闭式解析边界；2）基于这些边界构造反事实IMDP，并在其上做悲观值迭代，从而计算达成目标反事实结果的最小鲁棒干预。

Result: 多个案例研究表明该方法具有鲁棒性，并能实用地识别出：若改变哪些最小动作集合，本可导致更优结果。

Conclusion: 该框架统一处理统计与因果不确定性，因基于解析边界构造故高效可扩展，适用于现实MDP环境，为反事实解释与最小干预识别提供实用工具。

Abstract: Counterfactual reasoning (asking what would have happened, had a decision been different) is a powerful tool for identifying causes of failure and explaining the behaviour of AI systems in sequential decision-making tasks. In Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), two sources of uncertainty complicate counterfactual inference: statistical uncertainty in the MDP transitions when the MDP is estimated from trajectory data, and uncertainty about the unknown causal model, as there are multiple structural causal models (SCMs) compatible with each MDP. Existing work addresses these two challenges in isolation. We address both simultaneously by introducing a framework for partial counterfactual inference in MDPs that is robust to both statistical and causal uncertainty. Our approach provides: 1) closed-form analytical bounds for the counterfactual probabilities that are valid across all SCMs entailed by a given interval MDP (IMDP); 2) a method to compute minimal robust interventions to achieve a desired counterfactual outcome via pessimistic value iteration on the induced counterfactual IMDP. Since the latter is constructed using our analytical bounds, our approach remains efficient and scalable to realistic MDP environments. Experiments across multiple case studies demonstrate our method's robustness and practical utility for identifying minimal sets of actions that, if changed, would have led to improved outcomes.

</details>


### [349] [Design Space Exploration of Reinforcement Learning Configurations for Post-Legalization Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20224)
*Foteini Oikonomou,Maria Pantazi-Kypraiou,George Goudroumanis,Pavlos Stoikos,Athanasios Tziouvaras,Christos Anagnostopoulos,Georgios Karakonstantis,George Floros*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对GNN-PPO框架用于合法化后布局优化进行了系统设计空间探索，评估18种配置，识别缺陷并提出设计分类方法以指导RL模型设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN与RL已被用于VLSI布局优化，但其在合法化后布局精修中的有效性尚不明确，需要系统性研究来评估其前景与局限。

Method: 在三个ISPD2015基准上对GNN-PPO框架进行系统设计空间探索，评估涵盖奖励函数、GNN架构、动作空间、候选集大小及训练策略的18种配置，并分析结果、提出设计分类方法。

Result: 通过18种配置的对比分析，识别出RL方法在合法化后布局优化中的潜在缺陷，并评估其前景与机会。

Conclusion: RL方法在合法化后布局精修中的有效性仍存疑虑；提出的设计分类方法可指导RL模型的设计决策。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) have recently been explored for VLSI placement optimization, but their effectiveness for post-legalization placement refinement remains unclear. This paper presents a systematic design space exploration of a GNN-Proximal Policy Optimization (GNN-PPO) framework across three ISPD2015 benchmarks. We evaluate 18 configurations covering reward functions, GNN architectures, action spaces, candidate-set sizes, and training strategies. We analyse the results we obtain to identify pitfalls and to assess the prospects and opportunities of the RL methods for post-legalization placement. On top of that we propose a design classification approach to guide the design decisions of RL models.

</details>


### [350] [Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20312)
*Xin Li,Xiaohuan Gu,Yifan Wang,Shaobin Ling,Tianli Shi,Jingao Xu,Zhimeng Yin,Dapeng Wu,Yun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HiMeco：一种受大脑启发的自进化智能体，通过海马-元认知反思诊断具身空间任务中的失败原因，并将交互抽象为参数化技能，在ESI-Bench达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体在具身空间任务中面临复杂多步决策与部分视觉证据，执行失败难以归因（误感知、探索不足或规划错误），仅凭执行反馈无法揭示责任来源，导致简单积累经验反而强化无效策略。

Method: 受元认知监控与海马记忆巩固启发，提出HiMeco：通过海马-元认知反思在感知-探索-规划(PEP)层面诊断失败，对比执行尝试以提炼可复用策略与避错指导；将交互程序抽象为参数化技能，并用证据契约与执行验证决定其保留与复用；策略和技能指导后续交互，记忆仅在轮次间更新，模型参数保持冻结。

Result: 在ESI-Bench上达到最先进性能，并在无需进化的情况下将EmbSpatial-Bench准确率提升3.94个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过诊断式反思与技能抽象，HiMeco有效提升具身空间推理能力，且无需微调模型参数即可实现自进化与迁移。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.

</details>


### [351] [Argument Graph Uncertainty: Quantifying Uncertainty from the Logical Structure of Reasoning Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20328)
*Simon Baur,Sumire Honda,Wojciech Samek,Jackie Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Argument Graph Uncertainty，一种事后框架，通过单条思维链的逻辑结构构建论元图，用 Dirichlet 后验估计 LLM 的不确定性，在无需额外调用模型的情况下优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险推理任务需要可靠的不确定性估计，但现有方法依赖昂贵的采样策略或忽略模型输出内部逻辑结构的浅层 token 级信号。

Method: 针对多选题任务，用轻量指令微调模型或确定性规则将推理链切分为命题单元，再用 NLI 模型推断关系边，构建两个互补的论元图。边分数聚合为答案选项上的 Dirichlet 后验，其集中度给出反映局部步间连贯性与全局逻辑一致性的校准不确定性。

Result: 在 GPQA、MMLU-Pro、TruthfulQA 上，跨多个推理模型持续超越基于 token 和基于一致性的基线；组合分析表明其信号与现有方法正交，可作为不确定性集成中的互补组件。

Conclusion: 框架无需额外调用被评估模型，仅依赖小型高效辅助模型，成本低且提供完全可解释的逐节点不确定性归因。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying large language models in high-stakes reasoning tasks, yet most existing approaches rely on expensive sampling strategies or shallow token-level signals that ignore the internal logical structure of model outputs. We introduce Argument Graph Uncertainty, a post-hoc framework for multiple choice question tasks, that estimates model confidence directly from the logical structure of a single chain-of-thought reasoning trace. Our method uses either a lightweight instruction-tuned model or a simple deterministic rule to segment the reasoning chain into propositional units, then applies a NLI model to infer relational edges and construct two complementary argument graphs over these segments. The resulting edge scores are aggregated into a Dirichlet posterior over answer options, whose concentration yields calibrated uncertainty estimates reflecting both local step-to-step coherence and global logical consistency across the reasoning trace. Evaluated on GPQA, MMLU-Pro and TruthfulQA, our method consistently surpasses token-based and consistency-based uncertainty baselines across multiple reasoning models. We further demonstrate through extensive combination analyses that argument graph uncertainty captures an orthogonal signal to existing approaches, making it a complementary component in uncertainty ensembles. Crucially, our framework requires no additional calls to the evaluated model and relies entirely on small, efficient auxiliary models, producing fully interpretable, per-node uncertainty attributions at low computational cost.

</details>


### [352] [TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20334)
*Dongzhuo Li,Fangzhou Cheng,Weiwei Li,Kevin Han,Haixu Ma,Zhongchang Sun,Ruiyi Li,Serena Li,Xiangjun Fan,Lizhu Zhang,Yuandong Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TreeFlex 让 ReAct 智能体的策略自主决定搜索路径，用树结构管理上下文并为节点生成摘要，通过 Reflection/Execution 双角色与树感知 GRPO 联合训练，在深度研究基准和 SWE-bench Verified 上显著超越扁平 ReAct 与 FoldAgent。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReAct 风格智能体在单一上下文中累积观测、中间结果和失败尝试，导致上下文膨胀，过时和离题信息挤占有限容量并掩盖相关证据，使聚焦推理愈发困难。

Method: TreeFlex 由 harness 维护搜索树，将每个中间状态连同简短摘要记录为节点。单一语言模型担任两种角色：Reflection 依据全局摘要视图选择要恢复的节点并给出指令；Execution 恢复该节点路径并执行指令，保存新节点或提出解，由 Reflection 批准或转回其他节点。策略据此决定深化、分支、回访、验证或停止，无固定遍历顺序与节点分数。训练上用树感知的 GRPO，联合训练导航、任务动作、检查点与方案审查，采用任务级结果奖励加过程奖励。

Result: 4B 模型小规模 RL 后，在相同活跃上下文限制下，深度研究基准达 48.8% 准确率，高于扁平 ReAct 的 41.5% 和 FoldAgent 的 42.8%，Pass@8 高约十个百分点。SWE-bench Verified 上从同一 9B 模型 RL 训练，TreeFlex 解决 54.9% 任务，优于 FoldAgent 的 43.3% 和其逐步变体的 45.2%。

Conclusion: 让策略自主决定在搜索树中的导航位置，并结合树感知联合训练，可在不增加活跃上下文的情况下有效缓解上下文膨胀，显著提升复杂深度研究与软件工程任务的性能。

Abstract: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. Through these choices, the policy decides whether to deepen the current line, branch from or revisit an earlier state, verify a proposal, or stop, without a fixed traversal order or a score for each node. We train navigation, task actions, checkpointing, and proposal review jointly with a tree-aware adaptation of GRPO, using task-level outcome rewards augmented by process rewards. After small-scale RL of a 4B model, with the same active-context limit for all methods, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy on a challenging deep-research benchmark, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent, and its Pass@8 is about ten points higher than either. On SWE-bench Verified, with all three systems trained with RL from the same 9B model, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for its step-wise variant.

</details>


### [353] [Lifted State Policy Optimization: Internalizing Self-Correction through Transition Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20350)
*Ren Zhuang,Ben Wang,Shuifa Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Lifted State Policy Optimization (LSPO)，以"成本调整的局部状态转移"为学习基本单元，通过提升状态、能量函数与塑形奖励优化推理，在Qwen3.5-27B上单次推理达71.8%准确率，接近测试时反思的71.9%且延迟降28%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好优化只对最终答案排序、轨迹RL只最大化累计回报，二者都未能对"将错误推理状态转为更好状态"的局部改变给予信用归因。

Method: 为每个文本答案附加一个可学习的连续坐标构成"提升状态"，用能量函数评估并排序；设计塑形奖励驱动能量下降（扣除编辑与步数成本）；通过内部化损失将低能量答案吸收进直接生成器。

Result: Qwen3.5-27B上单次策略在数学、科学、代码、逻辑基准上平均准确率71.8%，媲美测试时反思的71.9%，延迟降低28%、token减少25.8%；在稠密与MoE骨干上均成立，对照实验证实转移信用、提升坐标及答案内部化各有贡献。

Conclusion: 以局部状态转移为核心学习单元可有效提升推理质量并兼顾效率，代码已开源。

Abstract: Preference optimization ranks final answers and trajectory RL maximizes aggregate returns, yet neither credits the local change that turns a flawed reasoning state into a better one. We introduce Lifted State Policy Optimization (LSPO), which establishes this finite, cost-adjusted transition as the primary unit of learning. Each textual answer is augmented with a learned continuous coordinate, forming a lifted state that an energy function evaluates and orders. A shaped reward drives energy descent net of edit and step costs, and an internalization loss absorbs selected low-energy answers into the direct generator. On Qwen3.5-27B, the resulting single-pass policy reaches 71.8% aggregate accuracy across mathematics, science, code, and logic benchmarks, matching test-time reflection at 71.9% with 28% lower latency and 25.8% fewer tokens. The pattern holds across dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, and matched controls confirm that transition credit and the lifted coordinate each contribute, as does answer internalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/Venomrko/lspo.

</details>


### [354] [From Relevance to Validity: Zero-Shot Tool Selection via Functional and Contextual Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20388)
*Xiaoxuan Dong,Jin Zhang,Zichen Yuan,Yue Zhou,Zihao Rao,Dexu Yu,Tingyong WU,Wenhao Deng,Junchen Fu,Pengwei Sun,Yang Ran,Bo Lan,Yongxin Ni,Youhua Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对LLM智能体零样本工具选择中的"迁移有效性差距"，提出渐进式验证框架，融合语义相关性、功能性兼容与上下文证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体面对未见领域和上下文时，零样本工具选择至关重要。现有方法主要依赖相关性排序，但语义匹配无法保证工具功能兼容或在新上下文中仍适用，存在"迁移有效性差距"。

Method: 提出渐进式验证框架，在语义相关性基础上补充基于端点的功能兼容性验证和任务条件化的上下文证据验证。

Result: 在跨领域和跨数据集迁移中持续提升能力排序效果，在功能或上下文模糊场景下增益更大；消融实验证实功能验证与上下文验证的互补贡献。

Conclusion: 语义相关性不足以支撑零样本工具选择，引入功能与上下文验证可有效弥补迁移有效性差距。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly face tasks from unseen domains and execution contexts, making zero-shot tool selection essential for identifying tools that can satisfy task requirements. Existing dominant methods mainly rely on relevance ranking, but semantic matching alone cannot ensure that a tool is functionally compatible or remains applicable in a new context. We preliminarily identify a \emph{transfer-validity gap}, where semantically relevant tools may still fail to satisfy functional or contextual requirements after transfer. To address this gap, we propose \methodname{}, a progressive validation framework that complements semantic relevance with endpoint-grounded functional compatibility and task-conditioned contextual evidence. Across cross-domain and cross-dataset transfer, \methodname{} consistently improves capability ranking, with larger gains under functional or contextual ambiguity. Ablation results further confirm the complementary contributions of functional and contextual validation.

</details>


### [355] [SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20431)
*Qianru Meng,Xi Zhang,Konstantinos Papakostas,Congfeng Cao,Wenxiang Hu,Tianyi Lu,Xiao Zhang,Lun Zhou,Zaiqiao Meng,Zhaochun Ren,Xiaohui Yan,Yougang Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SwarmRSI 框架，通过进化科学智能体群体实现科研的递归自我改进，在多个基准上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科研中的递归自我改进（RSI）旨在让智能体通过自身实验经验提升研究能力。科学智能体群体可整合不同方向的证据与实现来指导后续实验，但存在两大难题：实验结果不佳时难以判断应修正假设还是其实现；整体程序得分会掩盖对其他智能体有用的组件。

Method: 提出 SwarmRSI 框架，包含：Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation（利用其他智能体的实验反馈来完善假设及其实现）、Complementary Swarm Recombination（跨智能体复用保留的假设与互补程序组件，使部分结果支持新研究），以及 Recursive Swarm Evolution（将两机制整合为反馈循环，用新实验证据指导后续研究）。

Result: 在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 和 MLE-Bench Lite 上实验表明 SwarmRSI 达到 SOTA 性能；进一步评估显示积累的研究经验可提升在留出任务上的表现；生物学家复现了其程序并进行后续生物学分析。

Conclusion: SwarmRSI 通过进化科学智能体群体有效实现递归自我改进，兼顾假设与实现的协同优化及组件复用，性能领先且具备实际科研可用性。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.

</details>


### [356] [The Wealth of Agents: Scaling Agentic AI Across Developers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20518)
*Austin W. Hanjie,Carlos E. Jimenez,Zirui Wang,Karthik Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究多开发者智能体系统（MDA），通过实证与理论模型论证其可作为智能体AI的新扩展轴，实现超越单开发者系统（SDA）的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体系统由单开发者全权控制构建，开发简便但限制了系统规模与能力上限；作者希望探索多开发者协作是否能将前沿能力推向单开发者无法达到的高度。

Method: 构建开发者与系统的实证模型和理论模型，对比MDA与SDA；在GAIA通用助手基准上，将多个专业化开发者的智能体组合成MDA进行评测，并与投入数倍预算的通用SDA对比。

Result: 在GAIA上，单个准确率不超过35%的专业化开发者群体，通过MDA组合后达到70%准确率，比投入数倍开发预算的通用SDA中位数高出12个百分点。

Conclusion: 理论模型表明MDA能激励专业化分工并更高效利用聚合的开发资源，初步证明MDA是推动智能体AI协作发展的新扩展轴。

Abstract: Today's agentic systems are typically designed, built, and deployed by single developers with full control over all participating agents. While this simplifies development, it limits the potential scale of agentic systems. We study multi-developer agentic systems (MDAs) which enable developers to collaboratively build agentic systems to push frontier capability beyond what any individual developer could achieve alone. We construct empirical and theoretical models of developers to compare MDAs with single-developer agentic systems (SDAs). On GAIA, a general assistant benchmark, a population of specialized developers whose individual agents do not exceed 35% accuracy reaches 70% when their agents are combined in an MDA. This MDA performs 12 percentage points above the median general-purpose SDA built with several times each specialist's development budget. Our theoretical models show how MDAs can incentivize specialization and encourage more efficient use of aggregated developer resources. Put together, our results make a preliminary case for MDAs as a new scaling axis by enabling developers with diverse capabilities and resources to advance agentic AI collaboratively.

</details>


### [357] [ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20532)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Peng Zhang,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"可决策认证的主动证据获取"框架，在免费元数据/付费观测边界下，用CEIG图与决策加权包围目标指导视觉证据查询并给出ε决策证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体需判断视觉证据是否值得获取、查询哪个候选/分辨率、何时停止交互，现有方法缺乏成本约束下的决策可认证性与停止准则。

Method: 构建反事实证据交互图CEIG表示一元价值、二阶交互与条件伤害并维持分数包围；用决策加权包围目标收紧可改变动作的界；缺口导向精化只评估可能改变当前动作的交互；ε决策证书保证未解析项不改变所选动作；配对延续rollout学习付费预览价值，成本过滤与轨迹认证分离，监控器绑定证书与冻结轨迹。

Result: 640例数据（384/128/128），任务分0.842、grounding F1 0.816、证据召回0.873、1.74次接受调用、286.5K视觉token、p95延迟742ms；证书密集回放动作一致率0.992、证书率0.988，每决策仅评估19.6个昂贵交互项（对比191.4）。

Conclusion: 该方法在严格成本边界下实现高效且可认证的主动证据获取，显著减少昂贵交互评估并保持高决策一致性与语义质量。

Abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $ε$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

</details>


### [358] [PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20560)
*Weichen Lyu,Chong Xia,Mingyu Dong,Long Xu,Shengjun Zhang,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PhySGA，一个基于物理空间接地的智能体框架，通过智能体探索与物理仿真实现3D物体组合，可通用交互式装配刚体、铰接体和可变形物体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D物体组合对内容创作和机器人仿真至关重要。现有方法依赖数字空间中的静态先验（LLM直接预测坐标或扩散先验生成图像），在悬挂、重力沉降、隐藏容纳等复杂组合任务上表现不佳，因为这些任务需要全局规划、细粒度对齐和物理仿真的交互式构建过程。

Method: 设计协作式前馈-反馈架构：Assembly Agent负责几何与运动学推理，进行全局步骤规划和粗调；Critic Agent基于接触动力学推理，进行仿真器状态诊断和细粒度闭环修正。Action Routers将语义规划映射为仿真器中可执行的物理原语；任务特定的自进化技能库将历史试错反馈蒸馏为可复用经验。

Result: 在Isaac Sim中的大量实验表明，PhySGA在关系保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量上显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将智能体探索与物理仿真结合，PhySGA有效解决了复杂3D组合任务，并借助自进化技能库提升成功率、减少探索次数。

Abstract: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.

</details>


### [359] [Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20563)
*Shangyin Tan,Ben Zhou,Lakshya A Agrawal,Jialin Zhang,Yilin Chen,Qiuyang Mang,Donghyun Lee,Dennis Jacob,Koushik Sen,Alex Dimakis,Matei Zaharia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过周期性"遗忘"搜索状态从最佳候选重启，突破LLM智能体自动研究的历史锚定瓶颈，四任务上较并行智能体提升15%、较单智能体提升39%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动研究扩展策略（单智能体长迭代、并行、并行通信）会随历史累积而趋于平台期：智能体被自身历史尝试锚定，编辑变少变小，更多预算收益甚微。

Method: 在带通信的多智能体团队中实现"遗忘"机制：周期性丢弃搜索状态（各智能体会话与候选历史），并从当前最佳候选重新启动；在启发式编程、核优化、模型训练四类任务上评估。

Result: 相比并行智能体最高提升15%，相比单智能体最高提升39%。

Conclusion: 对开放式发现而言，智能体被允许"记住什么"与"分配多少算力"同样重要。

Abstract: Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further.
  We implement forgetting in a team of agents with communication and evaluate it on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization and model training. The results show up to 15% improvement compared to parallel agents, and up to 39% compared to a single agent. Our results suggest that, for open-ended discovery, what an agent is allowed to remember matters as much as how much compute it is given.

</details>


### [360] [Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20597)
*Haofei Yu,Yixing Chen,Yining Zhao,Xuyan Ye,Yuxiang Liu,Zhigang Hua,Yan Xie,Shuang Yang,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CoPE，通过多步动作目标增强语言智能体 RL 训练，提升性能与样本效率且无推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程轨迹训练成本高，标准 agentic RL 仅用终端标量奖励，浪费中间步骤监督。现有值目标（单标量、难构建）和观测目标（长且噪声、仅一步）均不理想。

Method: 在成功 on-policy 轨迹上，让策略骨干预测每个历史后的动作序列，对每步动作从先前历史进行预测监督，形成时间集成，使行动与预测协同进化；推理仍单步执行。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop、τ²-bench、AppWorld 五个基准上，聚合性能优于 GRPO 及带预测辅助目标的 RL 基线；ScienceWorld 样本效率较 ECHO 高 1.9×、较 GRPO 高 2.0×。

Conclusion: CoPE 用单一策略骨干实现增益，无需额外模型、单独预训练或推理开销，代码已开源。

Abstract: Training language agents is bottlenecked by the high cost of long-horizon rollouts, yet standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) learns only from a terminal scalar reward, leaving the supervision in intermediate steps largely unused. Prior work exploits this supervision through value targets that estimate per-step success probabilities or observation targets that fit environment response. Both are hard to construct well: (1) value targets come from the same single scalar signal for each step in the trajectory, and (2) observation targets, such as web pages and terminal logs, are long and noisy and reach only one step ahead. We propose \name, which adds a third kind of multi-step action targets. On successful on-policy trajectories, \name trains the policy backbone to generate the action sequences that follows each history. Each action is also supervised when forecast from the preceding histories, forming a temporal ensemble that the shared backbone absorbs during training, and this enables acting and forecasting to co-evolve. The policy still acts one step at a time at inference, with no overhead. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, $τ^2$-bench, and AppWorld), \name (1) achieves stronger aggregate performance than GRPO and RL baselines with predictive auxiliary targets across simulated environments, while improving overall performance on both realistic applications; (2) delivers up to $1.9\times$ and $2.0\times$ higher sample efficiency than ECHO and GRPO, respectively, on ScienceWorld; and (3) achieves these gains with a single policy backbone, without additional models, separate pretraining, or inference overhead. The codebase is available at https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/CoPE.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [361] [Thompson Sampling for Learning in Zero-Sum Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18899)
*Kenshi Abe,Kaito Ariu,Po-An Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究高斯赌博机反馈下未知有限二人零和矩阵博弈中的Thompson采样，证明在集中式自博弈下期望累积对偶间隙为O(√T)，纯均衡时提升至O(log T)，并给出精确系数与匹配的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Thompson采样(TS)在经典随机赌博机中具有对数级最优遗憾，但其在多智能体学习中的行为尚不明确，尤其在未知零和博弈中的表现缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 研究未知有限二人零和矩阵博弈（高斯赌博机反馈）。在集中式自博弈中，TS从后验采样单一收益矩阵，并选择该采样博弈的纳什均衡进行博弈。

Result: 对每个具有唯一纳什均衡的固定零和博弈，期望累积对偶间隙为O(√T)；纯均衡情形提升至O(log T)。给出√T项精确系数，仅依赖均衡策略与噪声水平。建立匹配的√T极小极大下界，以及针对唯一纯均衡博弈类的实例相关对数下界。实验验证了预测的速率与系数。

Conclusion: TS在集中式自博弈的零和矩阵博弈中可实现√T级（纯均衡时对数级）对偶间隙，且理论下界与上界匹配，验证了TS在多智能体零和博弈中的有效性。

Abstract: Thompson sampling (TS) achieves logarithmic and asymptotically optimal regret in classical stochastic bandits, but its behavior in multi-agent learning remains less understood. We study TS in an unknown finite two-player zero-sum matrix game with Gaussian bandit feedback. Under centralized self-play, TS samples a single payoff matrix from the posterior and plays a Nash equilibrium of the sampled game. For every fixed zero-sum game with a unique Nash equilibrium, we show that the expected cumulative duality gap is $O(\sqrt T)$. The rate improves to $O(\log T)$ for pure equilibria. We then identify the exact coefficient of the $\sqrt T$ term, which depends only on the equilibrium strategies and the noise level. We also establish a minimax lower bound matching the square-root dependence on $T$ and an instance-dependent lower bound matching the logarithmic dependence on $T$ for a class of games with a unique pure equilibrium. Experiments support the predicted rates and coefficient.

</details>


### [362] [Maximin share allocations for two types of items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19099)
*Yu Chen,Kai Jie Wong,Xiaorui Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究两类任务（chores）下不可分物品的MMS公平分配问题，证明此时MMS分配总存在且可多项式时间计算，并将技术推广到两类物品及混合情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MMS分配在n>2时并非总存在，因此文献致力于寻找可保证精确MMS分配的特殊实例类。本文针对物品可分为两种类型的情形展开研究。

Method: 提出一种受作业调度领域先前工作启发的几何方法，用于构造MMS分配。

Result: 证明当物品可分为两类chores时，MMS分配总存在且可在多项式时间内计算；技术进一步扩展到两类goods以及一类goods加一类chores的混合实例。

Conclusion: 两类类型限制确保MMS分配的存在性与高效计算性，为MMS可保证的实例类提供了新结果。

Abstract: We study the fair allocation of indivisible items among $n$ agents with additive valuations (or costs) using the fairness notion of maximin share (MMS). Since MMS allocations do not always exist when $n > 2$, one direction in the literature has been to identify special classes of instances in which exact MMS allocations can be guaranteed. We show that, when items can be divided into two types of chores, MMS allocations always exist and can be computed in polynomial time using a novel geometric approach inspired by prior work in job scheduling. We further discuss how our technique extends to instances with two types of goods, as well as mixed instances consisting of one type of objective good and one type of objective chore.

</details>


### [363] [Learning in Strategic Queuing with Geometric Recharge: From Bandits to Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19179)
*Cristian Palma Foster,Eva Tardos*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究自私无遗憾队列在单包缓冲服务器上的路由学习，刻画出长期吞吐、稳定性与竞争比，并解决多队列系统的过配置因子开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心路由器使用小缓冲、未知服务率，队列是自私短视且用无遗憾学习选服务器；需理解这种分散学习下的吞吐、稳定性和所需过配置。

Method: 将单队列问题建模为几何充值老虎机，分析任意无遗憾学习者的长期平均吞吐；再推广到多队列竞争缓冲服务器，推导高概率无遗憾学习下的稳定性条件与过配置因子。

Result: 单队列：任意无遗憾学习者的长期平均吞吐至少为服务率的Hamacher和，且界紧；稳定当且仅当到达率低于该和；对最优策略至少0.77竞争且紧。多队列：最小过配置因子为1/(1-λmax)；稳定性条件为总到达率<(1-λmax)×总服务率，充分且有时必要；λmax=1/2时把Abel等上界从3改进到2，匹配下界并解决开放问题。

Conclusion: 无遗憾学习在单包缓冲路由中具有可刻画的吞吐与稳定性；多队列系统仅需有限过配置即可稳定，并确定紧的过配置因子与稳定性阈值。

Abstract: We study packet routing in queuing systems where queues act as selfish, myopic agents that use no-regret learning algorithms to select servers with unknown service rates. To model the small buffers used in data centers, we assume that each server has a single-packet buffer. Even such a tiny buffer already captures the features of buffering: routers can exploit multiple servers while accepted packets remain in service, but packets can occupy servers for multiple rounds, complicating future service and learning.
  We first analyze a single queue routing packets to $m$ buffered servers with service rates $μ_1, \dots, μ_m$. This setting is equivalent to an instance of the recharging bandits problem with geometric recharge. We prove that any no-regret learner achieves a long-run average throughput of at least the Hamacher sum of the server rates, and that this bound is tight. Consequently, a single no-regret queue is stable if and only if its arrival rate is below the Hamacher sum of the server rates. Moreover, comparing against an optimal policy, we show that any no-regret learner is at least $0.77$-competitive, which is also tight.
  We then study multi-queue systems where $n$ queues with arrival rates $λ_1, \dots, λ_n$, each at most $λ_{\max}$, compete for service from $m$ buffered servers. We show that the smallest overprovisioning factor that guarantees the system to be stable under high-probability no-regret learning is $\frac{1}{1-λ_{\max}}$. Equivalently, in terms of the total arrival and service rates, the condition $\sum_{i=1}^n λ_i < (1-λ_{\max})\sum_{j=1}^m μ_j$ is sufficient, and sometimes necessary, for stability under no-regret learning. In particular, for $λ_{\max} = 1/2$, this improves the upper bound of Abel et al. (EC 2026) from $3$ to $2$, matching their lower bound and resolving their open question.

</details>


### [364] [Truthful and Expected-Payment-Optimal Model Routing in Graph-Based Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19316)
*Jiayuan Liu,Mingyu Guo,Jiarui Gan,Vincent Conitzer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究将日常任务路由给更便宜的LLM提供商时的成本优化问题，将其建模为单参数采购拍卖，提出STAR机制，在拓扑感知下实现策略防护并最小化用户期望支付。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为降低LLM生成成本，可将任务分配给更便宜的提供商，但切换提供商会导致累积上下文需重新处理；保持依赖任务在同一提供商可复用上下文，因此路由决策在任务间相互耦合。此外，各提供商可能私下知晓实时单位成本并策略性虚报。

Method: 将路由问题形式化为单参数采购拍卖，提出STAR（策略防护的拓扑感知智能体路由）。其分配规则与支付通过在可能成本报告上积分工作量计算，使真实报告成为效用最大化策略，并覆盖真实提供商的执行成本。

Result: 在独立成本分布与非递减虚拟成本条件下，STAR还能最小化用户对提供商的期望总支付。合成实验分离了拓扑感知带来的执行成本收益与虚拟成本优化的支付收益：前者随扇出和传输负载增长，后者随测试的先验形状异质性路径逐渐增加；配对敏感性研究量化了先验误设下支付节省的变化，同时保持策略防护性。

Conclusion: STAR可在耦合的路由决策中实现策略防护的LLM提供商选择，并兼顾拓扑感知的执行成本节省与虚拟成本优化的支付节省，且对先验误设具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Assigning routine tasks to cheaper large language model (LLM) providers can reduce generation cost, but switching providers may require processing accumulated context again. Keeping dependent tasks with the same provider can instead reuse eligible context. Graph-based workflows therefore couple routing decisions across tasks. Independent providers may also privately know their real-time unit costs and strategically misreport them. We formulate this routing problem as a single-parameter procurement auction and propose STAR (Strategy-proof Topology-aware Agent Routing), which minimizes virtual-cost-weighted graph workloads. Its allocation rule and payments, computed by integrating workload over possible cost reports, make truthful reporting utility-maximizing regardless of other providers' reports and cover each truthful provider's execution cost. With independent cost distributions and non-decreasing virtual costs, STAR additionally minimizes the user's expected total payment to providers. Controlled synthetic experiments separate the execution-cost benefit of topology awareness from the payment benefit of virtual-cost optimization: the former grows with fan-out and transferred payload, while the latter increases gradually along the tested prior-shape heterogeneity path. A paired sensitivity study quantifies how payment savings vary with prior misspecification while strategy-proofness is preserved.

</details>


### [365] [What You Earn from What You Learn: Characterization and Complexity of the Value of Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19488)
*Ratip Emin Berker,Ioannis Anagnostides,Emanuel Tewolde,Brian Hu Zhang,Tuomas Sandholm,Vincent Conitzer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究扩展式决策问题中信息的价值，给出统一刻画（与冲突图的最大分数色数相关），并分析完美信息价值与回忆价值的计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将信息价值从具体收益环境中剥离，度量信息细化的结构重要性，推广了Berker等（AAAI'25）提出的回忆价值概念。

Method: 建立在任意信息细化下信息价值的统一刻画，揭示其与特定冲突图族的最大分数色数的联系；据此分析完美信息价值（冲突图为余图）与回忆价值（可归约为任意图的分数色数）两类细化。

Result: 完美信息价值：冲突图为余图，分数色数退化为团数，虽团数易解但对图族优化仍为NP完全；按不完美信息度参数化则固定参数可解。回忆价值：可实现任意图的分数色数，可取分数值，判定为S2P完全。

Conclusion: 回忆价值严格难于完美信息价值；回答了Berker等（AAAI'25）关于回忆价值的刻画与复杂度的开放问题。

Abstract: We examine the value of information in extensive-form decision problems: the largest multiplicative gain that a decision maker can obtain from an information refinement, taken over all payoff environments. This measures the structural importance of information disentangled from any particular payoff specification, and generalizes the notion of value of recall recently introduced by Berker et al. (AAAI'25). We establish a unifying characterization of the value of information under any information refinement, uncovering an intriguing connection to the maximum fractional chromatic number over a certain family of conflict graphs. We then employ our characterization to elucidate the complexity of two central information refinements.
  First, for the value of perfect information in perfect-recall decision problems, we find that the relevant conflict graphs are cographs, so the fractional chromatic number collapses to the clique number. Even though the clique number is tractable for a given cograph, we show that the additional layer of optimization (over the family of graphs) makes computing the value of perfect information NP-complete. On the positive side, we prove fixed-parameter tractability in terms of the degree of imperfect information. Second, for the value of recall in imperfect-recall decision problems (with no absentmindedness), we first show that the value of recall can realize the fractional chromatic number of any graph. Interestingly, this implies that, unlike the value of perfect information, the value of recall can take fractional values. Building on this reduction, we then establish S2P-completeness. This addresses questions left open by Berker et al. (AAAI'25)---both on the characterization and the complexity of the value of recall---and shows that computing the value of recall is strictly harder than the value of perfect information.

</details>


### [366] [PPAD-Completeness of Contiguous Envy-Free Cake Cutting with Additive Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19690)
*Yasushi Kawase,Bodhayan Roy,Mohammad Azharuddin Sanpui*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明连续蛋糕的完整ε-无嫉妒分配与精确无嫉妒分配均为PPAD完全，且不可分物品路径上EFc分配问题对加性估值也为PPAD完全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究公平分配（嫉妒自由）问题的计算复杂性，特别是连续蛋糕分配与不可分物品路径分配中的PPAD困难性，并探究在极弱估值限制下困难性是否仍成立。

Method: 归约技术：为蛋糕片段分配价格，使得在每个近似无嫉妒分配中所有价格几乎相等（无论片段如何分配给代理人）；并构造相应的约束实例以证明PPAD困难性。

Result: 对归一一有理分段常数加性估值，计算完整连续ε-无嫉妒蛋糕分配是PPAD完全的，即使ε用一元表示、密度仅取两值且所有代理人相同、至多六个断点亦然；精确连续无嫉妒分配同样PPAD完全。对每个固定整数c≥1，路径上不可分物品的连续EFc分配对加性估值是PPAD完全的，即使二值估值（每个物品恰被一个代理人估价）且各代理人估价物品数相同也成立。

Conclusion: 连续蛋糕的（近似/精确）无嫉妒分配及路径不可分物品EFc分配均具有PPAD完全复杂性，说明此类公平分配问题在很受限的估值条件下仍计算困难。

Abstract: We prove that computing a complete contiguous $\varepsilon$-envy-free cake allocation is PPAD-complete for normalized rational piecewise-constant additive valuations. The hardness holds even when $\varepsilon$ is given in unary, and even when every density takes only two values, which are the same for all agents, and is piecewise constant with at most six breakpoints. As a consequence, computing an exact contiguous envy-free allocation is also PPAD-complete, and the hardness holds under the same restrictions on the densities. Our key ingredient is to assign prices to the pieces so that, in every approximately envy-free allocation, all prices are nearly equal, regardless of how the pieces are assigned to the agents. We further show that, for every fixed integer $c\ge1$, computing a contiguous EF$c$ allocation of indivisible goods on a path is PPAD-complete for additive valuations, and the hardness holds even for binary valuations in which each good is valued by exactly one agent and all agents value the same number of goods.

</details>


### [367] [Effective-Balance Design in Ethereum Proof-of-Stake](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19699)
*Bolin Zhang,Xuechao Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将以太坊有效余额规则视为机制设计问题，在比例分配博弈中分析验证者质押行为，发现固定参与者时存在唯一纳什均衡，并通过模拟表明将储备价格从32 ETH降至30 ETH可增加活跃身份数与有效质押量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PoS经济安全依赖激励广泛且有意义的参与，而质押奖励机制设计至关重要。以太坊有效余额规则如何影响验证者行为、身份拆分与合并激励尚未被系统性地作为机制设计问题研究。

Method: 将协议参数（奖励系数、激活阈值、最大有效余额）建模为机制设计变量，验证者在诱导的比例分配博弈中响应。固定参与验证者与身份数量时求验证者层面总质押的唯一纳什均衡；允许身份拆分或合并时，在重新清算市场后评估各候选身份结构。利用Beacon Chain存取款、Lido质押流、Etherscan余额及校准合成代理构建地址级预算代理，进行示例性模拟。

Result: 在固定参与者与身份数量下存在唯一纳什均衡；身份重构激励取决于市场重置后的收益比较，需考虑所有验证者的质押反应。示例模拟中，采用示意性成本系数，将储备价格从32 ETH降至30 ETH使活跃身份数增加5.922%，总有效质押量增加0.098%。

Conclusion: 有效余额规则可通过机制设计视角分析，其参数调整会通过均衡反应影响验证者身份结构与总质押水平，需结合市场再清算效应评估激励后果。

Abstract: Proof-of-Stake (PoS) systems offer a scalable and energy-efficient alternative to Proof-of-Work (PoW). The economic security of PoS relies critically on incentivizing broad and meaningful participation through well-cali\-brated staking reward mechanisms. We study Ethe\-reum's effective-balance rules as a mechanism-design problem in which the protocol chooses a reward coefficient, an activation threshold, and a maximum effective balance, and validators respond in the induced propor\-tional-allocation game.
  For fixed participating validators and identity counts, we establish a unique Nash equilibrium in validator-level total stakes. When validators can split or merge their visible identities, each candidate identity structure must be evaluated after the market re-clears. Restructuring incentives therefore depend on post-reset payoff comparisons that account for all validators' stake responses. For an illustrative simulation, we construct address-level budget proxies from Beacon Chain deposits and withdrawals, Lido staking flows, Etherscan balances, and calibrated synthetic agents. With illustrative cost coefficients, lowering the reserve price from 32 ETH to 30 ETH increases active identities by 5.922\% and total effective stake by 0.098\%.

</details>


### [368] [No-Regret Learning in Stackelberg Security Games with an Unknown, Bounded Set of Attacker Types](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20066)
*Sabil Ahmad,Ishita,Aditi Singh,Swaprava Nath*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 在未知攻击者类型集合的重复Stackelberg安全博弈中，可学习性取决于防御者的观测能力：观测类型时可达近最优√T遗憾；仅观测目标时存在线性遗憾下界；加入周期性类型告知可恢复次线性遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无悔保证假设防御者预先知道攻击者类型集合，本文移除该假设，研究类型集合未知（大小至多K_max且不告知防御者）时能达到何种学习保证，并刻画观测能力对可学习性的影响。

Method: 按观测信息分三种情形分析：1) 观测每次攻击者类型，采用边出现边加入类型列表的算法；2) 仅观测被攻击目标且类型来自无限全集，构造三目标博弈论证下界；3) 额外每B轮被告知已出现类型，使用部分信息学习器并分析延迟的加性代价。

Result: 观测类型时遗憾为Õ(nK_max√T)，与已知类型同阶√T，仅多√K_max因子且无需使用K_max；仅观测目标时无次线性算法，在三目标博弈中每轮遗憾至少T−2（即使单一类型）；每B轮告知类型时遗憾为Õ(nK_max^{4/3}T^{2/3}+K_max B)，且延迟的加性代价不可避免。

Conclusion: 未知类型集合下的学习性由观测信息决定：类型可见时可近无损学习；类型不可见时可能完全无法学习；适度的周期性反馈能恢复次线性遗憾，但延迟代价不可消除。

Abstract: In a repeated Stackelberg security game, a defender commits in every round to a randomized allocation of its resources, and an attacker, drawn from a set of types, best-responds. Existing no-regret guarantees assume that the defender knows this set of types in advance. We drop this assumption: the set of types is unknown, and its size is at most $K_{\max}$, an upper bound that the defender is not told. We show that what can be learned then depends on what the defender observes. If it observes the type of each attacker, an algorithm that adds types to its list as they appear achieves regret $\tilde O(nK_{\max}\sqrt{T})$ over $T$ rounds with $n$ targets, the same $\sqrt T$ rate as with known types, at an extra factor of only $\sqrt{K_{\max}}$ and without ever using $K_{\max}$. If it observes only the attacked target and types come from an infinite universe, no algorithm has sublinear regret: in a fixed three-target game every algorithm suffers regret at least $T-2$, even against a single attacker type, because it cannot tell which type it faces. If, in addition, it is told every $B$ rounds which types have appeared so far, sublinear regret returns, at $\tilde O(nK_{\max}^{4/3}T^{2/3}+K_{\max} B)$. The first term is the rate of the partial-information learner we use, and we show that the additive cost of the delay cannot be avoided.

</details>


### [369] [What Does Disagreement Mean? A Semantic Identifiability Frontier for Pairwise Preference Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20450)
*Manoj Saravanan,Rohit Kumar Salla,Shrikar Reddy Kota*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究成对比较数据中的分歧能否被识别：在匿名二元反馈下只能点识别聚合偏好 μ_q，而持久分歧 τ_q 与非二元质量 α_q 存在不可识别纤维；重复标注可识别 τ_q，允许弃权可识别 α_q，二者结合可点识别全部语义三元组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对比较数据中，同一查询上的分歧可能来自稳定的潜在异质性、短暂的随机性，或被强制二选一界面掩盖的非二元回答。作者希望厘清这些语义区分有多少能从反馈通道本身中被识别出来。

Method: 提出一个非参数潜在语义模型，为每个查询引入三个量：聚合方向偏好 μ_q、持久分歧 τ_q、非二元质量 α_q。在匿名二元通道下证明精确语义纤维定理，并利用同标注者重复的协方差恒等式识别 τ_q、利用允许弃权的反馈直接识别 α_q。同时推导有限样本估计量、非渐近集中不等式与语义感知的动作恢复保证。

Result: 证明在匿名二元通道下 μ_q 是点识别的，而 (τ_q, α_q) 只能在一个与同一二元分布相容的显式可行区域内变动。重复标注识别 τ_q，弃权反馈识别 α_q，两者结合可点识别完整语义三元组；理论在定理匹配的合成数据上得到验证。

Conclusion: 偏好学习中的分歧语义具有明确的识别边界：普通强制二选一数据不足以区分持久异质性与非二元性，但通过重复标注和允许弃权的反馈设计，可以恢复完整语义结构，并为后续决策动作恢复提供理论保障。

Abstract: Pairwise comparison data are a standard supervision signal in preference learning, but disagreement in such data can reflect stable latent heterogeneity, ephemeral stochasticity, or non-binary responses hidden by a forced-choice interface. We study which of these semantic distinctions are identifiable from the feedback channel itself. We introduce a nonparametric latent semantic model with three querywise quantities: aggregate directional preference $μ_q$, persistent disagreement $τ_q$, and non-binary mass $α_q$. Under the anonymous binary channel, we prove an exact semantic fiber theorem: $μ_q$ is point-identified, whereas $(τ_q, α_q)$ vary over an explicit feasible region compatible with the same binary law. Same-annotator repeats identify $τ_q$ through a covariance identity, abstention-enabled feedback identifies $α_q$ directly, and together they point-identify the full semantic triple. We also derive finite-sample estimators, nonasymptotic concentration bounds, and semantics-aware action-recovery guarantees, and validate the theory on theorem-matched synthetic data.

</details>


### [370] [Price of Anarchy of First-Price Auctions in Agentic Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20587)
*Shubhendu Trivedi,Jacob Eisenstein,Alekh Agarwal,Ian Gemp,Michael Kaisers,Adam Fisch*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文分析agentic市场（AI agent竞价获取用户prompt）中第一价格拍卖(FPA)的福利损失，论证竞争下限和条件独立两个特征可将price-of-anarchy从一般情况的1-1/e显著改善至接近1-1/e²甚至趋近于零，并用EmbedLLM数据集上的策略性竞价模拟验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FPA简单透明、无需中心化了解私有能力与成本，但非真实性：竞价者可能低报，导致prompt未分配给估值最高者，产生福利损失(PoA)。作者希望说明agentic市场的特有结构能缓解这一问题。

Method: 理论建模FPA并引入两个特征：(1)competitive floor——多个竞价者对prompt的估值高于最优福利的某基线份额（如强模型被蒸馏为廉价替代品）；(2)near-independence——条件于prompt后估值近似独立（大部分可预测变动由prompt难度决定）。分别推导福利下界。

Result: 竞争下限可随下限升高将福利损失降至零；估值分布趋近条件独立时，效率保证趋近最优福利的1-1/e²倍。两者均显著优于一般情况的1-1/e界。EmbedLLM prompt routing数据集上的策略性竞价模拟验证了结果。

Conclusion: agentic市场的竞争下限与条件独立性赋予FPA远优于经典最坏情况的福利保证，说明真实、高效的去中心化prompt分配在这些条件下是可行的。

Abstract: An agentic market is a decentralized serving-time market where AI agents bid to claim each user prompt. An agent's bid is based on its expected value for the prompt, which is the expectation of the reward for its response minus its inference costs. First-price auctions (FPAs), in which the highest bidder pays its bid and receives the prompt, are a natural way to allocate prompts in such a market, since they are simple and transparent to run, and do not require central knowledge of private capabilities and costs. However, FPAs are not truthful: participants may bid less than their true value in the hope of a larger profit, and the prompt may then be allocated to someone other than the bidder who values it the most. This welfare loss is quantified by the $\textit{price-of-anarchy}$ (PoA). In this paper, we argue that agentic markets are likely to possess features that reduce the price-of-anarchy. The first is a $\textit{competitive floor}$, which occurs when multiple bidders usually value the prompt above some baseline share of the optimal welfare (e.g., because the best models are often distilled into cheaper alternatives, which perform similarly). We show that competition among them then limits the welfare loss, which can be driven to zero as the floor rises. The second feature is $\textit{near-independence}$ of values after conditioning on the prompt, which occurs when most of the predictable variation in the expected value is determined by the difficulty of the prompt. As the value distribution approaches conditional independence, we can derive an efficiency guarantee that approaches a factor of $1 - 1/e^2$ of the optimal welfare. Thus, both features give rise to welfare lower bounds that are significantly better than the well-known general case of $1 - 1/e$. We validate these results empirically using auctions with strategic bidders simulated on the EmbedLLM prompt routing dataset.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

### [371] [Lotus: Learning to Understand Time-series by Learning to Forecast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18877)
*Van Dai Do,Huu Hiep Nguyen,Minh Hoang Nguyen,Manh Nguyen,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"预测接地"（forecast grounding）预训练原则，并实现为LOTUS模型：将时间序列分块映射到LLM嵌入空间，并让LLM隐藏状态预测下一块，同时融合原始块与其频谱表示。在多个骨干和数据集上以极少参数取得最佳平均性能（59.91%准确率，超越最强基线3.36%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序语言模型仅通过标签、描述或问答对来对齐数值信号与语言，这种监督虽鼓励语言化表示，但并未显式要求表示保留时序信号的演化信息。作者希望语言对齐的时序表示在被适配到下游任务前，仍能预测未来演化。

Method: 提出forecast grounding预训练原则并实例化为LOTUS：将每个时序通道划分为不重叠的patch，映射进LLM嵌入空间；利用时序token的LLM隐藏状态预测下一个patch，从而保留时间信息；并提出时序-频谱patch表示，将原始patch与其频谱表示结合后再映射，以同时捕捉时序变化与周期模式。

Result: 在3个语言模型骨干和6个下游评估数据集上，LOTUS以最少的可训练参数取得最佳平均性能，达到59.91%准确率，超越最强匹配基线3.36%。表示分析显示LOTUS利用了数值输入并在学习到的patch表示中保留了时序结构。在TSRBench上，比其大25至50倍的模型也被其超越。

Conclusion: forecast grounding是一种有前景的预训练原则，可让紧凑的时序语言模型超越远大于自身的模型，表明显式保留未来演化信息对时序语言表示至关重要。

Abstract: Time-series language models typically align numerical signals with language using labels, captions, or question-answer pairs. Although such supervision encourages linguistic representations, it does not explicitly require them to preserve information about how the underlying time-series signal evolves. We introduce forecast grounding, a pretraining principle that requires language-aligned time-series representations to remain predictive of the future evolution before they are adapted to downstream tasks. We instantiate this principle in LOTUS, which divides each time-series channel into non-overlapping patches and maps them into the LLM embedding space. It then predicts the next patch from the LLM hidden states of the time-series tokens, encouraging the learned representation to retain temporal information. To capture both temporal changes and periodic patterns, we also propose a temporal-spectral patch representation that combines each raw time-series patch with its spectral representation before mapping it into the LLM embedding space. Across three language model backbones and six downstream evaluation datasets, LOTUS achieves the best average performance with minimal trainable parameters, reaching 59.91% accuracy and outperforming the strongest matched baseline by 3.36%. Our representation analyses further show that LOTUS uses the numerical input and preserves temporal structure in its learned patch representations. These results establish forecast grounding as a promising pretraining principle, enabling compact time-series language models to outperform models 25 to 50 times their size on TSRBench.

</details>


### [372] [Inverse Reasoning Models for Efficient Post-Training and Verification from Answer-Only Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18878)
*Eric O. Korman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于答案数据的自蒸馏方法，将CoT视为潜变量，训练一个可复用的逆推理LLM生成推理轨迹，在Qwen3-0.6B的Countdown和GSM8K上超越GRPO饱和后的表现，并可兼作验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事后训练推理LLM面临两难：监督微调需要CoT数据，数据效率低（许多场景只有prompt-answer对）；强化学习虽无需CoT但计算昂贵，每步需多次自回归采样且不保证非零梯度。作者希望探索两者的中间地带。

Method: 提出自蒸馏技术，仅用答案数据，把CoT当作潜变量。训练一个"逆推理LLM"，根据答案生成原始模型的推理轨迹。逆模型只训练一次，可在后续批次答案数据上复用，生成过程全部离线且提前完成，适合持续事后训练。流程为：GRPO训练饱和后，进行单轮离线蒸馏。

Result: 在Countdown和GSM8K上（Qwen3-0.6B）：GRPO饱和后单轮离线蒸馏使硬题pass@1约翻倍；Countdown上在每个mix ratio的所有hard-tail指标上均优于拒绝采样自蒸馏（GSM8K增益较小，因拒绝采样在模型从未自解的问题上无信号）。继续GRPO在fresh数据上于硬pass@1略占优，但在pass@8、pass@32落后蒸馏且每步需重生成rollout。逆模型还可作准确验证器：best-of-n选择使Countdown选择准确率从0.753（多数投票）提升至0.969。

Conclusion: 以答案数据+逆推理模型离线蒸馏是监督微调与强化学习之间的有效折中，适合持续事后训练，并附带验证器功能，显著提升困难任务与测试时选择表现。

Abstract: Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient since in many applications one only has prompt-answer tuples and lacks the groundtruth chain-of-thought (CoT) sequence. On the other hand, reinforcement learning (with verifiable rewards, for example) can operate without CoT data but it is much more compute-inefficient since it requires multiple autoregressive completions per optimization step, none of which are guaranteed to give a non-zero policy gradient. In this work we explore a middleground, a self-distillation technique that uses answer-only data, treating CoT as latent variables. This relies on training a partner ``inverse reasoning LLM" that generates the original's reasoning traces conditioned on the answer. The inverse model is trained once and reused across incoming batches of answer-only data, with all generation happening offline and up front, making the approach particularly suited to continual post-training. Using Qwen3-0.6B on the Countdown and GSM8K tasks, we show that after GRPO training has saturated, a single offline distillation round from the inverse model roughly doubles pass@1 on hard prompts and, on Countdown, outperforms rejection-sampling self-distillation on every hard-tail metric at every mix ratio (with smaller gains on GSM8K); rejection sampling by construction has no signal on problems the model never solves on its own. Continued GRPO on the fresh data retains an edge at hard pass@1 but trails distillation at pass@8 and pass@32 while regenerating rollouts at every step. As an added bonus we see that the inverse model has a second application as an accurate verifier of correctness. When used for best-of-$n$ selection at test time, it raises selection accuracy on Countdown from 0.753 (majority voting) to 0.969.

</details>


### [373] [Riding the Fixed-Point Curve: Image Classification in the Continuous Thought Machine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19220)
*Thomas Hannagan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析Continuous Thought Machine (CTM)在ImageNet图像分类中的内在机制，发现其思考轨迹由不断移动的吸引不动点刻画，且大部分过程与图像无关，暗示CTM对所有图像采用了统一策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTM在多个领域展现出未被解释的涌现思维过程，作者希望揭示其如何分类图像（尤其是ImageNet）。

Method: 将每个思考步视为强非正规映射，分析其吸引与平衡放大特性；利用Banach定理刻画局部唯一吸引不动点及其沿思考轨迹的移动；通过打乱跨图像的查询并预测下一个查询来检验注意力调度的通用性。

Result: 吸引性在初始化时已存在，训练显著增强非正规性；思考轨迹近似为不动点曲线且滞后一拍；轨迹运动大部分跨图像共享，表现为神经元上的行波；跨图像打乱查询仅损失7%准确率，图像无关增量预测下一查询的R²=0.98（留出集）。

Conclusion: 结果表明CTM对全部ImageNet图像采用了一种单一、通用的处理策略，注意力调度在很大程度上与具体图像无关。

Abstract: The Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) is a recurrent network that attends to inputs and makes predictions based on the synchronization between its neurons. On tasks spanning many domains, it displays emergent thought processes that have not been explained. We report a number of findings about how the CTM classifies images, focusing on ImageNet. Each thinking step is an attracting but strongly non-normal map exhibiting balanced amplification (Murphy and Miller, 2009); while attraction is already present at CTM initialization, training highly promotes non-normality. By Banach's theorem, the neural state has a locally unique attracting fixed point, which moves at every step, and the thought trajectory is the curve these fixed points trace, followed one tick behind. Most of that curve's motion is shared across images, and visible as a previously reported traveling wave of activity across neurons. The attention schedule along the thought is largely generic: shuffling queries across images at every tick costs only 7 percent of classification accuracy, while image-independent increments predict the next query with R^2 = 0.98 (held out). Our results suggest that the CTM has found a single strategy to process all ImageNet images.

</details>


### [374] [Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18879)
*Ziyuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对9种代表性类别增量学习方法在5种蛋白质编码器和2个酶功能数据集上进行受控基准测试，发现无方法能在不同编码器间可靠迁移，问题源于弱梯度稳定性信号、嵌入几何异质性和协方差假设不匹配。作者主张应将表征视为持续学习设计的核心组件，并需发展编码器感知的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质功能注释的标签空间不断扩展，类别增量学习（CIL）自然适合在无需全量重训练的情况下纳入新发现的功能。然而现有CIL方法主要在视觉领域发展，尚未在冻结的蛋白质表征上被系统评估。

Method: 对9种代表性CIL方法进行受控基准测试，覆盖5种序列、结构及序列-结构蛋白质编码器和两个不同规模的酶功能数据集；保持编码器冻结，并在不同表征间使用一致的评估设置。同时进行诊断分析，考察梯度稳定性信号、嵌入几何和协方差假设的影响。

Result: 没有方法能在不同编码器间可靠迁移，且这些失败在不同阶段构造下依然存在。诊断分析表明不稳定性源于弱梯度稳定性信号、嵌入几何的显著异质性，以及协方差假设的合适容量随数据集规模和编码器而变化。

Conclusion: 表征本身应被视为持续学习设计的核心组件，而非被动的特征提取器。可靠的蛋白质CIL需要编码器感知的方法，能够根据所操作表征的几何自适应调整统计假设和容量。

Abstract: Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining. Yet existing CIL methods have been developed largely in vision and have not been systematically evaluated over frozen protein representations. We conduct a controlled benchmark of nine representative CIL methods across five sequence-, structure-, and sequence--structure-based protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets at different scales, while keeping the encoders frozen and evaluation settings consistent across representations. We find that no method transfers reliably across encoders, and that these failures persist across alternative phase constructions. Diagnostic analyses reveal that this instability arises from weak gradient-based stability signals, substantial heterogeneity in embedding geometry, and covariance assumptions whose appropriate capacity changes with both dataset scale and encoder. These findings suggest that the representation itself should be treated as a central component of continual-learning design rather than a passive feature extractor. More generally, reliable protein CIL will require encoder-aware methods that adapt their statistical assumptions and capacity to the geometry of the representation on which they operate. Code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/ProteinCIL.

</details>


### [375] [Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18880)
*Ziyuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究未见基因组合的扰动效应预测问题，提出"加性分歧"(AD)指标，即将模型预测与单基因效应相加的简单加性基线之差作为置信度信号，发现AD在跨数据集和模型中均能有效指示预测误差，并可指导智能体筛选流程决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高通量扰动筛选常用机器学习预测未见基因组合的效应，但当测试对中两个基因单独都见过、组合未见时，标准OOD方法往往失效，因为单独看两个基因都不陌生，缺乏有效的置信度信号。

Method: 将每个模型预测与由两个已观测单基因效应相加得到的简单加性预测进行比较，其差值定义为加性分歧(AD)，用以衡量模型为未见组合引入的额外交互效应。在八种预测方法和三个Perturb-seq数据集上评估AD作为置信度信号的表现，并研究其在智能体扰动筛选流程中的决策指导作用。

Result: 专门神经预测器未能稳定超越简单加性基线；预测偏离加性基线越大，误差越大；传统基于输出和嵌入的置信度信号跨数据集和模型不一致，而AD在所有评估的组合场景中均保持信息量。代码已开源。

Conclusion: AD是一种在组合泛化场景下稳定有效的置信度信号，可指导智能体扰动筛选工作流的决策，但专用神经预测器相对简单加性基线无明显优势。

Abstract: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/OOD.

</details>


### [376] [Token Utility for On-Policy Distillation via Local Trust-Region Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18883)
*Narayanan Sadagopan,Yilan Chen,Vijay Lingam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出从蒸馏目标本身推导token重要性，得到效用 s_t=g_t^⊤F_t^†g_t，并实例化为FUW加权方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏的token选择方法依赖不确定性、师生分歧等启发式信号，缺乏从蒸馏目标直接推导的重要性度量。

Method: 从蒸馏目标的局部KL预算下的loss下降量推导token效用 s_t=g_t^⊤F_t^†g_t，其中g_t为logit梯度、F_t为类别Fisher矩阵；反向KL下等于学生加权方差，前向KL下等于Pearson χ²散度。实例化为Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW)，一种连续、均值归一化的token加权。

Result: 在7个数学推理基准和3对Qwen3师生模型上，FUW在反向KL下提升1.35-4.0 macro points，前向KL下提升1.08-2.71 macro points，且与现有选择方法竞争力相当。

Conclusion: FUW用单一闭式分数从训练目标推导重要性，能有效改进OPD，且与多个启发式标准在宽选择比例下高度一致。

Abstract: Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher-student disagreement, and mismatch direction. We instead derive token importance from the distillation objective itself: how much can each position's loss decrease under an equal local KL budget on the student's predictive distribution? The answer is the utility $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$, where $g_t$ is the logit gradient and $F_t$ is the categorical Fisher matrix. For reverse-KL it equals the student-weighted variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio, and for forward-KL it equals the Pearson $χ^2$ divergence, so the appropriate utility follows from the choice of objective. On shared training checkpoints, several independently motivated criteria, including student entropy, KL disagreement, and TIP, concentrate their importance on nearly the same positions as the derived utility at a 50\% selection fraction, while diverging at stricter fractions and for direction-specific criteria. We instantiate the utility as Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW), a continuous, mean-normalized token weighting. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 student-teacher pairs, FUW improves over matched uniform OPD under both reverse-KL (1.35-4.0 macro points) and forward-KL (1.08-2.71 macro points), and is competitive with existing selective methods using a single closed-form score derived from the training objective.

</details>


### [377] [PMO-Dock: Benchmarking Docking, Specificity, and Generalization in Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19011)
*Gor Simonyan,Tatevik Abrahamyan,Narek Abelyan,Tigran Fahradyan,Hrant Khachatrian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PMO-Dock基准与协议，用于基于对接的分子优化，包含25个任务（hit生成、lead优化及新的特异性任务），并采用严格oracle预算评估。四个方法的测试表明无普适最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PMO基准基于简单性质oracle，无法反映基于结构的药物设计；领域转向对接目标后评估不统一，方法间缺乏公平比较协议和样本效率约束。

Method: 构建PMO-Dock基准与协议，含25个任务（hit生成、lead优化、特异性任务：需强靶向结合并惩罚脱靶）。协议分离模型开发与最终评估：验证任务用于调参，测试任务留作最终评估且开发期间不可用；测试在严格oracle预算下进行。基准测试四种范式方法：Saturn（强化学习）、GenMol（离散扩散）、Genetic-guided GFlowNet、ChemLlama（基于LLM的进化搜索）。

Result: 无跨任务普遍最优方法；超参数迁移（跨任务与跨类别）分析显示迁移往往有限且因方法而异。

Conclusion: 该基准为评估对未见任务的泛化能力及有限测试时oracle预算下的样本效率提供了具体标准，并强调需要方法依赖的选择策略。

Abstract: The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design. As the field has moved to docking-based objectives, evaluation practice has become unstandardized, and different methods report results on different docking tasks, often without a shared protocol for fair comparison or sample-efficiency constraints. To address this, we introduce Practical Molecular Optimization for Docking (PMO-Dock), a benchmark and protocol for docking-based optimization consisting of 25 tasks covering hit generation, lead optimization, and a new specificity task requiring strong on-target binding while penalizing off-target interactions. The protocol separates model development from final evaluation: validation tasks are used for hyperparameter tuning, and test tasks are held out for final evaluation and are not used during development. Evaluation on the test tasks is done under a strict oracle budget to reflect realistic drug-discovery settings. We benchmark four diverse high-performing methods spanning different optimization paradigms, Saturn (reinforcement learning), GenMol (discrete diffusion), Genetic-guided GFlowNet, and ChemLlama (LLM-based evolutionary search). Our results show no universally best method across tasks, additional analyses of hyperparameter transfer (cross-task and cross-category) and sensitivity show that transfer is often limited and varies by method, motivating method-dependent selection strategies. This benchmark provides a concrete standard for evaluating generalization to unseen tasks and sample efficiency under a limited test-time oracle budget.

</details>
