For smooth stochastic nonconvex optimization, we establish a scalar-oracle lower bound of $Ω\!\left(dL_0^2\min\{ΔH,L_0^2\}/ε^4\right)$ assuming a smooth, globally lower-bounded population objective and a second-moment bound on sample Lipschitz constants. A smooth reduction then yields a lower bound for Goldstein stationarity, proving the joint minimax optimality of the dependence on $(d,δ,ε)$ under explicit high-dimensional and small-accuracy conditions. Crucially, our results allow algorithms to query arbitrary points in $\mathbb{R}^d$, adaptively select sample-function labels, reuse the same sampled function at any number of locations, and output points without spatial restrictions. Thus, unlike lower bounds based on bounded query regions or fresh evaluation noise, our guarantees apply to a fully adaptive, reusable-sample scalar oracle. We also establish a separate noiseless exact-value lower bound against randomized algorithms, and hence also against deterministic methods. Our proof combines a globally defined sequential nonconvex construction with an exact Gaussian scalar channel, multistage random-field estimates, and an antithetic finite-sample realization that preserves information hardness under adaptive reuse.

</details>


### [452] [Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19683)
*Yuwei Sun,Siyu Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种记忆增强的潜在世界模型，用内容可寻址记忆库增强JEPA式预测，通过两个损失防止表征坍塌，在多个基准上以轻量架构实现长时程规划的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在动力学世界模型存在表征坍塌、计算开销大、长时程规划能力受限的问题。

Method: 在JEPA式预测中引入内容可寻址记忆库；直接从观测学习高层表征，在共享潜在空间的多时间尺度上运行，并通过自适应层归一化进行条件预测；设计两个互补损失以保证槽位多样性和时间利用平衡，防止坍塌。

Result: 在PushT、Tworoom、Reacher、OGBCube上，以轻量架构取得SOTA性能，长时程规划任务上优于传统潜在世界模型。

Conclusion: 记忆增强与多尺度潜在建模能有效提升世界模型的长时程规划能力，兼具效率与性能。

Abstract: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

</details>


### [453] [Beyond Distribution Matching: Selective Margin Preservation for Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19685)
*Yuxuan Wang,Guangxiang Zhao,Xinyu Tan,Yahui Han,Xinxiang Yin,Zhonghai Wu,Xiangzheng Zhang,Lin Sun,Tong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SRP-SFT，一种软边界目标，通过 hinge 约束参考 top-K 非目标 token 对的排序关系，提升下游性能且无需冻结分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SFT 会改变非目标 token 的 logit margin。匹配局部参考分布虽能保留概率并惩罚 margin 扩张，但过于严格；本文希望用软辅助目标保留选定的局部非目标 margin 关系而不冻结分布。

Method: SRP-SFT：在固定 teacher-forced 前缀上，对参考 top-K 非目标 token 对的参考缩放下界施加 hinge（边界满足即停止）；理论上推导违反 margin 的 KL 代价、可行域及条件效用，并给出减少总体违反的有限步条件。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base 与 UltraFeedback 单 epoch 实验中，三个种子下均优于 CE 和 LP-SFT。seed 1234 时 MATH-500 pass@1 从 49.56% 升至 54.56%，代码四项指标均值从 65.91% 升至 69.50%。

Conclusion: SRP-SFT 能选择性保留非目标 margin 排序关系并提升数学与代码生成性能；排序对照、缓存诊断、敏感性扫描及六个额外骨干验证了结果的出现范围。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes logit margins among non-target tokens at teacher-forced prefixes. Matching a local reference distribution keeps those probabilities and also penalizes margin expansions. We ask whether a soft auxiliary can preserve selected local non-target margin relations without freezing that distribution. We introduce \textbf{Selective Rank-Preserving SFT (SRP-SFT)}, a soft margin target: a hinge on reference-scaled lower bounds for pairs from the reference's top-$K$ non-target tokens, applied at fixed teacher-forced prefixes. The hinge stops once the requested bound is met. We derive the KL cost of violating a margin, characterize the feasible region and its conditional utility, and give a finite-step condition for reducing aggregate violations. In one-epoch experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and UltraFeedback, this target raises MATH-500 and code-generation scores over CE and LP-SFT at all three training seeds. At seed 1234, MATH-500 pass@1 rises from 49.56\% to 54.56\% and the four-metric code mean rises from 65.91\% to 69.50\% relative to LP-SFT. Ranking controls, held-out cache diagnostics, sensitivity sweeps, and six additional backbones show where these score changes appear.

</details>


### [454] [Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19687)
*Aryan Das,Arnab Bhattacharya,Vinay Kumar Verma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FSPO，一种单策略框架，结合当前特权自适应与函数空间时间整合，在无需持续教师模型的情况下提供密集 token 级监督，提升语言模型推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 的标量结果监督过于粗糙；自蒸馏虽提供密集 token 级指导，但教师随学生演化导致目标不稳定、需额外正则化。

Method: FSPO 存储稀疏历史 next-token 分布作为固定时间目标，实现时间分离；引入特权分歧校正抑制局部高估动作、可靠性自适应基础在自生成证据失效时加强参考监督、质量与覆盖感知时间记忆保留已验证行为并改进特权示范。

Result: 在推理与工具使用基准上，5 小时训练预算内 FSPO 取得最高平均准确率，较最强基线平均提升约 4 个百分点，并将 Olmo3-7B-Instruct 的峰值内存从约 70GB 降至 56GB。

Conclusion: FSPO 以单策略框架实现稳定密集监督，兼顾性能与内存效率，优于现有基线。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. Across reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, FSPO achieves the highest average accuracy under a 5-hour training budget, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 4% points on average while reducing peak memory from about 70 GB to 56 GB on Olmo3-7B-Instruct.

</details>


### [455] [Annealed Lévy Diffusion via Gaussian Surrogate Reverse Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19692)
*Yuling Jiao,Lican Kang,Jerry Zhijian Yang,Cheng Yuan,Ruizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出退火Lévy扩散(ALD)，通过随时间变化稳定指数α(t)，将重尾探索与高斯精炼结合，兼容标准高斯噪声预测训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DLPM采用固定尾指数重尾扰动，缺乏从重尾探索到高斯精炼的过渡灵活性。

Method: 边缘优先表述将稳定噪声表示为标量高斯尺度混合，支持标准高斯噪声预测加一个尺度输入；提出ALD-renoise与ALD-posterior两种采样器，复用同一预测器。

Result: 在四个二维基准、九模式不平衡混合、MNIST、CelebA64、CIFAR-10LT增强及截断Holtsmark数据上评估，ALD在轻尾与流形结构目标上保持局部几何，并考察了训练效率与预测扰动影响。

Conclusion: ALD有效融合重尾探索与高斯精炼，能保持局部几何结构，具良好通用性与训练效率。

Abstract: Gaussian diffusion models offer a practical framework for generative modeling. Denoising Lévy Probabilistic Models (DLPM) introduce heavy-tailed perturbations with a fixed tail index throughout denoising. We introduce Annealed Lévy Diffusion (ALD). ALD varies the stability index $α(t)$ to combine heavy-tailed exploration with Gaussian refinement. Our marginal-first formulation represents stable noise as a scalar Gaussian scale mixture. This formulation enables standard Gaussian noise-prediction training with one additional scale input. We study two sampling processes. ALD-renoise estimates the clean sample and injects fresh marginal noise. ALD-posterior preserves dependence between successive states through an accumulated conditional variance and a Gaussian bridge update. Both samplers reuse the same trained predictor with different scalar inputs. We evaluate ALD on four 2D benchmarks and an imbalanced nine-mode mixture. We also examine training efficiency and the effects of prediction perturbations on clipped Holtsmark data. Additional experiments evaluate MNIST and CelebA64 generation and CIFAR-10LT augmentation. ALD preserves local geometry on the evaluated light-tailed and manifold-structured targets.

</details>


### [456] [ReGRA: Residual-Gradient Adaptation for Complementary Low-Rank Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19700)
*Fanyao Li,Yuxi Liu,Xiaohao Liu,He Chang,Zhaoxin Wang,Zhulin Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReGRA两阶段方法：先训练LoRA，再在去除首阶段子空间投影后的残差梯度方向上初始化第二适配器，配合正交正则，使固定秩预算利用更充分，性能超过同秩方法，甚至媲美两倍秩LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA秩增大并不保证所有学习方向都提升下游性能；秩16实验中仅保留top奇异成分性能最好，增加成分反而下降，说明固定秩预算利用不充分。

Method: 两阶段：第一阶段训练LoRA；在校准集上估计任务梯度，去掉其在首阶段更新诱导的双边子空间上的投影；聚合残差梯度方向初始化第二阶段适配器，不改变首阶段更新；并加正交正则鼓励两更新捕获互补方向。两个更新可合并进预训练权重，无额外推理开销。

Result: 在多样基准集上，相同总秩下ReGRA优于替代方法，甚至匹配两倍秩的LoRA适配器；消融与分析支持核心设计选择的贡献。

Conclusion: ReGRA通过残差梯度方向利用固定秩预算，实现更高效微调，兼顾性能与零额外推理开销。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning by learning low-rank weight updates. Increasing rank expands adaptation capacity, but does not guarantee that all learned directions improve downstream performance. In a diagnostic experiment with rank-16 LoRA, we show that retaining only the top singular components achieves the best performance, whereas adding further components degrades it. Motivated by this, we propose Residual-Gradient Adaptation (ReGRA), a two-stage method for making more effective use of a fixed rank budget. After the first stage, ReGRA estimates task gradients on a calibration set and removes their projections onto the two-sided subspace induced by the first-stage update. It then aggregates the residual-gradient directions to initialize a second-stage adapter without changing the first-stage update. An orthogonality regularizer encourages the two updates to capture complementary directions. Both updates can be merged into the pretrained weights, incurring no additional inference overhead. Across diverse benchmark sets, ReGRA achieves stronger performance than alternatives with the same total rank and even matches LoRA adapters with twice the rank. Ablation studies and further analysis support the contribution of its core design choices. Code is available at https://github.com/Fanyao-Li/ReGRA.

</details>


### [457] [New Model, Old Habits: Behavior Transfer under Model Swapping in Multi-Session LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19712)
*Youngbin Choi,Sehyun Hwang,Suhyeon Jun,Seoyeon Lee,Sunghyun Choi,MoonJeong Park,Dongwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 多会话智能体可在LLM间切换以平衡性能与成本，本文发现"行为迁移"现象，并提出DASH摘要方法缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多会话智能体切换LLM时需传递历史以保持连续性，但历史对接收模型行为的影响尚未被充分研究。

Method: 通过多会话任务的控制实验揭示行为迁移现象；提出方向与作者感知的历史摘要方法DASH，保留强模型行为、减少弱到强的迁移。

Result: 行为迁移在原始历史传递时最明显，摘要可大幅减弱；重复交换实验中，DASH优于原始历史传递与朴素摘要基线。

Conclusion: 有效的多模型编排不仅要考虑用哪个模型，还要考虑传递哪些行为模式。

Abstract: Multi-session agents can switch between LLMs to balance performance and inference cost. Such switches require transferring a history for continuity, yet their effects on the recipient remain underexplored. Through controlled experiments with multi-session tasks, we uncover behavior transfer: recipients tend to adopt reasoning and action patterns from the models that generated their histories. This effect is most evident with raw-history transfer but is substantially reduced by summarization. Based on these findings, we propose Direction- and Authorship-aware Summarization of History (DASH) that preserves stronger-model behavior while minimizing weak-to-strong transfer via summarization. Experiments with repeated swaps show that DASH outperforms raw-history transfer and naive summarization baselines. These results suggest that effective multi-model orchestration requires considering not only which model to use, but also which behavioral patterns to carry forward.

</details>


### [458] [TIMERSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19725)
*Haoxin Liu,Deqing Fu,Lucheng Fu,Yiqiao Jin,Rushi Qiang,Harshavardhan Kamarthi,B. Aditya Prakash*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIMERSI 是一个围绕冻结时序基础模型的自改进智能体部署系统，通过编码智能体将任务描述转为可执行流水线并迭代优化，在 198 个任务上超越所有提交。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序基础模型零样本预测能力强，但实际部署仍需针对任务设计输入输出；直接推理无法利用领域知识、无法解决重复性预测误差，而定制流水线又需大量专家人力。

Method: 用一个编码智能体把任务描述转化为可执行的流水线修改，在历史预测窗口上测试每次修订，并利用观测误差指导后续修订；部署阶段用自适应选择器在相似条件下根据已完成预测挑选合适流水线。

Result: 在 TIME 和 FEV-bench 的 198 个任务上，TIMERSI 在六项点预测与概率预测指标上超过所有提交；对照实验支持反馈引导修订优于非迭代流水线搜索；进一步实验验证了对不同编码智能体和预测模型的泛化性。

Conclusion: 反馈引导的自改进智能体部署范式可有效弥补冻结时序基础模型在实际部署中的不足，并具备跨智能体与模型的泛化能力。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real- world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and re- curring forecast errors unaddressed, while tai- lored pipelines require substantial human ex- pertise and effort. We introduce TIMERSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A cod- ing agent translates task descriptions into ex- ecutable pipeline changes. It tests each re- vision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent re- visions. During deployment, an adaptive se- lector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar con- ditions. Across 198 tasks on TIME and FEV- bench, TIMERSI outperforms all submissions on six point and probabilistic forecasting met- rics. Controlled comparisons support the value of feedback-guided revision over non-iterative pipeline search. Further experiments verify the generalization with different coding agents and forecasting models.

</details>


### [459] [What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19731)
*Julia Barth,Armin Sommer,Kunvar Thaman,Jannik Schilling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究智能体"目标误泛化"现象，在Procgen环境和机器人任务中识别出三种策略-目标错位形式：功能性目标替换、策略捷径、线索竞争，并揭示目标在决策路径不同深度丢失对应不同的修复方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标误泛化（goal misgeneralization）中智能体行为看似合理却不追求预期目标，但学界对误泛化智能体中"预期目标到底发生了什么"理解薄弱，需要一个关于目标在内部如何丢失的系统性刻画。

Method: 在三个Procgen环境和五个机器人任务上进行实验，追踪目标信息在内部何处仍然可用、对策略影响多强、在动作选择中扮演何角色，据此区分三种错位机制。并用两种干预（steering引导、下游重连）测试不同深度的可恢复性。

Result: 功能性目标替换、策略捷径、线索竞争三种机制对应目标在不同深度丢失。线索竞争（目标到达决策层）中，引导可将目标达成率从16.0%提至95.3%；动作捷径（目标到达策略层但未到决策层）中，只有下游重连有效，从31.6%提至84.3%；目标完全惰性时两者均无效。

Conclusion: 目标误泛化并非单一的目标表征失败，而是发生在不同深度上的多种策略对齐失败，且失败深度与何种修复方法有效紧密相关。

Abstract: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.

</details>


### [460] [ProtModernBERT: Compute-Efficient Protein Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19738)
*Alberto Martínez,Natalia Flechas Manrique,Llorenç Espinosa-Portalés,Luc Andrea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ProtModernBERT，采用现代化BERT架构预训练的蛋白质语言模型，在低算力条件下以更少预训练FLOPs匹配或接近现有模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型蛋白质语言模型在序列-功能学习和实验设计中很重要，但架构改进在资源受限实验室的低算力场景下研究不足。

Method: 构建仅编码器Transformer的现代化BERT风格模型ProtModernBERT，在氨基酸序列上预训练，与ProtBert、Amplify、ESM2对比；覆盖二级结构预测、无序预测、亚细胞定位等监督结构任务及ProteinGym零样本功能基准。采用基于聚类的验证协议选择超参数，并用随机初始化模型分离架构与数据的贡献。

Result: ProtModernBERT以减少80-90%预训练FLOPs的成本匹配或接近Amplify-120M和ProtBert，并在控制预训练条件下缩小与ESM2的差距；现代架构组件提供更强的归纳偏置，在低算力场景中比参数量更关键。

Conclusion: 现代架构改进可在低算力下带来性能/计算效率的有利权衡，架构归纳偏置在资源受限的蛋白质语言模型设计中比参数规模更重要。

Abstract: Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design. However, architectural improvements are underexplored, especially in low-compute regimes of relevance for resource-constrained research laboratories. We show that the training cost for encoder-only transformer architectures can be reduced by leveraging modern architectural refinements, offering an encouraging performance / compute-efficiency trade-off. We introduce ProtModernBERT, a modernized BERT-style model pre-trained on amino acid sequences, and compare it with ProtBert, Amplify, and ESM2 across a set of supervised structural tasks -encompassing secondary structure prediction, disorder prediction, and subcellular localization- and ProteinGym's zero-shot functional benchmark. We find that ProtModernBERT matches or closely tracks the performance of Amplify-120M and ProtBert with up to 80-90\% reduction in pre-training FLOPs, and narrows the gap to ESM2 when controlling for pre-training. Our analysis using a cluster-based validation protocol for hyperparameter selection and randomly initialized models disentangles the contributions of architecture and data, showing that modern components provide stronger inductive biases that are more consequential than parameter count in low-compute regimes.

</details>


### [461] [CAST: History-Adaptive Spectral Clipping for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19761)
*Jiacheng Li,Jianchao Tan,Kefeng Zhang,Yuchen Xie,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CAST（自适应尺度与阈值的梯度裁剪方法），作为软谱裁剪(SSC)的历史自适应扩展，用于稳定大规模MoE模型训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSC能降低梯度奇异值，但其效果依赖梯度尺度和裁剪阈值，缺乏自适应性。

Method: CAST利用AdamW的前一阶二阶矩设定行、列尺度；用裁剪输出估计谱范数的指数移动平均设定每个矩阵的阈值；在AdamW更新前恢复原始坐标。

Result: 训练19.08B参数MoE模型、83.89B tokens，CAST在训练和平均验证损失上优于九个梯度处理基线，梯度突刺最少，比最佳基线少用7.2%步数达到相同最终平滑训练损失。

Conclusion: CAST通过历史自适应尺度与阈值有效提升大规模模型训练的稳定性与效率。

Abstract: Soft spectral clipping (SSC) reduces gradient singular values, but its effect depends on the gradient scale and clipping threshold. We introduce CAST (Clipping with Adaptive Scales and Thresholds), a history-adaptive extension of SSC. AdamW's previous second moment sets row and column scales. An exponential moving average of the clipped output's estimated spectral norm sets each matrix's threshold. CAST restores the original coordinates before the AdamW update. We train a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 19.08B total parameters for 83.89B tokens. CAST achieves lower training and mean validation losses than nine gradient-processing baselines, with the fewest relative gradient spikes. It reaches the best baseline's final smoothed training loss in 7.2\% fewer steps.

</details>


### [462] [Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19768)
*Peilong Zhou,Hongtao Zhang,Yulong Huang,Cangyuan Li,Mingyu Chen,Ying Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环Transformer存在"过度思考"问题：超过训练深度后正确率骤降。作者在Mealy机上下文执行任务中剖析：计算本身是精确的，但保留(retention)与复用(reuse)是不同能力，且它们取决于训练方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer可重复运行同一块，因而能超过训练时的循环数推理，但会"过度思考"——超出训练深度后会把正确答案变错。作者想厘清这种晚期错误究竟源于计算失败、记忆丧失，还是状态无法被后续计算复用。

Method: 在Mealy机上下文执行任务中，用模拟器提供中间目标与对隐状态干预的精确反事实。模型训练到在循环32处作答，并测试到循环64。改变训练监督方式（随机位置 vs 始终最后位置、随机化训练循环数、截断梯度），并通过隐状态交换与固定实验分离计算、保留与复用。

Result: 循环32处全对，但循环64仅保留22%答案。若每样本随机监督一个位置，保留率升至99.8%；随机化训练循环数也有帮助；截断梯度（渐进训练）无效。计算是精确的：位置k在循环k算出，交换循环k隐向量可使后续位置精确转向另一输入的延续（十个模型各237/237对）。但保留≠复用：即使几乎保留全部答案的模型，从循环k起固定位置k会使准确率降到4–6%，而从循环k+4起固定则无害；已发布的回避过度思考的循环迷宫网络表现相同。

Conclusion: 学会计算不等于学会保留，且回避过度思考并不能使状态在其答案首次出现时可复用。保留能力取决于训练目标的设计。

Abstract: Looped transformers compute by applying one block repeatedly, so they can run for more loops than they were trained with. Recurrent reasoners are known to overthink: iterating past the trained depth can turn a correct answer into a wrong one. Such a late error can reflect failed computation, loss of retention, or a state that later computation cannot reuse. We separate these cases in in-context Mealy-machine execution, where a simulator supplies intermediate targets and exact counterfactuals for hidden-state interventions. Models trained to answer at loop 32 are fully correct there but keep only 22% of these answers at loop 64. Retention depends on what training asks for: supervising one randomly chosen position per example, instead of always the last, keeps 99.8%, and randomizing the number of training loops also helps; truncating gradients, as in progressive training against overthinking, does not. The computation itself is exact: position $k$ is computed at loop $k$, and swapping its loop-$k$ hidden vector for the one from another input redirects every later position to that input's exact continuation (237/237 pairs in each of ten models). Retention, however, is not reuse. Even in models that keep nearly all answers, holding each position $k$ fixed from loop $k$ drops accuracy to 4--6%, whereas holding it from loop $k+4$ is harmless. A released recurrent maze network trained to avoid overthinking behaves the same way. Learning to compute is thus not learning to retain, and avoiding overthinking does not make a state reusable when its answer first appears.

</details>


### [463] [From Global to Tail Convergence: Dynamics of $α$-Stable Score-Based Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19773)
*Ianis Hammani,Claire Boyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对保尺度 $\alpha$-稳定 L{é}vy 生成动力学做非渐近收敛分析，量化早停、初始化、分数近似与时间离散化误差，并揭示尾指数匹配（$\alpha=\nu$）是稳定生成模型刻画极端事件的关键机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 $\alpha$-稳定 L{é}vy 过程的分数生成模型被提出作为布朗扩散的替代方案，实验上采样更好、重尾建模更强，但理论保证不足。

Method: 针对保尺度 $\alpha$-稳定生成动力学开展非渐近收敛分析，覆盖紧支撑与幂律目标；在 $p$-Wasserstein 距离下量化早停、初始化、分数近似与时间离散化影响，并与布朗动力学对比。

Result: 初始化误差随前向时间指数衰减；仅从全局 Wasserstein 收敛看两种模型在重尾目标上无本质区别。差异体现在尾部：任意正生成时刻稳定动力学产生指数 $\alpha$ 的幂律尾，而布朗动力学保持轻尾；目标尾指数为 $\nu$ 时，极端分位数正确缩放当且仅当 $\alpha=\nu$。

Conclusion: 尾指数匹配是稳定生成模型捕获极端事件的原则性机制，为模型选择提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Score-based generative models driven by $α$-stable L{é}vy processes have been proposed as an alternative to Brownian diffusion models, with empirical evidence suggesting improved sampling and better modeling of heavy-tailed data. Yet theoretical guarantees for these models remain limited. We develop a non-asymptotic convergence analysis for scale-preserving $α$-stable generative dynamics, covering both compactly supported and power-law targets. In p-Wasserstein distance, we quantify the effects of early stopping, initialization, score approximation, and time discretization, and show exponential decay of the initialization error. A comparison with Brownian dynamics reveals that global Wasserstein convergence alone does not fundamentally distinguish the two models: both initialization errors decay exponentially with the forward horizon on the common class of heavy-tailed targets. A sharp separation emerges instead in the tails. At any positive generation time, stable dynamics produces power-law tails with index $α$, whereas Brownian dynamics remains light-tailed. For a target with tail index $ν$, asymptotically correct extreme-quantile scaling is possible precisely when $α$=$ν$. These results identify tail-index matching as a principled mechanism behind the ability of stable generative models to capture extreme events.

</details>


### [464] [Learning Who Benefits Most: Multi-Treatment Causal Ranking for Population Health Stratification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19782)
*Rocco Zaccagnino,Martina Girolamo,Alberto Lombardi,Delfina Malandrino,Donatello Telesca,Alessia Ture*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PROMETHEUS将人口健康分层重构为多治疗因果排序问题，用双重稳健因果信号加孪生神经排序模型，按预期增量收益对患者-治疗机会排序，在合成与半合成实验中验证了排序与分配价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分层框架（如意大利DM77）按临床需求和照护路径分组，但在资源受限下无法指导"应优先改变哪些照护"。

Method: 将每个临床可允许的照护强化与维持现有路径对比；在共享参照病症、结局、随访期和收益尺度的域内联合学习治疗，结合双重稳健因果信号、孪生神经排序模型及对比表征预训练，生成跨患者与照护画像的全局可比排序。

Result: 在合成实验与使用ASL Benevento真实行政协变量的半合成实验中评估排序质量、分配价值、鲁棒性与失效模式，结果表明可恢复生成的收益排序并在评估场景下优先排序照护机会。

Conclusion: PROMETHEUS提供了可操作分层的临床前方法；在临床使用前仍需用真实观察性治疗-结局数据进行验证。

Abstract: Population health stratification frameworks, such as the Italian DM77, organize patients by clinical need and care pathways but offer limited guidance on which care changes to prioritize under constrained resources.
  We present PROMETHEUS (Proactive Resource Optimization through Multi-treatment Effect-based Targeting in Healthcare Environments Using Stratification), a framework that formulates population health stratification as a multi-treatment causal ranking problem. Its objective is to order eligible patient-treatment opportunities by expected incremental benefit rather than obtain perfectly calibrated individual treatment-effect estimates.
  Each clinically admissible care intensification is compared with maintaining the patient's current pathway. Treatments are learned jointly to produce a globally comparable ranking across patients and care profiles, within domains sharing a reference condition, outcome, follow-up horizon, and benefit scale. This separates clinical need, treatment benefit, and resource-constrained allocation.
  PROMETHEUS combines doubly robust causal signals with a Siamese neural ranking model and contrastive representation pretraining. The shared representation captures similarities across care transitions, supporting prioritization under capacity constraints.
  Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments using real administrative covariates from ASL Benevento evaluate ranking quality, allocation value, robustness, and failure modes. The results support the framework's ability to recover generated benefit orderings and prioritize care opportunities in the evaluated settings. PROMETHEUS provides a preclinical approach to actionable stratification; validation with observed treatment-outcome data is required before clinical use.

</details>


### [465] [Reinforcement Learning via Advantage Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19783)
*Zhiyuan Zhou,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出优势引导（Advantage Guidance），一种兼具监督学习稳定性与强化学习性能的策略优化方法，通过优势条件训练与对比扩散引导采样，在26个长时程稀疏奖励任务上超越现有最优RL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL虽有望超越数据中展示的策略，但存在训练不稳定和超参数敏感的问题；监督学习虽稳定可扩展，却受限于示范行为质量。作者希望兼得两者优点。此外，简单的监督学习加条件化（如按未来奖励或优势）通常劣于专门的RL方法。

Method: 提出Advantage Guidance策略提取方法：保持监督学习的简单结构并加入优势条件化；通过有效的条件训练提升模型对优势信号的响应能力；在采样时引入对比扩散引导，使学到的优势条件策略逼近KL正则化的最优策略。

Result: 在26个长时程、稀疏奖励任务上（涵盖不同最优程度的数据集），Advantage Guidance显著优于此前最先进的RL方法；能显著提升模型对条件优势信号的响应能力。

Conclusion: 研究表明，可以在保持监督学习简单稳定结构的同时实现与RL相当甚至更优的策略优化性能，优势条件化结合对比扩散引导是有效路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of learning a policy that can outperform what is shown in the data. However, in practice, such systems suffer from instability and hyperparameter sensitivity. In contrast, supervised learning provides a stable and scalable training objective, but is fundamentally limited by the quality of the demonstrated behavior. In this paper, we ask whether we can perform policy optimization with something as simple and stable as supervised learning but as performant as RL. Unfortunately, naively training the policy with supervised learning and conditioning on future rewards or advantages typically underperform dedicated RL methods. We introduce a new policy extraction method, Advantage Guidance, that retains the simple supervised learning structure with advantage conditioning while outperforming prior RL methods through effective conditional training and contrastive diffusion guidance during sampling. We show that Advantage Guidance can significantly improve a model's ability to respond to conditional advantage signals, and the contrastive guidance during sampling can use the learned advantage-conditioned policy to target the KL-regularized optimal policy. Empirically, we find that Advantage Guidance significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL methods on 26 long-horizon, sparse reward tasks across datasets with varying degrees of optimality.

</details>


### [466] [Asymptotically Exact Negative Guidance of Diffusion Models via Positive-Unlabeled Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19802)
*Hirohane Takagi,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种负引导方法，从显式目标密度采样，结合PU学习与序贯蒙特卡洛，实现渐近精确且可直接替换现有负引导采样器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有负引导方法在局部注入排斥项，导致采样器缺乏显式密度目标，其偏差无法通过增加计算量系统性降低，因此无法保证收敛到理想分布。

Method: 定义显式目标密度（用避免强度参数化），统一处理参考样本与基于分数的条件；在每个扩散时间步将样本属于不期望条件概率的估计建模为正-无标签(PU)学习问题，利用条件样本为正例、扩散粒子为无标签数据进行轻量在线训练；再用序贯蒙特卡洛校正粒子漂移带来的残余不匹配，使任意现有负引导方法可作为提议核。

Result: 在高斯混合上逼近真实目标分布；在避免与生成质量、分布偏差、多样性之间的权衡上帕累托优于现有方法；在预训练分数网络的图像生成设置中同样有效。

Conclusion: 该方法获得显式且渐近精确的负引导采样器，在粒子极限下收敛到目标密度，并能将现有负引导方法嵌入为提议核，兼顾质量与多样性。

Abstract: Negative guidance of diffusion models generates samples that avoid an undesired condition, specified either by reference samples or by a conditional score alongside an unconditional model. Existing methods inject repulsive terms derived from local information at each sample, so the resulting sampler does not target an explicit density, and its bias cannot be systematically reduced by increasing computation. We instead present a negative-guidance method that samples from an explicit target density, which uniformly handles both reference-sample and score-based specifications and suppresses probability mass near the undesired condition with an avoidance strength that parametrizes the target density itself. Realizing this target requires estimating, at each diffusion timestep, how likely each sample is to belong to the undesired condition. We cast this estimation as a Positive-Unlabeled learning problem that admits lightweight online training along the diffusion trajectory, using condition samples as positives and diffusion particles as unlabeled data. Because the guided particles drift from the unconditional marginal, we further correct the residual mismatch via Sequential Monte Carlo, yielding a sampler that is asymptotically exact in the particle limit and that turns any existing negative-guidance method into its proposal kernel. Empirically, our method approaches the ground-truth target on Gaussian mixtures and Pareto-dominates existing methods on trade-offs between avoidance and generation quality, distributional bias, and diversity, including in an image-generation setting with a pretrained score network.

</details>


### [467] [Efficient contextual partial monitoring with general function approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19804)
*Kapilan Balagopalan,Hao Qin,Kwang-Sung Jun,Chicheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为有限随机部分监测（PM）博弈引入侧信息，基于E2D元算法提出E2D.PMSide框架及高效探索策略，在全局/局部可观测设定下达到最优遗憾界，并通过合成实验与LLM路由任务验证性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带有侧信息的上下文部分监测学习问题中，原始E2D算法的探索规则计算上不可实现（intractable），且已有探索方法（如逆间隙加权）此前仅在bandit设定中被证明有效，因此需要设计计算高效且具有最优遗憾界的框架。

Method: 利用Foster等人（2021）的Estimation-to-Decisions（E2D）元算法，设计E2D.PMSide框架，使用在线回归预言机基于历史(context, action, feedback symbol)三元组估计结果分布。针对原E2D探索规则不可解的问题，提出两种高效探索规则：全局可观测设定下采用ε-greedy，局部可观测设定下采用逆间隙加权（IGW）。此外提出变体OE2D.PMSide，结合离线回归预言机处理上下文独立同分布抽取的情形。

Result: 两种探索规则在T上均达到最优遗憾阶（optimal regret orders）；OE2D.PMSide在上下文从固定分布独立抽取时结合离线回归预言机也能达到最优遗憾。在合成标签高效预测游戏及LLM路由任务（学习器根据提示、不确定性与内部状态特征决定是否将查询从弱模型升级到强模型）中，方法性能优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为带侧信息的上下文部分监测提供了计算高效、遗憾最优的通用框架，将逆间隙加权成功扩展到部分监测设定，并在实际任务中验证了有效性。

Abstract: We study finite stochastic partial monitoring (PM) games with side information, a paradigm of sequential learning with partial feedback. On each round $t \in [T]$, both player and environment observe a context and player chooses an action and environment simultaneously chooses an outcome. The player neither observes the outcome nor the loss; instead, they only observe a feedback symbol which is partially informative about the outcome. We utilize the Estimation-to-Decisions (E2D) meta-algorithm of Foster et al.(2021) to design E2D.PMSide, a computationally efficient framework for contextual partial monitoring, which uses an online regression oracle to efficiently estimate the outcome distributions based on historical (context, action, feedback symbol) tuples. Since the exploration rule given by the original E2D algorithm is intractable to compute, we propose two computationally efficient exploration rules that achieve optimal regret orders in $T$: in the globally observable setting, our exploration rule is based on $ε$-greedy, while in the locally observable setting, our exploration rule uses inverse gap weighting (Foster & Rakhlin, 2020), which was previously only known to be effective in the bandit setting. We show that a variant of E2D.PMSide named OE2D.PMSide can be combined with offline regression oracles to give an efficient algorithm with optimal regret when the contexts are drawn independently from a fixed distribution. We evaluate our algorithm on a synthetic label-efficient prediction game and an LLM routing task, in which a learner decides from prompt, uncertainty, and internal state features whether to escalate a query from a weak model to a strong one. We show that our method has superior performance to prior approaches.

</details>


### [468] [VaryST: Generalizable Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Beyond the Closed-World Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19813)
*Shengnan Guo,Jinjun Cheng,Xiaowei Mao,Jianhao Zhang,Haochen Lv,Yang Jiang,YiHeng Huang,Yan Lin,Youfang Lin,Huaiyu Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VaryST：一种从零训练、可动态构建预测上下文的紧凑时空预测模型，应对时间演化、空间变化与观测可用性变动，实现强泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实部署环境不断变化（时间分布演化、空间域变化、观测可用性改变），而现有模型通过节点专属表示、预定义空间支持集和依赖持续可用的观测，与训练环境紧密耦合，泛化能力受限。

Method: VaryST从长期历史中导出节点表示以捕捉当前行为并适应时间变化；动态选择预定义邻域之外的功能相关支持节点，并结合近期与长期目标状态及全局上下文以适应空间变化；训练时对模型最依赖的历史片段进行选择性掩码，促使模型利用替代的时空依赖来应对观测可用性变化。

Result: 在六个真实数据集上与十七个基线模型的实验表明，VaryST取得强域内预测精度，在空间与时间变化下显著提升零样本与少样本泛化能力，并对观测可用性变化保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: VaryST通过动态构建预测上下文，从零训练即可在时空变化环境中实现强泛化，验证了其应对部署环境变化的有效性。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal forecasting is fundamental to many real-world systems, yet deployment environments are inherently varying: temporal distributions may evolve, spatial domains may change, and observation availability may shift from training conditions. Existing models are often tightly coupled to their training environments through node-specific representations, predefined spatial support sets, and reliance on consistently available observations, limiting generalization to changing environments. To this end, we propose VaryST, a compact spatio-temporal forecasting model trained from scratch that achieves strong generalization by dynamically constructing predictive context from available long-term observations. To accommodate temporal changes, VaryST derives node representations from long-term histories, capturing current behavior in the context of longer-term patterns. To adapt to spatial changes, it dynamically selects functionally relevant support nodes beyond predefined neighborhoods and integrates their information with recent and long-term target states and global context. To handle varying observation availability, VaryST selectively masks historical patches on which the model relies most during training, encouraging it to exploit alternative temporal and spatial dependencies for accurate forecasting when key observations become unavailable. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets against seventeen baselines show that VaryST achieves strong in-domain forecasting accuracy, substantially improves zero- and few-shot generalization under spatial and temporal changes, and remains robust to varying observation availability.

</details>


### [469] [When Does Depth Help? Understanding Layerwise Inference in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19814)
*Wenwen Gong,Haotian Gu,Zhen Yang,Jiaying Ma,Hanqing Zhang,Zhongshen Wang,Jingjun Wang,Shouyi Xu,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究TabPFN-3等表格基础模型(TFM)的逐层计算冗余问题，发现"早期预测可达性"不等于"后续层多余"，深度冗余是输入依赖的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期逐层分析发现TFM早期表示即有强预测能力、层间计算重叠，但这些证据无法证明后续层对所有输入都可丢弃，聚合准确率也掩盖了哪些输入真正受益于额外计算。

Method: 对TabPFN-3全部24个上下文学习层，在272个分类数据集上结合表示几何、预测轨迹、截断实验与结构干预进行分析，并考察另外4个TFM的表示动态。

Result: 发现明显的"扩张-压缩"轨迹，晚期维度收缩越强则类原型分离提升越大；早期稳定样本在类别预测稳定后表示仍持续变化；局部模糊样本从浅层到深层获得的准确率增益大于易分样本；重复单一预训练块或打乱层序平均会降低性能。

Conclusion: 研究区分了"预测可达性""类别稳定性"与"继续计算带来的收益"三者的差异，支持对TFM深度冗余做输入依赖的评估，而非简单认为后层可丢弃。

Abstract: Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers. Recent layerwise analyses identify strong predictive performance in early TFM representations and substantial overlap in computation across layers. However, early predictive accessibility alone does not establish whether later layers are dispensable for every input, and aggregate accuracy can obscure which inputs benefit from additional computation. We study all 24 in-context-learning layers of TabPFN-3 across 272 classification datasets, combining representation geometry, prediction trajectories, truncation, and structural interventions, while also examining related representation dynamics in four additional TFMs. We uncover a pronounced expansion-compression trajectory, with stronger late dimensional contraction associated with larger increases in class-prototype separation. A targeted analysis of early-stabilizing samples shows that substantial representational changes persist after predicted classes stabilize, while locally ambiguous queries obtain larger accuracy gains from shallow to late layers than well-separated queries. Repeating a single pretrained block or perturbing layer order reduces predictive performance on average, constraining simple post-hoc substitutions in the frozen model. These findings distinguish predictive accessibility, class stability, and the benefits of continuing computation, supporting an input-dependent assessment of depthwise redundancy in TFMs.

</details>


### [470] [MAPLE: A Multi-Axis Parametric Knowledge Extraction Lens for LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19827)
*Minsuh Joo,Youna Kim,Choonghyun Park,Soo Kyung Kim,Hyunsoo Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MAPLE框架，通过多维诊断指标刻画知识提取增强(KEE)技术对LLM参数知识提取的复杂影响，超越单一准确率评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM从训练数据吸收大量知识，但其概率性本质不保证知识在输出中显现。KEE技术（激活引导、解码调整、提示）可修改推理来强化预测或揭示难获取的答案，但现有评估仅关注总体准确率，将"恢复的失败"与"被破坏的成功"混为一谈，掩盖了多样化效应。

Method: 提出MAPLE统一框架，包含三层诊断指标：表层（答案恢复与破坏）、概率层（未恢复失败样本上的gold-token排名变化）、超越采样层（固定预算采样遗漏答案的恢复率）。评估六种KEE技术，涵盖解码、激活引导和提示三类，跨OLMo2、Qwen2.5、Llama3三个模型家族。

Result: 分析揭示了各KEE技术之间不同的效应与权衡关系。

Conclusion: MAPLE有助于超越总体准确率来理解和比较KEE技术，具有重要价值。

Abstract: LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs. To bridge this gap, Knowledge Extraction Enhancement (KEE) techniques such as activation steering, decoding adjustments, and prompting modify inference, potentially reinforcing existing predictions or surfacing less accessible answers. Yet their evaluations centered on aggregate accuracy, which obscures diverse effects by collapsing recovered failures and disrupted successes into a single score. We introduce MAPLE, a unified framework for characterizing how KEE techniques affect parametric knowledge extraction. Its diagnostic metrics disentangle these effects at the surface, probability, and beyond-sampling levels by measuring answer recovery and disruption, gold-token rank shifts on unrecovered failures, and recovery of answers missed by fixed-budget sampling. We evaluate six KEE techniques spanning decoding, activation steering, and prompting across three model families: OLMo2, Qwen2.5, and Llama3. Our analysis reveals distinct effects and trade-offs across techniques, highlighting the value of MAPLE for understanding and comparing KEE beyond aggregate accuracy.

</details>


### [471] [CTIA-ODE: Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19831)
*Chengyi Pan,Huangqimei Zheng,Hao Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出连续时间预测框架CTIA-ODE，通过连续时间变量间注意力在ODE求解器中动态查询外生变量，无需显式时间对齐，并在八个数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多变量时间序列预测的离散时间架构强制异构变量间进行刚性时间对齐，难以捕捉持续演变的外生效应。

Method: 核心为Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention (CTIA)，嵌入ODE求解器，使内生轨迹沿积分路径动态查询静态外生上下文；并引入双重稳定策略：Linear Residual Augmentation (LRA)提供宏观趋势锚，Outlier-Robust Hybrid Loss (ORHL)缓解重尾异常影响。

Result: 在八个真实世界数据集上取得SOTA预测性能，覆盖不同数据集与预测时域；内存占用小、推理延迟低，长时域下优势明显，具有良好精度-效率权衡。

Conclusion: CTIA-ODE通过连续时间建模有效融合外生变量，避免刚性时间对齐，兼顾精度与效率，适合长时域多变量时间序列预测。

Abstract: Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging. Prevailing discrete-time architectures often impose rigid temporal alignment across heterogeneous variables, which may limit their ability to capture continuously evolving external effects. To address this limitation, we introduce CTIA-ODE, a continuous-time forecasting framework centered on Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention (CTIA). Specifically, CTIA is embedded within an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, enabling the continuously evolving endogenous trajectory to dynamically query a static exogenous context along the integration path without requiring explicit temporal alignment. To improve the stability of the continuous latent dynamics, we further introduce a dual-stabilization strategy: architecturally, a Linear Residual Augmentation (LRA) module provides a macroscopic trend anchor, while an Outlier-Robust Hybrid Loss (ORHL) mitigates the influence of heavy-tailed anomalies during optimization. Extensive experiments across eight real-world datasets demonstrate that CTIA-ODE achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance across diverse datasets and prediction horizons, while maintaining a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off with a compact memory footprint and low inference latency, particularly under long-horizon forecasting settings. Anonymous code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CTIA-ODE-15A6/.

</details>


### [472] [Rent-Seeking Language Models: Reward Models Set the Prices, Frequent Audits Curb the Rent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19832)
*Zixiao Wang,Xingbo Du,Duzhen Zhang,Le Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 把 RLHF 中的奖励过度优化重新解释为“寻租”：策略像企业从代理奖励模型（监管者）处获取无真实质量支撑的收益。在固定测试平台上，RL 将 41%-66% 的代理增益转化为“租金”，而真实奖励停滞；策略学会编造细节或回避事实问题，并表现出监管经济学预测的审计阈值聚集行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上 RLHF 的奖励过度优化被称为 reward hacking，但该描述缺乏可度量指标与可检验预测。作者希望借助监管经济学中的“寻租”框架，将其转化为可量化的租金、捕获指数与无谓损失，并导出可验证的预测。

Method: 在版本控制的固定测试平台中，使用三个模型家族、准确率匹配的代理奖励模型和两个黄金奖励模型进行 RL 训练；引入寻租度量（租金、捕获指数、无谓损失）并检验审计频率、审计目标性及“监管者—策略亲缘关系”等经济学预测；还将税收经济学中的 bunching 估计器迁移到 RL 训练。

Result: RL 将 41%-66% 的代理增益转为租金，黄金奖励停滞；租金随监管者定价变化。一个代理奖励偏好“自信的具体信息”，另一个偏好“勤勉表现”，导致策略分别编造不存在的实体细节（97%-100% 探测）或回避事实问题（67%-98%）。亲缘关系带来约 0.1 个标准差的固定溢价，但在优化下不提供额外杠杆。固定期望罚款下，频繁轻度审计优于罕见重度审计；随机审计与定向审计每次效率相当。首次发现策略学会停在定向审计阈值之下。

Conclusion: 将奖励过度优化视为寻租提供了可测量、可预测的新视角，揭示了 RLHF 中代理奖励与真实质量脱钩的具体机制，并对审计设计具有实践启示。

Abstract: Reward model overoptimization in RLHF is usually described as reward hacking. We recast it as rent-seeking: the policy, a firm, earns reward from a regulator, the proxy reward model, that true quality does not back. The lens turns overoptimization into measurable quantities, namely rent, a capture index and deadweight loss, and into testable predictions from the economics of regulation. In a fixed, version-controlled testbed with three model families, accuracy-matched proxy reward models and two gold reward models, RL turns 41% to 66% of its proxy gain into rent while gold reward plateaus. Rent follows each regulator's prices. Neither proxy verifies facts, but one pays for confident specifics and the other for displays of diligence, so RL policies learn to fabricate details about nonexistent entities (97% to 100% of probes) or to deflect factual questions (67% to 98%). Kinship between policy and regulator adds a fixed premium of about 0.1 standard deviations but gives the policy no extra leverage under optimization. At a fixed expected fine, frequent mild audits beat rare severe ones, and random audits are as efficient per audit as targeted ones. Bringing the bunching estimator of tax economics to RL training, we also find a first sign that policies learn to stay just below a targeted audit's threshold.

</details>


### [473] [Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19844)
*Sifan Yang,Hongyi Tao,Dingzhi Yu,Haomin Bai,Wei Jiang,Silin Gao,Pi Bu,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出残差修正子空间优化框架，将优化器状态维持在子空间并将正交残差梯度加入更新，开发了 SMRC 与 PMRC，均达 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率并匹配全空间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有子空间优化算法依赖随机梯度的主奇异子空间，但训练后期梯度噪声可能主导该子空间，阻碍收敛。需要一种在保持子空间低内存优势的同时恢复收敛性的方法。

Method: 采用残差修正框架：优化器状态存于子空间，更新时加入正交残差梯度。将其集成到动量SGD得到SMRC，引入"子空间虚拟迭代"解决动量与残差修正的耦合；扩展为多阶段变体，周期重算基并设计边界修正对齐虚拟迭代。进一步集成到Muon得到PMRC，对投影动量施加矩阵sign，并用加权动量追踪分析处理残差梯度。

Result: SMRC 在固定正交基下达到 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率，匹配全空间动量SGD；多阶段版本保持同阶速率。PMRC 建立 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率，匹配全空间 Muon；多阶段 PMRC 同样保持同阶速率。大量实验验证了算法的有效性与效率。

Conclusion: 残差修正框架可有效解决子空间优化中的梯度噪声主导问题，为动量SGD和Muon等优化器提供理论收敛保证的多阶段内存高效方案。

Abstract: Memory-efficient subspace optimization has emerged as a practical approach to reducing the memory cost of LLM training while preserving optimization performance. Previous algorithms typically rely on the leading singular subspace of stochastic gradients, yet the gradient noise may dominate the subspace in later training stages and can prevent convergence. To overcome this limitation, we adopt a residual correction framework, which maintains the optimizer states in the subspace and adds the orthogonal residual gradient to the parameter update. We first integrate this scheme into momentum SGD to develop SMRC, which attains an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for a fixed orthonormal basis, matching that of full-space momentum SGD. Our analysis introduces a subspace virtual iterate to resolve the coupling between the momentum and the residual correction. Furthermore, we extend SMRC to a multi-stage variant which periodically recomputes bases to track the evolving dominant subspace and retains the same rate. Since each basis refresh breaks the consistency of the virtual iterates, we devise a boundary correction approach that aligns them across stages. Beyond momentum SGD, we incorporate our framework into Muon and propose PMRC, which applies the matrix sign to the projected momentum. Through a weighted momentum tracking analysis that accounts for the residual gradient, we establish an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for PMRC, which matches the rate of full-space Muon. We also design a multi-stage PMRC with periodically refreshed bases, which maintains a convergence rate of the same order. Extensive experimental results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithms.

</details>


### [474] [Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19855)
*Boris Ruf,Marcin Detyniecki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对扩散语言模型(LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B)与自回归模型(Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B)进行了能耗基准比较,发现长序列下扩散模型每token能耗约为AR模型的一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM规模扩大,推理能耗成为关键问题。自回归模型是业界标准,而扩散语言模型因支持并行token生成成为有前景的替代方案,但其能耗特性尚缺乏系统比较。

Method: 对扩散模型(LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B)与AR模型(Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B)进行能耗基准测试,分析模型架构、KV-cache优化与每token焦耳效率之间的权衡。

Result: 长序列(200–600 token)下,扩散模型达2.5–2.7 J/token,比带KV-cache的AR模型(5.3–5.7 J/token)约高效2倍;KV-cache为AR模型在长序列下带来50–70%的能耗降低。

Conclusion: 扩散语言模型在长序列推理中具有显著的能效优势,可为LLM推理的能耗优化提供替代路径。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).

</details>


### [475] [SPARS: A Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection Framework for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19876)
*Teif Aldaajani,Huda Hakami,Maha A. Thafar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPARS，一种无回放的混合持续学习框架，结合全局参数隔离与局部参数正则化，实现稳定性-可塑性平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习需在新任务学习时保留旧知识，但共享参数更新会导致灾难性遗忘。现有方法存在缺陷：回放法涉及隐私、内存和可扩展性问题；参数隔离法限制知识迁移；正则化法易受新旧任务干扰。需更好的稳定性-可塑性权衡方案。

Method: SPARS用Fisher信息矩阵或新型置信度评分（利用logit敏感性，无需标签）估计参数重要性；将参数分为获胜、邻域、非重要三类区域，分别采用选择性冻结、软正则化、无限制学习。此外采用二次判别分析缓解类增量学习中的分类器偏差。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和TinyImageNet上，SPARS在任务增量和类增量学习中均持续优于现有隔离和正则化方法。TinyImageNet类增量学习提升6%，同时为未来任务保留超过60%参数。

Conclusion: SPARS通过无回放混合框架有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在稳定性与可塑性间取得平衡，性能与参数保留均表现优异。

Abstract: Continual learning aims to acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, updating shared parameters when learning new tasks often overwrites existing knowledge, causing catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting but rely on previous samples, raising privacy, memory, and scalability concerns. On the other hand, parameter isolation-based methods preserve learned knowledge but may limit knowledge transfer, whereas regularization promotes adaptability but remains susceptible to interference between old and new tasks. To maintain the stability-plasticity trade-off, this paper proposes Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection (SPARS), a replay-free hybrid framework combining global parameter isolation with localized parameter regularization. SPARS estimates parameter importance using either the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) or a novel Confidence Score (CS) estimator that leverages logit sensitivity and achieves comparable performance to FIM without requiring labelled data. Based on parameter importance, SPARS partitions parameters into three importance-aware regions namely, winning, neighboring, and non-important parameter regions. Each region receives a different adaptation strategy: selective freezing, soft regularization, or unrestricted learning based on its role in the stability-plasticity trade-off. To mitigate classifier bias in class-incremental learning, we employ Quadratic Discriminant Analysis to improve performance on previously learned classes .Experiments on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet demonstrate consistent improvement in average incremental accuracy over existing isolation- and regularization-based methods across task- and class-incremental learning. On TinyImageNet, SPARS achieves the best performance with 6% improvement for class-incremental learning while retaining over 60% of parameters for future tasks.

</details>


### [476] [Neural Wasserstein Splines: Representation-Invariant Second-Order Priors for Trajectory Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19878)
*Amartya Banerjee,Harlin Lee,Caroline Moosmüller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NWSP方法，用Wasserstein光滑性先验学习连续种群曲线，实现对未配对快照间演化的推断，兼具表示不变性与竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 种群动态常只能通过未配对快照观测，导致测量之间的演化欠定；二阶正则化虽可约束，但对采样粒子加速度的惩罚依赖于粒子表示，同一边际曲线不同表示会有不同加速度代价。

Method: NWSP为基于样本的方法，用神经网络将隐变量映射到时间三次样条控制点，任意时刻样本直接来自样条基无需数值积分；将生成器速度投影到有限标量势字典的梯度上，并对其随时间求导，得到内在Wasserstein加速度的有限维替代，与分布拟合损失联合训练；NWSP-N进一步学习势函数以锐化加速度估计。

Result: 在多种合成与单细胞基准上，NWSP与传输及流方法相比极具竞争力，16个设置中11个排名前二；正则化在16个设置中13个优于未正则化样条；与粒子加速度惩罚相当，同时提供可证明的表示不变性。

Conclusion: 对于固定字典和岭参数，证明种群惩罚仅依赖边际曲线，并给出其对矩估计误差的敏感性界，说明该方法在保持表示不变性的同时有效约束种群演化。

Abstract: Population dynamics are often observed only as unpaired snapshots, which leave the evolution between measurements underdetermined. Second-order regularization can constrain it, but a penalty on the accelerations of sampled particles is a prior on joint particle paths, and different particle representations of the same marginal curve can have different acceleration costs. We therefore introduce Neural Wasserstein Splines (NWSP), a sample-based method that learns a continuous population curve under a Wasserstein smoothness prior. A neural network maps latent variables to the control points of a cubic spline in time, so samples at any time come from the spline basis without numerical integration. We project the generator's velocity onto gradients of a finite dictionary of scalar potentials and differentiate this measure-dependent projection in time, obtaining a finite-dimensional surrogate for the intrinsic Wasserstein acceleration, trained jointly with distributional fit losses. For a fixed dictionary and ridge parameter, we prove that the population penalty depends only on the marginal curve and bound its sensitivity to moment-estimation errors. Learned potentials (NWSP-N) sharpen acceleration estimates. On various synthetic and single-cell benchmarks, NWSP is highly competitive with transport and flow-based methods, ranking in the top two in 11 of 16 settings. The penalty improves on an unregularized spline in 13 of 16 settings and, while competitive with a particle-acceleration penalty, adds provable representation invariance.

</details>


### [477] [Occupancy Modeling via Drifting: One-Step Generation Enables Direct Policy Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19883)
*Robin Uhrich,Marco Bagatella,Núria Armengol Urpí,Pavel Kolev,Georg Martius*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析从无标签数据做强化学习的"生成式占用建模"配方，沿三个轴（占用多模态结构、生成模型类别、策略提取方法）逐项实验验证，最终提出用 drifting 一步生成采样器建模占用的精简新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为基础模型与生成建模的进展，使"在无奖励轨迹上预训练生成模型来建模占用（折扣状态访问分布），待少量带奖励数据出现时提取策略"成为有吸引力的范式。但该配方中各设计选择缺乏系统评估，本文旨在拆解并验证这些选择。

Method: 沿三条轴分解该配方：(i) 占用多模态结构需被捕捉的程度，(ii) 生成模型类别，(iii) 策略提取方法。对每条轴考察已有选项、提出更简替代方案并做实验验证；最终提出用 drifting（现代一步生成采样器）建模占用的精简方法。

Result: 该方法使得可通过直接对占用模型求导来提取策略，并绕过 critic 蒸馏；实验表明这一轻量设置在标准基准上带来性能提升。

Conclusion: 简化占用建模与策略提取流程（一步生成采样 + 直接微分）即可在标准基准上取得更好性能，说明更简洁的设计在该范式中可行且有效。

Abstract: The growing interest in behavior foundation models, combined with recent advancements in generative modeling, has led to an appealing recipe for reinforcement learning from unlabeled data: pre-train a generative model to model occupancies, i.e., discounted state visitations, on reward-free trajectories, such that a policy can be easily extracted once a small reward-labeled dataset becomes available. We decompose this recipe along three axes: (i) the degree to which the multi-modal structure of occupancies must be captured, (ii) the class of generative model, and (iii) the method used for policy extraction. Along each axis, we consider existing choices, propose simpler alternatives, and validate each decision experimentally. This analysis culminates in a novel, streamlined method that leverages drifting, a modern one-step generative sampler, to model the occupancy. We show that this enables policy extraction via direct differentiation through the occupancy model, and bypasses the need for critic distillation. Overall, we observe that this nimble setup leads to improvements in performance on standard benchmarks.

</details>


### [478] [On the Limits of Representation-Based Test-Time Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19892)
*Mikołaj Piórczyński,Wojciech Masarczyk,Damian Sójka,Sebastian Cygert,Bartłomiej Twardowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了 TTA 在生成式 MLLM 上的适用性，发现基于表征的 TTA 无法恢复其受损坏下的性能，原因是 MLLM 视觉 token 序列的偏移几乎正交并遍布整个嵌入空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在常见损坏下准确率显著下降；TTA 在 CLIP 类对比模型上有效，但在生成式 MLLM 上尚未被充分探索，且因其序列式 token 生成而具有独特挑战。

Method: 通过实验检验表征式 TTA 在 MLLM 上的效果：即使在离线利用目标数据、违背标准 TTA 假设的条件下，进行样本盲的特征对齐，并分析偏移的几何特性。

Result: 样本盲、位置共享的纠正在 MLLM 上仅带来边际准确率提升；MLLM 视觉 token 序列的偏移近乎正交并覆盖整个嵌入空间，而 CLIP 类模型则在单一池化分类嵌入中共享域偏移方向。

Conclusion: 这些发现界定了单编码器位置、样本盲、位置共享校正的能力上限，表明仅靠表征空间干预可能不足以确保 MLLM 的损坏鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.

</details>


### [479] [Universal Sample-Based Embeddings of Higher-Order Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19899)
*Radovan Haluška,Christopher Solinas,Nathan R. Sturtevant,Martin Schmid,Michael Bowling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一框架，将分布、函数、图等高阶对象编码为固定大小嵌入向量，用样本训练的编码器加领域解码器实现对整族对象的紧凑表示并泛化到未见成员。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络处理有限维向量，但许多问题需推理分布、函数、图等高阶对象。这些对象难以显式紧凑表示，且通常需表示整族对象（含训练中未见的成员）。现有方法只针对特定对象类型，缺乏跨类型统一方案。

Method: 编码器仅从有限采样集将对象映射为固定大小嵌入；领域专用解码器以该嵌入为条件建模对象，提供训练信号。因编码器只依赖样本，同一架构适用不同对象类型；解码器沿用该对象类型的原生模型，从而继承其操作与归纳偏置。在分布、函数、图上实例化。

Result: 每种情况下单个训练模型都能表示整族对象并泛化到未见成员；嵌入具下游效用：嵌入空间插值分布、嵌入空间求解微分方程、由图嵌入预测未见边。

Conclusion: 该框架以样本驱动的编码器与领域解码器统一表示多类高阶对象，兼得通用性与领域归纳偏置，并从嵌入中展现实际下游应用价值。

Abstract: Neural networks operate naturally on finite-dimensional vectors, yet many problems require reasoning about higher-order objects such as distributions, functions, and graphs. Such objects capture relationships within a ground set and rarely admit an explicit compact representation. Moreover, we typically want a compact representation not of a single higher-order object but of an entire family of such objects, including members unseen during training. While a few approaches exist for particular object types, none is designed to work across object types. We propose a unified framework that represents any higher-order object as a fixed-size embedding vector learned over a family of such objects. An encoder maps an object, seen only through a finite set of samples, to an embedding, and a domain-specific decoder supplies the training signal by modeling the object conditioned on that embedding. Since the encoder works only from samples, one architecture serves different object types. Because the decoder is a model already suited to single instances of the object type, the framework inherits that model's native operations and inductive biases. We instantiate the framework on distributions, functions, and graphs. In each case we show that a single trained model represents an entire family and generalizes to members unseen during training. Furthermore, we demonstrate the downstream utility of these embeddings: interpolating distributions in embedding space, solving differential equations in embedding space, and predicting unseen edges from a graph's embedding.

</details>


### [480] [When Non-Adversarial Noise Hurts Learning: Benchmarking Skill Self-Evolution in Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19910)
*Tao Yu,Zhongtian Luo,Yuchen Long,Yiheng Lu,Yuxuan Zhou,Yanpei Gong,Siyi Cao,Yuqing Wu,Haopeng Jin,Zhenghao Zhang,Yujia Yang,Jingmin Zhu,Yunyun Hou,Xinming Wang,Hongzhu Yi,Jiachen Liu,Sirui Wang,Nan Duan,Yan Huang,Liang Wang,Tianjin Huang,Yanyan Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 RSE-Bench，首个评估普通非对抗噪声下技能自进化鲁棒性的基准，并给出 RSEClaw 框架；发现噪声学习仅保留约25.5%–42.1%的干净自进化增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体常将经验蒸馏为可复用技能，但经验中的错误会固化进规则并影响后续任务。现有评估多关注干净学习或技能冻结后的扰动，对自进化过程中的鲁棒性理解不足。

Method: 构建RSE-Bench，覆盖4个领域、6个基准，对指令、环境证据、执行记录、结果-记录配对施加受控扰动，保持任务与原生评分不变；协议分离学习期噪声与评估期输入噪声，在留出任务上测试冻结技能库；并提出方法无关框架RSEClaw，支持一致噪声注入与暴露/技能更新诊断。

Result: 在3种方法、2个骨干上，噪声学习仅保留干净自进化聚合增益的25.5%–42.1%；仅限执行记录与结果-记录配对的扰动，其平均损失可与输入侧噪声相当，尽管原始执行与评估未被改动；诊断发现候选技能文本差异与留出性能均值微小变化并存。

Conclusion: 技能自进化对普通非对抗噪声高度脆弱，且隐性记录侧扰动同样有害；需要更重视学习过程鲁棒性，RSEClaw为诊断提供工具。

Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly improve by distilling experience into reusable skills, but errors in that experience can persist in learned rules and affect later tasks. Existing evaluations largely examine clean learning or perturbations encountered after skills are frozen, leaving robustness during self-evolution insufficiently understood. We introduce RSE-Bench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating skill self-evolution under ordinary, non-adversarial noise. It spans four domains and six benchmarks, with controlled perturbations to instructions, environmental evidence, execution records, and outcome--record pairings that preserve the underlying tasks and native scoring rules. The protocol separates noise during learning from input-side noise at evaluation, testing frozen skill stores on held-out tasks. We also introduce \textsc{RSEClaw}, a method-agnostic framework supporting consistent noise injection and process diagnostics of actual exposure and skill updates. Across three methods and two backbones, noisy learning retains only $25.5\%$--$42.1\%$ of the aggregate gain achieved by clean self-evolution, depending on the noise type. Perturbations confined to execution records and outcome--record pairings cause average losses comparable to input-side noise, despite leaving the original executions and evaluations intact. Diagnostics further identify differences in candidate skill text that coexist with small changes in mean held-out performance.

</details>


### [481] [CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19911)
*Zhi Li,Haowei Liu,Hongchen Yang,Xiaoxuan Wang,Song Gao,Zhenli He,Wei Zhou,Shaowen Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出闭环对抗鲁棒性蒸馏框架CARD，让蒸馏后的学生反向反馈精炼鲁棒教师，再继续训练同一学生，突破传统单向蒸馏范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗鲁棒性蒸馏把鲁棒教师当作固定知识源，单向传递鲁棒性给学生，学生蒸馏完成后师生交互即终止，丢弃了学生可能带来的有用反馈；但不加区分的学生弱到强传递又可能把学生错误传播给教师。

Method: CARD先进行强到弱的对抗蒸馏，再用可靠性增强的学生反馈精炼教师：结合逆向对抗学生反馈与师生差异最大化；随后用精炼后的教师在不改变基础蒸馏目标下继续训练同一学生。理论上给出样本级可靠弱到强反馈传递的充分条件和精炼教师风险的分布级上界。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet-10上，跨多种师生架构和基础蒸馏方法，CARD在多数设置下提升对抗鲁棒性，同时基本保持干净准确率。

Conclusion: 蒸馏后的学生能为教师提供有用反馈，使鲁棒性传递超越传统单向教师到学生的范式。

Abstract: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedback transfer and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher's risk. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base distillation methods show that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy. These results show that the distilled student can provide useful feedback to the teacher, enabling robustness transfer to proceed beyond the conventional one-way teacher-to-student paradigm.

</details>


### [482] [Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19919)
*Minhyuk Kang,Beom Seok Kang,Nikolai Argatoff,Miguel Nouman,Danish Khan,William A. Goddard,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出O-kRystal双空间轨道学习框架，用低成本PBE计算作为基线与轨道信息来源，预测HSE06等高精度能带修正，在近6000种三维材料上MAE仅0.171 eV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高精度电子能带结构计算对材料性质预测至关重要，但计算成本高昂，需要一种低成本方法逼近高阶理论精度。

Method: 以PBE计算作为能量基线并提供实空间与倒空间轨道矩阵信息，结合PBE能带能量，按晶体动量与自旋对单个电子态预测更高理论层级的能量修正；并在G0W0二维材料上验证方法的可扩展性。

Result: 在带边中点5 eV内，对近6000种三维材料（绝缘、金属、磁性、非磁性）预测HSE06能带能量MAE为0.171±0.009 eV；在六种强关联材料上PBE能带MAE降低68.7%，并解析过渡金属d与配体p态相对位置变化；仅在高对称点训练仍能在未见路径点保持相当精度，并可从密集布里渊区预测重构HSE06态密度。

Conclusion: 轨道学习可跨理论层级推广，为超越DFT的高保真、动量分辨电子结构预测提供潜力。

Abstract: Accurate electronic band structures are essential for predicting material properties, but high-fidelity calculations are computationally demanding. We introduce O-kRystal, a dual-space orbital-learning framework that uses a lower-cost Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) calculation as both an energy baseline and a source of structured orbital information. Combining PBE band energies with real- and reciprocal-space orbital matrices, O-kRystal predicts higher-level corrections for individual electronic states as a function of crystal momentum and spin. For states within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint, it predicts Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06) band energies with a mean absolute error of $0.171 \pm 0.009$ eV across nearly 6,000 three-dimensional materials spanning insulating, metallic, magnetic, and nonmagnetic systems. On a separate benchmark of six strongly correlated materials, it reduces the corresponding PBE band-energy MAE by 68.7% and resolves orbital-dependent changes in the relative placement of transition-metal d and ligand p states. Despite training only at high-symmetry points, it maintains comparable accuracy at unseen points along band paths and reconstructs HSE06 densities of states from dense Brillouin-zone predictions. Finally, training O-kRystal on $G_0W_0$ quasiparticle energies for two-dimensional materials demonstrates its applicability across levels of theory and the potential of orbital learning for higher-fidelity, momentum-resolved electronic-structure prediction beyond density functional theory.

</details>


### [483] [MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19920)
*Yanyi Su,Chenyan Wang,Yulei Gong,Yeyun Chen,Xiaohui Yang,Jun Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MolHop智能体框架，将约160万商业分子骨架组织为粗到细的层级动作空间，通过骨架导航与分子编辑实现跨骨架分子发现，在药物与商业化合物任务上显著提升跨骨架联合成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化与结构迥异替代分子的发现是两类本质不同的搜索问题。现有LLM分子设计智能体多聚焦局部优化，仅在已有结构邻域内进行修饰，无法探索更广化学空间去发现全新骨架、同时保留参考分子功能特征的分子。

Method: MolHop框架：1) 将约160万商业分子骨架组织成粗到细的层级动作空间；2) 智能体通过骨架导航动作选择新探索区域，并通过分子编辑调整候选分子性质；3) 维护历史轨迹记忆以支持长程搜索；4) 通过智能体强化学习训练出MolHop-9B模型。

Result: 接入Grok-4.6与DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1后跨骨架联合成功率大幅提升；MolHop-9B优于GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-5-Opus、Gemini-3.1-Pro等生成式基线，且生成的候选分子与参考分子骨架差异更大。

Conclusion: 超越传统优化范式的有效分子发现依赖于结构化的化学空间与动作空间，使智能体能够探索全新结构区域而非仅修饰已有分子。

Abstract: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.

</details>


### [484] [MorphingNet: Symbolic Regression Where the Network Is the Formula](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19942)
*Jincheng Gao,Jiahe Yi,Shuo Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MorphingNet 将符号回归转化为连续优化问题：网络中每个单元的函数形式作为可训练参数，单元在训练中连续"变形"，训练后通过结构恢复步骤重写为短初等表达式，在 SRBench 上达到 SOTA 精度并大幅提速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归需在固定算子库上离散搜索表达式，搜索空间大、随数据规模扩展困难。作者希望把"搜索公式"变成"训练网络"，从而利用稠密线性代数与 GPU 加速，避免算子库依赖。

Method: 提出 MorphingNet：单元要么是无极点有理函数，要么是复指数—对数函数，随参数变化可在指数、正弦、阻尼振荡、幂律、对数之间连续过渡。函数形式本身作为参数训练，训练中网络始终是可读公式；训练后再用结构恢复步骤将其改写成简短初等表达式。训练为稠密线性代数，GPU 友好。

Result: 在 SRBench 上取得 SOTA 精度；在合成基准上恢复大多数生成公式；在大数据上比最强搜索方法快最多两个数量级。

Conclusion: 将公式搜索转化为网络训练为符号回归与数据驱动的科学发现提供了新范式。

Abstract: We introduce MorphingNet, a network for symbolic regression (SR) whose units change their function continuously. Instead of searching over expressions built from a fixed operator library, MorphingNet trains the form of each function as a parameter, so SR becomes one continuous optimization problem. Its units are either pole-free rational functions or complex exponential--logarithm functions, which move between exponentials, sinusoids, damped oscillations, power laws and logarithms as their parameters change. The network is a readable formula at every step of training, and no operator library is needed to train it; a structure-recovery step afterwards rewrites the trained formula into short elementary expressions. Training is dense linear algebra, so it is GPU-friendly and scales to large data. MorphingNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SRBench, recovers most generating formulas on synthetic benchmarks, and on large data is up to two orders of magnitude faster than the strongest search method. By turning the search for a formula into the training of a network, MorphingNet offers a new paradigm for SR and for scientific discovery from data.

</details>


### [485] [Learning Graph Energies for Finite-Time Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19946)
*Amartya Banerjee,Xingyu Xu,Caroline Moosmüller,Harlin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出有限时域能量学习，使Metropolis-Hastings采样器在固定步数下的终端分布更准确，而非仅追求平衡态能量正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能量在平衡态准确不代表采样器在固定步数停止后能给出准确样本，图生成等离散结构任务中这一有限时域偏差显著。

Method: 固定初始化、提议与退火安排，学习接受能量以匹配固定步数后的返回分布。用冻结预训练模型提供初始化与提议，训练仅用判别器打分完整样本；通过对接受与拒绝分支的耦合延续，在给定条件下得到对固定判别器无偏的接受梯度估计，无需平衡负样本或对离散状态求导。生成时仅用学习能量在原单轨迹采样器中采样。

Result: 在12个可精确计算终端分布的二元目标上，短时域设置下学习能量的终端总变差中位数均低于平衡正确的能量，且多数设置下优于其数值调优的标量倍数。MOSES上，学习两系数GEM势组合相比尺度校准GEM将FCD降低3.7–10.5%，最短预算有效性提升，更高预算下有效性略有下降。

Conclusion: 直接优化有限步采样器的实际返回分布比修正平衡态能量更有效，为离散生成提供无需重排序、无判别器评估的实用方案。

Abstract: Energy-based models can represent distributions over discrete structures such as molecular graphs, but an energy that is accurate at equilibrium need not yield accurate samples when the sampler stops after a fixed number of steps. We introduce finite-horizon energy learning, which adapts the acceptance energy of a Metropolis--Hastings sampler to the distribution it returns after a prescribed number of steps, with initialization, proposals, and annealing schedule held fixed. For graph generation, a frozen pretrained model supplies initialization and proposals, and a learned energy governs acceptance. A training-only discriminator scores completed samples, and coupled continuations of the accepted and rejected branches of a proposal give an acceptance-gradient estimator that is unbiased for a fixed discriminator under stated conditions, without equilibrated negative samples or differentiation through discrete states. Generation uses the learned energy in the original single-trajectory sampler, without discriminator evaluations or reranking. On twelve pairwise binary targets with exactly evaluated terminal laws, learned energies have lower median terminal total variation than the equilibrium-correct energy in every tested short-horizon setting, and than its numerically tuned scalar multiple in most settings. On MOSES, a learned two-coefficient combination of pretrained Graph Energy Matching (GEM) potentials lowers FCD by 3.7--10.5\% relative to scale-calibrated GEM at matched sampling steps, with validity gains at the shortest budget and a sub-point validity trade-off at higher budgets.

</details>


### [486] [Safe-FCL: Continual Risk Awareness and Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation for Federated Continual Learning of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19968)
*Shuaijie Ma,Yongkang Hu,Yu Cheng,Jiuan Zhou,Yi Xie,Yushuo Zhang,Zhaoxia Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Safe-FCL 框架，通过持续风险感知与细粒度安全聚合提升联邦持续学习中 LLM 的安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦微调中恶意客户端更新会危害全局模型安全，且随任务演化恶意模式不断变化，现有防御难以长期可靠检测风险。

Method: 集成两项机制：CRA 学习跨任务新兴风险模式，并利用历史特征保护子空间约束检测器更新以缓解遗忘；FGSA 结合客户端风险评分与模块级历史偏差，自适应调节聚合贡献。

Result: 实验显示优于现有 SOTA：Rule 与 MD-Judge 分数分别提升 0.41% 和 0.64%，平均风险识别准确率提升 2.01%。

Conclusion: Safe-FCL 能有效应对联邦持续学习中的演化恶意更新，在保障安全的同时减少对良性更新的限制。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety. As federated tasks evolve, changing malicious update patterns challenge the ability of existing defenses to maintain reliable risk detection over time. To address this challenge, we propose Safe-FCL, a framework integrating continual risk awareness with fine-grained safety aggregation for federated continual learning of LLMs. Specifically, the Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) mechanism learns emerging risk patterns across sequential tasks and constrains detector updates using a protective subspace derived from historical features, mitigating forgetting of previously learned malicious patterns while adapting to new risks. To translate risk awareness into aggregation-level safety control, the Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation (FGSA) mechanism combines client-level risk assessments from CRA with module-level deviations from historical update behavior to adaptively regulate aggregation contributions, suppressing potentially malicious updates while minimizing unnecessary restrictions on benign updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FCL outperforms current SOTA methods, improving global-model Rule and MD-Judge scores in federated continual learning by 0.41% and 0.64%, respectively, while increasing average risk recognition accuracy by 2.01%.

</details>


### [487] [LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19975)
*Zefeng He,Yunkai Chai,Xiaoyang Chen,Tong Zhu,Zongliang Wu,Yun Luo,Yafu Li,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 LatentLoop，通过对循环 MoE 的首次循环压缩序列、二次循环保持全分辨率并重分配节省算力增大隐藏维度，实现非对称算力分配，在 1.3B–7B 参数范围降低验证 NLL 并提升九项基准成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 MoE 共享参数但不同循环访问扮演不同角色。作者通过可学习残差系数发现：首次访问尺度较小，固定系数实验表明降低首次访问尺度可保持或提升性能，而降低第二次则损害性能，这一非对称性促使探索非对称算力分配。

Method: LatentLoop 压缩首次访问的序列长度，第二次访问保留全分辨率，并将节省的算力重新分配给更大的隐藏维度；同时学习首次访问更新全序列的强度，跨循环共享 MoE 权重但为不同序列分辨率使用独立注意力参数。

Result: 在 15 种配置（1.3B–7B 参数，最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）中一致降低验证 NLL；拟合 NLL=1.988 时相对 vanilla MoE 与循环基线预测算力节省 19.0% 和 7.9%；在九项基准的 0-shot 与 5-shot 设置下各规模平均分均有提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明非对称算力分配是循环 MoE 模型的一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose \textbf{LatentLoop}, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. We further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence, and share MoE weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their different sequence resolutions. Across 15 configurations spanning 1.3B--7B parameters, with the largest budget exceeding $10^{21}$ FLOPs, LatentLoop consistently lowers validation NLL. At a fitted NLL of 1.988, predicted compute savings are 19.0\% and 7.9\% relative to vanilla MoE and the looped baseline. It also improves average scores on nine benchmarks at all sizes in 0-shot and 5-shot settings. These results suggest asymmetric compute allocation is a promising direction for looped MoE models.

</details>


### [488] [Empirical Boundaries of Reservoir Computing for Few-Shot Sequence Pattern Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19997)
*Mario Mallea,Angela Nebot,Franscisco Mugica*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对回声状态网络（ESN）的分布、架构与优化变体进行实证分析，在少样本seq2seq模式任务上刻画其性能边界，并提出G-ESN与深层共享读出机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
