Most existing approaches treat imputation as a preprocessing step independent of the downstream task, a separation that becomes problematic under train-test mismatches in missingness mechanisms or rates. We introduce a unified framework that treats missing entries as variables in a task-conditioned optimization problem. We instantiate this framework in two settings: an amortized approach for scenarios with missing data at both training and test time, and a latent optimization approach for settings where only training data is incomplete.
  The evaluation is conducted on 98 tabular datasets, and robustness under train-test mismatches is assessed on 36 datasets. Results reveal that reconstruction error constitutes a poor proxy for predictive utility (Spearman rho approximately 0.16 to 0.32), and that task-aware imputation becomes critical in scenarios where classical methods fail to recover complete-data performance, achieving win rates of up to 80% in challenging train-test mismatch scenarios.

</details>


### [527] [Non-asymptotic Convergence of Average-reward Q-learning with Options](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20347)
*Kintan Saha,Ahana Deb,Anders Jonsson,Debabrota Basu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次为平均奖励设置下的选项Q学习算法（inter-option与intra-option）建立了均方意义下 $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ 的有限样本收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选项（options）允许延长与层次化动作，平均奖励设置可处理持续任务，但此前缺乏平均奖励选项Q学习的有限样本收敛分析。

Method: 证明inter-/intra-option Bellman算子满足多步span收缩（unichain假设），提出其同步估计量以得到两种选项Q学习变体，并扩展随机逼近框架进行收敛率分析。

Result: 在文献中最小假设下，证明了两种算法在均方意义下达到 $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ 的收敛速率。

Conclusion: 首次为平均奖励选项Q学习提供有限样本收敛保证，统一覆盖inter-option与intra-option两种设置。

Abstract: We study the finite-sample convergence of Q-learning algorithms for the average-reward formulation of Reinforcement Learning (RL) with options. While options allow temporarily extended and hierarchical actions, the average-reward formulation incorporates continual tasks beyond discounted and episodic RL. We establish the first $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ convergence guarantees, in the mean-square sense, for average-reward option Q-learning algorithms in both the inter- and intra-option settings. First, we prove that both inter- and intra-option Bellman operators satisfy multi-step span contractions under unichain assumptions. Then, we propose synchronous estimators of these multi-step option Bellman operators leading to two variants of option Q-learning. Finally, we extend the stochastic approximation framework to prove convergence rates of these two algorithms under the minimal assumptions used in the literature.

</details>


### [528] [NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20349)
*Yaozhi Wen,Kun Zhao,Wei Wei,Haoyang Chen,Kangning Wang,Yi Sun,Shaowei Gu,Dingkun Liu,Shuang Qiu,Huiguang He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeuroDETR，一个离散时空多尺度框架，用于从连续EEG中异步检测事件类别及时域边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步EEG事件检测无需预设事件边界即可识别事件，但其难点在于从持续背景活动中提取事件相关模式。

Method: NeuroDETR结合结构化tokenization与事件感知特征细化：多尺度时域codebook捕捉短暂响应与持续动态，Spatial-Pyramid VQ分层编码通道空间结构，形成紧凑事件记忆以联合分类事件并估计起止时间；在tokenization前使用FOCAL稀疏注意力模块，利用预测的事件存在性引导时域特征细化与空间聚合。

Result: 在覆盖多种范式的八个EEG数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: 为在连续交互与监测中识别有意义神经活动的BCI系统开发提供了基础。

Abstract: Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. Before tokenization, we apply FOCAL, an event-aware sparse attention module that uses predicted event presence to guide temporal feature refinement and spatial aggregation, emphasizing likely event periods while preserving context across the recording. Experiments on eight EEG datasets that span diverse paradigms demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These findings provide a basis for the development of BCI systems that recognize meaningful neural activity during continuous interaction and monitoring.

</details>


### [529] [Beyond Expert Rankings: Contrast Calibration for Mixed-Precision MoE Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20353)
*Renjie Xie,Juncheng Yang,Aoting Hu,Yan Liang,Mingxi Zhang,Zheheng Hong,Wei Xu,Yanzhi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NatScale，一种对比校准的混合精度MoE量化分配框架，通过幂变换校准专家权重并联合评估误差，在9个设置中取得最低KL散度与最高token一致率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型每token仅激活少量专家但需存储全部专家权重。混合精度量化可按专家敏感度分配比特，但仅凭专家排序无法确定误差应加权多强，存在排序与权重强度脱节的空白。

Method: NatScale用模型特定的幂变换将基于梯度的专家权重校准到信息论对比目标，同时保持排序；联合评估每个专家的gate、up、down配置估计输出误差；再结合误差、校准权重与基于权重谱、方差和精度衰减的先验，在存储预算下选择配置。

Result: 在三个模型、全部九个设置中，NatScale相对五个分配基线取得最低native-to-quantized KL散度和最高top-token一致率；在七个设置中取得最低困惑度。

Conclusion: 结果凸显目标感知精度分配的重要性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models activate only a few experts per token, yet all expert weights must be stored. Mixed-precision quantization reduces this storage cost by assigning higher bit-widths to sensitive experts and lower bit-widths to resilient ones, but expert rankings alone do not determine how strongly to weight their errors. To address this gap, we propose NatScale, a contrast-calibrated allocation framework for mixed-precision MoE quantization. It uses a model-specific power transformation to calibrate gradient-based expert weights to an information-theoretic contrast target while preserving rankings. We jointly evaluate each expert's gate, up and down configurations to estimate its output error. We then combine these errors and calibrated weights with an existing prior based on weight spectra, variance and precision decay to select configurations under a storage budget. Across three models, NatScale achieves the lowest native-to-quantized KL divergence and the highest top-token agreement in all nine settings against five allocation baselines. It also yields the lowest perplexity in seven settings. These findings highlight the importance of objective-aware precision allocation.

</details>


### [530] [Fractional is Better: Learnable Derivative Orders in Neural Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20363)
*Fares B. Mehouachi,Saif Eddin Jabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出∂-NO（del-NO），一种架构无关的增强方法，通过向神经算子提供可学习的分数阶导数特征来改进PDE求解，并从理论上刻画了最优导数阶与PDE阶之间的偏差-方差权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子虽架构多样，但普遍使用原始坐标-值对(x, u(x))作为输入，忽略了PDE的微分结构。作者希望通过引入与微分结构对齐的输入特征来提升学习效果。

Method: 通过温和解的Picard迭代分析，证明输入导数显式出现在解算子中；从理论上推导导数特征对逼近界的改善；提出∂-NO增强，为任意神经算子主干提供可学习的分数阶导数特征；并通过谱空间偏差-方差权衡的闭式刻画来确定最优导数阶β*，同时支持从数据中学习β以实现自动谱正则化。

Result: 理论证明提供导数特征可将逼近界从O(W^{-(s-m)/d})提升到O(W^{-s/d})；核心意外发现是最优导数阶β*严格小于PDE阶m；在多个基准问题和架构上，∂-NO一致提升预测精度，且学到的阶数反映了受噪声与有限样本约束调制的已知物理表征。

Conclusion: 导数增强特征能有效降低网络的隐式微分负担，∂-NO作为通用增强方法可显著提升神经算子性能，其学习到的导数阶具有物理与统计双重意义。

Abstract: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, enabling fast surrogate solutions to partial differential equations. Despite remarkable architectural diversity, these methods often share a common input representation: raw coordinate-value pairs $(x, u(x))$. We ask whether inputs aligned with PDE differential structure can improve learning. Through Picard iteration on mild solutions, we show that derivatives of the input appear explicitly in the solution operator, suggesting that providing derivative features should reduce the network's implicit differentiation burden. We prove this intuition: providing derivative features improves approximation bounds from $O(W^{-(s-m)/d})$ to $O(W^{-s/d})$, where $W$ is parameter count, $s$ is input regularity, $m$ is the PDE order, and $d$ is spatial dimension. Our central finding, however, is a surprise: the optimal derivative order $β^*$ is strictly less than the PDE order $m$. This gap arises from a bias-variance tradeoff in spectral space that we characterize in closed form. Learning $β$ from data achieves automatic spectral regularization. We introduce $\partial$-NO (del-NO), for derivative-augmented neural operators, an architecture-agnostic augmentation that provides learnable fractional derivative features to any neural operator backbone. Across benchmark problems and architectures, $\partial$-NO consistently improves prediction accuracy, with learned orders that reflect a representation of known physics modulated by noise and finite-sample constraints.

</details>


### [531] [ReAl: Refine neural operators via aligning dynamical flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20369)
*Jing Xu,Zenglin Xu,Li Yi,Ruoxi Jiang,Yuan Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReAl，一种模型无关的即插即用模块，通过条件流匹配学习残差分布并配合轨迹级奖励对齐，增强预训练PDE代理，提升高频保真度与长期稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于MSE训练的神经PDE代理能捕获主导动力学，但丢失高频信息与精细结构；生成模型虽能捕捉细尺度分布，但其随机误差在自回归展开中累积，破坏长期稳定性。

Method: ReAl分两阶段：精化阶段用条件流匹配模型学习确定性基础预测周围的残差分布，恢复缺失的精细结构并保留主导动力学；对齐阶段针对混沌系统中自回归放大的生成偏差，从同一输入生成多条轨迹，用轨迹级奖励强化精化器，实现长时程动力学对齐。

Result: 在多种代理架构和PDE任务上的实验表明，ReAl一致提升了高频保真度、预测精度和长时程稳定性。

Conclusion: ReAl作为通用插件可有效弥补MSE代理与生成方法各自的不足，兼具细尺度重建与长期稳定预测能力。

Abstract: Neural partial differential equation (PDE) surrogates trained with mean squared error (MSE) can capture dominant dynamics but often lose high-frequency information and fine-scale structures. Generative models (e.g., Flow Matching) can capture the distribution of fine-scale details, yet stochastic errors may accumulate during autoregressive rollouts and compromise long-term stability. To address these limitations, we introduce Refine and Align(ReAl), a model-agnostic plug-in that augments pretrained PDE surrogates to improve the reconstruction of high-frequency structures associated with complex physical phenomena. In the refinement stage, a conditional flow-matching model learns the residual distribution around the deterministic base prediction, recovering missing fine-scale structures while retaining the dominant dynamics. In the alignment stage, to mitigate the generative discrepancies amplified in the autoregressive rollout, particularly in chaotic systems, we generate multiple trajectories from the same input and reinforce the refiner with trajectory-level rewards, thereby achieving long-horizon dynamical alignment. Experiments across diverse surrogate architectures and PDE tasks demonstrate that ReAl consistently improves high-frequency fidelity, forecasting accuracy, and long-horizon stability.

</details>


### [532] [From Human Corrections to Learned Segmentations: A Critical Mathematical Review of Information, Learning, and Human Effort](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20396)
*Jon Sporring*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇批判性叙述综述，用统一的数学框架（目标信息、预测误差、响应可预测性、人工工作量）梳理反馈在"选择-学习更新-评估"全流程中的作用，比较主动学习、机器教学、交互式分割与序列预测评估，主张区分"预测教师响应""识别人类意图""实现更好分割"三类不同论断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类修正何时能转化为有用学习、在相同人工代价下如何实现更好分割，这两个问题缺乏统一的分析视角，现有研究常混淆响应协议、更新机制与工作量分母，也混淆模拟交互与真实人类证据。

Method: 采用批判性叙述综述，建立共同数学表述：用精确贝叶斯更新将评估标签信息转为期望对数损失改进；用超额风险分解刻画近似学习者的损失；用条件信息分解分离被选位置、标签与展示上下文的作用。在此框架下对比主动学习、机器教学、交互式分割、序列预测评估。

Result: 实证比较表明响应协议、更新机制与工作量分母对结论有实质影响，可将"当前掩码精修"与"可复用学习"、"模拟交互"与"人类证据"区分开；同时明确日志能揭示什么、什么需要独立评估、什么仍依赖模型假设。

Conclusion: 未来研究重点是在匹配工作量下检验：选择揭示了什么、利用它是否改善同化、所得交互策略是否提升分割效果。这三者是不同论断——预测教师响应不必然识别人类意图，也不必然带来更好学习。本文不提出新采集算法，也不声称经验优越性。

Abstract: When does a human correction become useful learning, and what establishes better segmentation at matched human effort? This critical narrative review follows feedback through its selection, learner update, and evaluation. It compares active learning, machine teaching, interactive segmentation, and sequential predictive evaluation using a common mathematical account of target information, predictive error, response predictability, and human work. An exact Bayesian update converts evaluation-label information into expected log-loss improvement; an excess-risk decomposition explains what an approximate learner can lose. Conditional information decompositions separate the roles of selected locations, labels, and displayed context. Empirical comparisons show why response protocols, update mechanisms, and effort denominators matter, distinguishing current-mask refinement from reusable learning and simulated interaction from human evidence. We identify what logs can reveal, what requires independent evaluation, and what remains model-dependent. The resulting research priorities are to test what selection reveals, whether using it improves assimilation, and whether the resulting interaction policy benefits segmentation at matched effort. These are distinct claims: predicting a teacher's responses need not identify human intentions or establish better learning. No new acquisition algorithm or empirical superiority is claimed.

</details>


### [533] [Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20401)
*Daman Arora,Xuecheng Liu,Himanshu Gaurav Singh,Fahim Tajwar,Abitha Thankaraj,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Haiwen Feng,Yuda Song,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出GracefulRL，通过重塑优化景观，用结果级奖励信号训练模型"优雅失败"——即在可靠时保持成功行为，在不可靠时执行安全回退策略，无需回退标注或推理时的验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习提升语言模型任务能力的同时也奖励"猜测"：当成功是唯一奖励来源时，选择安全回退总不如冒险一搏，而当错误操作可能损坏数据库或发布错误代码时，这种激励代价高昂。因此需要让模型学会优雅失败。

Method: 直接用策略梯度结合回退行为的中间奖励会因不利的优化动态而脆弱。GracefulRL通过重塑优化景观来促进优雅失败，并且该行为直接源自结果级奖励信号，无需指定何时回退的标注，也不需要验证器等推理时机制。

Result: 在多种任务和规模上训练出的模型基本保持了原有任务解决能力，同时能在行为不可靠时选择性地回退。

Conclusion: 结果表明强化学习不仅能激励模型追求成功，还能让模型推理自身能力边界，并在判断成功无望时改变策略。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifier. Across a range of tasks and scales, we train models that largely preserve their task-solving capability while selectively falling back when acting would be unreliable. More broadly, our results show that reinforcement learning can not only incentivize models to succeed, but also to reason about the limits of their capabilities and change course when they determine that success is out of reach.

</details>


### [534] [Hyperspherical Contrastive Representations Unlock Planning and Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20409)
*Jonghae Park,Sungil Son,Jonghun Shin,Junseo Lee,H. Jin Kim,Benjamin Eysenbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 C-Slerp，一种自监督强化学习方法，利用对比表征作为可复用构建块，通过球面线性插值在闭式解中推断中间路点，堆叠最多八个方块，并在长程导航与机器人操作任务中取得显著成效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在长程任务中通常依赖先验数据、奖励、演示或预训练模型，且需要单独的高层策略或图搜索来规划路点，效率低且难以适应任务难度。作者希望实现从零开始的自监督学习，并让规划过程简洁、可复用且自适应。

Method: C-Slerp（Contrastive Planning via Spherical Linear Interpolation）将对比学习得到的表征作为可复用的构建块，反复组合以推断中间路点序列。在超球面参数化下，学习到的表征可通过球面线性插值以闭式解推断中间路点，无需额外训练高层策略或进行图搜索；表征几何还指导根据目标难度调整路点数量。

Result: 实验显示，该方法在长程导航和机器人操作任务中均成功，包括一些强基线无法取得单次成功的场景。消融实验表明，使用固定数量路点会显著降低性能，说明自适应难度规划的重要性。

Conclusion: C-Slerp 通过对比表征与球面线性插值实现了高效、自适应的长程规划，避免了高层策略与图搜索，并验证了按任务难度调整路点数量的必要性，为无先验数据的自监督强化学习提供新思路。

Abstract: We develop a self-supervised reinforcement learning algorithm that learns to build towers of up to eight cubes from scratch, without prior data, rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models. Our method, Contrastive Planning via Spherical Linear Interpolation (C-Slerp), uses contrastive representations as reusable building blocks and repeatedly composes them to infer a sequence of intermediate waypoints. Under our hyperspherical parameterization, the learned representations allow intermediate waypoints to be inferred in closed form through spherical linear interpolation, without training a separate high-level policy or performing graph search. Importantly, the representation geometry also tells us how to adjust the number of waypoints based on the difficulty of each goal-reaching problem. Experiments show that our method succeeds on long-horizon navigation and robotic manipulation tasks, including settings where strong baselines fail to achieve a single success. Ablations further show that using a fixed number of waypoints substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of adapting the plan to task difficulty.

</details>


### [535] [When Does Momentum Help in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20413)
*Kaifei Wang,Zikang Shan,Liwei Wang,Yinyu Ye,Han Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过bandit建模RLVR，理论证明并实验验证：增大EMA动量系数β在一定范围内可加速优化并提升LLM后训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期实证工作质疑一阶动量在带可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)中的有效性，本文旨在从理论与实验角度重新审视动量的作用。

Method: 采用RLVR的bandit建模，使用带偏差修正的指数移动平均(EMA)动量，分析精确策略梯度与采样估计梯度两种情况，并在Qwen3-4B-Base与Qwen2.5-32B上进行实验验证。

Result: 精确梯度下，增大β在避免过冲的范围内严格加速优化；采样梯度下，保持η/(1-β)在安全区间可获得非消失增益。Qwen2.5-32B上增大β₁使平均验证准确率提升近2个百分点。

Conclusion: 在实用LLM后训练中应选择较大的动量系数，该原则在大规模模型上同样有效。

Abstract: Momentum is a classical tool for accelerating convex optimization and a standard component of modern large language model training. Yet recent empirical work has questioned the usefulness of first-moment momentum in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We study this question through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) momentum, where the EMA coefficient $β$ controls how quickly the weights on past gradients decay. When policy gradients are evaluated exactly, we prove that increasing $β$ within a range that prevents overshoot strictly accelerates optimization. When gradients are estimated from sampled responses, a positive expected gain can be obscured by sampling fluctuations. We show that as the learning rate $η$ decreases, the expected gain with fixed $β$ vanishes faster than these fluctuations, whereas increasing $β$ to keep $η/(1-β)$ within the safe regime preserves a nonvanishing gain that eventually dominates them. Bandit simulations quantitatively validate these predictions. RLVR experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base using SGD with EMA and AdamW support our principle of choosing larger coefficients in practical LLM post-training. On Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, simply increasing $β_1$ improves mean validation accuracy by nearly $2$ percentage points over the conventional choice, demonstrating the principle's effectiveness at a larger model scale.

</details>


### [536] [One Size Does Not Fit All: Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20415)
*Alessia Rossi,Felipe Campelo,Gabriel L. Oliveira*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAP-SAM 将 SAM 的固定扰动半径重新解释为扰动信号强度，并根据曲率（sharpness ratio）自适应调制半径，在保持与 SAM 相同收敛率的同时提升泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 依赖固定扰动半径 ρ，忽略局部曲率：ρ 过小难以逃离尖锐极小值构成的差区域，ρ 过大又无法收敛到损失-尖锐度权衡良好的解，导致效率低下。

Method: 提出 Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM（CAP-SAM），一种几何感知方法，将 ρ 视为扰动信号强度，并基于 sharpness ratio 自适应调制扰动半径，以更有效地在损失曲面上搜索鲁棒极小值。

Result: 证明 CAP-SAM 在非凸随机设定下保持与标准 SAM 相同的收敛率；在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上，跨多种网络结构持续优于 SAM 及其主要变体。

Conclusion: 通过曲率感知的自适应扰动半径，CAP-SAM 在理论与实验上均优于固定半径的 SAM，兼顾收敛性与泛化性能。

Abstract: Poor generalisation in deep neural networks is frequently associated with convergence to sharp minima. Sharpness-Aware Minimisation (SAM) improves generalisation of deep neural networks by minimising a combination of the training loss and the local sharpness of the loss landscape, biasing convergence towards flat minima. However, SAM relies on a fixed perturbation radius $ρ$ that ignores local curvature, leading to inefficient behaviour: the perturbation may be too small to escape poor basins defined by sharp local minima, or too large to allow convergence to solutions with good loss-sharpness tradeoff. We reinterpret $ρ$ as the intensity of the perturbation signal and propose Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM (CAP-SAM), a geometry-aware method that modulates the perturbation radius based on a sharpness ratio, enabling a more effective search for robust minima on the loss landscape. We prove that CAP-SAM preserves the same convergence rate as standard SAM in non-convex stochastic settings. Extensive experiments indicate that our approach consistently outperforms SAM and its most prominent variants across diverse network architectures on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.

</details>


### [537] [Tracking a Small Set of Experts in Online Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20416)
*Angelos Assos,Anand Brahmbhatt,Elad Hazan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线凸优化中"切换k次专家"问题，证明计算低效性是本质的：在超图种植团猜想下，任何多项式时间算法在最坏情况下至少需承受 (k√d)^{1-o(1)} 的后悔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Freund 提出能否与仅切换 k 次、只使用 m 个专家的比较器竞争。离散专家情形已由 Bousquet-Warmuth (2020) 用高效最优算法解决。本文将该问题推广到连续动作空间的在线凸优化，考察信息论最优与多项式时间可达后悔之间的差距。

Method: 将动作空间离散化后套用 Bousquet-Warmuth 算法可得 O~(md+k) 的（非高效）后悔，而已知最优高效算法后悔为 O~(dk)。作者通过归约，在超图种植团猜想（hypergraphic planted-clique conjecture）假设下证明计算下界。

Result: 在超图种植团猜想下，证明对任意多项式时间算法，存在实例使其后悔至少为 (k√d)^{1-o(1)}。

Conclusion: 该计算低效性是内在的，信息论最优后悔与多项式时间可达后悔之间存在本质分离。

Abstract: For the fundamental problem of prediction from expert advice, Freund asked whether one could compete with a comparator that switches $k$ times among only $m$ experts. For a discrete set of experts, this problem was resolved by Bousquet and Warmuth (2020), who gave an efficient algorithm with optimal regret matching the information-theoretic limit.
  We study the analogous problem in online convex optimization, where the action space is continuous. An inefficient algorithm can be derived by discretizing the action space and applying the Bousquet--Warmuth algorithm, giving regret of $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$, while the best known efficient algorithm for this problem has regret $\widetilde{O}(dk)$. We show that this computational inefficiency is inherent, establishing a separation between the information-theoretic and polynomial-time regret achievable for this problem. Specifically, under the hypergraphic planted-clique conjecture, we show that for every polynomial-time algorithm there exist instances for which it incurs at least $(k\sqrt d)^{1-o(1)}$ regret.

</details>


### [538] [OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20418)
*Mohamed Bouadi,Nassim Bouarour,Aditya Tanna,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出紧凑型表格基础模型 OrionMoE-Small，结合分布感知表示与数据集条件稀疏专家混合，在合成分类任务上预训练，无需梯度适配即可进行下游预测，性能媲美更大型模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型多依赖密集架构，对所有特征和数据集施加相同变换，难以适应异构表格问题，计算效率与自适应性不足。

Method: 基于双轴 Transformer 架构，沿特征轴选择性激活专家，路由决策同时由单特征表示和整体数据集上下文决定，实现数据集条件下的稀疏混合专家计算，同时保留跨任务共享计算路径。完全在结构化因果先验生成的合成分类任务上预训练。

Result: 多个表格基准上，性能可与显著更大的基础模型竞争，在小上下文和高维数据集上表现尤为突出；在类别不平衡下相对性能良好，并凸显特征组成的重要性。

Conclusion: 分布感知表示与数据集条件稀疏专家计算可在紧凑模型下实现强表格预测能力，无需任务特定参数更新或梯度适配，为高效表格基础模型提供可行路径。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis Transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts along the feature axis, with routing decisions informed by both individual feature representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. OrionMoE-Small is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. Experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models, with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. Further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.

</details>


### [539] [Continual Learning for Reliable In-Sequence Molecular Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20426)
*Siddhant Setia,Junichi Suzuki,Tadashi Nakano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Affine Memory Replay (AMR)，一种基于持续学习的仿真方法，用于增量评估分子通信协议性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子通信中生物纳米机器需按序交换分子编码信息，需要可靠的在序通信。随着实验设置复杂度逐渐增加，如何增量评估通信协议性能成为问题。

Method: AMR构建持续学习模型估计纳米机器间通信性能，存储历史仿真样本，并通过插值与外推合成额外回放样本。在增量性能估计任务中，回放历史与合成样本以正则化模型更新，使模型适应新设置同时保留旧知识。

Result: 实验表明，AMR在顺序学习的估计任务中，整体估计准确率显著优于现有持续学习方法，在适中训练成本下有效平衡记忆稳定性与学习可塑性。

Conclusion: AMR为分子通信协议的增量性能评估提供了有效方案，兼顾稳定性与可塑性。

Abstract: This paper considers reliable in-sequence molecular communication, where bio-nanomachines exchange molecule-encoded information in a specified order, and investigates a new simulation-based method to incrementally evaluate communication protocols by gradually increasing the complexity of experimental settings. The proposed method, called Affine Memory Replay (AMR), builds a continual learning (CL) model to estimate communication performance between bio-nanomachines. AMR stores past simulation samples and synthesizes additional replay samples through interpolation and extrapolation between past samples. Through incremental performance estimation tasks, it replays both past and synthetic samples to regularize model updates, helping the model adapt to new experimental settings while retaining knowledge from earlier ones. Experimental results show that AMR significantly outperforms existing CL methods in maintaining overall estimation accuracy across sequentially learned estimation tasks. It effectively balances memory stability and learning plasticity under moderate training cost.

</details>


### [540] [The Accuracy Well: Nonmonotone Accuracy Dynamics at Vanishing Initialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20439)
*Yaroslav Gusev,Eugene Golikov,Dmitry Yarotsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了小初始化下的分类动力学，发现并命名为"准确率井"（accuracy well）的非单调现象：准确率在训练早期快速上升后显著下降，很久之后才恢复。作者在三阶段解释框架下为该现象建立了严格理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分类准确率与训练损失之间的关系常被默认同步，但小初始化下两者可能严重脱节。作者希望揭示准确率所反映的、训练损失无法捕捉的学习动力学方面。

Method: 作者在深层线性网络、MNIST 上的全连接 ReLU 网络、CIFAR-10 上的深度卷积网络及合成任务中观测该现象，覆盖不同损失、优化器和训练/测试准确率。提出"目标驱动组织—退化瓶颈—募集与恢复"三阶段解释，并对浅层与深层线性网络建立严格理论，另构造合成二分类任务进行证明。

Result: 观测到准确率早升、中降、后恢复的普遍非单调行为。理论上证明高准确率可在预测器和损失变化均渐近消失时出现，随后准确率退化；在简单合成分类任务中证明准确率渐近升至 100%、崩塌至 0、最终永久恢复到 100% 的极端情形。

Conclusion: 分类准确率能揭示训练损失无法体现的学习动力学特征，仅以损失评估训练过程可能产生误导。

Abstract: We study classification dynamics under small initialization and identify a pronounced non-monotone behavior of accuracy that we call the accuracy well: accuracy rises rapidly early in training, subsequently drops, and only much later recovers. We observe this phenomenon in deep linear networks, fully connected ReLU networks on MNIST, deep convolutional networks on CIFAR-10, and controlled synthetic tasks, across different losses and optimizers and in both training and test accuracy. We propose a three-stage explanation in terms of target-driven organization, a degeneracy bottleneck, and subsequent recruitment and recovery. We develop a rigorous theory of these dynamics for shallow and deep linear networks, showing in particular that high accuracy can emerge while the predictor and the change in loss remain asymptotically vanishing, before continued optimization causes accuracy to deteriorate. For a simple synthetic classification task, we prove an extreme instance in which accuracy asymptotically rises to 100%, collapses to 0, and later recovers permanently to 100%. Our results show that classification accuracy can reveal aspects of learning dynamics that are not captured by the training loss alone.

</details>


### [541] [Learning by Examples: Power Grid Steady State Analysis with a Tabular Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20462)
*Olayiwola Arowolo,Oluwadara Adedeji,Peter Palensky,Jochen L. Cremer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探究预训练表格基础模型 TabPFN 能否作为电力系统稳态分析的通用神经求解器，在潮流预测、N-k 故障筛选和电压稳定裕度预测任务上，无需微调即可匹配或超越任务专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在科学领域泛化性强，但在电力系统中应用多为任务专用，缺乏通用性。

Method: 使用预训练 TFM（TabPFN），在 118 与 2000 节点系统上评估三个任务：潮流预测、N-k 故障筛选、电压稳定裕度预测，并与任务专用神经基线对比，且不进行重训练或微调。

Result: 118 节点潮流预测电压幅值误差 1×10⁻³ pu、相角 0.30°；N-1 及接近不可行潮流情形下与 DCPF 近似相当；百万级 N-2 情形下支路/电压越限 AUC 达 0.92/0.95；2000 节点 VSM 在小样本下仍准确。

Conclusion: 尽管未使用电力系统专用数据预训练且无需微调，TFM 在多项电网分析任务上表现优异，展现其作为通用神经求解器的潜力。

Abstract: Foundation models have shown strong generalization across scientific domains, but their use in power systems remains largely task-specific. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TFM), TabPFN, can serve as a general-purpose neural solver for power grid steady-state analysis. We evaluate the TFM on three tasks: power flow (PF) prediction, N-k contingency screening (NCS), and voltage stability margin (VSM) prediction. We performed experiments on 118- and 2000-bus systems, comparing the TFM against task-specific neural baselines. Without retraining or fine-tuning, the TFM matches or outperforms the best task-specific model in several settings across the three tasks. For 118-bus PF prediction, a variant of the TFM achieves errors of $1\times 10^{-3}$ pu for voltage magnitudes and $0.30^\circ$ for voltage angles, outperforming all baselines. On unseen N-1 contingency and close-to-infeasible PF cases, the TFM is competitive with the DCPF approximation. For millions of unseen N-2 contingencies, the TFM achieves AUCs of 0.92 and 0.95 for branch and voltage violation screening, respectively. The TFM also attains accurate VSM prediction performance for the 2000-bus system with limited labelled data. The TFM attains strong results across the tested tasks despite pretraining without any power-system-specific dataset and requiring no fine-tuning step. These results offer a glimpse into the potential of pretrained TFMs as a neural solver for a range of power grid analysis tasks.

</details>


### [542] [Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN): An Analysis of Adaptive Action Grids in Decoupled Q-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20463)
*Parham Nooranbakht,Seyed Mahdi Basiri Azad,Joschka Bödecker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性增长Q网络(SGQN)，用自适应动作网格替代均匀增长，在DMControl任务上表现竞争性，并分析哪些成分真正重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于价值的Q学习用于连续控制时需离散化动作空间，但离散分辨率在早期探索与最终精度之间存在权衡。原有的增长式Q网络(GQN)从粗到细均匀增长分辨率，可能并非最优。

Method: SGQN保持解耦Q学习，用自适应动作网格替代均匀增长：在高估计Q值的bin旁添加bin，剪除低Q值的bin，动作采用ε-greedy选择。

Result: 在8个DMControl任务(2-12维动作)上，SGQN在4个任务上最终回报最高，3个任务上距最佳方法不足1.1%，Walker Run上比Bang-Bang MPO低3.4%，平均每维使用9个bin中的7.5个。消融显示自适应网格并非主因：增长激活所有候选bin如同均匀增长，去除剪枝影响至多1.1%。真正重要的是从粗网格开始(全9 bin会导致种子崩溃)和ε-greedy选择(退火softmax使回报降低23%-100%)。

Conclusion: SGQN对增长和剪枝超参数不敏感。它与其他基线还存在未控制的差异(如每步一次而非每八步一次梯度更新)，因此其优势不归因于单一组件。作者将SGQN定位为竞争性的价值型方法，并作为对增长式动作网格中关键成分的分析。

Abstract: Value-based Q-learning for continuous control can discretise the action space, but the resolution of the discretisation trades early exploration against final precision. Growing Q-Networks (GQN) grow the resolution uniformly from coarse to fine. We introduce Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN), which keeps decoupled Q-learning and replaces uniform growth with an adaptive action grid: bins are added next to bins with high estimated Q-value, bins with low Q-value are pruned, and actions are chosen epsilon-greedily. On eight DeepMind Control Suite (DMControl) tasks with 2 to 12 action dimensions, SGQN has the highest mean final return among the compared methods on four, is within 1.1% of the best method on three more, and is 3.4% below Bang-Bang MPO on Walker Run, using on average 7.5 of 9 available bins per dimension. We then test whether the adaptive grid explains these results, and find that it does not. Growth activates every candidate bin and behaves like uniform growth, and removing pruning changes the return by at most 1.1%. Two other choices matter: starting from a coarse grid, since starting with all 9 bins produces collapsed seeds, and epsilon-greedy selection, since an annealed softmax lowers the return by 23% to 100%. SGQN is insensitive to its growth and pruning hyperparameters. It also differs from the GQN and DecQN baselines in other respects, notably one gradient update per environment step instead of one per eight, which we did not control for, so we do not attribute its advantage to a single component. We present SGQN as a competitive value-based method and as an analysis of which ingredients of a growing action grid matter.

</details>


### [543] [Decoupled Marginal Sharpening for Training-Free Inference-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20483)
*Weixin Wang,Wei Deng,Anderson Schneider,Yuriy Nevmyvaka,Pan Xu,Andrew Bennett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DMS方法，在推理时无需更新权重或外部奖励模型，通过解耦推理路径与答案边际的锐化来改进LLM推理，结合全自适应退火SMC采样，在多任务上取得最优pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有reward-free power-sampling方法存在两大问题：目标层面对全序列锐化会使概率集中于少数精确轨迹，抑制支持同一答案的其他路径；采样层面有限粒子SMC反复重采样导致路径坍缩。

Method: DMS先对推理分布锐化采样，再对答案概率在推理种群上做加权边际化并锐化答案边际，用独立指数分别控制探索与聚合集中。采样上用Fully Adapted Annealed SMC，结合退火power目标序列、局部全自适应提议与预测性祖先重采样。

Result: 在MATH500、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、AIME24/25及三个基础模型上，DMS在全部任务中取得最高平均pass@1。

Conclusion: 通过解耦推理路径与答案边际的锐化强度并改进SMC采样器，可在推理时有效提升LLM推理性能，避免传统power-sampling的路径坍缩与多样性损失。

Abstract: We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models. Recent reward-free power-sampling methods define the sequence-level power target $π_α(y\mid x)\propto p_0(y\mid x)^α$, where $α>1$, which increases the relative probability of completions that are already likely under the base model. Existing methods use Metropolis--Hastings or Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to approximately sample from this target. However, two challenges arise at different levels. At the target level, full-sequence sharpening can concentrate probability on a few exact reasoning--answer trajectories, suppressing alternative paths that support the same answer. At the sampler level, finite-particle SMC can suffer from path collapse when resampling repeatedly duplicates a few high-weight prefixes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Marginal Sharpening (DMS), which separately controls how strongly the model favors particular reasoning paths and how strongly it favors final answers after aggregating support across those paths. At the target level, DMS first samples from a sharpened reasoning distribution, then marginalizes the model's answer probabilities over the resulting weighted reasoning population and sharpens the induced answer marginal. Separate exponents allow mild reasoning sharpening to encourage exploration of diverse paths, followed by stronger answer-marginal sharpening to concentrate probability on answers with greater aggregate support across those paths. At the sampler level, we develop Fully Adapted Annealed SMC, which combines an annealed sequence of power targets with locally fully adapted proposals and predictive ancestor resampling. Experiments on MATH500, GPQA-Diamond, HumanEval, and AIME24/25 across three base models show that DMS achieves the highest mean pass@1 among the compared methods in all tasks.

</details>


### [544] [Average-Reward Policy Identification from a Single Continuing Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20486)
*Tongxi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究平均奖励强化学习中单轨迹探索，证明通过自适应信息收集，单轨迹学习在最坏情况下与无限制访问样本的难度相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为，从单条轨迹学习需要额外时间在状态间导航，因此比能自由采样任意状态-动作对的方法需要更多经验。作者质疑这种导航成本是否必然存在。

Method: 针对平均奖励RL，设计一种算法，在收集信息的同时学习在何处收集信息，确保所需样本能被高效获取；并将信息收集需求与环境提供信息的方式相适应。

Result: 建立了识别近最优策略所需交互次数的上界；进一步证明了匹配的信息论下界，表明对广泛环境类别和足够高精度，单轨迹学习在最坏情况下不比无限制访问状态-动作样本更难。

Conclusion: 导航带来的额外复杂度成本可以通过自适应信息收集需求加以避免，挑战了单轨迹学习必然更难的直觉。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning, an agent must explore an unknown environment to learn how to make good decisions. Unlike methods that can freely sample any state--action pair, an agent learning from a single trajectory must spend additional time navigating between states. It is therefore natural to expect that learning from a single trajectory requires more experience. In this paper, we show that this additional cost is not always necessary. For average-reward reinforcement learning, we develop an algorithm that learns where to collect information while ensuring that the required samples can be obtained efficiently. We establish an upper bound on the number of interactions needed to identify a near-optimal policy. Furthermore, we prove a matching information theoretic lower bound, showing that, for a broad class of environments and at sufficiently high accuracy, learning from a single trajectory is no harder in the worst case than learning with unrestricted access to state action samples. Our results reveal that the additional complexity cost of navigation can be avoided by adapting information gathering requirements to how the environment provides information.

</details>


### [545] [Hindsight-Privileged RLVR: Single-Rollout Token Credit Without Group Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20497)
*Wei Chen,Yubing Wu,Zhou Xu,Haoyue Zhang,Delu Zeng,Jiahao Wang,Junmei Yang,Pan tiewen,Jingfeng Liu,Zhiheng Zhou,Bo Li,Min Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HP-RLVR，一种单次采样方法，利用轨迹自身未来信息生成token级奖励权重，解决GRPO在组内奖励相同时学习信号消失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR难以将终末奖励分配给单个推理token；GRPO等组相对方法在同组尝试结果全同时会丢失基于奖励的学习信号。

Method: 单次采样：用生成策略快照在因果历史和含未来结果与验证反馈的后见上下文下分别给token打分，以归一化Jensen-Shannon散度作为相对历史基线的奖励权重，产生有界token信用，无需参考解或学习评论家。

Result: 在共享100步训练下，Qwen3-8B上HP-RLVR比GRPO分别快1.21倍（数学）、1.46倍（代码）、2.30倍（ALFWorld），每提示采样量仅为1/8；整体准确率相当，数学占优，代码与ALFWorld GRPO略优。ALFWorld中GRPO有43.2%(4B)和49.0%(8B)梯度范数为零，HP-RLVR没有。

Conclusion: HP-RLVR通过后见之明提供密集token信用，显著提升训练效率并避免零梯度问题。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. In paired Qwen3-8B runs over a shared $100$-step schedule, HP-RLVR trains $1.21\times$, $1.46\times$, and $2.30\times$ faster than GRPO on mathematics, code generation, and ALFWorld, using one eighth the rollouts per prompt. Accuracy is comparable overall, with HP-RLVR ahead on mathematics at all three sizes and GRPO ahead on code and ALFWorld. In ALFWorld, $43.2\%$ (4B) and $49.0\%$ (8B) of GRPO's gradient-norm records are zero, versus none for HP-RLVR.

</details>


### [546] [Graph-Enhanced Disease Trajectory Discovery and Temporal Endpoint Forecasting from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20502)
*Jin-Jia Zheng,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图增强框架，从MIMIC-IV构建分支motif并用时间感知Transformer做事件时间预测，主要价值在于长程时序支持而非提升判别或生存预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向EHR蕴含疾病进展结构，但有效预测需控制数据泄漏、处理删失结局并提供可检查的轨迹证据。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV v3.1中先划分患者再构图，仅用训练集学习连续入院转移，冻结验证集选出的分支motif策略；共得99,527个motif，时间感知Transformer通过端点特定交叉注意力为每个端点检索≤24个患者兼容motif。

Result: 五个种子下micro-AUPRC由0.9330升至0.9357，事件时间MAE由676.9降至657.7天（减少19.2天，95%CI 13.8-24.8）。730天内事件MAE变差，730天后改善58.9天。分支条件化降低条件MAE 26.9天（95%CI 23.0-30.8），但无更好micro-AUPRC；生存评价未显示优于history-only离散风险模型；GNN修复改善未见边发现但未提升下游预测。

Conclusion: 分支motif应被定位为结构化轨迹上下文，其主要价值是长程事件时间支持，而非一致更强的端点判别、生存预测或因果解释。

Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can reveal disease-progression structure, while useful forecasting requires leakage-controlled discovery, censor-aware outcomes, and inspectable trajectory evidence. We developed a graph-enhanced framework in MIMIC-IV v3.1 that splits patients before graph construction, learns train-only consecutive-admission transitions, and freezes endpoint-specific branching-motif policies selected on validation data. The final catalog contained 99,527 motifs, and a time-aware Transformer retrieved at most 24 patient-compatible motifs per endpoint through endpoint-specific cross-attention. Across five training seeds, micro-AUPRC increased from 0.9330 to 0.9357, while event-time MAE decreased from 676.9 to 657.7 days (reduction 19.2 days; 95% paired patient-cluster bootstrap CI, 13.8-24.8). Timing effects were heterogeneous: MAE worsened for events within 730 days but improved by 58.9 days for events occurring after 730 days. In an exploratory internal temporal split, branch conditioning reduced conditional event-time MAE by 26.9 days (95% CI, 23.0-30.8) without evidence of better micro-AUPRC. Corrected survival evaluation over the supported 0-2,555-day interval did not establish macro C-index or integrated Brier score superiority over a matched history-only discrete-hazard model. A directed, degree-matched GNN repair substantially improved unseen-edge discovery, yet replacing GNN-derived scores within fixed motif identities did not improve downstream forecasting. These results position branching motifs as structured trajectory context whose main value is long-range timing support rather than uniformly stronger endpoint discrimination, survival prediction, or causal explanation.

</details>


### [547] [A Two-Level Clinical Novelty Prioritization Framework for Disease Trajectories Discovered from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20512)
*Jin-Jia Zheng,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两级框架，用于对已从MIMIC-IV中挖掘出的99,527个分支轨迹motif进行语义新颖性与临床优先级排序，强调"表征感知+不确定性感知+相对文献"的优先级评估，而非因果发现或临床裁定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图结构支持（graph-based structural support）能产生疾病轨迹目录，但结构支持并不等于语义新颖性；已有发现的轨迹需要一种能区分"结构上成立"与"语义上有意义/新颖"的优先级机制。

Method: 基于冻结的上游流水线（MIMIC-IV v3.1，患者不相交、仅训练集）挖掘的99,527个分支motif。框架分两级：路径级与节点-端点级的语义稀疏度，与经可靠性调整的临床优先级分离。每个motif或节点-目标对生成3种确定性文本化，用BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5嵌入，并以166,972篇2023年前PubMed文献的mean top-20余弦距离校准。进行了多种鲁棒性分析（邻居数、模板、编码器、通用标签分类、评分设置、PrimeKG、修正的密度型RND）。

Result: 正向重组出现在8.63%的motif中，对全局排序影响可忽略；特异性与支持/GNN可靠性项改变了临床优先级排序。语义剂量分析未支持评分与预测收益间的单调关系（每SD 1.96天; 95% CI, -0.75至4.68）。在冻结catalog-q90高语义子组中，分支增强预测将条件事件时间MAE降低20.1天（95% CI, 13.3-27.0），sMAPE降低2.37个百分点（95% CI, 1.81-2.93），但判别与端点排序差异不确定。修正RND与主评分尾部一致性低（Spearman rho=0.430; q90 Jaccard=0.125）。

Conclusion: 结果支持对已发现轨迹进行"表征感知、不确定性感知、相对文献"的优先级排序，而非将其视为因果发现或经临床医生裁定的新颖性。

Abstract: Graph-based analysis of electronic health records (EHRs) yields disease-trajectory catalogs, but structural support does not establish semantic novelty. We present a two-level framework to prioritize 99,527 branching motifs previously discovered by an upstream patient-disjoint, train-only MIMIC-IV v3.1 pipeline and frozen after validation-based catalog selection. The framework separates path-level and node-to-endpoint semantic sparsity from reliability-adjusted clinical priority. Three deterministic textualizations per motif or node-target pair were embedded with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and calibrated against 166,972 pre-2023 PubMed references using mean top-20 cosine distance. Positive recombination occurred in 8.63% of motifs and had negligible effect on global ranking, whereas specificity and support/GNN reliability terms changed clinical-priority ordering. Robustness analyses across neighbor counts, templates, encoders, generic-label taxonomies, score settings, PrimeKG, and corrected density-based RND showed that broad ordering was more stable than hard top-k membership. A semantic-dose analysis did not support a monotonic relation between score and forecasting benefit after endpoint and token-count adjustment (1.96 days per SD; 95% CI, -0.75 to 4.68). In the frozen catalog-q90 high-semantic subgroup, branch-enhanced forecasting reduced conditional event-time MAE by 20.1 days (95% CI, 13.3-27.0) and sMAPE by 2.37 percentage points (95% CI, 1.81-2.93), while discrimination and endpoint-ranking differences were inconclusive. Corrected RND showed low tail agreement with the primary score (Spearman rho = 0.430; q90 Jaccard = 0.125) despite a similar aggregate timing association. These findings support representation-aware, uncertainty-aware literature-relative prioritization of discovered trajectories rather than causal discovery or clinician-adjudicated novelty.

</details>


### [548] [One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20576)
*Artin Tajdini,Manpreet Kaur,Peng Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CIPR自监督目标，通过跨界面策略正则化提升LLM智能体对界面扰动的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练使LLM智能体能力绑定到训练所用界面，语义保持的界面扰动（如重命名动作、改符号）会导致性能下降；独立评分样本仅将依赖扩展到训练界面分布，仍无法应对分布外扰动。

Method: CIPR用无信息标识符替换动作名，将每个训练样本以两种界面呈现，其中等价动作按构造对应，惩罚两界面下动作分布间的KL散度，使策略在跨界面时保持一致。

Result: 在有监督和强化学习后训练中均提升鲁棒性；在智能体函数调用任务上，留出界面扰动使后训练智能体准确率下降近25%，CIPR恢复10.5%，同时不损害原界面准确率。

Conclusion: CIPR通过跨界面一致性正则化有效缓解界面绑定问题，提升智能体对界面扰动的泛化能力。

Abstract: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. We evaluate CIPR in both supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training, where it improves robustness. On agentic function calling, held-out interface perturbations reduce the accuracy of a post-trained agent by nearly 25%, and CIPR recovers 10.5% while leaving accuracy on the unchanged interface intact.

</details>


### [549] [Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20514)
*Saatvik Kher,Hyungrok Do,Judy Zhong,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线流式场景下的智能体选择问题，采用贝叶斯多臂老虎机与Thompson Sampling，在准确率与子群公平性之间进行权衡，并支持延迟反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分类器评估假设批处理设置，即每个智能体需对所有样本打标签，昂贵且不切实际，因此需要在线自适应选择智能体并更新策略。

Method: 将问题建模为贝叶斯多臂老虎机，使用Thompson Sampling，显式平衡预测性能与敏感属性的子群公平性，并处理真实标签的延迟观测。

Result: 在表格分类器、大语言模型和人类标注者等多类真实数据集上实验，相比基线显著降低后悔值；理论上给出了同时考虑准确率与公平性的所选智能体性能保证。

Conclusion: 该在线策略能在延迟反馈下有效选择兼顾准确率与公平性的智能体，并具备理论性能保障。

Abstract: Evaluations of classifiers (AI or human or agents) often assume a batch setting in which every agent produces labels on every example in a test set, which can be expensive or impractical in many contexts. This motivates online policies that adaptively select agents to query as examples arrive and update policies as outcomes are observed. We study the problem of selecting, in an online stream, the agent that best balances (i) predictive performance and (ii) subgroup fairness of a sensitive attribute, and that allows for delayed observations of true class labels. We formulate this as a Bayesian multi-armed bandit problem using Thompson Sampling, explicitly balancing accuracy and fairness. We conduct empirical evaluations on real-world datasets spanning problems involving tabular classifiers, large language models, and human labelers, demonstrating substantial reductions in regret relative to baselines. Our theoretical contributions include guarantees on the performance of the selected agent that incorporate both the accuracy and fairness aspects of the problem.

</details>


### [550] [The Physics Is the Network: Fast, Training-Free Neural Emulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20525)
*Luka Todorovic,Kaushal Gianchandani,Sai Ravela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyNet将多项式动力学的连续时间神经表示与用于离散时间积分的简单循环网络耦合，在系数已知时无需训练即可保持数值格式，实现高效GPU并行求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是避免传统神经仿真中"学习已知物理替代品"的需求，探索无需训练的神经化数值求解方案。

Method: 方法为构建PolyNet：连续时间多项式动力学神经表示 + 简单循环网络离散积分；在已知系数下形成无需训练的tensor graph。以1D KdV方程为例，与CPU/GPU有限差分Runge-Kutta求解器及三种训练神经模型（状态映射仿真器、物理信息预测器、学习趋势积分器）对比。

Result: 在解析孤子解参考下，跨网格分辨率、10^6色散尺度时间步、多达10^4轨迹的集合及不同初始振幅条件下，PolyNet精度与数值求解器相当，且可外推到训练条件之外；GPU吞吐率高，在测试分辨率范围内近似恒定，集成扩展性良好。

Conclusion: PolyNet证明了无需学习的神经仿真可兼具数值保真度与高效硬件执行，适合大规模并行与集合仿真。

Abstract: Neural emulation need not require learning a substitute for known physics. We investigate PolyNets that couple a continuous-time neural representation of polynomial dynamics with a simple recurrent network for discrete-time integration. When the governing coefficients are known, the resulting tensor graph requires no training and preserves the prescribed numerical scheme while enabling efficient hardware execution and parallel simulation. Using the one-dimensional Korteweg-de Vries equation, we compare PolyNet with CPU and GPU finite-difference Runge-Kutta solvers and three trained neural models: a state-map emulator, a physics-informed predictor, and a learned-tendency integrator. Analytical soliton solutions provide a reference for amplitude and phase errors across grid resolutions, 10^6 dispersively scaled time steps, ensembles of up to 10^4 trajectories, and varying initial amplitudes. PolyNet achieves accuracy comparable to the numerical solvers, including at amplitudes outside the learned models' training conditions. It combines this fidelity with high GPU throughput, approximately constant over the tested resolution range, and favorable ensemble scaling.

</details>


### [551] [Revisiting Simple Baselines for Relational Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20534)
*Viet The Nguyen,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Gunther Gust*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文重新审视简单传播方法在关系深度学习中（RDL）的有效性，提出用固定低通特征传播+MLP建模，并结合Correct-and-Smooth标签传播，在RelBench上取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RDL领域依赖复杂GNN和Transformer架构，但简单关系基线的效果被低估，难以判断达到强预测性能需要多大架构复杂度。作者观察到预测信号来自目标属性、关系属性和历史标签三方面。

Method: 将固定低通特征传播适配到关系实体图，训练MLP进行预测；再用Correct-and-Smooth（一种图标签传播算法）在任务特定meta-graph上利用历史标签精化预测结果。

Result: 在RelBench的分类与回归任务上，基于邻域过滤特征的MLP在多数任务上优于仅用目标实体特征的MLP，并恢复了异质GNN相当一部分性能；Correct-and-Smooth利用历史标签带来额外提升，但需单独构建meta-graph。

Conclusion: 研究重新验证了经典传播方法作为简单RDL基线的有效性，并指出规范化meta-graph构建是有效标签传播的关键挑战。

Abstract: Relational deep learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning end-to-end predictive models over relational databases by representing them as temporal heterogeneous graphs. Recent advances based on graph neural networks and Transformers have achieved strong performance across diverse domains. However, the effectiveness of simpler relational baselines remains underexplored, making it difficult to assess how much architectural complexity is needed to achieve strong predictive performance. Motivated by the observation that predictive signals arise from target attributes, relational attributes, and historical labels, we revisit how effectively these signals can be exploited using simple propagation methods. We adapt fixed low-pass feature propagation to relational entity graphs and train an MLP for prediction. The resulting predictions are further refined using Correct-and-Smooth, a graph-based label propagation algorithm that incorporates historical labels over task-specific meta-graphs connecting target entities. Across classification and regression tasks on RelBench, an MLP trained on neighborhood-filtered features outperforms one using only target-entity features on most tasks and recovers a substantial portion of the performance of heterogeneous GNNs. Correct-and-Smooth provides further gains from historical labels, although applying it requires a separately constructed meta-graph because connections among target entities are not directly specified by the relational entity graph. Together, our studies revisit the effectiveness of established propagation methods as simple RDL baselines while identifying canonical meta-graph construction as a key challenge for effective label propagation.

</details>


### [552] [Detection of Potato Plant Leaf Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20544)
*Haimanot Bitew Alemayehu,Simachew Melaku Ayalew,Chilotie Desalew Mengesha,Ayisheshim Almaw Bogale,Anteneh Birhan Yenew,Abrham Tegegne Bogale*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 开发轻量级CNN对马铃薯叶片进行分类（健康、早疫病、晚疫病），在PlantVillage与埃塞俄比亚田间数据集上验证，性能优于VGG16和MobileNetV2且更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 马铃薯是埃塞俄比亚重要的粮食安全作物，但受叶部病害（尤其早疫病和晚疫病）影响。需要一个计算高效的方案帮助小农户进行初步病害识别。

Method: 提出轻量级CNN，用PlantVillage的2,215张图像训练，在埃塞俄比亚Banja地区采集的247张独立田间图像上评估，并与VGG16、MobileNetV2在精度和计算效率上比较。

Result: PlantVillage上训练/验证/测试准确率分别为99.04%、98.21%、98.66%；田间数据集准确率90.28%。模型446,787个可训练参数，约1.70 MB，每轮训练5.58秒（VGG16为9.96秒，MobileNetV2为7.68秒）。

Conclusion: 紧凑CNN在马铃薯叶病分类上具潜力，凸显独立田间评估的重要性（田间图像条件比受控基准数据集更复杂多变）。该方法可支持埃塞俄比亚及类似农业环境中小农户的初步病害识别。

Abstract: Potato is an important food-security crop in Ethiopia, but its production is affected by foliar diseases, particularly early blight and late blight. This study develops a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify potato leaves into three categories: healthy, early blight, and late blight. The proposed model was trained using 2,215 images from the PlantVillage dataset and evaluated on an independent field dataset containing 247 images collected from potato farms in Banja, Awi Zone, Ethiopia. On PlantVillage, the model achieved 99.04% training accuracy, 98.21% validation accuracy, and 98.66% test accuracy. On the field dataset, it achieved 90.28% accuracy. The study also compares the proposed CNN with VGG16 and MobileNetV2 in terms of classification performance and computational efficiency. The proposed model contains 446,787 trainable parameters, occupies approximately 1.70 MB, and requires an average of 5.58 seconds per training epoch in the reported experimental setup, compared with 9.96 seconds for VGG16 and 7.68 seconds for MobileNetV2. The results demonstrate the potential of a compact CNN for potato leaf disease classification and highlight the importance of independent field evaluation, where image conditions are more variable than in controlled benchmark datasets. The proposed approach may support preliminary disease identification for smallholder farmers in Ethiopia and similar agricultural settings.

</details>


### [553] [Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20572)
*Kaixiang Zhao,Tianrun Yu,Shangzhe Li,Yuxiao Yang,Amanda Hughes,Weitong Zhang,Taylor W. Killian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CriticOPD，通过让教师对错误轨迹进行批判并让学生据此改写，恢复 on-policy distillation 中教师对错误前缀的可恢复性，从而提升学生数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD 假设教师能从学生写出的任意前缀给出正确答案（可恢复性），但该假设在错误轨迹上失效：教师虽能识别错误，却会跟随学生的错误继续推理。

Method: CriticOPD 利用错误识别来恢复可恢复性：教师对错误轨迹进行批判，学生依据批判重写解答；含批判的特权信息输出由教师评分，而学生训练时仅使用不含批判的修订版本。

Result: 在两个 Qwen3 学生模型和六个数学推理基准上，CriticOPD 均优于 OPD，且在竞赛类问题上增益最大。

Conclusion: 通过引入教师批判与改写机制，CriticOPD 有效解决了 OPD 在错误轨迹上可恢复性缺失的问题，显著提升推理性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.

</details>


### [554] [Continuum Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20586)
*Afshin Khadangi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Continuum Attention (CA)，用连续分段线性记忆曲线上的积分替代离散 key/value 查找，实现精确归一化注意力并保持二次复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 注意力依赖离散 key/value 查找，作者希望探索连续积分作为注意力机制的替代方案。

Method: 每个 query 沿分段线性记忆曲线诱导指数相关性密度，通过对密度积分与插值 value 求得闭式指数矩归一化注意力（含半 token 边界贡献）；梯度由至多二阶矩解析计算，支持并行 GPU 实现，保持二次序列复杂度与标准解码器结构。

Result: 相比普通 softmax 与 focal attention，验证集负对数似然分别平均降低 0.0200 和 0.0480 nats/byte，在所有配对比较中胜出；额外独立验证切片上比最强 softmax 基线优 0.0457 nats/byte（配对 95% 置信区间）。

Conclusion: 连续积分是有前景的注意力替代方向，但更大规模的泛化性仍待验证。

Abstract: We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve. Each query induces an exponential relevance density along the curve. Integrating the density and interpolated values yields exact normalized attention from closed form exponential moments, including half token boundary contributions. The gradients follow analytically from moments of order at most two, enabling parallel GPU implementations while retaining quadratic sequence complexity and the standard Transformer decoder. Compared with ordinary softmax and focal attention, CA reduces mean validation negative log likelihood by 0.0200 and 0.0480 nats per byte, respectively, winning all paired comparisons. An additional disjoint validation slice yields a 0.0457 nats per byte advantage over the strongest selected softmax baseline, with a paired 95% confidence interval. These findings motivate continuous integration as a promising attention alternative while leaving larger scale generalization open.

</details>


### [555] [Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20588)
*Walter Simoncini,Dheeraj Varghese,Gertjan J. Burghouts,Cees G. M. Snoek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需重训练的方法，将预训练Transformer弹性化为单一模型，可在线适配多种计算预算，将MLP神经元与注意力头在共同尺度上联合重要性排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型族只提供固定尺寸（如S/B/L），用户受硬件和延迟约束被迫选择特定模型，在变化查询负载下往往次优，缺乏灵活性。

Method: 对功能单元排序问题做可微松弛：不同于以往对每个MLP块或注意力头只优化单一重要性权重，本方法在共同尺度下联合排序每个MLP神经元和注意力头，通过在多个稀疏目标下同时最小化软剪枝后的损失来完成。

Result: 在27个视觉和文本Transformer编码器（22M至8B参数）上，稀疏度至60%仍平滑退化，深度剪枝优于一次性基线。DINOv3 ViT-H+/16剪至50%稀疏度移除427M参数，ImageNet-1k线性探测精度仅降0.8%，无需权重校正或重训练；60%稀疏度下AugReg ViT-B/16在A100上吞吐提升至1.80倍、单查询延迟降低1.26倍。构建仅需数分钟，时间随参数量亚线性增长。

Conclusion: 该弹性化方法以分钟级构建、免重训练方式，产出可在连续计算预算间动态适配的单一模型，显著提升部署灵活性且性能损失小。

Abstract: Scaling up transformers has produced models with broad capabilities, deployed across heterogeneous hardware and fluctuating workloads. Yet, model families offer only a few fixed sizes (e.g., S, B, L), forcing users to commit to a model based on hardware and latency constraints. This rigidity is often suboptimal under varying query loads. We introduce a retraining-free method that elastifies pre-trained transformers into a single model that adapts on-the-fly across a continuum of computational budgets. Our key contribution is a differentiable relaxation of the functional unit-ranking problem: unlike prior work, which optimizes a single importance weight per MLP block or attention head, we rank every individual MLP neuron and attention head jointly, on a common scale, by minimizing the model's loss under soft pruning across many sparsity targets, all at once. Across 27 vision and text transformer encoders ranging from 22M to 8B parameters, our method yields smooth degradation up to 60% sparsity and outperforms one-shot baselines under deep pruning. For example, pruning DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 to 50% sparsity removes 427M parameters while reducing ImageNet-1k linear-probing accuracy by only 0.8%, without the need for weight correction or retraining. At 60% sparsity, a pruned AugReg ViT-B/16 model achieves up to $1.80\times$ higher throughput and $1.26\times$ lower single-query latency on an A100 GPU. Elastic models are produced in minutes, with construction time scaling sub-linearly with parameter count.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [556] [AdaFrame: Hierarchical Multimodal Deduplication with Adaptive Information Budgeting for Cost-Efficient Video Advertisement Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19127)
*Abdul Basit Tonmoy,Arman Luthra,Guang Lin,Qixin Deng*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: AdaFrame是一种内容自适应预处理级联方法，通过三层滤波器（感知哈希、LPIPS、CLIP语义聚类）去除冗余帧，并利用ISD确定每视频帧预算，以降低VLM视频分析成本同时保持提取精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀帧采样会导致VLM多模态骨干网络处理大量冗余内容，而现有keyframe选择方法多为人类观看优化，非下游提取精度优化。

Method: 提出AdaFrame预处理级联：三级递进滤波器（感知哈希、LPIPS、CLIP语义聚类）在昂贵的跨模态推理前剔除冗余帧；并用ISD（通过帧嵌入奇异值分解估计视频语义复杂度）确定每个视频的帧预算。

Result: 在Pitt Ads Dataset的500个视频广告上，帧数减少48%，VLM推理成本降低75%；topic准确率86.0%（+1.6pp），sentiment准确率79.4%（+7.5pp）。

Conclusion: AdaFrame在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了VLM视频分析的下游准确率，验证了内容自适应预处理的有效性。

Abstract: Uniform frame sampling for vision-language model (VLM)-based video analysis often floods multimodal backbones with redundant content, while existing keyframe selection methods are typically optimized for human viewing rather than downstream extraction accuracy. We propose AdaFrame, a content-adaptive preprocessing cascade that reduces visual redundancy without sacrificing extraction fidelity. Three progressively finer filters, perceptual hashing, learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS), and CLIP-based semantic clustering, efficiently eliminate redundant frames before costly cross-modal inference. Per-video frame budgets are determined using Intrinsic Semantic Dimensionality (ISD), which estimates each video's semantic complexity through singular value decomposition of its frame embeddings. Experiments on 500 video advertisements from the Pitt Ads Dataset show that AdaFrame reduces the frame count by 48 percent and VLM inference cost by 75 percent compared with uniform sampling, while achieving 86.0 percent topic accuracy, an improvement of 1.6 percentage points, and 79.4 percent sentiment accuracy, an improvement of 7.5 percentage points.

</details>


### [557] [Shared Sentiment Evidence from Frozen Multimodal Models for Continuous Sentiment Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19981)
*Shuobo Wang,Ruiqi Chen,Shaobo Qiao,Shixu Yang,Feng Xu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出共享情感证据(SSE)输出空间接口，用冻结骨干、固定视图与情感选项语义生成28维向量，经CatBoost回归实现连续多模态情感分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续多模态情感分析需从可能冲突的语言、声学、视觉线索估计极性与强度。硬判断压缩了情感备选信息，而习得式融合接口将任务适应绑定于模型表示，缺乏可复用性。

Method: SSE为固定视图与情感选项语义的输出空间接口。用四个查询在冻结骨干上产生五选项分布，由其概率、熵与跨视图关系构成28维向量，输入CatBoost回归。用匹配的Ridge与CatBoost对照评估额外视图、确定性摘要与非线性读出贡献，并在多个冻结骨干上按同一接口规范独立拟合。

Result: 在CH-SIMS-v2与CMU-MOSI上，基于Qwen的接口优于仅监督联合读出；在另外三个冻结骨干上，同接口与固定读出设置下独立拟合的头也优于仅联合预测。

Conclusion: 结果表明可从可复用的输出坐标中学习连续情感，验证了输出空间接口设计的有效性。

Abstract: Continuous multimodal sentiment analysis estimates polarity and intensity from linguistic, acoustic, and visual cues that may disagree. Hard judgments compress sentiment alternatives, while learned fusion interfaces tie task adaptation to model representations. We introduce Shared Sentiment Evidence (SSE), an output-space interface with fixed view and sentiment-option semantics across frozen backbones. Four queries yield five-option distributions whose probabilities, entropy, and cross-view relations form a 28-dimensional vector for CatBoost regression. On CH-SIMS-v2 and CMU-MOSI, the Qwen-based interface improves on supervised joint-only readout. Matched Ridge and CatBoost controls assess the contributions of additional views, deterministic summaries, and nonlinear readout. With the same interface specification and fixed readout settings, separately fitted heads also improve on joint-only prediction for three additional frozen backbones. These results support learning continuous sentiment from reusable output coordinates.

</details>


### [558] [Lluna: Collaborative Unimodal Models for Missing-Modality Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20526)
*Haoyue Bai,Yinyi Luo,Heqing Huang,Xiaoyuan Yi,James Evans,Jindong Wang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 论文研究模态缺失下预训练单模态模型的协作问题，发现协作增益会随输入缺失而衰减甚至反转，提出Lluna方法，在八个数据集上取得最佳平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练单模态模型通过协作可进行多模态预测，但当模态缺失时，这种协作甚至不如保留下来的单个单模态模型准确。以固定的存活模型为锚点，发现即使锚点输入不变，协作增益也会随其他输入消失而减弱或反转。诊断还揭示聚合后模态特有信息恢复减少，协作表征依赖状态。

Method: 提出Lluna，结合从适配单模态特征出发的直接私有预测路径，以及提供残差修正的公共图协作分支。通过渐进式协作一致性（Progressive Collaboration Consistency），沿单模态移除方向组织由丰到贫的指导，对齐归一化公共表征，同时用任务监督使预测适配可用证据。

Result: 在涵盖情感计算、场景理解与医学预测的八个数据集上，Lluna在非完整输入状态下取得最佳平均性能，Mean-Missing平均比最强基线提升4.26%。固定锚点诊断在全部八个任务的最小输入下均显示正向的平均协作增益。

Conclusion: Lluna能有效缓解模态缺失导致的协作性能下降，在多种任务上优于现有基线，代码已开源。

Abstract: Pretrained unimodal models offer a flexible route to multimodal prediction through collaboration, but this collaboration can become less accurate than a surviving unimodal model when modalities are missing. We study this setting using fixed surviving-model anchors and find that collaborative gains can weaken or reverse as inputs disappear, even when the anchor's own input is unchanged. Our diagnostics further reveal reduced recovery of modality-specific information after aggregation and state-dependent collaborative representations. We propose Lluna, which combines a direct private prediction path from adapted unimodal features with a common graph-based collaboration branch that provides a residual correction. Progressive Collaboration Consistency organizes richer-to-poorer guidance along single-modality removals, aligning normalized common representations while task supervision adapts predictions to the available evidence. Across eight datasets spanning affective computing, scene understanding, and medical prediction, Lluna achieves the best evaluated average performance over non-full input states, improving Mean-Missing by 4.26\% on average relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. The fixed-anchor diagnostic also shows positive gains in mean collaboration under minimal inputs on all eight tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/Lluna.

</details>


### [559] [Frame Rate, Not the Grid: A Confound in Single-Clip Optical ENF Video Forensics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20549)
*Ryan Wyton,Bacha Rehman*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 单片段视频中的电网频率（ENF）取证受相机帧率混叠干扰，恢复出的电网频率由帧率而非供电决定，导致真伪视频无法区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ENF被广泛用于验证视频拍摄地点及检测伪造/生成视频，但作者指出单短片段读取电网频率存在被忽视的取证隐患：相机帧率谐波与真实闪烁落入同一窄带，此混叠的取证后果此前未被研究。

Method: 理论分析帧率谐波与真实闪烁的窄带混叠机制；在804个有可测带内谱线的片段上评测闪烁特征对真伪视频的区分能力；通过受控合成实验对照真实电网的真值验证机制；并提出感知梳状（comb-aware）估计器建模帧率谐波。

Result: 闪烁特征无法区分真实与生成视频（AUC=0.509）；生成视频恢复出的电网频率与帧率完全一致；受控合成证实了机制；comb-aware估计器在受控条件下恢复了真实电网与帧率梳状谱的区分。

Conclusion: 在常用帧率下单片段电网频率及区域识别不可靠，估计器会给出高置信度而非弃权；需采用感知梳状的估计器来区分真实电网与帧率谐波。

Abstract: The optical electric network frequency, the faint mains-driven flicker imprinted on rolling-shutter video, is increasingly proposed for verifying where footage was captured and for flagging manipulated or generated video. This letter shows that reading the mains frequency from a single short clip is confounded by the camera frame rate: at the rates in common use, a harmonic of that rate lands in the same narrow band as the true flicker, so the recovered grid is set by the frame rate, not the supply, and the estimator returns a confident value instead of abstaining. The underlying aliasing is known; its forensic consequence is not, and is the contribution here. On the 804 clips with a measurable in-band line the flicker feature does not separate genuine from generated video (area under the curve 0.509), while the recovered grid tracks the frame rate exactly for the generators, and a controlled synthesis confirms the mechanism against ground truth for genuine grids. Single-clip grid, and hence region, identification is therefore unreliable at the standard rates, and a comb-aware estimator that models the frame-rate harmonics restores the distinction between a genuine grid and a frame-rate comb under controlled conditions.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [560] [A Systematic Study of Deprecated Android API Usage Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19150)
*Tarek Mahmud,Meiru Che,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统研究Android废弃API及其替代方案，基于1000个废弃API和4336个迁移实例归纳出六类迁移模式和更新模式，并用其指导LLM提示，在GUPPY基准上提升了正确更新数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Android API持续演进导致废弃API需要迁移，但现有自动化迁移技术受限于API变化的多样性和上下文复杂性，效果有限。

Method: 分析GitHub上1000个废弃API和4336个迁移示例，归纳六种迁移类别及涉及版本检查、参数适配、对象初始化、数据类型转换和交互机制变化的复现更新模式；将这些模式加入GUPPY零样本提示。

Result: 在156个基准任务上，模式引导提示将正确更新从139提升到147，并在六个类别中的五个表现更优。

Conclusion: 基于真实迁移模式的知识可有效增强LLM对Android废弃API迁移的表现，为自动化迁移提供可行方向。

Abstract: Android Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) continuously evolve, causing existing APIs to become deprecated and requiring developers to migrate their usages to recommended replacements. Although prior studies have proposed automated migration techniques, their effectiveness is often limited by the diversity and contextual complexity of API changes. This paper presents a systematic study of deprecated Android APIs, their recommended replacements, and real-world usage updates performed by developers. Based on an analysis of 1,000 deprecated APIs and 4,336 migration examples collected from GitHub, we identify six migration categories and derive recurring usage-update patterns involving Android-version checks, parameter adaptation, object initialization, data-type conversion, and changes in API interaction mechanisms. To assess their applicability, we augment the zero-shot GUPPY benchmark prompts with the migration category and corresponding usage-update pattern. On 156 benchmark tasks, the pattern-guided prompt improves correct updates from 139 to 147 and performs better in five of the six categories.

</details>


### [561] [DivAlgo: A systematic evaluation of algorithmic diversity for code generation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19157)
*Anubhav Jangra,Smaranda Muresan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出DivAlgo基准和轻量相似度指标，评估代码生成模型的算法多样性，发现模型生成代码多样性远低于人类方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM广泛用于代码生成，但其生成算法多样性的能力尚不清楚，需要量化评估。

Method: 构建大规模DivAlgo数据集（包含编程问题的多样算法解），并提出轻量级相似度指标用于大规模评估；对24个现代代码生成模型进行实验。

Result: 无控制模型生成代码多样性仅为人类的约31%；最佳多样性策略也仅达约70%。虽可引导模型按人类策略生成，但无法复现人类解的多样性。

Conclusion: 代码生成模型在捕捉人类算法多样性方面存在局限，过度接触模型生成代码可能缩小程序员的算法词汇。

Abstract: Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings. However, the competence of large language models (LLMs) to generate algorithmically diverse code remains largely unknown. We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems. We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation. Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity. Moreover, while it was possible to steer the models to generate solutions based on human strategies, they were unable to reproduce the diversity of the human solutions. These findings indicate the limitations of code generation models in capturing the algorithmic diversity humans exhibit, and that overexposure to model-generated code can narrow programmers' algorithmic vocabulary.

</details>


### [562] [Beyond Functional Correctness: Static Code Quality Profiling of LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19167)
*Jue Huang,Tarek Mahmud,Meiru Che,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文对LiveCodeBench中73个LLM生成的65,663个Python程序进行大规模静态质量剖析，发现仅用通过率评估代码质量不够，模型间在可维护性和可靠性上存在系统性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM代码生成评估多聚焦于基准测试套件的通过率（功能正确性），但测试往往不完整，通过测试并不代表代码可维护、可靠或结构良好。

Method: 使用Pylint、Radon、SonarQube等静态分析工具，对LiveCodeBench中73个模型生成的65,663个Python程序进行大规模静态质量剖析，重点关注可维护性与可靠性。

Result: 模型间存在无法由正确性解释的系统性差异，可维护性是最显著的差异来源；正确性往往伴随结构性权衡，而非统一带来更简洁的解决方案。

Conclusion: 研究结果呼吁建立超越通过率的评估框架，以更全面地衡量LLM生成代码的质量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet most evaluations still focus on whether generated code passes benchmark test suites. Functional correctness alone, however, provides only a limited view of quality: benchmark tests are often incomplete, and passing them does not guarantee that code is maintainable, reliable, or well-structured. This paper {presents a large-scale static quality profiling of} LLM-generated Python code, with a focus on maintainability and reliability. Using 65{,}663 programs from 73 models in LiveCodeBench, we evaluate generated code with established static analysis tools, including Pylint, Radon, and SonarQube. Our results show systematic differences across models that are not captured by correctness alone, with maintainability emerging as the clearest source of variation. We further find that correctness often comes with structural trade-offs rather than uniformly simpler solutions. Overall, our findings motivate evaluation frameworks that assess LLM-generated code beyond pass rates alone.

</details>


### [563] [OS-Bench: Evaluating SWE Agents on Cross-OS Code Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19368)
*Qirui Jin,Kenan Li,Liao Zhu,Lingching Tung,Yikai Zhang,Yijia Wu,Zijian Jin,Pengfei Gao,Yu Kang,Qingwei Lin,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OS-Bench：首个跨操作系统（Linux↔Windows）代码迁移的可执行基准，含140个任务，最佳模型成功率仅26.4%/20.4%，揭示跨OS迁移是困难且未被充分探索的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级SWE基准虽覆盖广泛开发任务，但对“将现有实现从一个OS迁移到另一个OS且保持双系统行为一致”这一常见又技术独特的挑战洞察不足。跨平台特性常先在一个系统实现、后补另一系统，因此需要专门的评测基准。

Method: 提出OS-Bench：用同一仓库在Linux和Windows上收集的执行覆盖率对比来识别迁移机会；验证平台特定代码区域，归纳为5类迁移场景，转化为带目标平台测试与源平台回归测试的仓库级任务；最终含来自111个仓库、5种语言（C/C++/C#/Go/Rust）的140个任务（91个Win→Linux，49个Linux→Win）；用SWE-agent、Claude Code、OpenHands、Win-agent评测6个模型。

Result: 最佳配置在Linux目标任务上成功率仅26.4%，Windows目标任务20.4%，且需保持双系统正确性。

Conclusion: 跨OS迁移是极具挑战且研究不足的能力，OS-Bench可作为改进平台感知SWE智能体的测试平台。

Abstract: Language-model (LM) agents are increasingly evaluated on repository-level software engineering (SWE) benchmarks derived from GitHub issues and pull requests. Although these benchmarks cover a broad range of development tasks, they provide limited insight into a common yet technically distinct challenge: migrating an existing implementation from one operating system (OS) to another while preserving behavior on both. We introduce OS-Bench, an executable benchmark for cross-OS code migration between Linux and Windows. Motivated by case studies showing that cross-platform features are frequently implemented on one OS before support is added for another, OS-Bench identifies migration opportunities by comparing execution coverage collected from the same repository on both systems. Platform-specific regions are then verified, organized into five migration scenarios, and transformed into repository-level tasks with target-platform tests and source-platform regression tests. The resulting benchmark contains 140 validated tasks from 111 repositories across C, C++, C#, Go, and Rust, comprising 91 Windows-to-Linux and 49 Linux-to-Windows migrations. We evaluate six models with SWE-agent, Claude Code, OpenHands, and Win-agent. The best configurations achieve only 26.4% success on Linux-target tasks and 20.4% on Windows-target tasks while preserving correctness across both systems. These results indicate that cross-OS migration is a challenging and underexplored capability, and OS-Bench is a testbed for improving platform-aware SWE agents.

</details>


### [564] [BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19447)
*Di Wu,Xu He,Shu Wang,Kun Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出BenchChecker，通过取证式两阶段检测识别APR基准中的数据污染，并在多个基准和模型上验证了检测有效性及其对评测结果的显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM自动程序修复（APR）基准存在数据污染问题：测试样本出现在训练集中，导致性能被虚高。需要一种更可信的评测方法来检测此类污染。

Method: BenchChecker兼容开源与闭源模型，仅用文本模型输出和公开仓库历史。基于持久性补丁可能保留在训练所用近期仓库快照中的观察，采用取证式两阶段检测：第一阶段通过代码前缀探测模型推断训练包含情况（仓库存在性测试）；第二阶段通过相似度对齐与测试套件验证进行补丁存在性测试。

Result: 在基于The Stack v2训练的StarCoder-15B、StarCoder2-15B和CodeGen2-16B上评测，BenchChecker在六个基准上实现约0.9的AUC。应用于SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench时，过滤污染样本使多数LLM在中等难度任务上的报告解决率相对原值下降超过20%。

Conclusion: BenchChecker能有效检测APR基准中的数据污染，揭示现有评测性能被高估，为更可信的评测提供支持。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCoder2-15B, and CodeGen2-16B trained on The Stack v2 demonstrate that BenchChecker achieves robust detection with AUC scores around 0.9 across six benchmarks. Furthermore, applying BenchChecker to SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench reveals that filtering contaminated samples reduces the reported resolution rates of most LLMs by more than 20% relative to the original rates on medium-difficulty tasks.

</details>


### [565] [JevCoder: When Does Decision Delegation Pay Off in Code Repair?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19596)
*Jiahao Zhang,Yifan Zhang,Yu Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出低成本概率判断器Jev及围绕其构建的修复工作流JevCoder，在减少token消耗的同时保持/提升修复质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
