Motivation: 编码智能体修复代码时反复决策，这些决策影响修复轨迹与后续请求的token成本。作者探究哪些修复决策可委托给低成本概率判断器，以降低token使用同时维持修复质量。

Method: 判断器以预定义答案的概率形式作答、不生成解释。作者跨修复阶段评估判断质量，测试单次干预如何改变后续修复工作，并与无判断器（unguided）的修复以及用修复模型自身作为判断器的同一工作流对比。基于此提出JevCoder：结合代码片段推荐与动作类型指导，并用判断结果决定何时提交。

Result: 在3个修复模型、同一组400个任务（SWE-bench Verified 200个、SWE-Bench Pro Verified 200个）上评估。相比无判断器修复，JevCoder将平均修复模型token使用降低21.6%-50.6%，且三个模型的修复率均更高。

Conclusion: 干预的收益取决于其改变了多少工作量，而非判断本身的成本；低成本概率判断器可有效委托部分修复决策，实现token节省与修复质量提升的双赢。

Abstract: A coding agent repeatedly makes decisions as it repairs code. These decisions shape repair trajectories and affect the token cost of successive model requests. We ask which repair decisions can be delegated to a low-cost probabilistic judge to reduce token use while maintaining repair quality. The judges answer questions with probabilities over predefined answers, without generating explanations. We evaluate judgment quality across repair stages and test how individual interventions change subsequent repair work. We compare these interventions with unguided repair, which uses no judge, and with the same workflow using the repair model itself as the judge. The benefit depends on the work an intervention changes, rather than the cost of the judgment alone. Based on these studies, we propose JevCoder, a workflow built around Jev, a low-cost probabilistic judge. It combines code-snippet recommendations with action-type guidance and uses judgments to determine when to submit. We evaluate three repair models, each on the same 400 tasks: 200 from SWE-bench Verified and 200 from SWE-Bench Pro Verified. Compared to unguided repair, JevCoder reduces mean repair-model token use by 21.6%-50.6%, with higher observed repair rates across all three models.

</details>


### [566] [When Does the Dependency Graph Help Code-to-Architecture Mapping?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19769)
*Rakhshanda Jabeen,Morgan Ericsson,Jonas Nordqvist,Anna Wingkvist*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文将代码到架构映射建模为有向多关系依赖图上的半监督节点分类任务，用图神经网络自动补全文件与架构模块的映射，从而缓解架构技术债。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统实现偏离预期模块分解会产生架构技术债，而源文件与架构模块之间的映射往往缺失、不完整或人工维护成本高，因此需要自动化方法恢复这种映射。

Method: 以文件为节点、类型化依赖为边，结合代码标识符和目录结构得到的词法特征，构建有向多关系依赖图；从少量标注样本出发，用迭代自训练扩展到其余文件。对比 GCN、GAT 与无图 MLP（特征和训练流程相同），并以 Naive Bayes 为基线。

Result: 在十个开源 Java 和 C/C++ 系统上各运行 100 次，三种神经模型在两项 F1 指标上均优于基线。GAT 取得最高的系统级中位数 macro-F1 和 micro-F1，分别为 83.5 和 92.2；MLP 在若干系统上仍有竞争力甚至更优。在最大的 Chrome（18,343 个文件）上，GAT 和 GCN 的 macro-F1 分别比 MLP 高 22 和 19 个点，且持续错分文件显著更少。连通性和同质性可解释神经消息传递的优势，多关系聚合在两个模型、所有系统上均优于合并单一关系边。

Conclusion: 图神经网络可有效支持代码到架构映射，尤其在大型系统上优势明显；但部分模型排名依赖训练随机种子，较小优势需谨慎解读，而 Chrome 上的大规模图收益保持稳健。

Abstract: Architectural technical debt arises when a system's implementation drifts from its inten ded modular decomposition, while the mapping between source files and architectural modu les is missing, incomplete, or costly to maintain manually. We formulate code-to-archite cture mapping as semi-supervised node classification over a directed multi-relational de pendency graph, with files as nodes, typed dependencies as edges, and lexical features d erived from code identifiers and directory layout. Starting from a small labeled sample,
  an iterative self-training procedure expands the mapping to the remaining files. We com pare a graph convolutional network (GCN), a graph attention network (GAT), and a graph-f ree multi-layer perceptron (MLP), using identical features and training procedures for t he learned models, against a Naive Bayes reference. Across 100 runs on ten open-source J ava and C/C++ systems, all three neural models outperform the reference on both F1 metri cs. GAT achieves the highest averages of system-level median macro and micro F1, at 83.5
  and 92.2, respectively, whereas MLP remains competitive or superior on several systems.
  On Chrome, the largest system with 18,343 files, GAT and GCN exceed MLP by 22 and 19 ma cro-F1 points, respectively, and have substantially fewer persistently misclassified fil es. Connectivity and homophily are associated with where neural message passing helps, w hile multi-relational aggregation outperforms a single merged edge type on every system for both GCN and GAT. A follow-up study finds that several model rankings depend on the training seed, qualifying smaller advantages without removing the large graph benefit ob served on Chrome.

</details>


### [567] [Systematic Detection of Energy Regressions in Software Version Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19895)
*Jérôme Maquoi,François Bechet,Luís Cruz,Benoît Vanderose,Xavier Devroey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 EnergyTrackr，一种在多次提交中检测能源回归的方法，并在 5 个 Java 项目的 1,932 个提交上评估了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绿色软件工程日益重要，但缺乏在提交级别自动、有效地识别能源回归的方法，尤其是基于统计显著性能源变化进行自动检测的研究较少。

Method: 在 5 个 Java 项目的 1,932 个提交上对 EnergyTrackr 进行实证评估，并对比线性算法（分析整个提交历史）与更高效的对分搜索算法。

Result: EnergyTrackr 能有效识别提交间显著的能源变化；对分算法在揭示整体软件能源趋势方面与线性方法效果相当，同时降低了资源消耗和处理时间。

Conclusion: EnergyTrackr 有望帮助开发者准确监控项目中的能源回归和改进，并优化源代码以降低软件能耗。

Abstract: Context: Green software engineering is emerging as a crucial response to the rising energy impact of information technology, especially in continuous development. However, challenges remain in devising automated methods to efficiently identify energy regressions across commits. In particular, little effort has been put into automatically detecting regressions at the commit level by identifying statistically significant changes in energy consumption. Objectives: This paper presents EnergyTrackr, an approach for detecting energy regressions across multiple commits. Methods: We empirically evaluated EnergyTrackr on 1,932 commits from five Java projects, assessing its ability to identify significant energy changes. We also compared a straightforward linear algorithm that analyzes the entire commit history with a more efficient dichotomous search algorithm. Results: The evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness of EnergyTrackr in identifying significant energy changes across commits. Our findings highlight the efficiency of the dichotomous algorithm in uncovering overall software energy trends, achieving results comparable to the linear approach while reducing resource consumption and processing time. Conclusion: We expect EnergyTrackr to help developers accurately monitor energy regressions and improvements in their projects and optimize their source code to reduce software energy consumption.

</details>


### [568] [Taming the Online Software Engineering Tongue: Detecting and Reducing Offensive Language in Software Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19961)
*Jithin Cheriyan,Bastin Tony Roy Savarimuthu,Stephen Cranefield*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究调查在线软件工程社区中攻击性语言的普遍性与性质，基于13万条评论构建检测分类模型并提出可解释的攻击性语言减少系统OLRS-SE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线软件工程社区（如Stack Overflow）存在粗鲁和冒犯性评论，损害参与者情感健康，使社区变得不友好和充满敌意，因此需要研究并减少攻击性语言。

Method: 收集Stack Overflow、GitHub、Gitter和Slack四个平台13万条用户评论，开发六组共72个机器学习模型（传统与深度学习），主要采用BERT进行多种分类任务，并开发两个基于语言的模型将攻击性评论改写为非攻击性评论。

Result: 最佳模型F1分数在0.56至0.94之间，平均F1为0.85；通过30名参与者用户研究评估，系统易于使用且能有效减少攻击性语言。

Conclusion: OLRS-SE系统能检测、分类并向发帖者解释评论为何具有攻击性，同时提供非攻击性替代建议，整体有效；未来可探索不同大语言模型在攻击性语言减少方面的能力。

Abstract: Online Software Engineering (SE) communities such as Stack Overflow have become unwelcoming and hostile spaces, as evidenced by the presence of rude and offensive comments that are detrimental to the emotional wellbeing of participants. The main objective of this work is to investigate the prevalence and nature of offensive language in online SE communities, and develop approaches to classify them with the ultimate goal of reducing offensive language by proposing an Offensive Language Reduction System (OLRSSE) that has the ability to detect, classify, and explain to the poster why a comment is offensive and also propose non-offensive alternative suggestions. Using data from 130,000 user comments on discussions held in four prominent SE platforms: Stack Overflow, GitHub, Gitter and Slack, we developed six sets of twelve (72 in total) different machine learning models (both traditional and deep learning). The F1-Score of the best performing models in the system ranges from 0.56 to 0.94, with an average F1-Score of 0.85, predominantly using BERT as the primary model for various classification tasks. Also, two language-based models were developed for paraphrasing offensive to non-offensive comments. The overall utility of the OLRS-SE was evaluated using user studies with 30 participants, which showed that the developed system is easy to use and also effective in reducing offensive language. Investigating the capabilities of different large language models for offensive language reduction is a promising avenue for future research.

</details>


### [569] [Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Code Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19970)
*Alex Wolf,Pooja Rani,Harald C. Gall*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 TAFT（时序自适应微调），把仓库演化本身当作监督信号，解决代码库级问答模型随代码演化而失配的问题，在四个维度上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级代码理解问答支持开发者推理跨代码库分布的功能与用法，但仓库专用 LLM 会随代码演化而失配。该挑战被定义为"时序仓库自适应"，需同时完成四件事：获取新知识、抑制过时知识、保留仍有效知识、保持语义邻近知识。现有检索、微调、模型编辑方法只能覆盖其中一部分。

Method: TAFT 将仓库转变（repository transitions）作为监督信号：从仓库转变中构造时序接地（temporally grounded）的 QA 数据；通过偏好优化将新有效知识与过时知识配对；并回放以转变条件为条件的保留样本，以维持仍有效知识。基于增强的时序 SWE-bench 数据集评估，含 10 个时序切片、255,295 条 QA；对比延迟式（Baseline）、逐切片重训（Baseline-Batched）及带知识锚点的变体，从更新知识、过时答案抑制、保留、邻近稳定性四维度衡量。

Result: TAFT 稳定优于延迟式与批处理基线：更新/抑制知识准确率平均相对提升 18%，保留准确率翻倍，邻近准确率约为 1.5 倍。直接提供知识锚点时，TAFT-KANT 在平均更新/抑制、保留、邻近准确率上分别再提升 3.55%、8.35%、13.00%。

Conclusion: TAFT 在所有评估维度上均有效，能够使代码理解问答与仓库演化保持对齐。

Abstract: Repository-level code comprehension question answering (QA) supports developer reasoning over functionality and usage distributed across codebases. However, repository-specialized large language models (LLMs) can become misaligned as code evolves. We study this challenge as temporal repository adaptation: acquiring new knowledge, suppressing obsolete, retaining still-valid, and preserving semantically neighboring knowledge. Existing retrieval, fine-tuning, and model-editing methods address only parts of this problem. We propose Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning (TAFT), a novel adaptation approach that treats repository transitions as supervision. TAFT derives temporally grounded QA data from repository transitions, pairs newly valid with obsolete knowledge through preference optimization, and replays transition-conditioned retention examples to preserve still-valid knowledge. We evaluate TAFT on an augmented temporal SWE-bench dataset comprising 255,295 QA entries across ten temporal slices, comparing deferred (Baseline), per-slice retrained (Baseline-Batched), and variants with knowledge anchors along four dimensions: updated knowledge, obsolete-answer suppression, retention, and neighbor stability. TAFT consistently outperforms both the deferred and batched baselines, with an average relative improvement of 18% in updated/suppressed knowledge accuracy, doubled retention accuracy, and roughly 1.5 times the neighbor accuracy. With directly supplied knowledge anchors, TAFT-KANT further improves mean updated/suppressed, retention, and neighbor accuracy over TAFT by 3.55%, 8.35%, and 13.00%, respectively. Overall, TAFT demonstrates its effectiveness across all evaluated areas, effectively enabling code comprehension QA alignment with repository evolution.

</details>


### [570] [LintEval: Benchmarking LLMs on Linter-Guided File Refactoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20027)
*Tongwei Deng,Jinyu Zhu,Yue Cao,Chenxu Wang,Yanzhen Zou,Bing Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 LintEval，一个跨 C++、Python、Java 的多语言基准，用于评估模型在保持功能前提下减少源码中 lint 告警的重构能力，包含 13,061 个程序和 171,662 条 lint 告警，并发现模型存在功能保持与告警减少间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码基准未明确评估“lint 引导的文件重构”能力，即模型需在保持正确初始功能的同时减少源文件中的 lint 告警。因此需要一个专门的基准来系统衡量此类能力。

Method: 构建 LintEval 多语言基准，覆盖 C++、Python、Java，包含 13,061 个具有正确初始功能的程序和 171,662 条由语言专用 linter 提取的告警。该基准联合评估四项指标：功能保持、lint 告警减少、新告警规避和编辑最小性。此外进行了监督微调（SFT）对照研究。

Result: 实验显示持续存在的权衡：闭源商用模型 Reduction@P 最高达 90.4%，但 Pass@1 仅 67.1%–68.3%；部分开源小模型 Reduction@P 很低甚至为负。微调研究显示监督格式很关键：面向重构的 SFT 将 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 的 Reduction@P 从 24.7% 提升到 76.0%。

Conclusion: LintEval 能够对在保持功能前提下改进源文件的模型进行受控评估，揭示了当前模型在功能保持与 lint 告警减少间的显著权衡，并表明重构导向的微调监督对提升该能力十分有效。

Abstract: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low or negative Reduction@P. A controlled fine-tuning study further shows that supervision format matters: refactoring-oriented SFT raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Reduction@P from 24.7% to 76.0%. LintEval enables controlled evaluation of models that improve source files under functionality preservation.

</details>


### [571] [SWE-Nexus: Automated Composition of Software Engineering Tasks from Test Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20038)
*Songwei Yu,Ziqi Miao,Jingxuan Xu,Junhao Fan,Haoyang Huang,Yuan Xiong,Zihang Xu,Weihao Li,Wenqiang Zhu,Yuechen Luo,Xinshun Feng,Yanan Wu,Ken Deng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SWE-Nexus是一个全自动流水线，通过测试执行构建仓库级实现任务，包含600个任务（跨105个仓库、6种语言），最佳配置一次成功率达37.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史代码变更提供任务边界，但无法识别测试所测的生产函数，也难以组合单个变更之外的已验证行为。

Method: 四个构建智能体选择测试、适配各仓库的追踪与评估协议并生成行为规格。对每个测试文件追踪生产函数体的执行足迹；仅当原始仓库中所有预期评分点通过且遮蔽追踪到的函数体导致至少一个失败/错误时保留该scope。兼容scope确定性组合，共享函数只计一次，并在完整组合遮蔽下重新验证每个测试文件。

Result: 基准含600个任务、105个仓库、6种编程语言，包括116个原子任务和484个组合任务。在三种智能体框架下评估12个模型，最佳配置一次尝试解决37.8%任务，scope加权评分衡量部分恢复。

Conclusion: SWE-Nexus能够从经过验证的行为构建任务，超越单个历史变更，实现仓库级实现任务自动化构建。

Abstract: Historical code changes provide convenient task boundaries, but do not identify which production functions selected tests exercise or support composing validated behaviors beyond a single change. We present SWE-Nexus, a fully automated pipeline that constructs repository-level implementation tasks from test execution. Four construction agents select tests, adapt tracing and evaluation protocols to each repository, and generate behavioral specifications. For each selected test file, tracing records an observed execution footprint of production function bodies. A scope is retained only if all expected scoring points pass in the original repository and masking the traced bodies causes at least one failure or error. Compatible scopes are composed deterministically, with shared functions counted once and every constituent test file revalidated under the complete combined mask. The benchmark contains 600 tasks from 105 repositories across six programming languages, including 116 atomic and 484 composite tasks. We evaluate 12 models under three agent scaffolds. The best configuration resolves 37.8% of tasks in one attempt, and scope-weighted scoring measures partial recovery. SWE-Nexus enables task construction from validated behavior beyond individual historical changes.

</details>


### [572] [The Code of Theseus: Can Agents Rebuild Software from Recovered Design Documents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20068)
*Cezar Sas,Sandra Mitrović,Fabio Barth,Georg Rehm,Matteo Salani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出从代码仓库的紧凑表示中恢复对齐的利益相关者意图、需求与架构的框架，构建了10,764个仓库的数据集，并通过"忒修斯之船"实验证明这些制品能传递测试无法捕捉的设计信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent日益需要"先设计后实现"，但训练和评估数据多聚焦于实现与测试，需求与设计文档常缺失、过时或私有；源代码虽丰富，但已有架构恢复方法会饱和上下文、难以扩展且只产出单一制品。

Method: 提出从紧凑仓库表示（静态依赖图和关键上下文文件）中恢复对齐的意图、需求和架构的框架；利用LLM评判三个生成器的制品；设计"软件忒修斯之船"实验：编码agent仅凭意图或加上恢复的需求与架构、仅给定接口契约和部分测试，重建29个Commit0库。

Result: 恢复的制品被评为清晰且内部一致，但正确性和抽象层次可靠性较低；制品未显著改变留出通过率（33.7% vs 35.8%），但显著使重建模块结构更接近原始（模块F1从0.54升至0.63），在两种生成器及简洁制品下均成立。

Conclusion: 恢复的制品能传递测试未能捕捉的设计，为"先设计后实现"的agent提供可扩展的设计级数据来源，且往返实验无需人工参考即可衡量这一效果。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly design a system before implementing it, yet the data to train and evaluate them centres on implementation and testing: requirements and design artefacts are often missing, outdated or private. Source code, in contrast, is abundant. Prior work recovers architecture documentation by feeding LLMs the source code or letting agents explore it, which saturates the context, does not scale to many repositories, and yields a single artefact rather than aligned ones.
  We present a framework that recovers aligned stakeholder intent, requirements and architecture from a compact repository representation, a static dependency graph and key contextual files, and release the artefacts of 10,764 Java, Python, C/C++ and C# repositories as a dataset. An LLM judge rates the artefacts of three generators as clear and internally consistent, but less reliably correct and at the right level of abstraction.
  To test whether the artefacts carry the design, we pose a software Ship of Theseus: a coding agent rebuilds 29 Commit0 libraries from the intent alone or with the recovered requirements and architecture, given only an interface contract and part of the tests. The artefacts do not significantly change the held-out pass rate (33.7% vs. 35.8%), but bring the rebuilt module structure significantly closer to the original (module F1 from 0.54 to 0.63), with either generator and even with concise artefacts.
  Recovered artefacts thus convey design that tests do not capture, offering a scalable source of design-level data for agents that design before they implement, and the round trip measures this without human references.

</details>


### [573] [SWE-Stream: Scaling Executable Training Data for SWE Agents via Progressive Construction and Elastic Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20193)
*Chengyang Liu,Wen Yang,Shifeng Chen,Delai Qiu,Ji Yang,Junnan Zhu,Yining Wang,Shengping Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SWE-Stream 通过渐进式构建与弹性流式执行，从开发历史中大规模生成可运行 SWE 训练任务，并显著提升训练效果与数据构建效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE 智能体训练受限于高质量可执行任务稀缺；开发历史虽含信号，但因环境不完整、测试缺失和产物不一致，难以直接用于任务构建。

Method: 提出 SWE-Stream：渐进式验证与精炼任务候选，尽量复用已有产物、必要时定向补全；并用弹性调度器异步协调构建阶段，在共享资源约束下根据负载调整执行预算。

Result: 基于 10,728 个仓库、6 种编程语言的开发历史，构建 80,874 个验证任务并收集 118,688 条成功轨迹。微调 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 后在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual、Pro 上分别达 69.0%、49.3%、45.42%。预算近似匹配下，Verified 达 45.6%，优于三种现有数据源；流式构建吞吐为批处理的 1.45 倍，且比固定限额流式多接受 13.2% 任务。

Conclusion: SWE-Stream 能有效扩展可执行 SWE 训练数据，在性能与构建效率上均优于现有方案，为 SWE 智能体训练提供可扩展的数据生成路径。

Abstract: Software engineering agents have advanced rapidly, but scaling their training remains constrained by the limited availability of high-quality executable tasks. Development histories contain valuable signals for constructing such tasks, yet they often require substantial reconstruction due to incomplete environments, missing tests, and inconsistent artifacts. We present SWE-Stream, a system for scaling executable SWE training data through progressive construction and elastic streaming execution. SWE-Stream progressively validates and refines task candidates, reusing existing artifacts when possible and applying targeted completion only when necessary. An elastic scheduler asynchronously coordinates construction stages under shared resource constraints, adapting execution budgets based on observed workload demands. Using development histories from 10,728 repositories across six programming languages, SWE-Stream constructs 80,874 validated tasks and collects 118,688 successful trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 on these trajectories achieves resolve rates of 69.0%, 49.3%, and 45.42% on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, respectively. In a controlled comparison with approximately matched training budgets, SWE-Stream achieves a 45.6% resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming three existing data sources. Moreover, its streaming construction strategy improves efficiency, delivering $1.45\times$ the accepted-task throughput of batch construction and accepting 13.2% more tasks than fixed-limit streaming.

</details>


### [574] [Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20344)
*Yuyao Ge,Shenghua Liu,Peizhong Gao,Chendi Ge,Chenxu Liu,Yiwei Wang,Lingrui Mei,Baolong Bi,Jiayu Yao,Jiafeng Guo,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 Doc2Harness，首个针对长时程 harness 工程（智能体框架搭建）的确定性基准，通过两阶段流程直接评测模型构建 harness 的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅在固定 harness 下测量下游任务成功率，忽视了对 harness 工程本身的探索，而智能体表现很大程度取决于模型之外的 harness。

Method: 两阶段：Stage 1 构建模型在固定 builder harness 中，依据仅含接口的契约骨架和整合十二个前沿 harness 行为的开发文档，在隔离容器中构建候选 harness；Stage 2 冻结候选 harness，按测试用例分容器运行，由脚本化 mock 模型端到端驱动，通过四个可观测通道（发往模型的请求、磁盘文件、进程退出码、命令输出）打分，并用正控制排除空洞通过。

Result: 19 个前沿模型各独立构建 3 次、共 328 个测试用例；GPT-6 Astra 通过率最高 53.05%，最弱 27.44%，差距约 26 个百分点。最强模型仍失败近半测试，失败集中于跨领域功能在模块间的拆分方式。

Conclusion: Doc2Harness 是首个确定性测量长时程 harness 工程的基准，揭示该任务仍是前沿模型的显著挑战。

Abstract: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.

</details>


### [575] [What Should a Software Team Spend on Agents? Simulation-Based Cost Optimization of Mixed AI-Human Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20394)
*Steffen Herbold*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过随机过程建模与仿真，研究人类开发者与AI代理混合团队的最优成本配置，发现逃逸缺陷是主要成本来源，AI能力比价格更关键，且不存在通用预算或团队结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理在软件开发中快速普及，但令牌成本不断上升，团队不清楚应在代理上花费多少、投资于哪些任务。

Method: 将含八种角色的人机混合团队建模为离散时间随机过程，涵盖缺陷注入与检测、技术债务、人类对代理的监督及带功能冻结的发布周期；用蒙特卡洛模拟和演化搜索，在432种场景下寻找成本最优团队，并与纯人类基线对比。

Result: 逃逸缺陷是主导成本驱动因素，61%的代理预算用于找缺陷；代理能力比令牌价格更重要；能力强代理团队中人类主要修缺陷、代理负责新功能实现；高能力代理团队通常比纯人类团队便宜，低能力代理无明显优势；实际开发速度下最优团队对开发者的支出仍高于代理。

Conclusion: 不存在普适的每开发者令牌预算或代理团队结构；与传​​统开发一样，最优成本-质量权衡取决于多种因素，需针对项目情境定制团队。

Abstract: Context: AI agents are rapidly adopted in software development, but their token costs are rising and it is unclear how much a team should spend on agents, and on which tasks.
  Objective: We determine how teams should divide spending between human developers and AI agents to deliver the features a project demands at the lowest total cost.
  Method: We model mixed teams of human developers and AI agents with eight specialized roles as a discrete-time stochastic process covering bug injection and detection, technical debt, human supervision of agents, and release cycles with feature freezes. Using Monte Carlo simulation and evolutionary search, we determine cost-optimal teams for 432 scenarios varying developer capability, project velocity, debt dynamics, agent capability and price, and bug costs, and compare them with a human-only baseline.
  Results: Escaped bugs are the dominant cost driver, and 61% of the agent budget goes to finding bugs. Agent capability matters more than token price, since higher-quality outputs reduce downstream quality assurance costs. In teams with capable agents, human developers mostly fix bugs and leave the implementation of new features to the agents. Teams with high-capability agents are typically cheaper than human-only teams, but low-capability agents offer no consistent advantage. At realistic velocities, the optimal teams still spend more on developers than on agents.
  Conclusions: There is neither a universal token budget per developer nor a universal agentic team structure. As in traditional development, this depends on many factors and teams need to be carefully tailored to the project context to achieve the optimal cost-quality trade-off.

</details>

### [576] [Design and Analysis of Temporal Representations in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19730)
*Alban Colas-Gattepaille,Alexandre Muzy*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文提出"时间表征程度"概念，将神经网络从非时间表征到完全时间表征形成连续谱，并通过实验证明提高时间表征程度可同时改善性能与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物神经网络的高效与学习能力常被认为源于其时间信息表征能力，这推动了脉冲神经网络的发展。然而，时间信息在神经网络中究竟如何表征，以及不同时间表征形式如何影响性能与计算效率，仍不清楚。

Method: 提出"时间表征程度"的概念，依据网络的激活、学习、编码与解码函数是否显式将时间作为计算变量，构建从非时间到完全时间的连续谱。在固定深度架构下，对比不同编码、激活机制与解码方式：人工神经网络中的非时间加权和激活、脉冲神经网络中的非时间二值脉冲激活、延迟神经网络中的基于脉冲时间的激活。

Result: 在事件型数据集上的实验表明，提高时间表征程度可同时提升性能与计算效率，并在 Google Speech Commands 数据集上达到当前最优性能。分析还揭示时间表征会引发不同的前向与反向计算轨迹，使梯度显式依赖于事件时间的历史。

Conclusion: 时间表征程度是理解神经网络性能与效率的重要视角，显式操作时间变量能带来性能与效率的双重提升，并改变反向传播中梯度的性质。

Abstract: The ability to represent temporal information is often hypothesized to underlie the efficiency and learning capabilities of biological neural networks. This motivates the development of spiking neural networks. However, it remains unclear how temporal information is actually represented in neural networks and how different forms of temporal representation affect performance and computational efficiency. We introduce the notion of the degree of temporal representation of a neural network, defined by whether its constituent functions (activation, learning, encoding, and decoding) explicitly manipulate time as a computational variable. This perspective yields a continuum ranging from non-temporal representations, where time does not explicitly appear as a computational variable in the network functions, to fully temporal representations, where computations explicitly operate on temporal variables. Using a fixed deep architecture, we compare different encoding, activation mechanisms and decoding with increasing temporal expressiveness: non-temporal weighted-sum activations used in usual artificial neural networks, non-temporal binary spiking activations used in spiking neural networks, and spike-time-based activations used in delay neural networks. Experiments on event-based datasets show that increasing the degree of temporal representation improves both performance and computational efficiency, allowing state-of-the-art performances on the Google Speech Commands dataset. We further analyze how temporal representations induce distinct forward and backward computational trajectories, leading to gradients that depend explicitly on the history of event times.

</details>


### [577] [Controlling the latency in temporal coded spiking models for neuromorphic datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19732)
*Alban Gattepaille,Alexandre Muzy*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文研究Delay Neural Networks (DeNN)，即直接计算神经元脉冲时间（绕过膜电位与阈值机制）的模型。作者提出解析控制其延迟的方法，并在动态时序数据集上实证研究延迟-准确率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带有强时间依赖的数据集（如语音关键词识别）中，如何利用脉冲模型挖掘时间信息仍是开放问题。TTFS编码与突触延迟是有前景的框架，但多数TTFS模型未在含时间信息的数据集上测试，其延迟（正确分类所需时间）表现鲜为人知。

Method: 基于TTFS框架，研究DeNN模型——直接计算神经元脉冲时间，跳过膜电位与阈值机制；提出对其延迟进行解析控制的方法，并在动态时序数据集上实证评估延迟-准确率权衡。

Result: 实现了对DeNN延迟的解析控制，并在动态时序数据集上展示了延迟与准确率之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 研究表明DeNN可通过解析方式控制延迟，并通过实验揭示了时序数据集上延迟与准确率的权衡，为TTFS框架在时间依赖任务中的应用提供了依据。

Abstract: Exploiting temporal information in datasets with high temporal dependencies (such as spoken keyword recognition) by spiking models is still an open problem. Promising frameworks include Time-To-First coding (TTFS) and the inclusion of synaptic delays into learning. In TTFS, neurons are forced to spike at most once, forcing the network to found its learning on the spiking times of neurons rather than their spiking rate. Some models use the TTFS framework to directly compute the spiking time of Integrate-and-Fire (IF) or Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons. However, most models built in the TTFS framework have not been tested against datasets containing temporal information. Little is known about the latency of these models on temporal datasets, where the latency is the time taken by the network to correctly classify a sample. In this work, we study the behaviour of Delay Neural Networks (DeNN) models, i.e. models that directly compute the spiking time of neurons by bypassing the membrane potential and thresholding mechanisms of spiking neurons. We show how to analytically control their latency, and empirically study the latency-accuracy tradeoff in a dynamic temporal dataset.

</details>
